nodes.brief: In the draughty corridor of the rope storehouse, you run your fingers over a thick three-strand tow-line, feeling the stiff tar coat your skin with a sticky residue.

exits.label: Wrap the stiff tow-line

nodes.title: The Heavy Tow-Line
nodes.page: Heavy tar coats your bare skin with a sticky, dark residue as you stroke the rigid fibers of a three-strand tow-line running through the draughty corridor of the rope storehouse. This massive cable could haul an ox down the cliff face, but its sheer bulk threatens to slow your pace before you even reach the first stair-town. The bronze Clapper hums against your shoulder blades, urging you toward a lighter path while the cold stone walls sweat moisture into the dim air.

nodes.brief: By the iron weighing scale near the ledger desk, the guild master demands your thumbprint on a parchment scroll before he will hand over the coiled hemp.

exits.label: Press your thumb to parchment
Step away from the ledger
Offer coin instead of a mark

nodes.title: The Ledger Desk
nodes.page: Ink wells bubble slightly in the freezing draft beside the iron weighing scale, where the guild master taps a parchment scroll with an impatient fingernail. Your thumb hovers over the damp ink pad, required to seal an agreement before a single foot of hemp passes into your pack. The mountain silence presses down hard on the rafters, broken only by the distant, mournful chime of a high tower bell answering the wind.

nodes.brief: Under the arched rafters of the rope-loft, you weigh your own frayed backup rope against the stiff, new fibers of the official guild stock while the clock chimes softly.

exits.label: Choose the familiar backup rope
Swap for the official stock

nodes.title: The Loft Rafters
nodes.page: Rafters creak overhead in the dim rope-loft as the clock chimes a slow, metallic hour into the freezing dusk. You compare your own travel-worn backup rope against the stiff, pale perfection of the official guild stock hanging from iron pegs. One is familiar and soft with use, while the other gleams with untried strength and the rigid guarantee of makers who never leave the mountain top.

nodes.brief: At the heavy oak wicket of the cable court office, a toll-lord watches you hesitate between taking the free municipal twine and signing away your rights for a guild line.

exits.label: Claim the free municipal twine

nodes.title: The Cable Wicket
nodes.page: Oak wood splinters slightly under your grip at the heavy wicket of the cable court office, where a toll-lord watches your hesitation with calculating, hooded eyes. Free municipal twine sits in a dusty barrel by the door, contrasting sharply with the fine, branded guild lines locked behind the iron grating. Every choice here carries a toll, whether paid in coin, freedom, or the watchful malice of men who own the ropes.

nodes.brief: On the frosty threshold of the cordage hall, you sign the guild ledger with a cold iron nib, binding your journey to the makers' strict terms and heavy penalties.

exits.label: Press on

nodes.title: The Guild Ledger
nodes.page: Cold iron scratches against parchment on the frosty threshold of the cordage hall as you sign away a portion of your freedom in exchange for certified strength. The guild master nods once, face carved from old habit and winter shadows, then shoves the coil into your arms. Strict terms bind the road ahead now, and penalties wait if you break them, along with the unbroken trust of the makers who forge the vertical world's lifelines.

nodes.brief: Beside the stacked coils of tarred hemp, you reject the guild's formal seal and toss your own worn, trusty rope over your shoulder with a quiet sigh of defiance.

exits.label: Press on

nodes.title: The Worn Rope
nodes.page: Tarred hemp coils lie forgotten as you toss your own battered, trusty rope over your shoulder with a sharp, defiant breath that mists in the freezing air. You reject the guild's formal seal and its endless rolls of parchment, trusting instead the frayed spots you have patched yourself through many seasons on the cliff. Against your back the bronze Clapper sits easier now that no ink-stained master holds a claim on your journey.

nodes.brief: Under the lintel of the rope-master's lodge, you bargain for a mid-tier coil of braided flax, paying half your remaining coppers to avoid the guild's more burdensome clauses.

exits.label: Press on

nodes.title: The Mid-Tier Flax
nodes.page: Flax fibers feel smooth and golden beneath your fingertips under the lintel of the rope-master's lodge, purchased with half your remaining coppers to keep the tax-collectors at bay. This mid-tier coil steers a middle course between the costly tyranny of the guild and the dangerous fraying of the municipal barrel. You loop the balanced length securely over your pack, ready to face the ninety steps with a clear conscience and a lighter purse.

nodes.brief: Near the iron winch at the lower exit, you knot a length of unbranded line around your waist, trusting your own knots rather than the fine print of the cable lords.

exits.label: Press on

nodes.title: The Unbranded Line
nodes.page: Iron winches grind somewhere below in the lower courtyard as you knot a length of unbranded line securely around your waist, testing every hitch with practiced fingers. Trusting your own knots feels safer than deciphering the hidden clauses and cruel terms tucked inside the cable lords' ledgers. The wind howls up through the stone stairwell, carrying the smell of snow and the distant, silver call of the lower bells.

nodes.brief: At the damp limestone arch, Elder Corin checks the hemp seal of your chosen Guild line against the biting gales.

exits.label: Step toward the narrow stone ledge
Follow the steep ramp of frozen timber
Take the sheltered switchback behind the granary

nodes.title: The Limestone Arch
nodes.page: Elder Corin checks the hemp seal of your chosen Guild line against the biting gales that howl through the monastery gates. Frost beads on his wool spectacles while he knots the official yellow marker into your harness. The bronze clapper ticks against your shoulder blades with every shift of the mountain wind. Three paths diverge beyond the gatehouse porch, each leading down into the gray cloud sea.

nodes.brief: In the shadowed mule yard, Biscuit tests the oiled canvas hitch while Master Hesketh inspects your bronze load.

exits.label: Lead Biscuit down the main mule path
Take the steep stone stairs to the left
Veer toward the lower freight winch

nodes.title: The Shadowed Mule Yard
nodes.page: Biscuit tests the oiled canvas hitch with a stubborn nudge of his gray muzzle while Master Hesketh inspects your bronze load for any sign of shifting. The mule's breath plumes white against the frost-covered slate walls of the stable. Every strap is taut, and the heavy iron rings gleam with fresh grease against the cold. Three separate tracks lead out from the courtyard gates into the gathering squall.

nodes.brief: Beside the frost-rimed horse trough, Miller Bran offers salted barley bread before you cross the ridge.

exits.label: Traverse the narrow ice-shelf above the abyss
Descend toward the drafty salt-porch
Head past the frozen sheep-fold into the fog

nodes.title: The Frost-Rimed Trough
nodes.page: Beside the frozen horse trough, Miller Bran offers a hard crust of salted barley bread to help steady your nerves before you cross the ridge. Wind rattles the icicles hanging from the horse-block, and Orison's broken shell sends a faint knock through the rock beneath your boots. Three distinct routes open before you through the swirling sleet.

nodes.brief: Under the creaking sign of the Nine Knots, Sola weaves a spare splice into your harness straps.

exits.label: Present your travel token at the guard-post
Press onward into the glare
Inspect the apprentice buckets near the conduit

nodes.title: The Nine Knots
nodes.page: Sola draws the waxed hemp tight between her calloused fingers, knotting an extra hitch into your shoulder straps under the creaking sign of the Nine Knots. The air smells of tar and dry juniper from the cordage bins lining the alley. With a final yank that tests the salt-cured fibers against your collarbone, she steps back and nods toward the outbound paths winding down the frozen limestone ridge. You hitch the bronze Clapper higher, feel its familiar note travel your spine, and look to your next step.

nodes.brief: Near the winch-house wall, a cable-lord named Garrow measures your packs with greedy, calculating eyes.

exits.label: Negotiate the cable toll
Slip past the winch-house unseen
Take the steep goat-track down

nodes.title: The Cable-Lord's Ledger
nodes.page: Garrow leans his heavy wool-wrapped bulk against the winch-house wall, measuring your laden packs with greedy, calculating eyes that miss nothing. His hand taps rhythmically against a leather toll-ledger tucked beneath his arm, hinting at the steep tariffs levied on every ounce of bronze leaving Orisonhold. The iron drums behind him groan as a cable-car descends into the white void below, spitting frosty grease onto the flagstones.

nodes.brief: Behind the drying rack of sheepskins, young Marta thrusts an extra pair of tallow mittens into your pocket.

exits.label: Inspect the collapsed retaining wall
Step out onto the exposed shelf
Head toward the high conduit

nodes.title: The Drying Rack
nodes.page: Young Marta darts out from behind the rattling sheepskin racks, her cheeks wind-chapped and glowing, and thrusts an extra pair of thick tallow mittens directly into your pocket. The sheepskins smell of lanolin and peat smoke, offering a brief, warm sanctuary against the rising mountain gale. She points a mittened finger toward the crumbling masonry ahead, whispering a quick caution about the loose shale near the lower buttress before scurrying back to her frames. You pull the rough wool snug over your knuckles and steady your grip on the straps.

nodes.brief: At the outer buttress, a pair of fog-wardens warns you of loose shale blocking the lower stone-cut.

exits.label: Descend the guarded stone-cut
Test the rope-slack guide-line
Seek shelter near St. Jude's shrine

nodes.title: The Outer Buttress
nodes.page: Two fog-wardens lean heavily on their long brass-tipped staves beside the outer buttress, their faces half-hidden behind grey wool hoods. They lift a gloved hand to warn you of treacherous shale sliding across the lower stone-cut in the bitter wind. A distant horn sounds faintly through the swirling mist from the cable-station below, signaling the shift change of the cable-riders. You shift the bronze Clapper on your back, testing your footing on the grit-strewn flagstones before committing to the descent.

nodes.brief: Over the high stone stile, the grey monastery wall ends and the sheer vertical drop begins.

exits.label: Cross the frozen rill with care
Warm your hands by the lime kiln

nodes.title: The High Stile
nodes.page: The grey monastery wall abruptly ends at the high stone stile, leaving nothing between your boots and the sheer vertical drop of the thirteen tiers. A thin rill of meltwater crosses the path, frozen into a slick sheet of black ice that glints coldly in the pale alpine light. Far below, the cloud sea churns in the valley like an ocean of milk, swallowing the upper stair-towns whole. You brace the heavy bronze load against your shoulder blades and prepare to cross the threshold into the open descent.

nodes.brief: On the narrow ice-shelf above the mule track, a stray pebble rattles down into the white abyss.

exits.label: Walk toward the upper winch station
Pick a path past the falling icicles

nodes.title: The Ice Shelf
nodes.page: Frost glazes the narrow ledge where you stand, making every placement of your boots a quiet negotiation with gravity. A stray pebble breaks loose beneath your heel, rattling down into the white abyss of the lower tiers until its sound swallows entirely into the cloud layer. The padded cradle on your back shifts its bronze load and reminds you of the long miles waiting below.

nodes.brief: Within the drafty salt-porch, Brann the cooper points out a hairline fracture in your wooden cradle frame.

exits.label: Wait while the cooper secures the frame
Leave quickly and head for the upper winches

nodes.title: The Salt-Porch Fracture
nodes.page: Bitter drafts whistle through the wooden slats of the salt-porch, smelling of dried brine and old timber. Brann the cooper peers closely at your burden, his scarred thumb tracing a hairline fracture across the wooden cradle frame that holds the great Clapper. A replacement stave might hold, but every minute spent here lets the mountain cold sink deeper into your bones.

nodes.brief: By the frozen sheep-fold, an old drover named Orvyn warns of sudden updrafts lifting heavy burdens.

exits.label: Count coins with the toll-clerk inside
Talk with the shepherd by the cliff face

nodes.title: The Frozen Fold
nodes.page: Wind howls around the drystone walls of the frozen sheep-fold, carrying the sharp scent of wet wool and melting rime. An old drover named Orvyn leans on his crook, squints up at the ragged gray clouds, and warns you that sudden updrafts can snatch a pack right off a traveler's shoulders. Along your spine the bronze tongue answers the gale with a low note.

nodes.brief: Under the swinging iron lantern of the guard-post, Joran demands your toll-token with a gruff nod.

exits.label: Show the token and pass the guard

nodes.title: The Iron Lantern
nodes.page: Shadows flicker wildly under the swinging iron lantern of the guard-post as sleet begins to pit the frozen mud. Joran stands square in the doorway, his leather gauntlets crossed over his chest, demanding your toll-token with a gruff, practiced nod. Biscuit snorts behind you, breath pluming white in the freezing air against the dark stone.

nodes.brief: Against the cliff face, the wind hums a thin chord through the bronze Clapper on your aching back.

exits.label: Rest near the shepherd by the overhang
Push onward past the rusted iron crane
Take the reckless way

nodes.title: The Singing Bronze
nodes.page: Solid granite presses against your shoulder while the mountain wind finds the mouth of the bronze Clapper on your back, drawing a thin, singing chord from the heavy metal. Your spine aches under the sheer dead weight, and the temptation to rush the descent before the weather closes in entirely pulls at your judgment.

nodes.brief: Past the frozen fountain, a nervous apprentice drops his tallow bucket down the deep stone chimney.

exits.label: Descent the steep slate steps carefully
Follow the path toward the rusted iron crane

nodes.title: The Stone Chimney
nodes.page: Ice rimes the edges of the frozen fountain where a nervous apprentice has just dropped his tallow bucket down the deep stone ventilation chimney with a hollow clatter. Below your boots, the slate steps drop away into gray obscurity, slick with rime and shadowed by the high monastery walls.

nodes.brief: At the narrow switchback known as Devil's Knee, Biscuit plants all four hooves against the ice.

exits.label: Ask the old shepherd for assistance
Lead the stubborn beast toward the gray mist

nodes.title: Devil's Knee
nodes.page: Black ice coats the narrow switchback known as Devil's Knee, and Biscuit has planted all four hooves firmly against the frozen rock, refusing to take another inch. As the wind surges around the corner, the bronze Clapper knocks a warning against your shoulder blades.

nodes.brief: Inside the damp salt-store, weaver Jessa hands over a spare hemp length before you cross the ridge.

exits.label: Head toward the three winds crossroads
Inspect the weathered boundary stone alcove

nodes.title: The Damp Salt-Store
nodes.page: Scent of wet hemp and old brine fills the damp salt-store where weaver Jessa presses an extra length of cord into your hands before you face the open ridge. Outside, the wind scours the frozen flags, threatening to catch anyone unanchored.

nodes.brief: Beneath the dripping icicles of the high conduit, a rook bursts from the masonry with a harsh cry.

exits.label: Stop briefly by the old boundary stone
Approach the low lintel of the guard-shelter

nodes.title: The High Conduit
nodes.page: Dripping icicles shatter against the frozen masonry of the high conduit as a startled rook bursts from the stonework with a harsh, barking cry. Your boots crunch over frozen gravel, echoing sharply in the thin, cold air between the buttressed walls.

nodes.brief: On the exposed limestone shelf, flying sleet stings your cheeks as you steady the shifting Clapper.

exits.label: Hold fast near the swinging handrail
Run across the frosted wooden landing

nodes.title: The Limestone Shelf
nodes.page: Driving sleet stings your cheeks on the exposed limestone shelf, forcing you to lean forward and steady the shifting Clapper against your spine. Beside you, the wooden handrail of the Ninety Steps groans and swings wildly in the fierce mountain gust.

nodes.brief: Beside the collapsed retaining wall, mason Toval stacks wet slate to mend the crumbling pathway.

exits.label: Step past the guard shelter
Approach the salt cistern barrels
Cross toward the wire bridge

nodes.title: The Mason's Wall
nodes.page: Wet slate clinks against wet slate as mason Toval builds up the crumbling path, his calloused fingers ignoring the chill of the stones. He stops to wipe mortar from his brow and eyes the bronze clapper lashed to your back, offering a sympathetic grimace. The mountain wind funnels through the gap, rattling the loose tools at his belt.

nodes.brief: Through the swirling white squall, the distant bronze bell-tower of Orisonhold chimes a muffled noon.

exits.label: Navigate the frosted landing steps
Head toward the wire bridge

nodes.title: Noon Through The Squall
nodes.page:
A heavy, muffled bronze toll rolls out from the distant bell-tower of Orisonhold, cutting through the swirling white squall like a blunt stroke of lead. Ice crystals cling to your eyelashes as you squint against the gale and hitch the clapper on your spine to keep balance on the slick flagstones. The mist swallows the stone parapet just a few paces ahead.

You can either push forward through the blinding flurry or seek shelter near the span.

nodes.brief: At the rope-slack turn, a frayed guide-line whips across your knuckles like a cold iron wire.

exits.label: Pass the sleeping sentinel
Check the cooper's barrels

nodes.title: The Frayed Guide-Line
nodes.page: A sudden slackening of the tension whips the guide-line across your knuckles, stinging like a lash of cold iron wire. You draw your hand back sharply, tucking it inside your woolen sleeve while you steady the swinging mass of the clapper against your ribs. The wooden framework of the walkway groans under the relentless pressure of the gale.

nodes.brief: Within the sheltered niche of St. Jude's shrine, a tallow candle guttered out moments before your arrival.

exits.label: Cross the abyss bridge
Speak with the weaver
Descend the frozen stair turn

nodes.title: St. Jude's Niche
nodes.page:
The wick of the tallow candle within St. Jude's sheltered stone niche still curls a thin wisp of grey smoke into the frigid air, having guttered out only moments before your arrival. You pause in its meager lee to catch your breath, listening to the faint, continuous hum of the bronze clapper against your shoulder blades. The stone floor of the shrine is powdered with fine drift-snow.

You can continue across the chasm, inspect the weaver's tally, or descend the frozen stair turn.

nodes.brief: Over the frozen rill, your left boot slips on black ice, throwing the heavy bronze load askew.

exits.label: Head for the buttress shadow
Navigate the frozen stair turn

nodes.title: The Black Ice Slip
nodes.page:
Your left boot catches hard on a sheet of invisible black ice over the frozen rill, throwing your whole body and the bronze load dangerously askew. You windmill your arms to recover your balance, your heels grinding into the frost until you finally steady yourself against the rock face. The metallic hum inside the cradle shifts to a sharper, higher pitch.

You can either move toward the buttress shadow or negotiate the icy stair turn.

nodes.brief: Near the abandoned lime kiln, local gatherer Ruda offers hot pine tea from a battered tin flask.

exits.label: Turn down the stone stair

nodes.title: The Lime Kiln Flask
nodes.page:
A plume of steam rises from the battered tin flask that local gatherer Ruda shoves cheerfully into your mittened hands, offering a draught of hot, biting pine tea. Warmth works into the cramp in your shoulders where the clapper straps bite through your coat. She points a gloved finger down toward the shadowed descent before returning to her baskets of dried moss.

You can take the path around the bend toward the stair turn.

nodes.brief: At the upper winch station, operator Brimm checks the tension wheel while the heavy cable hums.

exits.label: Walk to the lower gate landing

nodes.title: The Upper Winch Station
nodes.page:
Operator Brimm puts his shoulder to the iron brake lever as the hemp cable draws a deep vibrating note through the frozen winch house. Grease smokes faintly from the grooved wooden drum, smelling of mutton fat and cold iron. The cliff drops away sharply beyond the open loading bay into an endless sea of grey cloud.

You can continue onward toward the lower gate landing.

nodes.brief: Across the mossy gully, a cluster of icicles snaps and clatters down the cliff face.

exits.label: Approach the gate merchant
Step beneath the toll-house awning

nodes.title: The Mossy Gully
nodes.page:
A dense cluster of icicles snaps cleanly from the mossy gully overhead, clattering in a shower of sharp crystal shards across the rocky path before your boots. You shield your face with a forearm as the great clapper's vibration travels through your chest and the echoes die away into the white abyss.

You can press on toward the gate merchant or inspect the toll-house awning.

nodes.brief: Within the stone shelter, Toll-clerk Nesta counts copper coins by the flickering light of fat-lamp.

exits.label: Head toward the lower gate
Inspect the permit desk

nodes.title: The Toll-Clerk's Lamp
nodes.page:
Toll-clerk Nesta licks a thumb stained with purple ink, methodically counting small copper coins by the flickering, greasy light of a fat-lamp inside the stone shelter. The scent of burnt mutton tallow and damp wool fills the cramped recess, shielding you momentarily from the biting mountain draft. He does not look up as your heavy boots scrape the threshold.

You can continue toward the lower gate or examine the toll permits.

nodes.brief: Beside the frozen water-butt, mule-driver Korda strokes Biscuit's twitching ears to calm the beast.

exits.label: Proceed to the gate landing
Approach the toll-house clerk

nodes.title: Calming The Mule
nodes.page:
Mule-driver Korda murmurs low encouragement, stroking Biscuit's twitching, frost-rimed ears to soothe the stubborn beast against the rising howl of the wind. The mule stamps a heavy hoof against the frozen ground, its breath pluming white and thick in the freezing air while pack-saddles creak under their burden.

You can move forward toward the lower gate landing or check the toll-house.

nodes.brief: Under the granite overhang, an old shepherd named Daveth whittles a replacement peg for his pack frame.

exits.label: Walk past the merchant weighing dried chicory
Check the mule harness beside the iron ring

nodes.title: The Shepherd's Peg
nodes.page: Under the granite overhang, an old shepherd named Daveth whittles a replacement peg for his pack frame, shaving thin curls of juniper that smell sharp against the mountain chill. The bronze Clapper on your back knocks a low answering beat into your shoulder blades as you pause to catch your breath. Daveth does not look up from his work, merely gesturing with his crooked thumb toward the paths diverging before you in the grey mist.

nodes.brief: On the steep slate stairs, your thighs burn with every downward step under the crushing bronze weight.

exits.label: Approach the toll-house beneath the wooden awning
Attend to the mule by the frost-covered tethering ring

nodes.title: The Burning Thighs
nodes.page: On the steep slate stairs, your thighs burn with every downward step under the crushing bronze weight of Orison's tongue. Frost clings to the edges of your woolen coat, and the rhythmic clack of your boots is the only measure against the howling wind. Ahead, the stairway plunges deeper into the shadow of the mountain wall where the air tastes of old snow and damp stone.

nodes.brief: Past the rusted iron crane, the valley mist rolls upward like a grey woolen blanket.

exits.label: Seek shelter beneath the toll-house awning
Adjust the grey mule's frozen harness
Step toward the glimmering rope-market stalls

nodes.title: The Rolling Mist
nodes.page: Past the rusted iron crane, the valley mist rolls upward like a grey woolen blanket, swallowing the lower steps and blurring the edge of the abyss. The weight of the Clapper pulls you slightly forward, demanding constant balance on the slick stone. Somewhere in the white gloom, a bell-rope creaks against a hidden timber, answered only by the faint, deep thrum of the bronze you carry.

nodes.brief: At the crossroads of the three winds, a painted signpost points toward the lower stair-towns.

exits.label: Head toward the mist-shrouded market stalls
Listen for the wool-sorter inside the drafty shed
Inspect the flapping parchment on the notice board

nodes.title: The Three Winds
nodes.page: At the crossroads of the three winds, a painted signpost points toward the lower stair-towns with fading black letters. The gales buffet your loaded back, trying to pry you away from the cliff face, but you lean firmly into the stone. Scraps of ice skitter across the flags, clinking softly against your gaiters like tiny glass bells.

nodes.brief: Within the alcove of the weathered boundary stone, someone has left a fresh sprig of dried rosemary.

exits.label: Make for the misty rope-market cluster
Present your monastery seal to the guard captain
Cross the wooden footbridge toward the mills

nodes.title: The Boundary Stone
nodes.page: Within the alcove of the weathered boundary stone, someone has left a fresh sprig of dried rosemary, its herbal scent cutting cleanly through the bitter mountain air. Against your spine the bronze Clapper knocks in time with some unseen chord deep in the mountain rock. You trace the mossy letters carved into the granite before weighing your next move.

nodes.brief: Beside the sheer drop of the Ninety Steps, a loose handrail swings wildly in the mountain gust.

exits.label: Calm the mule near the tethering ring
Speak with the guard captain by the lower stair
Check on the wool-sorter inside the shed

nodes.title: The Loose Handrail
nodes.page: Beside the sheer drop of the Ninety Steps, a loose handrail swings wildly in the mountain gust, clanging rhythmically against rusted iron brackets. Every muscle in your body tightens as you hug the rock face, careful not to let the swinging bronze weight destabilize your footing on the icy stair. The drop below is a bottomless gray expanse of cloud and void.

nodes.brief: Under the low lintel of the guard-shelter, a sleeping sentinel jerks awake as your boots crunch.

exits.label: Head out toward the rope-market in the mist
Visit the wool-sorter inside the drafty shed

nodes.title: The Guard Shelter
nodes.page: Under the low lintel of the guard-shelter, a sleeping sentinel jerks awake as your boots crunch on the frozen gravel. The guard blinks away the sleep, wrapping a threadbare blanket tighter around narrow shoulders while eyeing the heavy cradle on your back. A small brazier of glowing charcoal inside the stone nook casts a brief, warm red light across the threshold.

nodes.brief: On the frosted wooden landing, a flock of mountain jackdaws scatters into the grey gloom.

exits.label: Present your monastery seal for inspection at the lower stair
Seek out the drafty wool-shed where Elva combs the fleeces

nodes.title: The Frosted Landing
nodes.page:
Frost glazes the splintered pine landing where a sudden clatter of dark wings erupts as a flock of mountain jackdaws scatters into the grey gloom, leaving the cold air vibrating with their sharp calls. Below your wool cloak, the bronze Clapper rests in its padded cradle and presses faintly against your shoulder blades. Two paths diverge beyond the scattered feathers, each drawing your eye downward into the swirling mountain mist.

You adjust the leather straps of the load and weigh the chill wind against the demands of the long descent ahead.

nodes.brief: Near the salt-encrusted cistern, cooper Thram patches a leaking barrel with fresh birch hoops.

exits.label: Report to the guard captain at the stair head
Cross the footbridge toward the distant water-mills
Read the decree on the cliff-side notice board

nodes.title: The Salt Cistern
nodes.page: Near the salt-encrusted cistern, cooper Thram patches a leaking barrel with fresh birch hoops, whistling a dour mountain tune between missing teeth. The smell of wet oak and brine mingles with the high-altitude ozone. He pauses to glance at the bronze tongue on your back, offering a brief, knowing nod before returning to his mallet work.

nodes.brief: Across the dizzying wire bridge, the first tier of the rope-market hangs above the abyss.

exits.label: Follow the path toward the rhythmic water-mills
Examine the fluttering decree on the notice board

nodes.title: The Wire Bridge
nodes.page: Across the dizzying wire bridge, the first tier of the rope-market hangs above the abyss like a spider's web strung with lanterns. The cable hums beneath your boots, vibrating with every gust that sweeps up from the gorge. Stalls draped in heavy canvas sway gently in the draft, smelling of hemp, tallow, and dried mountain herbs.

nodes.brief: Within the shadow of the buttress, weaver Milla checks her knotted tally-cord against the rising wind.

exits.label: Descend by the lower scaffolding path
Follow the outer wall toward the stairs

nodes.title: The Knotted Tally
nodes.page: Within the shadow of the buttress, weaver Milla checks her knotted tally-cord against the rising wind. The hemp loops are stiff with cold moisture, clicking against her knuckles like dry bone as she counts off the yardage for the upper cables. She tucks the cord into her belt and glances up at the burdened cradle on your back, her expression tightening into a careful frown.

nodes.brief: At the turn of the stone stair, a discarded leather mitten lies frozen stiff in the rime.

exits.label: Press onward down the frozen steps
Seek shelter near the sheltered alcove
Turn back toward the upper courtyard

nodes.title: The Frozen Mitten
nodes.page: At the turn of the stone stair, a discarded leather mitten lies frozen stiff in the rime. The wind howls against the masonry, scouring the frost-white steps until they shine like polished glass under the pale sky. A few paces further down, the stone narrows sharply between two iron brackets where the handrail disappears beneath an accumulated drift of dry snow.

nodes.brief: On the broad stone landing above the lower gate, merchant Vane weighs bundles of dried chicory.

exits.label: Continue past the weighing scales toward the road

nodes.title: The Chicory Bales
nodes.page: On the broad stone landing above the lower gate, merchant Vane weighs bundles of dried chicory. The sweet, bitter scent of the roots drifts across the cobblestones, masking the sharper tang of mountain sulfur and wet wool. He pauses mid-lift, calloused thumbs on the brass scales, while he eyes the bronze Clapper secured in your leather harness.

nodes.brief: Beneath the wooden awning of the toll-house, a clerk stamps travel permits with frozen red ink.

exits.label: Wait in line for your papers
Slip past toward the winch platform
Take the side path down the ridge

nodes.title: The Frozen Ink
nodes.page: Beneath the wooden awning of the toll-house, a clerk stamps travel permits with frozen red ink. Each blow of the wooden mallet sounds flat and dull against the frozen timber framing, while the queue of weary travellers shifts uneasily in the biting draft. The clerk does not look up when you approach, merely tapping the edge of the inkpad with a yellowed fingernail.

nodes.brief: Beside the tethering ring, Biscuit shakes the frost from his grey coat while you adjust the harness.

exits.label: Lead the mule toward the main archway
Check the cinch-straps once more

nodes.title: The Grey Coat
nodes.page: Beside the tethering ring, Biscuit shakes the frost from his grey coat while you adjust the harness. The mule blows a long whistling plume of steam into the crisp air, ears flicking back to catch the clink of the bronze Clapper against your padded frame. The leather straps are stiff with rime, requiring a firm tug to set the buckles right against his shaggy ribs.

nodes.brief: Through the gap in the stone parapet, the first cluster of rope-market stalls shimmers in the mist.

exits.label: Step through the gap into the market stalls
Keep to the upper stone path

nodes.title: The Mist-Shimmered Stalls
nodes.page: Through the gap in the stone parapet, the first cluster of rope-market stalls shimmers in the mist. Lanterns sway from the canvas eaves, casting long, dancing streaks of amber light across the damp ropes coiled in every doorway. The muffled shouting of the cable-merchants rises from the depths, competing with the steady, mournful drone of the mountain wind.

nodes.brief: At the head of the lower stair, guard Captain Selby inspects your monastery seal with tired eyes.

exits.label: Pass through the gate toward the central winch
Pause to ask about the lower trail conditions

nodes.title: The Monastery Seal
nodes.page: At the head of the lower stair, guard Captain Selby inspects your monastery seal with tired eyes. He runs a thick, calloused thumb over the hot red wax, checking the impression against the daylight before nodding a slow, grudging approval. Wind catches his woollen cloak while he points toward the open gate behind him.

nodes.brief: Inside the drafty wool-shed, sorter Elva combs burrs from a fleece while listening for your approach.

exits.label: Speak with Elva among the wool bales
Head straight for the exit doors

nodes.title: The Wool-Shed
nodes.page: Inside the drafty wool-shed, sorter Elva combs burrs from a fleece while listening for your approach. The air is thick with the rich, lanolin smell of unwashed sheep's wool and the dry rustle of discarded straw. She pauses her work, her fingers stained deep grey from the grease, and watches you step out of the howling draft.

nodes.brief: Over the wooden footbridge, the rhythmic thrum of distant water-mills vibrates through the damp air.

exits.label: Cross the bridge toward the milling terraces
Turn away along the cliff edge path

nodes.title: The Water-Mills
nodes.page: Over the wooden footbridge the distant water-mills knock through the damp air in a slow rhythm. The frozen spray from the wheel-race glazes the wooden handrails in a thin, translucent crust that crackles under your boots. Below the bridge, the grey slate roofs of the terrace millers cling precariously to the vertical stone face like swallows' nests.

nodes.brief: Against the cliff-side notice board, a fresh parchment decree flaps violently in the rising gales.

exits.label: Stop to read the flapping decree

nodes.title: The Flapping Decree
nodes.page: Against the cliff-side notice board, a fresh parchment decree flaps violently in the rising gales. The iron nails groan in their timber seat as the wind attempts to rip the proclamation loose, exposing jagged lines of black ink detailing new toll rates for the descent. Several frozen fingers of wax seal the bottom corner to the splintered wood.

nodes.brief: At the threshold of the rope market, the smell of Stockholm tar and wet hemp fills your lungs.

exits.label: Take the lower trading track now

nodes.title: Stockholm Tar And Hemp
nodes.page:
Stockholm tar and wet hemp fill your lungs at the threshold of the rope market, where the morning mist clings to coils of thick cable stacked higher than a mule-shed. Coarse fibers tickle your nose as you squeeze past a merchant weighing greasy strands on a rusted iron balance, the bronze Clapper pulsing low against your spine. Around you, apprentices shout over the creak of stretching hemp and the dull thud of heavy wooden mallets driving mooring pins into the granite floor.

Somewhere down the line, a signal horn blares twice, warning of a shifting cable load, and you must decide whether to rush your steps or wait out the impending gust.

nodes.brief: Under the timber archway, a line of laden pack-mules waits for the barrier bell to ring.

exits.label: Step through the rising iron gate

nodes.title: Timber Archway And Mules
nodes.page:
Under the heavy timber archway, a line of laden pack-mules waits for the barrier bell to ring, their breath pluming white against the gray slate of Orisonhold. Hooves shift restlessly on the frost-greased stones while drovers lean against weathered fence posts, chewing hardtack and watching the cloud sea roll below the ledge. The metal cradle on your back strains with each shift, and the bronze tongue inside knocks an anxious warning through your shoulder blades.

Ahead, the iron gate lifts with a harsh metallic screech, clearing the narrow track that winds down toward the hanging tiers.

nodes.brief: Beside the central winch-drum, master rigger Joran signals the clearance for the descent to Lowgate.

exits.label: Follow the rigger's cleared track downward

nodes.title: Winch Drum Clearance
nodes.page:
Beside the central winch-drum, master rigger Joran signals the clearance for the descent to Lowgate, his scarred hand cutting a crisp arc through the sharp mountain air. A thick hemp hawser shrieks around the greased oak cylinder, smoking slightly from the friction as the first cargo basket drops into the swirling white void of the gorge. Your boots grip the frozen granite step while the Clapper answers the massive machinery turning just inches from your ear with a deep note.

Joran nods curtly toward the open path, his eyes crinkling against the bitter wind.

nodes.brief: Out past the outermost winch-house, the endless grey tiers of the rope-town drop into the cloud sea.

exits.label: Advance along the fog-veiled cableway

nodes.title: Cloud Sea Drop
nodes.page:
Out past the outermost winch-house, the endless grey tiers of the rope-town drop into the cloud sea, a dizzying abyss where mountain peaks jut like dark islands through a churning ocean of fog. The wind claws at your wool cloak, tasting of pine pitch and ancient ice, while the Clapper knocks its bronze edge against the padded frame of your backpack. Far below, tiny bell-buoys swing in the updraft, their metallic clinking muffled by the dense blankets of vapor drifting up the cliff face.

Every timber and cable ahead groans under the sudden pressure of the rising gales.

nodes.brief: Ignoring the rising gale and the warnings of the gate-warden, you rush headlong down the icy steps with an unspooled rope, losing your footing as the heavy clapper drags you into the abyss.
nodes.title: The Unspooled Line
nodes.page: Ignoring the rising gale and the sharp warnings of the gate-warden, you rush headlong down the icy steps with an unspooled hemp line trailing behind you. A sudden blast of mountain air catches the trailing coils, wrapping your boots in a desperate tangle as you lose your footing on the rimed stone. Bronze on your back tips you forward into the gray abyss while wind roars in your ears and the mountain takes you whole.

nodes.brief: Ignoring the ice-warning on the upper stair, you rush the descent in the gathering squall until the frozen cradle slips and pitches the Clapper into the abyss.
nodes.title: The Frozen Abyss
nodes.page: Ignoring the ice-warning on the upper stair, you rush the descent in the gathering squall until the frozen cradle slips and pitches the Clapper into the abyss. The bronze tongue tears away from your straps with a sudden, weightless lurch, its familiar humming cut short as it plunges downward into the roaring white nothingness of the gorge. Frost coats your eyelashes and numbs your fingers as you reach out instinctively for a treasure that is already gone, swallowed by the mountain's bottomless throat. There is no recovery here, only the howling wind and the long, cold wait for the storm to take the remaining path.

nodes.brief: Arrival in The Rope Markets: bazaars slung on cables across the gorge, ropewrights and winch-boys, the Cable Court's toll-houses, a knot-oath, rumours of Lowgate. The reader enters with several ways forward.

exits.label: Follow the main stair
Cut across the lower ledges

exits.intent: Ask the way of a stranger
exits.label: Ask the way of a stranger
Take the old carriers' path

nodes.title: Arrival In The Rope Markets
nodes.page:
Arrival in The Rope Markets brings a dizzying rush of sound, color, and motion as bazaars slung on thick cables span the plunging gorge. Ropewrights hammer stubborn knots, winch-boys haul on greasy lines, and the looming toll-houses of the Cable Court demand heavy dues from every traveler passing through their gates. The scent of hot tallow and roasted chestnuts mixes with the damp mountain wind, while rumors of Lowgate's forge-masters echo from tavern awnings and crowded bridgeheads.

The path splits before you into several distinct routes, each offering its own hazards and rewards.

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Knot-Oath Stall: the Ropewrights offer shelter and passage in exchange for a knot-oath (to answer one request later); the reader accepts or refuses

exits.intent: Tie the knot-oath for the Ropewrights' help
exits.label: Tie the knot-oath for the Ropewrights' help

exits.intent: Refuse the oath and pay full price
exits.label: Refuse the oath and pay full price

nodes.title: The Knot-Oath Stall
nodes.page:
Inside the sprawling canvas pavilion of the Knot-Oath Stall, the air is thick with the scent of pine pitch and warm wool. Master ropewrights crowd the central cable hub, fingers looping and tucking hemp cords into tight, unyielding knots. They offer you immediate shelter, hot barley broth, and safe passage down the ice-slicked cable ways, but the price is absolute: you must swear an oath tied in a sailor's hitch, promising to answer one unspecified request for the guild when you reach Lowgate or return to Orisonhold.

Bind your word to theirs and you earn safe, swift passage down the freezing cliff face; refuse their tangled promises and you pay the full toll in coin and muscle, trusting only your own strength to carry the bronze Clapper down the mountain.

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Cable Court Toll-House: a Cable Court toll-house: take their loan (a debt, with a collector who will come for it) or pay from the reader's purse

exits.intent: Take the Cable Court's loan of passage
exits.label: Take the Cable Court's loan of passage

exits.intent: Pay the toll from your own purse
exits.label: Pay the toll from your own purse

nodes.title: The Cable Court Ledger
nodes.page:
A cramped chamber smells of stale tallow and iron ink-pots where the Cable Court toll-collectors present their terms for your passage. The clerk taps a long quill against a binding contract that promises heavy repayment terms down in Lowgate, or demands an immediate settlement from your own dwindling funds.

Every breath tastes of frozen dust in the low-ceilinged booth while Biscuit stomps an impatient hoof outside the reinforced door.

nodes.brief: Leaving The Rope Markets for The Windmill Terraces: close this part of the journey.

exits.label: Go on into the terraces

nodes.title: Leaving The Rope Markets
nodes.page:
Leaving The Rope Markets behind, the chaotic clamour of winch-boys and cable-riders fades into the high mountain silence. The air grows sharper and thinner as you cross the threshold from the suspended bazaars onto the descending stone stairs that bridge the vertical world. Every muscle in your back aches from the patient pull of the bronze tongue, which ticks deep against your shoulder blades.

Below you, the vast stepped architecture of the windmill terraces unfolds out of the gray mist.

nodes.brief: You step onto the swaying hemp bridges of the Rope Markets where merchants hawk greased tackle across a dizzying gorge.

exits.label: Dodge the flying mail-skiff overhead
Inspect old Garrow's tarred flax strands
Warm cold fingers by the chestnut brazier

nodes.title: Swaying Hemp Bridges
nodes.page:
You step onto the swaying hemp bridges of the Rope Markets where merchants hawk greased tackle across a dizzying gorge, their voices rising above the constant singing of the strained cables. Below your boots, the drop is sheer and bottomless, hidden only by wisps of cloud that snag on the lower cross-braces and tarred netting. The Clapper taps your back in time with the bounce of hundreds of travelers on the woven pathways.

A sudden flurry of activity breaks out ahead near a crowded crossing, drawing anxious eyes toward the iron tracks above.

nodes.brief: A winch-boy named Jory yells warnings from a creaking gantry above as heavy cargo baskets zip past your ears.

exits.label: Squeeze past the tangled rigging heap
Face the green-spectacled toll clerk
Slip down the damp salt-crusted stair

nodes.title: Creaking Gantry Warnings
nodes.page:
A winch-boy named Jory yells warnings from a creaking gantry above as heavy cargo baskets zip past your ears on humming iron runners. Splintered pine and stray hemp threads rain down onto the damp planking while you flatten your back against the cliff wall to let a team of cable-riders haul a massive crate of tin bars past. The bronze Clapper shifts inside its cradle, and its deep note briefly drowns the shouts of the porters and the screech of rusted pulleys.

A narrow gap opens between a stack of discarded rigging crates and the toll-lord's station.

nodes.brief: You duck beneath an awning of hemp coils while the bronze Clapper hums softly against the cradle on your back.

exits.label: Step down the salt-crusted stair

exits.privWhy: Biscuit the mule is with the reader and knows the ledges and the ropeway stalls
exits.label: Follow Biscuit past the hidden winch chute
Help Mara untangle the fouled winch-line

nodes.title: Awning Of Hemp Coils
nodes.page:
You duck beneath an awning of hemp coils while the bronze Clapper hums softly against the cradle on your back, offering a brief respite from the biting wind. The air here smells richly of Stockholm tar and dried lavender, carried down from the hidden orchard balconies tucked behind the merchant stalls. A stray ginger cat sits atop a barrel of tallow, watching you with sleepy indifference as the market crowd surges past in a blur of gray wool and brass buttons.

A narrow side alley opens up behind the stacked rope coils, offering a quiet alternative to the main thoroughfare.

nodes.brief: A Cable Court toll-house blocks the narrow plankway, demanding a bronze penny for every pound of suspended metal.

exits.label: Step forward and pay the toll
Argue the weight of the Clapper

nodes.title: The Toll At The Plank
nodes.page:
A stout timber toll-house blocks the narrow plankway across the gulf, its green-painted shutters battered by the mountain draft. A Cable Court clerk raps a brass knuckle on the wooden sill and names a copper coin for every pound of suspended metal swinging on your back. The bronze Clapper knocks a dull warning against your shoulder blades as you tally what you carry.

Behind you, the rope-market hums with shouting traders, but here the path narrows to a single plank where passage is measured strictly in coin.

nodes.brief: You dodge a flying mail-skiff that screeches along a greasy iron cable above the roaring chasm.

exits.label: Take refuge inside the anchor stone
Catch the eye of the rope-master

nodes.title: The Screeching Iron Cable
nodes.page: Sudden metal shrieks split the air as a mail-skiff hurtles along a greasy iron cable directly overhead, showering fine iron rust into the mist. You throw yourself against the damp rock face and clamp the padded cradle tight while the abyss yawns inches from your boots. The wind howls up through the gorge, carrying the smell of burning tallow and wet hemp from the stalls below.

nodes.brief: Old Garrow sells spliced strands of tarred flax while muttering about dishonest weigh-masters in the lower wards.

exits.label: Weave through the fluttering hemp market
Step over the grease-slicked capstan drum

nodes.title: The Splicer Of Tarred Flax
nodes.page: Old Garrow sits cross-legged among coils of blackened hemp, his calloused fingers knotting tarred flax while he mutters curses about dishonest weigh-masters in the lower wards. The scent of pine tar and sea-salt hangs thick around his stall, cutting through the thin mountain air like a blade. He pauses his work to eye the bronze Clapper with professional suspicion, spitting into the chasm below.

nodes.brief: A group of shivering winch-apprentices share roasted chestnuts over a brazier fueled by hemp shavings.

exits.label: Speak with the nervous tally clerk
Seek shelter near the moss-seller's corner

nodes.title: The Brazier Of Hemp Shavings
nodes.page: Shivering winch-apprentices crowd around a rusted iron brazier, warming their raw knuckles over a fire fed entirely by fragrant hemp shavings. They pass a tin cup of roasted chestnuts back and forth, offering a brief, smoky haven from the freezing gorge draft. The bronze Clapper knocks softly in answer to the crackling heat, vibrating against your travel-worn straps.

nodes.brief: You squeeze past a tangled heap of discarded rigging that threatens to trip Biscuit and the Clapper.

exits.label: Step over the grease-slicked capstan drum
Seek shelter near the moss-seller's corner
Duck the swinging timber counter-weight

nodes.title: The Tangled Rigging Heap
nodes.page: A mountain of discarded cordage blocks the narrow walkway, its frayed strands twisting like sleeping serpents across the timber boards. You must pick your footing carefully to avoid snagging Biscuit's pack or tumbling the heavy bronze Clapper into the yawning gap beside the scaffolding. The rigging groans under the sudden pressure of a shifting wind, threatening to spill over the edge.

nodes.brief: A toll-lord's clerk wearing green spectacles taps his ledger and glares at your heavy cargo cradle.

exits.label: Seek shelter near the moss-seller's corner
Duck the swinging timber counter-weight

nodes.title: The Green-Spectacled Clerk
nodes.page: Round green spectacles catch the light as a toll-lord's clerk taps his ledger with a bone stylus and glares at the cargo cradle strapped to your back. His ink-stained fingers twitch toward a brass bell used to summon the gate guards if any traveler disputes the tariff. The cold air bites at your ears while you wait for his verdict on the metal you carry.

nodes.brief: You slip down a damp salt-crusted stair where rope-scraps litter the boards like discarded snake skins.

exits.label: Heed the warning of the cable-rider
Cross the trembling willow-withem bridge
Let the inspector test your bronze
Duck beneath the low woven awning

nodes.title: The Salt-Crusted Stair
nodes.page: You slip down a steep, damp stair carved directly into the cliff-face, where old rope-scraps litter the slick boards like discarded snake skins. The salt-encrusted stone offers little traction, and every step requires deliberate focus to keep the suspended bronze Clapper from swaying off balance. Far below, the tiered roofs of the middle wards vanish into swirling banks of gray cloud.

nodes.brief: Biscuit drops his ears and nudges a hidden side-winch chute, bypassing the clogged toll-gate entirely with mule-savvy grace.

exits.label: Cross the trembling willow-withem bridge
Let the inspector test your bronze
