nodes.title: The Mule-Savvy Bypass
nodes.page: Biscuit flattens his ears and suddenly veers toward a hidden side-winch chute, using his stubborn mule-savvy to bypass the clogged toll-gate entirely. The clever beast squeezes past a rusted winch-housing, sliding his hooves sure-footedly down a steep gravel ledge that regular travelers ignore. You scramble after him, locking the bronze cradle in place as the main path falls away behind.

nodes.brief: A frantic rope-seller named Mara begs you to untangle a fouled winch-line before the evening gales hit.

exits.label: Duck beneath the low woven awning

exits.privWhy: the reader carries a Ropewrights' Guild rope and is waved through guild places
exits.label: Show your guild tether to pass
Dodge the falling tallow bucket

nodes.title: The Frantic Rope-Seller
nodes.page: A frantic rope-seller named Mara catches your sleeve, begging you to help untangle a hopelessly fouled winch-line before the evening gales slam into the gorge. Heavy cargo baskets grind violently against their wooden frames just overhead, threatening to snap the strained fibers into deadly whips. The sharp scent of burning friction oil fills your nose as you weigh her desperate plea.

nodes.brief: You balance on a narrow pine plank while a basket of salted char swings wildly past your ribs.

exits.privWhy: the reader carries a Ropewrights' Guild rope and is waved through guild places
exits.label: Show your guild tether to pass
Dodge the falling tallow bucket

nodes.title: The Swinging Salt Basket
nodes.page: You balance carefully on a narrow pine plank while a massive wicker basket filled with salted char swings wildly past your ribs, driven by an erratic gust. The damp wood creaks under your boots, and the abyss waits patiently beneath the gap in the railing. You press your back against the cliff face, letting the violent momentum of the cargo pass before taking another step.

nodes.brief: A Cable Court guard weighs your pack on a groaning brass scale while his colleague eyes the bronze Clapper.

exits.label: Rush past the sliding bucket

nodes.title: The Brass Scales
nodes.page:
Iron counterweights clink on a groaning brass scale as a Cable Court guard drops your pack onto the pan. His colleague leans over the counter, eyes narrowing at the pale green patina of the bronze Clapper strapped to your spine. The metal gives a low, sympathetic thrum against your shoulder blades, vibrating through the wood and canvas as the beam teeters, threatening an exorbitant toll for every pound of sacred metal you carry down the mountain face.

A frantic winch-boy spills his tallow bucket across your path just as a basket screeches down from above.

nodes.brief: You take shelter inside a hollow anchor-stone while an iron cable sings a high, piercing note in the wind.

exits.label: Slip behind the woodpile
Accept the bitter chicory water

nodes.title: The Anchor Stone
nodes.page: Frigid gales sweep across the open marketplace, causing a thick iron cable overhead to sing a high, piercing note that sets your teeth on edge. You duck quickly inside a hollow anchor-stone, finding a brief sanctuary from the biting wind and the watchful eyes of the toll-collectors patrolling the suspension bridges. The bronze Clapper knocks once against your padded cradle, answering a far vibration from the mountain's frozen heart.

nodes.brief: A one-eyed rope-master named Tallow inspects your backpack cradle with professional interest and a dry cough.

exits.label: Duck into the shadowy alcove
Take a cup of chicory water

nodes.title: The Rope-Master
nodes.page: A one-eyed rope-master named Tallow steps into your path, coughing dryly into a woollen knuckle as he inspects your backpack cradle with professional interest. His gnarled fingers trace the hemp lashings securing the bronze Clapper, testing the tension with the ease of a man who has spent fifty years binding the vertical world together against the abyss. He mutters something about winter gales before nodding at your burden.

nodes.brief: You navigate a suspended market square where hundreds of hanks of yellow hemp flutter like prayer flags.

exits.label: Skirt the edge of the great timber wheel
Guide Biscuit past the salted hides

nodes.title: Yellow Hemp Flags
nodes.page: Hundreds of hanks of bright yellow hemp flutter like prayer flags above the suspended market square, filling the crisp mountain air with the sharp scent of fresh tar and dry grass. You pick your way across the swinging timber planks, one hand firm on the padded cradle where the bronze Clapper knocks a long low note into tired muscle.

nodes.brief: A nervous clerk named Pip drops his tally-chalk as the bronze Clapper hums against your shoulder-straps.

exits.label: Skirt the edge of the humming timber wheel
Face the sergeant blocking the alley ahead
Learn a secure mountain knot from Bram
Turn back toward the upper rope market

nodes.title: The Clerk And Tally
nodes.page: A nervous clerk named Pip drops his tally-chalk when the bronze Clapper knocks against your shoulder-straps, and the white cylinder rolls into the greasy sawdust between his boots. Wet hemp and old grease ride the gorge wind through the rope market's narrow stalls, and the metal on your back answers every gust with a low bronze shiver. Pip scrambles to retrieve his chalk, muttering about toll receipts and missing weight tallies while pointing a trembling finger toward the various winch-lanes and timber platforms branching off into the freezing mist.

nodes.brief: You step over a grease-slicked capstan while winch-hands heave in unison against the mountain draft.

exits.label: Approach the sergeant demanding descent papers
Guide the mule past salted hides

nodes.title: The Capstan And Mule
nodes.page: You step over a grease-slicked capstan while winch-hands heave in unison against the mountain draft, their breath pluming white in the biting air. Behind you Biscuit stamps a loose wooden slat and shakes his head until the leather bells on his harness jingle against the long climb. The massive bronze Clapper in your back-cradle vibrates with the turning iron gears nearby. A low knock runs down your spine in time with the bustling market.

nodes.brief: A stall selling dried mountain moss and tallow-dips offers a warm corner away from the biting gorge wind.

exits.label: Show your permit to the demanding sergeant
Lead Biscuit past the stacks of salted hides
Listen to the weaver share a heavy-load knot
Turn back past the toll-house demanding pennies

nodes.title: The Tallow And Moss
nodes.page: A stall selling dried mountain moss and tallow-dips offers a warm corner away from the biting gorge wind, smelling faintly of rendered sheep fat and herbal smoke. The old vendor nods as you pause by her counter, the bronze tongue on your back knocking against its wooden cradle like a caged and restless thing. Down the narrow plankway beyond the stall, shouting winch-boys and cargo baskets make a chaotic wall of sound and motion between you and the lower stair-towns before nightfall.

nodes.brief: You dodge a swinging counter-weight that crashes into the timber framing with a hollow, booming thud.

exits.label: Dash across the slatted pine platform
Listen to the merchant begging for secrecy

nodes.title: The Swinging Counterweight
nodes.page: You dodge a swinging counter-weight that crashes into the timber framing with a hollow, booming thud, showering the damp cedar planks with fine wood splinters. The mountain wind howls through the rigging overhead, shaking the suspended walkways of the rope market until the whole precarious bazaar seems to sway over the abyss. Beneath your canvas coat, the bronze Clapper gives a sharp, metallic pulse as if warning you of the next sudden gust sweeping up from the lower valleys.

nodes.brief: An old cable-rider named Nesta warns you that the lower winches are jammed with frozen grease.

exits.label: Ask the weaver to show you the heavy-load knot

exits.privWhy: the reader carries a Ropewrights' Guild rope and is waved through guild places
exits.label: Show your braided guild-rope to clear the lane
Hear the nervous merchant beg a favor

nodes.title: The Frozen Winches
nodes.page: An old cable-rider named Nesta warns you that the lower winches are jammed with frozen grease, leaning heavily on a scarred ash staff while she points toward the icy drums below. Her weathered face is lined with the salt and frost of fifty winters on the cliff, and her sharp eyes flick at once to the bronze mass strapped across your shoulders. Around her stall, other traders hustle to clear the ice from their rigging before the afternoon gales lock the entire market in a collar of solid frost.

nodes.brief: You cross a trembling suspension bridge of twisted willow withes while the abyss yawns below your boots.

exits.label: Conceal the merchant wire in your pack
Climb the wooden pegs hammered into granite
Squeeze between the warm pine tar shacks

nodes.title: The Willow Bridge
nodes.page: Slender willow withes twist together to form a trembling suspension bridge that sways rhythmically while the bottomless abyss yawns directly below your heavy boots. You take slow, measured breaths, keeping your center of gravity low beneath the weight of the bronze Clapper as the gorge wind attempts to sweep your legs out from under you.

nodes.brief: A Cable Court inspector taps your bronze Clapper with a wooden rod to test its resonance and weight.

exits.label: Climb the vertical wooden pegs directly into the granite face
Answer the irate toll-clerk shouting from the open window
Turn back toward the upper ropeway before the inspection deepens

nodes.title: The Inspector's Rod
nodes.page: A Cable Court inspector steps into your path with a short wooden rod, tapping sharply against the bronze Clapper in your pack to test its resonance and weight. The dense metal rings a low note straight through your canvas straps into your shoulder blades, and nearby toll-guards snap their heads toward you.

nodes.brief: You duck beneath a low canvas awning where weavers twist fibrous grass into unbreakable anchor-tethers.

exits.label: Step toward the shouting near the toll window
Squeeze past the narrow gap between the winch-shacks

nodes.title: The Canvas Awning
nodes.page:
Coarse fibers brush your shoulder as you duck beneath a low canvas awning where weavers twist tough mountain grass into unbreakable anchor-tethers. The air smells sharply of dried reed and river mud, thick with the rhythmic scraping of palms against hemp. Outside this shelter, the suspended rope markets sway gently over the gray abyss, carrying the distant clatter of iron capstans.

You shift the padded cradle on your back, and the bronze Clapper knocks a low note that seems to set the tent-poles shaking.

nodes.brief: Your pristine Ropewrights' Guild tether earns an immediate nod from the gate-guards, who wave you past the toll-snarl.

exits.label: Squeeze past the narrow gap between the winch-shacks
Follow the scarred capstan-master toward the flickering lower lanterns

priv.why: the reader carries a Ropewrights' Guild rope and is waved through guild places

nodes.title: The Guild Accord
nodes.page:
Your pristine Ropewrights' Guild tether catches the eye of the gate-guards immediately, earning a respectful nod and an unhesitating wave past the crowded toll-snarl. Other travelers are stuck arguing behind wooden barriers, but your braided hemp insignia speaks of trade secrets and mountain loyalty. You stride through the checkpoint while the cold air bites your cheeks and the great gorge below yawns wide beneath your boots.

Biscuit follows close behind, his hooves clattering softly on the weathered timber planks of the market bridge.

nodes.brief: A frantic winch-boy drops his tallow bucket right across your path as a heavy basket screeches downward.

exits.label: Deal with the irate clerk shouting from the toll-house window
Head toward the capstan-master pointing down at the flickering lanterns

nodes.title: The Tallow Spill
nodes.page: Greasy yellow fat spills across the planks when a frantic winch-boy drops his wooden tallow bucket in your path, and a cargo basket screeches downward along the iron cable above. You pull up short, steadying the vibrating bronze Clapper on your back while the boy stammers an apology and scrambles to clear the slick timber planks.

nodes.brief: You slip into a shadowy alcove behind a mountain-ash woodpile while toll-collectors argue over ledger tallies.

exits.label: Drop down into the sheltered timber trench
Dodge past the hurried Cable Court runner in the gloom

nodes.title: The Timber Alcove
nodes.page:
Shadows stretch long across the crowded boards as you slip quietly into a narrow alcove behind a tall mountain-ash woodpile. Just beyond the stacked logs, toll-collectors lean over a scarred trestle table, arguing fiercely over ledger tallies and coin weights. The bitter scent of fresh sap mingles with the cold mountain wind that whips around the corners of the storage shed.

You hitch the bronze Clapper against your back and keep your breathing soft while the dispute echoes off the canyon walls.

nodes.brief: A ropewright named Fenn offers you a cup of bitter chicory water to clear the mountain dust from your throat.

exits.label: Step down into the sheltered timber trench away from the gale
Navigate the web of crossed guy-lines vibrating like harp strings

nodes.title: Bitter Chicory Water
nodes.page: A weathered ropewright named Fenn offers you a small wooden cup of bitter chicory water to clear the biting mountain dust from your parched throat. The warm, earthy brew takes the edge off the freezing air as you lean against a stout timber post and watch the cable-riders prep their winches for the evening shift.

nodes.brief: You skirt the edge of a great timber wheel where greasy hemp cables hum with the tension of the cliff.

exits.label: Drop down into the sheltered timber trench
Dodge past the hurried Cable Court runner in the gloom

nodes.title: The Great Timber Wheel
nodes.page:
Greasy hemp cables stand taut with the cliff's tension as you skirt the outer edge of a great timber wheel. The massive drum revolves with a low, bone-shaking rumble, drawing tight against a dozen hanging platforms out over the empty air. Spray from the frozen mists coats your knuckles in a thin layer of rime while you watch the iron-bound spokes turn in slow, relentless circles.

The bronze Clapper on your back answers the cable's vibration with a matching knock.

nodes.brief: A Cable Court sergeant blocks the alley with a spiked pole, demanding proof of your descent permit.

exits.label: Drop down into the sheltered timber trench
Dodge past the hurried Cable Court runner in the gloom
Navigate the web of vibrating guy-lines

nodes.title: The Spiked Pole
nodes.page:
A Cable Court sergeant steps directly into the narrow alley, blocking your way with a heavy, iron-tipped pole and demanding immediate proof of your descent permit. His silver tunic is stiff with frost, and his eyes narrow suspiciously at the bulky canvas-wrapped cradle on your back. The surrounding market stalls grow suddenly quiet as nearby merchants pause to watch the confrontation unfold over the yawning gorge.

Biscuit tosses his head, the harness jingling nervously in the freezing air.

nodes.brief: You guide Biscuit past a pile of salted hides while the bronze Clapper vibrates against your tired spine.

exits.label: Dodge past the hurried Cable Court runner in the gloom
Navigate the web of vibrating guy-lines
Step around the groaning iron winch-drum

nodes.title: The Salted Hides
nodes.page:
Piles of stiff, salted hides give off a sharp brine smell as you guide Biscuit carefully along the narrow ledge, keeping your boots clear of the freezing puddles. The bronze Clapper knocks against your tired spine in time with your footsteps on the planking. All around you, the vertical city clings to the mountain face in a dizzying cascade of ropes, winches, and timber scaffolding.

The rising evening gale begins to howl through the rigging overhead, carrying the distant sound of falling ice.

nodes.brief: A weaver named Bram shows you a secret knot that secures heavy loads against the fiercest mountain downdrafts.

exits.label: Navigate the web of vibrating guy-lines
Follow the torch-holding apprentice across the slippery boards
Step around the groaning iron winch-drum

nodes.title: The Weaver's Knot
nodes.page:
Quick-fingered hands demonstrate a secret knot that secures heavy loads against the fiercest mountain downdrafts, tying thick hemp with effortless grace. The weaver, whose apron is stiff with dried resin, nods approvingly as you replicate the twists with your numb fingers. Overhead, the sky turns the pale, bruised color of a winter plum as the sun dips below the jagged western peaks.

A glowing tallow torch flares nearby, casting long, dancing shadows across the frost-rimed boards of the rope-market.

nodes.brief: You dash across an exposed platform of slatted pine while ice-pellets rattle against your canvas coat.

exits.label: Follow the torchlight across the boards
Head toward the swinging toll-house lantern
Take the narrow snow ledge past the spinning lofts

nodes.title: The Slatted Pine
nodes.page: Ice-pellets rattle against your canvas coat as you dash across an exposed platform of slatted pine suspended over the yawning gorge. Beneath your boots, the frozen boards rattle with every gust of mountain air, and Biscuit stumbles once behind you, his hooves clicking sharply against the wood before he regains his footing. The bronze Clapper shakes in its padded cradle on your back in time with the whipping anchor cables that hold the entire market frame to the cliff. You need to pick your way forward before the storm thickens.

nodes.brief: The guard spots your braided guild-rope coil and instantly clears the winch-lane without demanding a single coin.

exits.label: Step around the groaning iron winch-drum
Walk toward the swinging toll-house lantern

priv.why: the reader carries a Ropewrights' Guild rope and is waved through guild places

nodes.title: The Guild's Favor
nodes.page: The guard spots your braided guild-rope coil looped across your shoulder and instantly clears the winch-lane without demanding a single coin or a second glance. A nod of mutual respect passes between you as you step past the heavy iron gate, leaving the cold toll-takers behind in their drafty box. The air here smells of clean hemp and old grease, offering a brief shelter from the biting winds that sweep across the upper market platforms. Biscuit huffs a warm cloud of steam into the dim evening air, eager to keep moving down the steep drop.

nodes.brief: A nervous merchant named Kael begs you to hide his smuggled tin wire beneath your bronze Clapper cradle.

exits.label: Move past the groaning cargo winch-drum
Follow the narrow snow ledge past the spinning lofts

nodes.title: The Smuggler's Plea
nodes.page: A nervous merchant named Kael darts out from a shadow of stacked hemp bales, his fingers twitching as he begs you to hide his smuggled tin wire beneath your bronze Clapper cradle. He glances anxiously toward the upper toll-post, whispering that the Cable Court inspectors are seizing all unbonded metal tonight. The Great Bell's tongue knocks against your spine while you weigh the risk of carrying more for a stranger who looks ready to bolt at the first hard boot on the planks.

nodes.brief: You climb a vertical series of wooden pegs hammered directly into the granite face above the bazaar.

exits.label: Approach the swinging toll-house lantern ahead
Step onto the narrow snow ledge past the lofts

nodes.title: The Granite Pegs
nodes.page: You climb a vertical series of wooden pegs hammered directly into the frozen granite face above the roaring bazaar, your fingers stiffening against the raw timber. Each handhold is caked in rime ice, and the bronze Clapper shifts in its cradle enough to tip your balance. Down below, the lantern lights of the rope markets blur into scattered amber embers against the gathering gray twilight of the mountain wall.

nodes.brief: A toll-house window flies open and an irate clerk demands to know why your pack is humming so loudly.

exits.label: Move toward the swinging toll-house lantern
Take the narrow snow ledge past the upper lofts

nodes.title: The Inquiring Clerk
nodes.page: A toll-house window flies open with a sharp crack of frost-bound wood, and an irate clerk leans out into the gale to demand why your pack is humming so loudly. He squints through the driving sleet, his quill poised over a ledger while he questions whether your cargo requires an extra descent tariff. The bronze tongue knocks against your shoulder blades, its ancient note rising as if it answers the clerk's suspicious gaze.

nodes.brief: You squeeze through a narrow gap between two winch-shacks where the smell of warm pine tar fills the air.

exits.label: Follow the narrow snow ledge past the spinning lofts
Head toward the flickering lanterns of the guild stalls

nodes.title: The Tar-Scented Gap
nodes.page: You squeeze through a narrow gap between two timber winch-shacks where the thick, comforting smell of warm pine tar fills the damp air. The howling mountain wind drops away for a few blessed moments, replaced by the rhythmic creak of heavy machinery and the low murmur of off-duty cable-riders sharing a flask of barley spirit in the corner shadows. Biscuit brushes his flank against the rough planking as he follows you through the tight squeeze.

nodes.brief: A gray-bearded capstan-master named Hake points a scarred finger toward the flickering lanterns of the lower market.

exits.label: Walk toward the flickering lanterns of the guild stalls

nodes.title: The Capstan Master's Direction
nodes.page: A gray-bearded capstan-master named Hake points a scarred, leather-wrapped finger toward the flickering lanterns of the lower market, shouting over the grind of a distant brake-wheel. He tells you to watch the ground cables for sudden tension shifts as the evening cargo runs begin down the mountain. Biscuit cocks an ear at the deep groaning of the capstan gears while you map out your footing in the dim light.

nodes.brief: You drop into a sheltered timber trench where rope-scraps deaden the howling roar of the mountain wind.

exits.label: Approach the glowing canvas pavilion of the Knot-Oath Stall

nodes.title: The Timber Trench
nodes.page: You drop into a sheltered timber trench where discarded rope-scraps deaden the howling roar of the mountain wind into a hollow, distant sigh. The ground here is padded with springy hemp cuttings and thick strands of tarred coir that cushion Biscuit's hooves as he steps down beside you. For a moment, high stacked walls of surplus cable reels block the freezing draft, and you check the lashings on the bronze cradle before the next leg of the descent.

nodes.brief: A Cable Court runner brushes past you in the gloom, carrying urgent dispatches about the frozen pass gates.

exits.label: Approach the glowing canvas pavilion of the Knot-Oath Stall

nodes.title: The Urgent Dispatch
nodes.page: A Cable Court runner brushes past you in the gloom, their woolen cloak frosted with rime as they carry urgent dispatches about the frozen pass gates down toward the lower terraces. Their boots clatter sharply against the frozen deck timbers before the runner vanishes around a towering stack of Manila rope coils. The sudden rush of wind in their wake sets the bronze Clapper ringing a sharp warning note against your back.

nodes.brief: You navigate a web of crossed guy-lines that vibrate like harp strings in the rising evening gale.

exits.label: Seek safe passage inside the glowing canvas pavilion
Face the chief rope-master blocking the descent path

nodes.title: The Vibrating Web
nodes.page: You pick through a web of crossed guy-lines that shake like giant harp strings in the rising evening gale, each taut fiber taking a different pitch from the mountain wind. Your boots find purchase on the frozen decking between the vibrating strands while you keep a steady hand on Biscuit's halter to guide him through the singing wire maze. Ahead, the path narrows toward the main assembly tents where the ropewrights gather.

nodes.brief: A ropewright's apprentice named Lyra holds a smoking tallow torch to light your footing across the slippery boards.

exits.label: Follow the glowing torch toward the market stalls
Take the winding ramp past the spinning lofts

nodes.title: Torchlight Across The Planks
nodes.page:
Lyra holds a smoking tallow torch high above her head, the grease spitting orange sparks against the damp night air as she illuminates your footing across the frost-slicked wooden boards. The bronze Clapper shifts inside its padded cradle on your back and sends a faint deep shiver through your shoulder blades. Below your boots, the abyss drops away into utter blackness, broken only by the distant, blinking lights of the lower tiers swaying on their hemp tethers.

You shift your weight carefully, balancing the dead weight of the bell-tongue against the mountain draft while the torch casts long, flickering shadows over the splintered guardrails.

nodes.brief: You step around a massive iron winch-drum that groans as it lowers a cargo crate into the gray abyss.

exits.label: Pick your way toward the guild's central counter
Follow the packed snow ledge past the winch house

nodes.title: The Groaning Winch Drum
nodes.page:
Heavy iron gears grind against one another with a teeth-aching shriek as a massive winch-drum rotates, slowly lowering a slatted cargo crate down into the gray abyss of the gorge. You step wide around the turning cable, the vibration of the tensioned hemp singing directly through the soles of your boots and rattling the bronze Clapper in its pack. A thin skim of mountain rime coats the brass housing of the winch, catching the weak amber light of a nearby toll-lantern.

You keep your balance low against the wind, watching the cargo basket vanish into the clouds below while the winch-boy leans hard on the wooden brake lever.

nodes.brief: A toll-house lantern swings wildly overhead, casting long dancing shadows across your heavy bronze burden.

exits.label: Head toward the guild's central counter
Take the narrow snow path past the spinning lofts

nodes.title: Lanterns In The Gorge
nodes.page:
A brass toll-house lantern swings wildly on its chain overhead and throws long frantic arcs of light across the padded cradle and the bronze you carry. Frost crisps the edges of your woolen collar as the mountain wind funnels violently between the timber struts of the market bridge. Somewhere in the murky depths a winch-bell tolls once, hollow, as if answering the faint knock of the Clapper against your spine.

You brace your shoulders against the biting draft and fix your eyes on the narrow boardwalk ahead where the rope-masters' stalls crowd the cliff edge.

nodes.brief: You follow a narrow ledge of packed snow past the rear wall of the upper rope-spinning lofts.

exits.label: Descend toward the central guild counter
Approach the flickering lanterns of the stalls
Turn back toward the suspended market square

nodes.title: Snow Along The Lofts
nodes.page:
Cold packed snow crunches beneath your boots as you follow a narrow ledge hugging the rear wall of the upper rope-spinning lofts, where the sharp smell of tarred hemp hangs thick in the freezing air. Through the slatted wooden shutters of the loft above, pale lamplight spills across the drift-piled path, accompanied by the steady rhythmic whir of spinning wheels. The bronze Clapper shifts with a dull, muffled thud against your padded harness, reminding you of the ticking minutes before the passes ice over for good.

You pull your woolen cloak tighter around your chest, weighing the path ahead against the bustling market square behind you.

nodes.brief: A weary guard leans against a wooden post, pointing you toward the flickering lanterns of the guild stalls.

exits.label: Approach the glowing guild stalls ahead

nodes.title: The Weary Guard
nodes.page:
A weary guard leans heavily against a frost-rimed wooden post, blowing warm air into cupped leather gloves while pointing a mittened finger toward the cluster of flickering lanterns marking the guild stalls. The wind rattles the wooden signs overhead, where thick knots are painted in faded red and black to show the ropewrights' marks. Your shoulders ache under the bronze Clapper, yet the low vibration against your back still times your steps.

You nod a silent thanks to the sentry and step past the timber post into the drifting snow.

nodes.brief: You approach the glowing canvas pavilion of the Knot-Oath Stall where master ropewrights wait by the main cable hub.

exits.label: Press on into the stall

nodes.title: The Knot-Oath Pavilion
nodes.page:
Bright canvas walls snap and crack in the rising gale as you approach the glowing pavilion of the Knot-Oath Stall, where several master ropewrights wait silently by the main cable hub. Thick coils of yellow hemp line the tent posts like coiled serpents, smelling strongly of fish oil and pine pitch. One of the masters steps forward into the flickering light, his knuckles scarred from decades of hauling cordage, his eyes locked on the bronze burden strapped across your shoulders.

You come to a halt in the shelter of the canvas awning, feeling the intense scrutiny of the guild elders.

nodes.brief: The master of the Knot-Oath Stall steps out from hemp curtains, offering safe passage in exchange for a binding promise.

exits.label: Press on past the curtains

nodes.title: Hemp Curtains And Oaths
nodes.page:
Hemp curtains part abruptly, and the master of the Knot-Oath Stall steps into the biting draft with an offer of safe passage down the mountain for a single binding promise tied in cord. The lantern light catches the silver threads woven through the master's woolen stole, marking him as a man of high standing among the cable-riders. The bronze Clapper hums softly against your spine, as if warning you against binding your word to hands that profit from every toll.

You stand before the parting curtain, considering the cost of a safe descent through the frozen gates.

nodes.brief: You halt before the guild's central counter where a knotted hemp cord hangs like a judge's scale in the lamplight.

exits.label: Press on to the counter

nodes.title: The Central Guild Counter
nodes.page:
You halt before the guild's central counter of polished oak, where a single knotted hemp cord hangs suspended like a judge's scale in the flickering lamplight. Several apprentices murmur quietly behind the timber barrier, sorting through ledgers weighed down with iron tokens and chunks of raw tin. The air smells of cold iron and dry grass, and the Clapper tips you a fraction off balance as you wait for someone to acknowledge your approach.

You rest your hands on the edge of the frosty counter, watching the swinging cord dance in the draft.

nodes.brief: The chief rope-master blocks your path with an outstretched cord, demanding your knot-oath before you descend any further.

exits.label: Press on past the barrier

nodes.title: The Chief Rope-Master
nodes.page:
The chief rope-master blocks your path with an outstretched length of tarred cord, demanding your formal knot-oath before you are permitted to descend any further down the cliff stairs. His weather-beaten face is expressionless beneath a heavy fur cap, and his calloused hands hold the cord taut between his knuckles like a tripwire. The wind howls through the gorge behind him, carrying the distant metallic ring of Lowgate's anvils far below in the freezing gloom.

You stand toe-to-toe with the guild leader while the bronze Clapper knocks an urgent warning against your back.

nodes.title: The Skein-Master
nodes.page:
On the sun-bleached hemp catwalk of the outer rope market, an old skein-master ties a double-carrick bend around your bronze cargo frame to test its lashing strength. His weathered fingers move with practiced speed, pulling the tarred strands taut until the bronze Clapper seats hard against your leather harness. He grunts in brief approval before tapping the knot with a wooden mallet.

The cliff winds buffet the open walkway, carrying the sharp scent of pine pitch and the distant rhythmic groan of heavy winches operating further down the precipice. You adjust your footing on the slatted timber, weighing your next route through the maze of hanging platforms and cordage bazaars.

nodes.title: The Hemp-Store Warmth
nodes.page:
In the damp shade of the hemp-store, a winch-apprentice named Garrow offers you a steaming mug of pine-needle tea while you inspect the frayed hauling lines ahead. The air here smells of cool grease and stored fibre, offering a brief respite from the biting mountain gale outside. He points out a cluster of thinning strands on your pack harness, advising you to reinforce the binding before tackling the steeper slopes below.

Outside the shadowed doorway, the market paths fork sharply between high-tariff toll houses and open public catwalks, leaving your next move entirely open.

nodes.title: The Larch Plank Crossing
nodes.page: Beneath a canopy of swinging hemp coils, you balance the heavy Clapper across a trembling larch plank while winch-boys haul salted tallow overhead. The wood groans rhythmically underfoot, echoing the deep, resonant vibration of the bronze tongue against your shoulder blades. Drops of cold grease patter down from the overhead cables like untimely rain, slicking the timber surface.

nodes.title: The Cordwainer's Measure
nodes.page:
Amidst the clatter of spinning jennies, a master cordwainer measures your bronze load against the spanning limits of the middle gorge. He runs a calloused thumb along the edge of your metal frame, muttering about standard weight clearances and municipal toll fees. The workshop hums with the relentless motion of vertical spindles and the dry rustle of twisted flax.

Beyond his workbench, several narrow routes diverge into the misty expanse of the hanging markets, each presenting its own challenge for a burdened traveler.

nodes.title: The Hawser-Tender's Warning
nodes.page:
On a platform dangling above the abyss, a grease-stained hawser-tender warns you that the wind-whistle through the wire is screaming foul tonight. He secures a loose iron turnbuckle with a sharp blow from his iron-headed hammer, pointing down toward the mist-shrouded drops. The freezing air bites at your cheeks, carrying the metallic tang of strained steel and wet hemp.

Every cable around you vibrates on a high pitch, and the bronze Clapper answers with a matching note against your back.

nodes.title: The Tarred Scraps
nodes.page:
Beside a bin of tarred hemp scraps, you mend a chafed shoulder strap while a market crier advertises three-ply hemp for a groat. The pungent aroma of pitch fills your lungs as you knot the replacement cord with cold, stiff fingers. Around you, the bustling trade of the rope markets continues unabated, with porters shouting warnings and mules stamping on wooden ramps.

You finish securing the strap and eye the branching paths that lead deeper into the vertical labyrinth.

nodes.title: The Guild-Tied Passage
nodes.page:
Because your guild-tied rope gleams with standard blue twine, the platform-warden waves you straight past the tariff barrier without checking your copper purse. He nods respectfully toward the bronze Clapper on your back, recognizing the mark of Orisonhold craftsmanship. The cleared path stretches out ahead, free of the usual congestion and bickering toll-collectors.

With a hand on the mule's neck, you walk on into the quieter sector reserved for recognized guild travelers.

nodes.title: The Timber Drum
nodes.page:
Within the echoing hollow of a giant timber drum, you rest your tired mule while overhead cables sing an icy counterpoint to the bronze. The massive wooden wheel slowly revolves, driven by unseen weights somewhere deep within the mountain's rocky core. Dust motes dance in the shafts of pale light piercing the planking joints, illuminating your breath in the chill air.

The steady mechanical pulse offers a moment of calm before you must guide your animal back out into the open air.

nodes.title: The Spun-Yarn Vendor
nodes.page:
Across a catwalk of woven wire, a spun-yarn vendor named Jael trades gossip about the broken bridge further down the gorge. She gestures with a skein of yellow twine toward a cluster of anxious travelers gathered near the lower winches. The wire mesh flexes slightly beneath your boots with every shift of weight, reminding you of the thousands of feet of empty air below.

You listen to her warnings about the delayed repairs while deciding whether to investigate the rumor firsthand.

nodes.title: The Sisal Hand-Cart
nodes.page:
In a narrow alcove hung with tallow buckets, you dodge a careening hand-cart loaded with heavy sisal bundles. The frantic push-boy calls out an apology as he rattles past, his wooden wheels squeaking against the frozen rime on the floor. You press flat against the damp stone wall, keeping your precious bronze burden clear of the passing cargo.

Once the cart clears the narrow passage, the way opens up toward several different bustling market alleyures.

nodes.title: The Oiler's Staging Post
nodes.page:
High winds whistle across the exposed timber platform as an oiler named Corin dips a stiff hog-bristle brush into an iron pail of tallow. He splashes machine grease directly onto your cradle runners with a wet slap, keeping the salt-air spray from seizing your iron fittings. The bronze Clapper shifts against your spine, dead metal whose low note matches the vibration of the tensioned cables all around you.

Corin wipes his greasy palms on his canvas apron and nods toward three separate paths leading deeper into the roaring market maze. You can head down the smoking tar-row, watch the mail-baskets cross the gorge, or seek shelter from the rising sleet.

nodes.title: The Unmonitored Hatch
nodes.page:
Plain unbranded hemp binds your simple carrying frame, lacking any flashy guild seal or stamped brass token. Because you carry only ordinary frayed cordage rather than the expensive imported flax, the busy toll-inspectors dismiss you as a local errand-runner and wave you right past their checkpoint. You slip through an unmonitored maintenance hatch behind a stack of spare winches and leave the noisy customs queue behind in the freezing mist.

The narrow service catwalk trembles underfoot and opens three ways away from the gatehouse before anyone looks twice at your burden.

nodes.title: The Flax-Fringe Rations
nodes.page:
Fluttering strands of pale grey flax hang like a damp curtain overhead, catching the moisture off the mountain wall. Beneath this natural shelter, you share a tough strip of dried mutton with an exhausted winch-tender named Hasty, whose fingers are permanently stained with hemp-oil and iron-dust. The two of you chew in silence while the great capstans groan above the market square, hauling invisible tons of cargo through the grey cloud-bank.

Hasty points a calloused thumb toward the lower tiers as soon as the last gristle is gone, indicating two routes deeper into the clamour of the rope-markets.

nodes.brief: Over a chasm of grey mist, a swaying rope-bridge dips sharply under the weight of an oncoming mule train.

exits.label: Pick your way past the tangled guy-ropes
Cross the split-pine bridge toward the guard

nodes.title: The Swinging Bridge
nodes.page:
Grey mist rolls up from the unfathomable depth of the gorge as a swaying rope-bridge dips sharply beneath your boots. A train of pack mules clatters onto the opposite end of the span, their iron-shod hooves striking the pine planks with a hollow, vibrating rhythm that threatens to knock you off balance. You press your shoulder against the cold cliff wall and lock the cradle while the canvas-wrapped Clapper answers the bridge's violent sway.

The mule train passes with a smell of wet leather and sweat, leaving you a choice between the upper guy-wires and the guarded foot-bridge ahead.

nodes.brief: In the shadow of a giant turning capstan, you tighten your hip-belt as the bronze Clapper gives a low, sympathetic thrum.

exits.label: Follow the massive braided towline down

nodes.title: The Turning Capstan
nodes.page:
A giant oak capstan turns with a rhythmic creak that shakes the very rock under your heels, its grease-blackened drum hauling miles of hidden cable through the mountain stone. You stop in its deep shadow to tighten your slipping hip-belt, adjusting the weight of the bronze Clapper against your tired back. As the massive wooden gear completes another rotation, the metal tongue inside your cradle knocks once and the knock travels straight through your ribs.

The path leads onward beside the open machinery pit where the main towline feeds into the dark interior of the cliff.

nodes.brief: Beside a stacking yard of creosoted poles, a market bailiff checks your cargo tags for the proper municipal stamp.

exits.label: Step past the open winch-pit and towline
Approach the split-pine foot-bridge and guard

nodes.title: The Stacking Yard
nodes.page:
Creosoted pine poles are stacked in neat, pitch-scented pyramids beside the cliff edge, dripping black tears in the cold air. A market bailiff in a stiff wool coat intercepts you here, tapping a wooden tally-stick against your cargo frame while checking your straps for the proper municipal stamp. He squints at the canvas covering the heavy bronze tongue, weighing your papers against the regulations of the Cable Court.

The bailiff finally shrugs and gestures toward the machinery workings, giving you a clear run toward the lower levels.

nodes.brief: Across an open lattice of larch beams, you dodge the whipping tail of a slackened tow-line that hums like an angry hornet.

exits.label: Walk beside the open winch-pit
Step into the sheltered alcove of hemp bales
Head toward the boiling vat of black pitch

nodes.title: The Lattice Beams
nodes.page:
An open lattice of larch beams provides a dizzying view of the cloud-filled void far below your boots. Without warning, a slackened tow-line snaps upward with a vicious crack, its whipping steel tail hissing through the air like an angry hornet just inches from your canvas pack. You duck and cling to the wet timbers as the bronze Clapper knocks a sharp warning against your spine.

The vibrating framework settles back into place, leaving three narrow paths branching out across the scaffolding.

nodes.brief: Within a cavernous salt-shed, you brush white crusts off your leather boots while hawser-spinners chant rhythmically at their wheels.

exits.label: Step out onto the exposed stone staging
Move toward the boiling vat of black pitch

nodes.title: The Salt-Shed
nodes.page:
Coarse white salt crystals coat the floor of the cavernous shed, crunching like dry snow under your leather boots as you brush the crusts from your hem. Deep in the gloom, a row of hawser-spinners chant rhythmically together, their weathered hands feeding damp hemp fibres into spinning wheels with hypnotic speed. The salty air bites at your throat, but the draft is sheltered from the worst of the mountain gale.

Two narrow exits pierce the back wall of the shed, one leading out to an exposed stone staging and the other toward the boiling pitch-vats.

nodes.brief: On a high ledge overlooking the lower precipice, a pulley-repairer hones a draw-knife near your mule's twitching ears.

exits.label: Walk past the boiling pitch-vat
Enter the vaulted transit shed ahead

nodes.title: The Ledge Repairer
nodes.page:
A pulley-repairer sits upon a high stone ledge overlooking the lower precipice, rhythmically whetting a razor-sharp draw-knife against an oiled oilstone. The metallic scraping sound rings close to your mule's twitching ears, making the animal sidestep nervously toward the sheer drop. You grab the halter-rope with one hand while steadying the heavy cradle with the other, keeping your footing secure on the frosted rock.

The repairer dips his chin toward two routes leading further down the mountain face.

nodes.brief: Beneath a web of guide-wires, a shivering child thrusts a handful of dried juniper berries toward your pocket for a half-penny.

exits.label: Step out onto the exposed stone staging
Follow the suspension cables across the gap

nodes.title: The Juniper Child
nodes.page:
A web of thin guide-wires sings a high, eerie note overhead in the mountain draft as a shivering child steps out from behind a winch-house. The small figure thrusts a handful of bruised, purple juniper berries toward your pocket, whispering a plea for a half-penny to buy a warm bowl of barley broth. Blue-cold fingers clutch the berries while bright watchful eyes rake over your cradle with sharp curiosity.

You murmur a brief refusal and look past the child to the two paths stretching out across the dizzying network of cables.

Below your boots, the mountain drops away into grey nothingness, and every plank groans under the sudden pressure of the shifting gale.

You shift the burden on your back, watching the neat stitches form a sturdy collar against the chafing canvas.

Biscuit plants all four hooves and lets out a stubborn, rattling snort that echoes off the cliff face. You tug gently on the halter rope, smelling the thick petroleum and wet stone while the mist clings to your wool sleeves.

nodes.title: The Void Archway
nodes.page: Within the drafty archway of a cable-house, you peer down into the grey void where the river foams three hundred feet below. Iron machinery clanks in the gloom above, and hot grease smells sharp in the damp air. You grip the stone doorframe with cold fingers, waiting for the gust to ease before you venture further along the precipice.

The thin wooden bridge pitches sharply underfoot, forcing you to grab the guide-ropes with both hands to keep the cradle steady. Around you the great network of lines twangs under every mountain draft.

nodes.title: Tar-Pot Breath
nodes.page: Beside a row of smoking tar-pots, you catch your breath while an overseer berates a lazy pulley-boy. Thick blue smoke drifts across the platform, stinging your eyes and smelling strongly of boiling resin and pine pitch. You rest a hand against the warm iron rim of a kettle, letting the heat thaw your stiffening fingers before moving on.

You duck your head as the dangling iron hardware clears your canvas pack by mere inches.

Through the cloth the metal pulses a low beat that seems to match your own tired heartbeat. Outside, the storm whips the hanging ropes into a whistling frenzy, making the wooden walls tremble from floor to rafter.

nodes.page: On a platform clamped directly to the cliff, a winch-master named Bran argues loudly with a toll-clerk over grease tariffs. His face is red with cold and anger, and his calloused hands gesture wildly toward a stack of dry hemp cables. You stand quietly near the edge of the boards, keeping the mule calm while the shouting bounces off the stone walls.

nodes.title: The Loose Spike
nodes.page: Beneath a tangled canopy of guy-ropes, your mule's hoof strikes a loose iron spike with a sharp metallic ring. Biscuit stumbles slightly on the uneven planking, tossing his head and rattling the iron harness rings in the quiet gloom. You reach out to soothe the animal's flank, checking the straps of the bronze cradle to ensure nothing has shaken loose.

nodes.title: The Hollow Drum
nodes.page:
Beside an open winch-pit, you watch a massive braided towline wind slowly onto a hollow oak drum. The greasy hemp groans under heavy tension, spraying a fine mist of cold water into your face as the gear teeth grind together with rhythmic regularity. The Clapper ticks against your spine in time with the turning machinery.

You weigh your options against the biting mountain wind, looking for a way past the watchful toll-houses ahead.

nodes.brief: Across a vibrating foot-bridge of split pine, a market guard taps his brass-headed truncheon against your bronze cradle.

nodes.title: The Split Pine Bridge
nodes.page:
Across a vibrating foot-bridge of split pine, a market guard taps his brass-headed truncheon against your bronze cradle. The abyss yawns far below through the gaps in the timber slats, smelling of old hemp and melting glacier ice. Your boots find firm purchase on the frost-slipped planks while the guard eyes the load on your back with cold professional suspicion.

A second path branches off toward the narrow interiors of the station, where shadows stretch long across the wooden walls.

nodes.title: The Hemp Bales
nodes.page:
Within a sheltered alcove of hemp bales, you wipe condensation from your brow while checking your harness buckles. The air smells strongly of tar and dried flax, offering a brief respite from the howling gale outside the canvas screens. Your mule shifts its weight uneasily against the rough fiber stacks, rattling its leather tackle in the dim, dusty enclosure.

Beyond the stack, the heavy iron plate of the tax-office threshold gleams under a sliver of gray light.

nodes.title: The Exposed Staging
nodes.page:
On an exposed stone staging, a mountain gust catches the Clapper and nearly knocks you off your feet. You stagger against the low parapet as icy air claws at your cloak and threatens to pitch you into the vast, empty gorge below. The bronze tongue strikes a sharp warning against your shoulder blades until you dig your boots into the gritty stone.

Ahead lies the high porch of the Cable Court, guarded by figures wrapped in thick wool.

nodes.title: The Boiling Pitch
nodes.page: Beside a boiling vat of waterproofing pitch, an apprentice stirs the black brew with a notched pine paddle. Thick, acrid smoke curls up into the open air, stinging your eyes and mixing with the cold mountain drafts. The bubbling resin pops rhythmically, casting oily glints across the timber framing of the lower stalls.

nodes.title: The Suspension Cables
nodes.page:
Across a network of sagging suspension cables, you follow a sure-footed porter carrying crates of dried lichen. Every step causes the iron wires to sing in a high, metallic register that sets your teeth on edge. Below your dangling boots, the misty void drops away into dizzying depths where the lower stair-towns vanish into cloud cover.

Several routes diverge from the far anchorage, offering passage through the maze of offices and checkpoints.

nodes.title: The Unhewn Granite
nodes.page:
Within a vaulted transit shed, you rest your aching shoulders against a cold pillar of unhewn granite. The stone is slick with condensation, drawing the heat straight out of your wool tunic as you catch your breath. Outside the wide archway, the clamor of the rope markets echoes off the canyon walls in a chaotic wave of shouting voices and clanking iron.

You can press forward into the administrative quarters or retrace your steps toward the spinning jennies.

nodes.title: The Brass Gauge
nodes.page:
On a frost-rimed wooden gallery, a toll-collector measures the thickness of your hauling lines with a brass gauge. His fingers are stiff with cold, yet he works with practiced precision, sliding the metal tool along your worn hemp ropes before jotting figures down in a leather-bound ledger. The bronze Clapper answers the scrape of his pen with a soft knock of its own.

The gallery continues toward the heart of the toll operations, dividing into two distinct checkpoints.

nodes.title: The Narrow Maintenance Gap
nodes.page:
Because you travel unburdened by the stubborn mule today, you easily squeeze through a narrow maintenance gap that blocks all pack-trains. The rough stone walls press close against your shoulders, forcing you to turn sideways and edge forward in absolute darkness. Cool air drafts through the fissure from the gorge below, guiding your hands along the damp, mossy rock face until you emerge into a narrow alley behind the main administrative block.

The alley opens out directly before the central checkpoint where travelers settle their accounts.

nodes.brief: Beside a stack of cedar shingles, an old rope-grader shakes his head at the salt damage on your leather frame.

exits.label: Enter the narrow hallway of the toll-station
Face the bronze-studded wicket of the central toll-house

nodes.title: The Cedar Shingles
nodes.page:
Beside a stack of cedar shingles, an old rope-grader shakes his head at the salt damage on your leather frame. He runs a calloused thumb over the frayed straps holding your heavy bronze cargo, warning you that the mountain moisture will rot the stitching before you reach Lowgate. The smell of fresh-cut cedar provides a clean contrast to the greasy tang of the surrounding cable works.

Two different thoroughfares branch out from the shingle stack, leading past the various desks and wickets.

nodes.brief: On the final approach to the checkpoint, a Cable Court sergeant blocks your path with a heavy iron-bound ledger.

exits.label: Sign the ledger to pass

nodes.title: The Iron Ledger
nodes.page: Heavy iron-bound ledgers slap against the wooden counter as a Cable Court sergeant blocks your narrow path with a scowl. Frost rimes his shoulder-clasps while he demands an immediate transit tally for the bronze burden strapped across your spine. Inside its padded cradle the Clapper knocks faintly, a low bronze note under the freezing wind that whistles through the gorge cables. You shift your weight on the wooden planks, feeling the bite of the leather harness while the sergeant dips his steel pen into a horn of black ink.

nodes.brief: Before the triple-bolted gates of the toll-house, you wait while a clerk weighs a merchant's silver against standard scale.

exits.label: Step forward to settle your toll

nodes.title: Silver and Scale
nodes.page: Triple-bolted gates of the high toll-house loom before you, barring any careless descent toward Lowgate. You wait patiently in the biting draft while a tired clerk weighs a merchant's heavy silver coins against a standard brass scale. The metallic clink echoes off the granite face of the cliff, competing with the distant grinding of the ropeway winches. Behind you the padded cradle gives a faint note that carries, and anyone nearby can hear the sacred metal you haul.

nodes.brief: In the shadow of the tall granite customs tower, the air smells sharply of wet hemp and cold ledger ink.

exits.label: Offer your credentials to the clerks
Slip past the counter toward the stairs

nodes.title: Ink and Hemp
nodes.page: Sharp scents of wet hemp and cold ledger ink hang thick in the shadow of the tall granite customs tower. A pair of toll-clerks argue in low whispers over a tangled knot of hemp rope used to secure stray cargo crates. Freezing mountain air nips your fingers as you hitch the leather frame that holds the Clapper. Every movement on these suspension bridges requires care, especially with the Cable Court watching from their high windows.

nodes.brief: Beside the toll-house warden's high desk, a brass bell chimes whenever a new traveler steps onto the platform.

exits.label: Present your travel permit for review
Negotiate a lower fee for the journey
Pay your way with hard silver groats
Turn back toward the upper ropeways

nodes.title: The Toll-House Bell
nodes.page: High overhead, a small brass bell chimes a sharp warning note whenever a new traveler steps onto the swinging platform. Beside the toll-house warden's high desk, stacked ledgers threaten to topple into the abyss below. You steady the cradle on your back while the warden looks up from his papers, eyeing the bronze tongue with professional suspicion. The cold air bites through your woolen tunic, making every breath plume like wood-smoke.

nodes.brief: Across the iron-plated threshold of the tax-office, you hear the scratch of steel nibs recording every pound of transit bronze.

exits.label: Hand your transit papers to the clerk
Empty your heavy purse of earned groats
Turn back toward the upper ropeways

nodes.title: The Tax-Office Threshold
nodes.page: Iron-plated thresholds rattle underfoot as you step across the entrance of the crowded tax-office. The frantic scratch of steel nibs fills the room, recording every single pound of transit bronze that passes down the mountain. You keep your posture rigid, though the Clapper taps a warning against your shoulder blades. Outside the frosted windows, the rope-markets sway gently in the grip of the ice-wind.

nodes.brief: Within the narrow hallway of the toll-station, a debt-collector sharpens his quill while eyeing your bronze Clapper's cradle.

exits.label: Agree to their steep credit terms
Empty your heavy purse of earned groats

nodes.title: The Debt-Collector
nodes.page: Narrow hallways of the stone toll-station smell of old tallow and stagnant breath. A debt-collector sharpens a goose-quill with a small curved knife while eyeing the bronze Clapper's padded cradle with predatory hunger. His ledger lies open to a page filled with daunting figures and red ink marks. A knock from the bronze tongue seems to agitate him. His hand pauses mid-stroke.

nodes.brief: On the windswept porch of the Cable Court, an armed bailiff bars your advance until your transit fee is settled.

exits.label: Empty your heavy purse of earned groats
Pay the toll with your remaining silver

nodes.title: The Armed Bailiff
nodes.page: Windswept wooden porches creak alarmingly under the boots of the Cable Court guards. An armed bailiff steps squarely into your path, his heavy halberd barring your advance until the transit fee is settled in full. The gorge below opens up in a dizzying drop of grey mist and frozen cables. You grip the straps of your burden, calculating whether you can slip past his reach before the winch-boys sound the alarm.

nodes.brief: Facing the bronze-studded wicket of the central toll-house, you prepare to settle your account with the gorge authorities.

exits.label: Pay the toll with your remaining silver

nodes.title: The Bronze Wicket
nodes.page: Bronze-studded wickets of the central toll-house gleam dully in the pale mountain light. You stand before the reinforced barrier, preparing to settle your account with the formidable gorge authorities once and for all. The Clapper knocks against your spine, restless for the foundry at Lowgate and done with this bureaucratic cage. Every second spent here costs warmth and daylight.

nodes.brief: At the Cable Court toll-house desk, you accept their bitter loan agreement, sealing a heavy debt with a fingerprint in red wax.

exits.label: Press on down the mountain stairs

nodes.title: The Red Wax Seal
nodes.page: Cable Court toll-house desks are cluttered with ink-pots and binding twine as you finally accept their bitter loan agreement. A heavy red wax seal is pressed firmly onto the parchment, binding you to a mountainous debt that will take years to sweat away in Lowgate. The clerk nods coldly, handing you the transit token with fingers like dry twigs. The humming Clapper on your back feels suddenly heavier, burdened by the weight of your own signature.

nodes.brief: Inside the cramped ledger-room of the toll-house, you sign the Cable Court's credit bond while a silent clerk notes your name for the repo-men.

exits.label: Press on down the mountain stairs

nodes.title: The Silent Clerk
nodes.page: Cramped ledger-rooms stifle your breath with the smell of old dust and damp wool. You scratch your name into the Cable Court's credit bond while a silent clerk notes your description line by line for the repo-men waiting at the lower gates. The scratch of his pen sounds like insects gnawing through dry timber in the quiet room. With the stroke finished, he pushes a brass transit disk across the scarred wood toward you.

nodes.brief: Before the high iron grating of the toll-house, you empty your heavy purse of earned groats to clear the crossing fee in hard cash.

exits.label: Step through the gate and press on

nodes.title: The Toll Counter
nodes.page:
Cold iron grates against your knuckles as you empty a heavy leather pouch of earned groats onto the high wooden desk. Coins clink and scatter across the grain while the clerk's ink-stained fingers sweep them into a brass bowl to clear the crossing fee in hard cash.

Behind you, Biscuit shifts restlessly on the swaying boards, hoof-nails scraping a hollow rhythm against the gorge below. You square your shoulders against the biting mountain draft and grip the cradle straps, ready for the path ahead.

nodes.brief: On the polished stone counter of the customs booth, you count out your last silver coins to pay the toll and keep your name off the loan ledgers.

exits.label: Leave the booth and press on

nodes.title: Silver Clearance
nodes.page:
Smooth polished stone yields beneath your fingertips at the customs booth while you count out your last gleaming silver coins one by one. The toll-master nods curtly and pockets the fee to keep your name far from the binding ink of the loan ledgers.

The air tastes of resin and old hemp in this narrow corridor suspended between cloud and stone. With your purse lighter but your conscience clear of debt, you eye the swaying ropeway stretching out toward the next tier.

nodes.brief: You step out from the toll-house shadows onto a swaying hemp walkway where winch-master Joram weighs your bronze clapper with greedy, narrowed eyes.

exits.label: Follow the upper cable toward the northern winches
Cut across the narrow maintenance plank to the left
Descend the steep ladder toward the lower market tier

nodes.title: The Winch-Master's Eye
nodes.page:
Harsh daylight hits your eyes as you step out from the damp toll-house shadows onto a swaying hemp walkway. Winch-master Joram stands by the groaning machinery, weighing your bronze clapper with greedy, narrowed eyes that calculate the worth of its metal.

The heavy cradle digs into your aching shoulders while the bridge rocks under a sudden gust from the gorge. Iron gears shriek behind the master as he gestures toward the branching pathways spanning the dizzying heights.

nodes.brief: Beneath your heavy cradle, the market boards creak over the bottomless gorge while clerk Nesta records your unpaid debt in a frozen ledger.

exits.label: Pick your way along the outer market rim

exits.privWhy: the reader carries only their own old rope and so is overlooked or underestimated
exits.label: Slip past the checkpoint as an insignificant traveler
Take the tallow-soaked twine offered by the frantic boy

nodes.title: The Frozen Ledger
nodes.page:
Weathered market boards creak under your cradle and take up the roar of the bottomless gorge below. Clerk Nesta stands by a frosted window, her quill scratching a sharp warning into a frozen ledger as she logs your unpaid debt.

Frost patterns spiderweb across the glass while the shadow of the great mountain looms larger in the late afternoon chill. You adjust the straps of your burden and look out over the complex web of ropes stretching into the mist.

nodes.brief: Shivering on a suspension bridge of braided flax, you dodge a careering cargo basket hauling tallow barrels toward the upper tiers.

exits.label: Enter the suspended timber gallery
Confront Master weaver Elden on the narrow plankway
Duck beneath the overhead trestle as draft mules pass

nodes.title: The Flax Bridge
nodes.page:
Frigid winds whip across a suspension bridge woven entirely from pale, braided flax that vibrates like a harp string. You flatten your back against the swaying rail to dodge a careering cargo basket hauling smoking tallow barrels toward the upper tiers.

Frost glazes the fibrous handlines while the bronze clapper presses a cool note against your spine. Below your boots, the cloud line breaks to reveal dizzying drops of sheer gray stone.

nodes.brief: Old Sula intercepts you near a stall of salted hides, warning that the Cable Court's collectors have blockaded the middle winch-platforms.

exits.privWhy: the reader carries a Ropewrights' Guild rope and is waved through guild places
exits.label: Flash your Guild token to the rope-guards
Hide in the alcove behind the tallow-chandler's booth
Watch the frozen pulley shower sparks from above

nodes.title: The Hide Market
nodes.page:
Pungent smells of salted hides and wet wool fill the narrow alley where old Sula catches your sleeve with wrinkled fingers. She warns in a raspy whisper that the Cable Court enforcers have blockaded the middle winch-platforms ahead.

Sacks of coarse salt stack high against the canvas walls, forming a dark labyrinth of stalls that shelter you from the biting wind. The low drone of the great bell miles above still echoes faintly through the canyon walls.

nodes.brief: A gust of mountain wind rattles the hanging bazaar's canvas awnings, threatening to pitch your heavy bronze burden into the white mist.

exits.label: Duck beneath the shower of sparks from the pulley
Accept the warm chicory water from apprentice Kenal
Crawl beneath the slumping trestle where weavers work

nodes.title: The Canvas Awnings
nodes.page:
Wild gusts of mountain wind tear at the canvas awnings of the hanging bazaar, sending sharp cracks echoing across the white mist. Your bronze burden shifts awkwardly and nearly pitches you and your load backward into the empty air.

Rope-threads fray against the anchor posts while merchants scramble to secure their swinging wares with double knots. You plant your boots firmly into the groaning pine planks and search for a stable footing.

nodes.brief: You squeeze past a knot-binder's stall where apprentices test hemp tensile strength against iron weights hung over the abyss.

exits.label: Approach toll-keeper Vane at the iron turnstile
Press flat against the bridge as an updraft hits
Skirt the edge of the great wicker sorting pit
Step toward the quiet corner near the lower winches

nodes.title: The Wicker Sorting Pit
nodes.page:
Rough wicker fencing presses against your ribs as you squeeze past a bustling knot-binder's stall filled with coils of hemp. Apprentices test tensile strength by hooking heavy iron weights over the edge and letting them swing out above the abyss.

The sharp scent of tar and dry grass hangs thick in the cold air between the high market stalls. Every rope in this bazaar takes a different pitch from the wind, a restless chord that sets your teeth on edge.

nodes.brief: Because your pack contains only simple worn hemp, the toll-clerks wave you past their gate as an insignificant pauper carrying no taxable prize.

exits.label: Take the lower stair toward the misty abyss
Dodge the swinging freight basket and dart left
Watch the guildmaster inspect the iron cable

priv.why: the reader carries only their own old rope and so is overlooked or underestimated

nodes.title: The Untaxed Pauper's Gate
nodes.page:
Toll-clerks peer out from their frost-rimed wooden booth, their eyes sweeping over your travel-worn pack and the simple length of ordinary hemp coiled on your shoulder. Because you carry no precious metal or dutiable cargo to tempt their greed, they dismiss you with a lazy wave of a mittened hand, letting you slip past the barrier without a sideways glance. The bustling market lane opens wider ahead, choked with the smell of pine tar and wet wool.

You adjust your heavy burden as the icy wind howls through the rigging above, wondering which path through the hanging bazaar will take you deeper into the gorge.

nodes.brief: A frantic winch-boy named Tolly thrusts a handful of tallow-soaked twine into your palm, begging you to inspect a frayed anchor-line.

exits.label: Step clear of the capstan and run right
Pause to help the boy mend the line
Face the blind squall along the limestone wall
Balance across the narrow fir pole bridge

nodes.title: The Frantic Winch-Boy's Plea
nodes.page: A frantic winch-boy named Tolly intercepts you near the capstan house, thrusting a handful of tallow-soaked twine directly into your numb palm. He begs you to inspect a frayed anchor-line that threatens to snap beneath the dangling cargo baskets. The cold air bites at your cheeks while the boy chatters nervously about the rising gale-force winds battering the market platforms.

nodes.brief: You navigate a suspended timber gallery where resin-smelling coils are stacked like dark sleeping serpents against the sheer cliff face.

exits.label: Scramble across the dripping timber gantry

nodes.title: The Suspended Timber Gallery
nodes.page:
You navigate a suspended timber gallery where towering stacks of resin-smelling coils rest against the sheer, dripping mountain face like dark sleeping serpents. The wooden planks groan under your boots with every step, vibrating with the distant thunder of the massive cable winches hauling freight between the hanging towns.

The damp chill clings to your clothes while you look for a way through the tangle of ropes.

nodes.brief: Master weaver Elden blocks the narrow plankway with a bundle of wire-cored cables, demanding double toll for any bronze passing through.

exits.label: Scramble across the wet gantry timber
Crawl through the greasy drainage chute

nodes.title: The Wire-Cored Toll
nodes.page:
Master weaver Elden plants his boots across the narrow plankway, burying his calloused hands in a bundle of stiff, wire-cored cables that hum faintly in the high wind. The old man narrows his eyes at the heavy canvas cradle on your back, where the bronze tongue rests, and demands double toll for any metal passing through his gate. Biscuit lowers his stubborn head, huffing a cloud of warm steam into the freezing air as the cable-tensions groan around you.

Elden taps his iron-shod staff against the timber deck. Coin sits cold in your palm; the gorge wind pulls at the cradle straps.

nodes.brief: A sudden team of heavy draft mules clatters across the overhead trestle, showering your shoulders with frozen grit and loose horseshoe nails.

exits.label: Follow the mule tracks toward the canvas tent
Careen down the sloped central tramway
Accept the greasy protective leather pad

nodes.title: The Heavy Draft Mules
nodes.page:
A sudden team of heavy draft mules clatters across the overhead trestle, their iron-shod hooves showering your shoulders with frozen grit and loose horseshoe nails. You press yourself tightly against the freezing limestone wall as the beasts thunder past, their breath pluming white in the thin mountain air.

The clatter fades into the howling wind, leaving you standing at a slippery junction in the market walkways.

nodes.brief: Because you bear the Guild's sacred knotted token, the rope-guards snap their splicing mallets to attention and clear a direct passage across the gorge.

exits.label: Hurry down the sloped central tramway
Meet the heavily laden ore basket at the platform

priv.why: the reader carries a Ropewrights' Guild rope and is waved through guild places

nodes.title: The Guild's Knotted Token
nodes.page:
Because you bear the Ropewrights' Guild's sacred knotted token proudly displayed on your jacket, the armed rope-guards snap their splicing mallets to attention as you approach. They clear a direct, unimpeded passage across the swaying gorge bridge, nodding respectfully to the heavy burden you carry.

The open walkway stretches before you, free of the usual tolls and delays that plague ordinary travelers in this hanging market.

nodes.brief: You slip into an alcove behind a tallow-chandler's booth while two Cable Court enforcers argue over ledger tallies in the freezing drizzle.

exits.label: Squirm through the greasy drainage chute
Approach the canvas watch-tent cautiously
Take the leather pad from the old braider

nodes.title: The Hidden Alcove
nodes.page:
You slip quietly into a narrow alcove behind a tallow-chandler's booth while two Cable Court enforcers angrily argue over ledger tallies in the freezing drizzle. Their voices echo off the damp rock face, discussing tax rates and seized bronze with menacing intensity.

Crouched in the shadows with your heavy burden, you wait for them to clear the path ahead.

nodes.brief: A frozen pulley screeches overhead, showering sparks onto the canvas roof above your head as a heavy timber crate swings past.

exits.label: Step toward the busy winch-station platform
Press flat against the shadowed alcove wall

nodes.title: The Screeching Pulley
nodes.page:
A frozen pulley screeches overhead, showering bright orange sparks onto the canvas roof above your head as a heavy timber crate swings violently past on a frayed tow-line. The acrid scent of burning hemp smoke fills the air while workers shout warnings back and forth across the chasm.

You need to pick your footing carefully before another stray crate comes hurtling out of the fog.

nodes.brief: Apprentice Kenal offers you a warm cup of chicory water in exchange for news of the broken bell-metal ticking inside your cradle.

exits.privWhy: Biscuit the mule is with the reader and knows the ledges and the ropeway stalls
exits.label: Follow the mule past the ropeway stalls
Dodge the whipping guide-line ahead

nodes.title: The Curious Apprentice
nodes.page:
Apprentice Kenal offers you a warm cup of bitter chicory water from a dented tin mug in exchange for news of the broken bell-metal ticking softly inside your canvas cradle. The young weaver leans against a wooden post, blowing on his steaming cup while the icy wind tugs at his woolen scarf.

You consider whether to share the tale of the shattered Orison or keep your silence and move on.

nodes.brief: You crawl beneath a slumping trestle where three weavers are splicing a hemp hawser with bone needles while shouting over the gale.

exits.label: Walk past the shadowed alcove wall
Duck under the whipping guide-line

nodes.title: The Splicers' Trestle
nodes.page:
You crawl beneath a slumping timber trestle where three veteran weavers are splicing a thick hemp hawser with bone needles while shouting over the roar of the gale. Strands of grey fiber swirl around you like winter snow as the great ropes groan under the weight of the suspended city.

Emerging on the other side of the trestle, you face two distinct routes deeper into the market labyrinth.

nodes.brief: A toll-keeper named Vane bars the iron turnstile with a heavy ledger, demanding proof that your bronze clapper is not stolen temple treasure.

exits.label: Slip past the gate into the shadows
Dodge aside as a guide-line snaps nearby

nodes.title: The Iron Turnstile
nodes.page: A toll-keeper named Vane bars the iron turnstile with a heavy ledger, demanding proof that your bronze clapper is not stolen temple treasure. The wind howls against the brass-bound covers of his book while the cold mountain air freezes the moisture on your eyelashes. You shift the canvas pack on your aching shoulders and feel the metal tongue knock faintly against your spine. Vane squints through grease-smeared spectacles, tapping an ink-stained finger impatiently on the frost-rimed wood of the barrier.

nodes.brief: The suspended bridge pitches violently sideways in an updraft, forcing you to press your chest flat against the freezing hemp mesh.

exits.label: Push onward across the open mesh platform
Bargain with Weaver Coren for safer shelter
Duck behind the pulp-wood stacks from watching children

nodes.title: The Pitching Bridge
nodes.page: The suspended bridge pitches violently sideways in an updraft, forcing you to press your chest flat against the freezing hemp mesh. Below your boots, the abyss yawns in shades of gray fog and distant stone, completely swallowed by the shifting cloud sea. The bronze clapper knocks heavily against your shoulder blades with every violent lurch of the bridge fibers. You dig your mittened fingers deep into the wet knots, waiting for a momentary lull in the gale before you attempt to crawl another yard forward.

nodes.brief: You skirt the edge of a great wicker sorting pit where discarded fibers swirl like dead leaves above the yawning gray void.

exits.label: Trade the bronze for waxed rigging line with Coren
Slide down the greased loading plank to bypass debris
Duck beneath the web of singing overhead cables

nodes.title: The Wicker Sorting Pit
nodes.page: You skirt the edge of a great wicker sorting pit where discarded fibers swirl like dead leaves above the yawning gray void. The air smells strongly of damp hemp, pine tar, and the sharp ozone tang of high-altitude ice. Winch-boys shout unintelligible warnings from invisible platforms somewhere above in the thickening mist. Every step requires absolute focus as the slick planking beneath your soles trembles to the rhythm of the hidden machinery.

nodes.brief: a scene in The Rope Markets: bazaars slung on cables across the gorge, ropewrights and winch-boys, the Cable Court's toll-houses, a knot-oath, rumours of Lowgate

exits.label: Scramble across the open mesh platform ahead
Take shelter near the stacked pulp-wood crates

nodes.title: The Cable Market Gust
nodes.page: Ice crystals rattle against your canvas pack as a sudden thermal updraft surges up through the rope-strung market stalls. Merchants scramble to secure dangling coils of hemp while lanterns swing wildly on their rusted iron hooks. You brace your legs against the tilting floorboards, clutching the padded shoulder straps until your knuckles turn white. The bronze tongue inside your pack gives a low mournful knock that travels straight through your chest.

nodes.brief: You duck under a swinging counter-weight just as a fully laden freight basket shoots out from the mist toward the lower stations.

exits.label: Hide among the stacked pulp-wood crates
Slide down the greased loading plank

nodes.title: The Swinging Counterweight
nodes.page: You duck under a swinging counter-weight just as a fully laden freight basket shoots out from the mist toward the lower stations. The iron pulley screeches in protest against the frozen axle, sending a shower of fine frost down upon your hood. Your muscles ache from the relentless downward pull of the heavy clapper, yet the steep path ahead offers no place to rest. Across the swaying gap, a winch-boy gestures frantically toward a narrow passage cut directly into the cliff-face.

nodes.brief: Guildmaster Orson tests the tension of a massive iron-bound cable with a silver tuning fork, ignoring your desperate plea for passage.

exits.label: Pay the exorbitant inspection fee at the iron gate
Duck beneath the singing overhead cables
Leap aside as a panicked pack-mule charges past

nodes.title: The Tuning Fork
nodes.page: Guildmaster Orson tests the tension of a massive iron-bound cable with a silver tuning fork, ignoring your desperate plea for passage. The clear, ringing tone is instantly swallowed by the constant, deep roar of the valley wind below. He adjusts a brass tension screw with calloused fingers, his attention entirely fixed on the vibrating strands. You stand shivering in the damp chill, wondering how much longer your shoulders can bear the dead weight of the temple's broken tongue.

nodes.brief: A sudden sleet squall blinds the walkway lanterns, forcing you to feel your way along the damp limestone wall by touch alone.

exits.label: Slide down the greased loading plank
Face the toll-master's clerk at the iron gate
Duck beneath the singing overhead cables

nodes.title: The Sleet Squall
nodes.page: A sudden sleet squall blinds the walkway lanterns, forcing you to feel your way along the damp limestone wall by touch alone. Tiny ice pellets sting your cheeks and coat your canvas pack in a rigid layer of frozen armor. Market noise falls to a muffled roar.
