The bronze Clapper ticks against your back whenever icy spray hits the padded leather harness.

Choose whether to head toward the stone grinding-floor or the swaying rope-bridge.

nodes.brief: On the dizzying wooden catwalk of mill twenty, miller-wife Zilla hangs heavy bunches of winter roots to dry.

exits.label: Cross the swaying high-altitude rope-bridge
Seek shelter near the smoking peat fire

nodes.title: Roots on the Catwalk
nodes.page: Frost glints off the high mountain timber as miller-wife Zilla ties heavy bunches of winter roots to the railing of mill twenty, her fingers red and stiff from the drafts. Biscuit shifts uneasily beside you as the bronze Clapper rides your back, his ears flicking at the whistle of the high-altitude wind threading the narrow gully. Zilla glances back from her knot-work, her eyes sharp and assessing against the glare of the snowfields below.

nodes.brief: Within the drafty shadow of mill twenty-one, miller Coren stacks heavy pine logs against the encroaching mountain drift.

exits.label: Inspect the nearby grain storage bins
Descend the steep stone stair toward the lower ledges

nodes.title: Stacking the Timber
nodes.page: Pine logs thud on the frozen planking inside mill twenty-one while miller Coren stacks a defensive rampart against the encroaching mountain drift. The air smells of sap, dry bark, and the faint, low-pitched hum of the bronze Clapper resting in your padded cradle. Coren pauses, wiping sawdust from his brow with a leather-bound wrist, and nods toward the narrow paths leading deeper into the terrace labyrinth.

nodes.brief: Beside the stone grinding-wheel of mill twenty-two, miller Leora sharpens an iron sickle with a rhythmic rasp.

exits.label: Walk past the rattling canvas sails

nodes.title: The Sharpening Wheel
nodes.page: Sparks scatter in a bright orange arc as miller Leora presses an iron sickle against the stone grinding-wheel of mill twenty-two, her movements rhythmic and practiced. The dry scrape of steel drowns out the whistling gale, though the bronze Clapper on your back keeps its sub-audible knock against your shoulder blades. Leora lifts the blade to test the edge with a calloused thumb, then looks up at the cradle on your back.

nodes.brief: Under the creaking canvas sails of mill twenty-three, miller Thaddeus complains of a stolen copper measure-cup.

exits.label: Descend the steep stone stair toward the lower ledges
Step into the dim interior of the lower mill
Turn back toward the upper terrace

nodes.title: The Missing Measure
nodes.page: Frustration echoes beneath the creaking canvas sails of mill twenty-three as miller Thaddeus mutters angrily about a stolen copper measure-cup missing from his workbench. The Clapper knocks against your spine in time with the wooden beams shaking in the gale. Thaddeus glares at the lintel, suspecting a passing traveler or a rival miller from the terrace above.

nodes.brief: On the precipitous stone ledge of mill twenty-four, miller-girl Maris feeds scraps of salted fish to a tame mountain crow.

exits.label: Step into the dim interior of the mill
Clear the frozen slush from the drainage sluice
Turn back toward the upper terrace

nodes.title: The Mountain Crow
nodes.page: Cold air whips across the precipitous ledge of mill twenty-four as miller-girl Maris tosses scraps of salted fish to a glossy, one-eyed mountain crow perched on the stone railing. The bird snaps up the morsel just as the bronze Clapper on your back emits a low, resonant vibration that makes the feathers on the crow's neck ruffle. Maris shields her eyes against the stinging sleet and watches you steady Biscuit's harness against the gust.

nodes.brief: Within the warm flour-scented interior of mill twenty-five, miller Olen warms his scarred hands over a brazier of coals.

exits.label: Clear the frozen slush from the drainage

nodes.title: The Warm Brazier
nodes.page: Glowing coals cast a reddish light across the flour-scented interior of mill twenty-five, where miller Olen warms his scarred hands over a small iron brazier. The bronze Clapper in your pack keeps a soft knock that blends with the crackle of dry wood and the settling of stone walls against the frost. Olen gestures toward an empty stool by the warmth, offering a brief respite from the biting air outside.

nodes.brief: Beneath the rattling wooden beams of mill twenty-six, miller Kren offers a bowl of thin barley broth for news of the pass.

exits.label: Approach the groaning sails of the lower terrace
Trade for news in the dusty shadows

nodes.title: Broth and Whispers
nodes.page: Wooden beams rattle overhead inside mill twenty-six as miller Kren pushes a steaming wooden bowl of thin barley broth across a grease-stained table toward you. Rich earthy steam mixes with the cold draft whistling through the floorboards, and the bronze Clapper rests cool against your shoulder. Kren leans in close, his eyes fixed on your pack as he waits for any news from the upper passes.

nodes.brief: Free of debt and obligations, you convince a suspicious miller to trade his spare iron wedge for a mere smile.

exits.label: Approach the groaning sails of the lower terrace
Turn back up the mountain toward the upper terraces

priv.why: the reader owes nobody and can bargain freely

nodes.title: Unburdened Bargain
nodes.page: Carrying no debts, ledgers, or obligations to weigh down your passage, you stand before a famously suspicious miller who eyes your pack with wary curiosity. Because your ledger is clean and your hands owe nothing to the local toll-lords, the old man softens his scowl and tosses a spare iron wedge onto the table in exchange for a simple, honest smile. The Clapper hums softly against your spine, sensing the rare ease of a transaction untainted by coin or threat.

nodes.brief: On the wind-lashed terrace of mill twenty-seven, miller-wife Jael pegs down flapping canvas wind-breaks against the gale.

exits.label: Step out onto the frost-rimed balcony
Inspect the clattering wooden hopper
Take the reckless way across the high terrace

nodes.title: The Wind-Lashed Balcony
nodes.page: Canvas wind-breaks snap like leather whips on the exposed balcony of mill twenty-seven as miller-wife Jael fights to secure a flapping corner against the mounting gale. Ice crystals rake your cheeks, and the bronze Clapper on your back knocks a deep warning that travels straight through your boots. Jael shouts over the roar of the wind, warning of the treacherous conditions building along the high shelf ahead.

nodes.brief: Within the dim stone flour-bin of mill twenty-eight, miller Brunn patches a torn canvas sail with heavy sailmaker's twine.

exits.label: Approach the groaning sails of the lower terrace
Step out onto the frost-rimed balcony

nodes.title: Sailmaker's Twine
nodes.page: Heavy sailmaker's twine snakes through miller Brunn's calloused fingers as he patches a torn canvas sail inside the dim stone flour-bin of mill twenty-eight. Flour dust coats the air and clings to your damp wool cloak, and the bronze Clapper muffles a soft tune against its padded cradle. Brunn knots the thread with a sharp tug of his teeth, glancing up at the sound of Biscuit's hooves shifting on the stone floor.

nodes.brief: Beside the clattering wooden hopper of mill twenty-nine, miller Doran curses the sudden shift in the mountain air-currents.

exits.label: Seek a path through the shadows
Wait beside the clattering hopper

nodes.title: The Clattering Hopper
nodes.page: Dust hangs thick in the cold draft beside the wooden hopper as miller Doran spits into the grain-chute, cursing the sudden shift in the mountain air-currents that threatens to choke his stones. Biscuit stamps a stubborn hoof against the flagstones, tired of the fine grey flour settling into his harness straps. You settle the bronze Clapper in its padded cradle and watch the miller wrestle a jammed slide-gate while the metal ticks faintly at your shoulder blades.

nodes.brief: On the frost-slick stone balcony of mill thirty, miller-boy Pimm tries to untangle a wind-knot in the signal cord.

exits.label: Help the boy untangle the cord
Look for an open lower track
Seek a different path through the shadows

nodes.title: The Signal Cord
nodes.page: Frost glazes the exposed stone balcony where miller-boy Pimm fights a stiff signal cord frozen hard into a stubborn wind-knot. The high-altitude air bites sharply at your cheeks, carrying the thin, metallic scent of snow from the higher crags above Orisonhold. Biscuit lowers his long ears, shaking his head against the whistling gale while you adjust the canvas straps holding the bronze Clapper tightly against your spine.

nodes.brief: Within the echoing timber loft of mill thirty-one, miller Tilda weighs small sacks of grey barley on a rusted beam-balance.

exits.label: Ask the miller for grain
Head toward the warm flour-loft

nodes.title: The Rusted Beam
nodes.page: Overhead in the timber loft a beam-balance creaks in time as miller Tilda drops small, grey sacks of barley onto the iron pan. Sweet grain dust fills the loft and keeps the biting mountain draft outside for a few breaths. You hitch the bronze Clapper in its padded cradle until the faint knock eases the strain across your aching shoulders.

nodes.brief: Beside the stone grinding-floor of mill thirty-two, miller Kray sweeps up spilled grain while muttering complaints about the toll-lords.

exits.label: Listen to complaints about toll-lords
Slip past to the frost-rimed balcony
Move toward the clattering wooden hopper

nodes.title: The Grinding-Floor Sweep
nodes.page: Stiff bristles scratch loudly across the stone grinding-floor as miller Kray sweeps up a scatter of golden barley kernels, muttering bitter complaints about the toll-lords of the Cable Court. The massive wooden millstones grind a deep bass note beside the bronze Clapper in your padded cradle, and the floorboards take both sounds up into your boots. Biscuit blows a warm, snorting breath against your sleeve, impatient to leave the cramped, flour-dusted room.

nodes.brief: Under the groaning wooden axle of mill thirty-three, miller Vola greases the iron journals with rancid mutton tallow.

exits.label: Hold the grease-pot for Vola
Step toward the suspension bridge

nodes.title: The Mutton Tallow
nodes.page: A thick, pungent smell of rancid mutton tallow rises from the iron journals beneath the groaning wooden axle as miller Vola swabs grease onto the screaming bearings. Each turn of the great wind-wheel shudders the stonework and rattles the bronze Clapper secured in your padded cradle. Biscuit shifts nervously on the slick floorboards, his iron-shod hooves clicking against the stone.

nodes.brief: On the dizzying rope-bridge of mill thirty-four, miller-wife Nola secures a loose guide-line against the rising frost-wind.

exits.label: Help secure the thrashing line
Cross toward the suspension bridge
Head directly for the warm flour-loft

nodes.title: The Guide-Line
nodes.page: Raw hemp burns against calloused palms as miller-wife Nola pulls a loose guide-line taut against the howling frost-wind on the dizzying rope-bridge. Below the swaying planks, the sheer mountain drop falls away into a vast sea of grey clouds, making your stomach turn with a sudden vertigo. You grip the wooden railing with one hand and brace the bronze Clapper on your back with the other.

nodes.brief: Within the drafty flour-shed of mill thirty-five, miller Oren pokes a smoking peat fire with a heavy iron poker.

exits.label: Warm your hands by the fire
Head toward the warm flour-loft
Push past toward the grinding-wheel

nodes.title: The Peat Fire
nodes.page: Grey smoke curls from a peat fire as miller Oren jabs the glowing embers with an iron poker inside the drafty flour-shed. The sudden warmth feels like a small mercy against the biting mountain chill that has numbed your fingers since dawn. Biscuit nudges your shoulder with his dusty muzzle, smelling the dry peat smoke and hoping for a rest.

nodes.brief: Beside the stone storage-bins of mill thirty-six, miller Hestia tallies bags of harvested grain with charcoal on a slate slab.

exits.label: Wait for the miller to finish
Step out under the rattling canvas

nodes.title: The Slate Slab
nodes.page: White chalk dust smears across a dark slate slab as miller Hestia tallies bags of harvested grain with quick, sharp strokes. Outside the narrow window, the canvas sails of the windmill snap rhythmically in the rising gale, nearly drowning out the faint, persistent hum of the bronze Clapper on your back. You hitch the cradle straps until the familiar bite lands on your collarbones.

nodes.brief: Under the rattling canvas sails of mill thirty-seven, miller Joram repairs a split wooden stave with iron binding hoops.

exits.label: Hand the miller spare wedges
Turn toward the stone grinding-wheel

nodes.title: The Binding Hoops
nodes.page: A heavy wooden mallet rings against iron binding hoops as miller Joram drives a loose hoop tight around a split stave on the great drum. The hammering travels through the floorboards and finds an answer in the bronze Clapper resting in your padded cradle. Biscuit paws at a pile of dry shavings, his ears flicking back and forth at the sharp noise.

nodes.brief: On the precipitous stone stair of mill thirty-eight, miller-boy Tavis struggles under the weight of a heavy meal-sack.

exits.label: Steady the boy's heavy load
Continue toward the canvas canopy

nodes.title: The Meal-Sack
nodes.page: Coarse burlap rasps against stone walls as miller-boy Tavis staggers down the precipitous stair under the crushing weight of a heavy meal-sack. His breathing comes in ragged gasps, matching the rhythmic, low-frequency hum of the bronze Clapper strapped securely to your own back. You flatten yourself against the damp masonry to give the struggling boy room to pass.

nodes.brief: Within the dim interior of mill thirty-nine, miller Corina sharpens a dull grain-shovel against a wet sandstone block.

exits.label: Step out onto the narrow plankway
Wait inside while the shovel is honed

nodes.title: The Sandstone Spark
nodes.page: Within the dim interior of mill thirty-nine, miller Corina sharpens a dull grain-shovel against a wet sandstone block, sending tiny silver sparks flying into the flour-scented air. Biscuit shifts his weight against the heavy bronze Clapper in your cradle, letting out a low, complaining huff that rattles the harness rings. Corina pauses, eyeing the muffled metal on your back with professional curiosity before gesturing toward the narrow exterior catwalk.

nodes.brief: Beside the churning wooden sluice-gate of mill forty, miller Beric clears away frozen slush from the drainage channels.

exits.label: Ask him for news of the path ahead
Offer to help clear the jammed ice
Keep moving past the churning water

nodes.title: The Frozen Sluice
nodes.page: Beside the churning wooden sluice-gate of mill forty, miller Beric clears away frozen slush from the drainage channels with swift, practiced thumps of an iron spade. Frigid mountain spray dampens your woollen cloak, and the Clapper knocks faintly against your shoulder blades as if sensing the rushing meltwater. Beric nods a brief greeting over the roar of the wooden gears, pausing to lean on his frost-pitted tool.

nodes.brief: Beneath the groaning sails of mill forty-one, miller Thura demands an exorbitant toll for the use of the lower stone steps.

exits.label: Pay the steep fee from your pouch

nodes.title: The High Toll
nodes.page: Beneath the groaning sails of mill forty-one, miller Thura demands an exorbitant toll for the use of the lower stone steps, crossing her flour-dusted arms over a stout canvas apron. The wind shrieks through the revolving oak beams overhead, drowning out all but the steady, metallic thrum of the bronze Clapper on your back. Biscuit plants his hooves stubbornly against the flagstones, refusing to budge until the dispute is settled.

nodes.brief: On the frost-rimed balcony of mill forty-two, miller-wife Mila warns that the upcoming wind-pass is blocked by heavy ice-drifts.

exits.label: Listen closely to her warnings about the drifts
Inspect the frozen pass with your own eyes

nodes.title: The Ice-Bound Pass
nodes.page: On the frost-rimed balcony of mill forty-two, miller-wife Mila warns that ice-drifts block the upcoming wind-pass, and she points a mittened finger toward the frozen gap below. Icicles hang like jagged glass teeth from the eves, shivering in the sharp, thin air that cuts straight through your layers of wool and leather. The heavy burden on your back feels colder than ever, vibrating in time with the distant groaning of the mountain glaciers.

nodes.brief: Within the dusty shadows of mill forty-three, miller Halden trades a handful of parched beans for a scrap of dried mutton.

exits.label: Trade a spare ration for some mutton
Decline the offer and check the harness

nodes.title: The Mutton Trade
nodes.page: Within the dusty shadows of mill forty-three, miller Halden trades a handful of parched beans for a scrap of dried mutton, his fingers moving with the mechanical speed of an old clockwork. The smell of rendered fat and roasting grain fills the dim alcove, offering a brief, warm respite from the biting chill of the terrace heights. Biscuit stretches his neck longingly toward the burlap sacks while you adjust the straps of the Clapper cradle.

nodes.brief: Beside the clattering wooden hopper of mill forty-four, miller Doran sharpens an old pruning knife on an oiled stone.

exits.label: Ask him about the condition of the steps
Watch the grinding stones turn in silence
Lead Biscuit past the clattering machinery

nodes.title: The Pruning Knife
nodes.page: Beside the clattering wooden hopper of mill forty-four, miller Doran sharpens an old pruning knife on an oiled stone, testing the gleaming edge with a calloused thumb. The rhythmic scraping echoes above the thunderous grinding of the upper millstones, shaking fine white dust from the heavy timber beams. Doran glances at the muffled bronze tongue on your back, offering a dry smile that creases his flour-white cheeks.

nodes.brief: On the dizzying suspension bridge near mill forty-five, miller-boy Kian drops a wooden tally-stick into the foggy abyss.

exits.label: Steady the boy before he loses his footing
Cross the swaying planks with slow care
Pull Biscuit close to the cliffside cable

nodes.title: The Lost Tally
nodes.page: On the dizzying suspension bridge near mill forty-five, miller-boy Kian drops a wooden tally-stick into the foggy abyss, watching it vanish into the gray nothingness below with a small gasp. The hempen ropes sway violently underfoot in the gusting mountain draft, making the heavy bronze Clapper shift uneasily in its padded cradle. Kian turns to you with wide eyes, gripping the handrail tightly as the bridge heaves in the wind.

nodes.brief: Within the warm flour-loft of mill forty-six, miller Senta offers a draught of sour small-beer in exchange for monastery gossip.

exits.label: Share the latest monastery news with her
Drink quickly and head back to the stairs

nodes.title: The Sour Draught
nodes.page: Within the warm flour-loft of mill forty-six, miller Senta offers a draught of sour small-beer in exchange for monastery gossip, her eyes sharp and curious in the dim light. Between you the earthenware jug goes round, sharp and yeasty on the dry chill in your throat, and the metal tongue on your back answers with a low note that will not quit. Senta leans in closer over a stack of empty grain sacks, eager to hear what news has trickled down from Orisonhold.

nodes.brief: Beside the massive stone grinding-wheel of mill forty-seven, miller Varis complains that the mountain winds have turned too cold for milling.

exits.label: Offer a hand to free the frozen axle

nodes.title: The Frozen Wheel
nodes.page: Beside the massive stone grinding-wheel of mill forty-seven, miller Varis complains that the mountain winds have turned too cold for milling, his breath pluming white in the freezing air. The great stone sits idle and silent, frosted over with a thick layer of rime that glints under the pale high-altitude sun. Varis kicks a frozen block of chaff away from the axle, grumbling about the shortening days and the stubborn ice.

nodes.brief: Under the rattling canvas canopy of mill forty-eight, miller Jole packs dried barley hulls tightly into insulating wall-pockets.

exits.label: Help him tuck the loose canvas tight

nodes.title: The Insulating Wall
nodes.page: Under the rattling canvas canopy of mill forty-eight, miller Jole packs dried barley hulls tightly into insulating wall-pockets to keep out the creeping frost. The dry husks rustle like dry leaves against the wooden framing, muffling the howling whistle of the wind outside. Jole wipes sweat from his brow despite the biting cold, pausing to secure another flap of canvas with a stout wooden peg.

nodes.brief: On the final windy terrace platform, master miller Morvath points toward the distant fog-shrouded roofs of Lowgate.

exits.label: Descend toward the lower mist

nodes.title: The Final Windy Platform
nodes.page:
Master miller Morvath points a flour-dusted finger toward the distant, fog-shrouded roofs of Lowgate far below, his breath pluming white against the biting air. On your back the massive bronze clapper answers the whistling gale that slices across the terrace with a slow shiver. Every stone here is rimed with gray frost, and the steep drop-offs of the mountain face yawn wide and indifferent to your errand.

You hitch the padded straps that cut into your shoulders while chill seeps into your woollen tunic. Biscuit stamps a stubborn hoof against the frozen slate, eager to leave the high ridges behind before the weather turns truly foul.

nodes.brief: Beside the massive stone wind-chime of mill forty-nine, miller Hestia listens for the low-frequency drone that heralds an alpine storm.

exits.label: Follow the cliff path downward

nodes.title: The Wind-Chime Mill
nodes.page:
Beside the massive stone wind-chime of mill forty-nine, miller Hestia listens intently for the low-frequency drone that heralds an alpine storm. Hollow brass tubes clatter softly in the rising draft, striking a discordant tune that makes the hair on your arms stand up. The bronze clapper in its cradle vibrates against your spine like a sleeping animal waking to danger.

Hestia pulls her fleece cap tighter over her ears and gestures sharply toward the path dropping away into the gray haze. The wind tears the words from her mouth, leaving only the metallic ringing of the chimes and the dull thud of your own boots on the ice-crusted stone.

nodes.brief: Within the echoing stone granary of mill fifty, miller-wife Jessa sorts through withered seed-corn by the light of a tallow dip.

exits.label: Step out into the freezing wind

nodes.title: The Granary Lamp
nodes.page:
Within the echoing stone granary of mill fifty, miller-wife Jessa sorts through withered seed-corn by the flickering light of a tallow dip. The air smells intensely of dry chaff, stored grain, and the cold damp of the mountain wall pressing against the back of the bins. Outside, the wind howls across the tiers, but here in the dim shelter, only the occasional drip of melting frost breaks the quiet.

Jessa glances up from her wooden sorting tray, her eyes dark and tired in the yellow flame, and nods toward the heavy iron-banded door leading back out to the open air. The bronze clapper rests heavily against your shoulder blades, a dead weight reminding you of the ticking clock.

nodes.brief: Across the frost-slick stone threshold of the final miller's lodge, you glimpse the winding stair descending into the gray mist below.

exits.label: Venture down into the fog
Retreat to the shelter above

nodes.title: The Threshold of Mist
nodes.page:
Across the frost-slick stone threshold of the final miller's lodge, you glimpse the winding stair descending into the gray mist below like a spine of broken bone. Ice coats the handrails, and the muffled roar of distant glacier water rises from the hidden depths of the gorge. Biscuit shifts uneasily behind you, his iron shoes scraping a sharp spark from the frozen flagstones.

The urge to turn back to the warmth of the flour-bins tugs hard at your chest, but the cracked bell in Orisonhold waits for its tongue. Every breath stings your throat as the altitude wind presses relentlessly against your laden frame.

nodes.brief: On the ninth barley tier, old Miller Bram offers a midnight tutorial in wind-whistles while your bronze clapper grows heavy and cold.

exits.label: Leave the mill at dawn
Check the frozen water-wheel
Listen to the miller's warning

nodes.title: The Ninth Tier Tutorial
nodes.page:
On the ninth barley tier, old Miller Bram offers a midnight tutorial in wind-whistles while your bronze clapper grows heavy and cold against your aching muscles. The wind screams through the stone flues of the mill, and Bram demonstrates how to purse your lips to match the pitch of the cliff drafts. Hours slip away in the freezing dark as you practice the strange, breathy notes meant to calm the upper gales.

Biscuit stands dozing in the draughty lean-to, his hide frosted with rime under the pale starlight. When the lesson finally ends, the night is deeper and the air is sharper, but you carry a new, subtle command of the mountain's voice in your lungs.

exits.label: Weigh the cost of schooling

nodes.title: The Skeletal Arms of Mill Six
nodes.page:
Beneath the skeletal arms of Mill Six, miller Thrum bargains a day of your youth for the secret grammar of gale-notes, his fingers tapping an impatient rhythm on a wooden grain scoop. The wind rattles the canvas sails overhead like dry bones rattling in a crypt. Refusing the offer leaves you with your precious time intact, but forces you to face the unpredictable upper drafts entirely on your own wits.

The bronze clapper gives a warning note against your back as you count every hour left before the passes seal shut. Thrum watches you with narrowed eyes, waiting to see whether you will trade your schedule or turn your back on his wisdom.

nodes.brief: Stumbling past frost-rimed hopper stones, you trade precious hours for a Miller's lesson while Biscuit chews salted straw in the dark.

exits.label: Step out onto the glazed steps
Watch the frozen water-wheel
Heed the miller's bitter warning

nodes.title: The Hopper Stones
nodes.page:
Stumbling past frost-rimed hopper stones, you trade precious hours for a miller's lesson while Biscuit chews salted straw in the dark. The rhythmic grinding of the basalt wheels fills the small loft, bone-deep and hard to ignore. Outside, the sky begins to pale with a sickly gray light that promises little warmth for the day's march.

You hoist the heavy padded cradle back onto your shoulders, feeling the extra burden of lost time settling into your lower back. The terrace path below winds down toward the next dizzying drop, glazed in fresh rime from the night's freeze.

nodes.brief: Amid grinding gears that hum like trapped hornets, miller Jael demands twenty-four hours of your schedule to teach the high-altitude whistle.

exits.label: Dodge the falling middlings sack
Mind the bronze clapper against the lintel
Face the Cable Court guard

nodes.title: The Hornet's Nest
nodes.page:
Amid grinding gears that hum like trapped hornets, miller Jael demands twenty-four hours of your schedule to teach the high-altitude whistle. Iron axles screech against oiled oak, filling the loft with a acrid smell of hot grease and ancient dust. You spend the long night bent over a clay pipe, learning how to pitch your breath against the mountain's scream.

When the lesson finally concludes, your lungs ache and your head swims from the lack of oxygen and sleep. Jael nods stiffly toward the exit chute, offering no parting kindness as you stumble back out into the freezing dawn.

nodes.brief: A gaunt miller named Cribb blocks the stone stair, offering the craft of wind-calls in exchange for a day spent turning his sluggish millstone.

exits.label: Share goat cheese with a warder
Slip past the narrow granite gap

nodes.title: The Blocked Stair
nodes.page:
Granitic dust coats your tongue as a gaunt miller named Cribb plants his heavy boots squarely across the narrow stone stair. He offers the intricate craft of high-altitude wind-calls, but only in exchange for an entire day spent toiling at his sluggish, groaning millstone. The bronze clapper knocks a dull warning against your shoulder blades, a reminder of the twenty-day window before the mountain passes freeze solid.

Below your feet, the mountain drops away into an abyss of cold grey cloud where no sound rises save for the distant clatter of unseen wind-wheels turning in the thin air.

nodes.brief: Shivering in the draughty flour-loft, you weigh the cost of a miller's nocturnal schooling against the rapidly shrinking span of your twenty-day journey.

exits.label: Inspect the rusted hatchway below

exits.privWhy: the reader carries a Ropewrights' Guild rope and is waved through guild places
exits.label: Flash your guild cord to pass
Soothe the stubborn mule by the fire
Brave the scouring flurry of snow

nodes.title: The Drafty Loft
nodes.page: Freezing draughts whistle through the slatted timber walls of the flour-loft, chilling your fingers as you weigh the price of the miller's nocturnal schooling. Every hour spent memorising whistle pitches eats into the dangerously brief span of your twenty-day journey to Lowgate foundry. Outside the wind howls across the barley terraces, rattles the loose roof-tiles, and sets the bronze clapper in its cradle knocking with a metallic ache.

nodes.brief: Recognized by the rope-knot carved on your pack, a friendly knot-master steers you past the miller's time-trap onto an untaxed winch-slide.

exits.label: Step out into the swirling snow
Pocket the strange iron relic
Listen to the old weather rhymes

nodes.title: The Knot-Master's Shortcut
nodes.page: Spotting the intricate rope-knot carved proudly onto your leather pack, a friendly knot-master steps from the shadow of the hopper stones and steers you deftly past the miller's time-trap. He leads you toward an untaxed winch-slide that bypasses the toll-barriers entirely, muttering a brief blessing of hemp and tension for the road ahead. The bronze clapper shifts in its padded cradle, its cold tongue knocking once at your sudden stroke of good fortune.

nodes.brief: Rejecting the miller's bargain of stolen time, you slip down a sheer grain-chute while the bronze clapper hums a warning against the frost.

exits.label: Pocket the heavy iron relic
Heed the old weather-teller's warnings
Track the distant smell of foundry smoke
Adjust the slipping canvas cradle

nodes.title: The Grain-Chute Descent
nodes.page: Refusing to barter away precious daylight for the miller's hollow promises, you dive headfirst into the slick darkness of a steep grain-chute. Powdered barley and splinters streak past as the wooden walls blur, and the bronze clapper strapped to your back knocks a warning into the frost. You emerge breathlessly onto a lower terrace, tasting dust and cold mountain air with every gasp.

nodes.brief: Emerging from the miller's loft minus a day, you find the stone steps glazed with rime and the valley mist rolling upward.

exits.label: Cross the rickety cedar bridge
Follow the scarecrow's wooden finger
Dodge the flying chaff of dry grain
Turn back to the upper mill

nodes.title: Rime Upon the Steps
nodes.page: Staggering outward from the stifling miller's loft, you discover that precious hours have vanished and left the stone steps sheathed in dangerous, glassy rime. A thick valley mist rolls upward from the gorges below, swallowing the lower terraces and turning every distant windmill into a skeletal shadow against the pale sky. The bronze clapper presses against your spine and knocks a cold note that matches the shiver running down your neck.

nodes.brief: A frozen water-wheel groans beside the path, its dripping paddles forming crystal spears that threaten the strap of your bronze burden.

exits.label: Follow the scarecrow toward the drop
Duck beneath the flying chaff
Shelter behind the retaining wall

nodes.title: The Dripping Water-Wheel
nodes.page: Giant crystal spears hang menacingly from a frozen water-wheel that groans beside the narrow track, threatening to slash the leather straps of your precious bronze burden if you misjudge your step. Water drips sluggishly from the upper ledges, instantly turning to razor-sharp ice as it strikes the stone. You press your shoulder against the cliff face, shielding the heavy clapper while your boots search for a secure foothold on the slick path.

nodes.brief: Miller Korr hawks phlegm into the barley bin, warning you that the glacier ladders ahead are already snapping in the night freeze.

exits.label: Dodge the cloud of dry chaff
Take shelter behind the stone wall
Take the reckless way

nodes.title: Korr's Grim Warning
nodes.page: Miller Korr spits a mouthful of dark phlegm into the barley bin and warns you with a flat stare that the glacier ladders spanning the lower chasms are already snapping in the vicious night freeze. The wind carries a bitter edge that promises frozen skin within minutes if you do not find shelter or descend with absolute speed. Your shoulders ache under the unyielding weight of the heavy bronze tongue as you weigh the terrible risk of the drop ahead.

nodes.brief: You dodge a falling sack of damp middlings as two terrace boys wrestle near the cliff edge over a stolen pewter spoon.

exits.label: Hide behind the dry-stone wall
Watch the fog-wardens pass by

nodes.title: The Stolen Spoon
nodes.page: Damp middlings rain down from above as two terrace boys grapple fiercely near the sheer cliff edge over a battered pewter spoon, nearly tumbling into the empty air. You flatten yourself against the rough stone wall to avoid the flying sacks, feeling the heavy bronze clapper vibrate against your spine in time with the boys' frantic breathing. The mountain wind howls through the narrow gap between the mills, smelling sharply of wet grain and old iron.

nodes.brief: The bronze clapper strikes a resonant note against a low stone lintel, drawing suspicious stares from weavers mending wind-nets.

exits.label: Accept the clerk's credit token
Traverse the sheet of blue ice

nodes.title: The Weaver's Scowl
nodes.page: A sudden metallic clang rings across the terrace as the bronze clapper strikes a protruding stone lintel, and local weavers mending large wind-nets look up with sharp, suspicious glares. They pause their rhythmic knotting, watching your laden shoulders with guarded eyes that mistrust strangers carrying metal meant for the forge. You mutter a quiet apology and quicken your pace along the narrow ledge, keeping your hand firmly on the padded cradle straps.

nodes.brief: A solitary guard from the Cable Court sits on a nail-keg, demanding an inspection fee for the bronze mass strapped to your tired shoulders.

exits.label: Meet the synchronized hand-bells
Ignore the stray mountain goat

nodes.title: The Cable Court Inspector
nodes.page: Sitting atop an empty nail-keg with a ledger spread across his knees, a solitary guard from the Cable Court watches your approach with cold, calculating eyes. He demands an immediate inspection fee for the massive bronze mass strapped to your tired shoulders, tapping an ink-stained finger against a wooden toll-box. The mountain air grows noticeably colder as the sun dips behind the jagged ridge above the terrace.

nodes.brief: You share a wedge of hard goat cheese with an exhausted fog-warden whose lantern flickers against the encroaching white wall.

exits.label: Negotiate credit with the clerk
Descend the slick glacier-run

nodes.title: The Fog Warden's Wedge
nodes.page:
White frost clings to your woollen mittens as you pause beside a low dry-stone wall to share a wedge of hard goat cheese with an exhausted fog-warden. Her horn-handled lantern flickers against an encroaching white wall of mist, casting long, wavering shadows across the barley stubble. The bronze clapper rests heavily against your shoulder blades, its cold metal muffled by layers of coarse canvas.

She points a gloved finger down towards the churning vapor where the switchbacks grow steeper and the air tastes of sulfur and old snow. You fold the remaining cheese into your pack and test the stability of your boots on the frozen mud before deciding your next direction.

nodes.brief: Frost crystals bloom across your leather boots as the stone track narrows between a sheer cliff and an unrailed drop of six hundred feet.

exits.label: Watch the distant mountain goat
Feel the clapper's low thrum
Tend the guttering candles

nodes.title: The Unrailed Drop
nodes.page:
Frost crystals bloom across your leather boots as the stone track narrows sharply between a sheer limestone cliff and an unrailed drop of six hundred feet. Every breath plumes white in the thin biting air as the canvas cradle with the bronze clapper slides sluggish against your spine. Far below, the tiered windmills of the terrace turn in sluggish silence against the grey sky.

You plant your boots on the rimed gravel and listen to mountain wind whistle hollow through the gorge crevices. The path ahead offers no shelter from the gathering gale, demanding absolute focus on every single footstep you take.

nodes.brief: A rusted iron bell-pull hangs beside a boarded hatchway, twitching as though an unseen hand underground is trying to ring for help.

exits.label: Retrieve the frozen tinker's hammer
Pause at the mountain shrine
Quiet the braying mule

nodes.title: The Rusted Bell-Pull
nodes.page:
A rusted iron bell-pull hangs beside a boarded hatchway set deep into the terrace retaining wall, twitching as though an unseen hand underground is trying to ring for help. The mountain wind howls through the narrow gap between the old barley stores, carrying the dry rattle of loose shale down the cliff face. You hitch the bronze mass in your canvas cradle and lean your aching shoulders against the damp stone for a moment.

The twitching cable falls still, leaving only the rhythmic groan of distant windmill sails turning in the freezing air. You weigh the strange subterranean signal against the darkening sky above, searching for a safe way past the shuttered doorway.

nodes.brief: Guided by your guild-wrapped hemp cord, the terrace toll-keeper waves you past the barrier without demanding your last copper coin.

exits.label: Observe the high ledge goat
Feel the bronze thrum

priv.why: the reader carries a Ropewrights' Guild rope and is waved through guild places

nodes.title: The Guild's Open Gate
nodes.page:
Your guild-wrapped hemp cord is enough: the terrace toll-keeper glances at your knotted insignia and waves you past the timber barrier without asking for your last copper coin. Cold mountain wind tugs at your coat, yet the familiar friction of the master cord holds you firm against the hostility of the high ledges. Biscuit steps carefully over the timber sill, his iron shoes clicking sharply on the clean-swept frost stones.

You tip your cap in silent acknowledgment to the gate-keeper, who turns back to his tally-board without another word. The path stretches ahead into the grey haze, offering unobstructed passage deeper into the descending stair-towns.

nodes.brief: Biscuit digs his hooves into the frosted shale, refusing to pass a smoking charcoal brazier tended by shivering barley-scavengers.

exits.label: Seek shelter at the stone shrine
Scrape the frozen mud

nodes.title: The Charcoal Brazier
nodes.page:
Biscuit digs his stubborn hooves into the frosted shale, refusing to pass a smoking charcoal brazier tended by shivering barley-scavengers who eye your bronze cargo with greedy curiosity. Sparks drift upward into the bitter air, smelling of scorched peat and wet wool. You murmur a low caution to the mule, tugging firmly on the lead-rope while keeping your body positioned between the animal and the glowing iron pot.

The scavengers mutter among themselves, huddled tight against the bitter draft howling off the upper snowfields. You coax the reluctant beast forward past the heat, eager to leave the smoky alcove behind in the freezing wind.

nodes.brief: A flurry of dry snow scours the terrace wall, stinging your cheeks and plastering your coat with frozen dust from the threshing floor.

exits.label: Rest by the mountain shrine
Calm the restless mule

nodes.title: The Flurry of Dry Snow
nodes.page:
A sudden flurry of dry snow scours the terrace wall, stinging your cold cheeks and plastering your woollen coat with frozen dust swept from the upper threshing floor. The world narrows to a swirling curtain of white, obscuring the drop-off to your left and the jagged masonry to your right. You press your shoulder firmly against the damp stone, clutching the steadying straps of the clapper's cradle to keep your balance against the gust.

Warm misted breath washes your sleeve as Biscuit leans his flank against your side in the freezing gloom. As the squall momentarily slackens its grip, the grey outline of the path reveals two distinct ways forward through the drifts.

nodes.brief: You pry a loose horseshoe from frozen mud, slipping the iron relic into your pocket as a minor talisman against mountain misfortune.

exits.label: Answer the mule's challenge
Clear your heavy boot treads

nodes.title: The Iron Relic
nodes.page:
You pry a loose horseshoe from the frozen mud of the path and slip the iron relic into your deep pocket as a minor talisman against mountain misfortune. The metal is rimed with yellow rust and ice, bearing the distinct punch-marks of a high-altitude forge. Biscuit tosses his shaggy head, rattling his halter-rings as you straighten up and test the weight of the clapper on your tired back.

The terrace around you stands silent and abandoned under a low overcast sky, save for the distant creak of an untended windmill. You rub your numbed fingers inside your mittens, choosing your next step along the narrowing ledge.

nodes.brief: An old woman huddles beneath a woollen shawl, muttering ancient weather-rhymes about the thirteen steps and the impending closure of Lowgate.

exits.privWhy: Biscuit the mule is with the reader and knows the ledges and the ropeway stalls
exits.label: Follow the mule's narrow track
Watch the erratic wind-vane

nodes.title: The Old Weather-Prophet
nodes.page:
An old woman huddles beneath a thick woollen shawl on a stone mounting block, muttering ancient weather-rhymes about the thirteen steps and the impending closure of Lowgate before the winter locks the gorge. Her dry fingers twist a length of barley straw into intricate knots as you pass, her clouded eyes tracking the heavy bronze clapper on your back with grim recognition. The wind catches her warning words, scattering them into the empty air above the drop.

You nod respectfully to her whispered prophecy, tightening your grip on the carrying straps. Two narrow tracks branch out before the mounting block, each leading deeper into the freezing terraces.

nodes.brief: The wind shifts sharply from the north, carrying the metallic tang of distant foundry smoke and the sharp yelp of a mountain fox.

exits.label: Follow the squeaking wind-vane

nodes.title: The Tang of Foundry Smoke
nodes.page:
The wind shifts sharply from the north, carrying the metallic tang of distant foundry smoke and the sharp, piercing yelp of a mountain fox quartering the scree slopes below. You inhale the sudden scent of coal-fire and hot iron with a surge of relief, knowing that Lowgate and the great forge-masters are drawing closer with every arduous mile. In its canvas sling the bronze clapper answers the unseen blast-furnaces with a faint knock against your spine.

You adjust your footing on the glazed limestone, letting the smell of smoke guide your gaze across the vast, plunging drop of the gorge. The path bends abruptly around a buttress of black rock, revealing a single onward route.

nodes.brief: You adjust the slipping canvas cradle of the clapper, feeling the dead bronze thrum in rhythm with your own tired heartbeat.

exits.privWhy: Biscuit the mule is with the reader and knows the ledges and the ropeway stalls
exits.label: Take the hidden mule path
Touch the vibrating retaining wall

nodes.title: The Rhythm of the Bronze
nodes.page:
The slipping canvas cradle of the clapper needs a hitch until the dead bronze settles into a slow rhythm against your own tired heartbeat. The metal holds the chill of the high mountain peaks, seeping through your thick tunic despite the woollen padding. Every step demands conscious effort now as the stone flags grow slicker with rime and wind-driven sleet.

You pause to catch your breath in the thin, biting air, palm flat on the icy terrace retaining wall until your trembling arms quiet. The path splits ahead around a stone water-cistern, offering two distinct routes through the frozen terraces.

nodes.brief: Crossing a rickety cedar bridge over a gorge of grey mist, you hear the timbers groan under the combined weight of you and Biscuit.

exits.label: Step carefully off the span

nodes.title: The Groaning Cedar Bridge
nodes.page:
Crossing a rickety cedar bridge over a gorge of grey mist, you hear the timbers groan under the combined weight of you and Biscuit. A draft of damp air and old pine rises from the abyss, and the bronze tongue in your cradle ticks once against your spine.

Every plank shifts slightly underfoot, testing your balance and reminding you that one misstep would send both traveler and burden down into the white obscurity.

nodes.brief: A tattered scarecrow stuffed with oat-straw points a crooked wooden finger toward the precipitous drop where the ladder-path begins.

exits.label: Leave the silent watcher behind
Inspect the milestone by the drop

nodes.title: The Straw Finger
nodes.page:
A tattered scarecrow stuffed with oat-straw points a crooked wooden finger toward the precipitous drop where the ladder-path begins. Its sackcloth head turns slowly in the mountain current, watching you pass while Biscuit gives a low, disgruntled snort at the straw man's empty sleeves.

The wind whistles through the dry stalks in a reedy rush that blends with the faint knock of the metal against your back.

nodes.brief: Miller Sedge hurls a handful of dry chaff into the wind to test the draft, narrowly missing your pack and the humming bronze tongue.

exits.label: Continue past the lower stone marker
Glance toward the distant ice rungs

nodes.title: Chaff on the Wind
nodes.page:
Miller Sedge hurls a handful of dry chaff into the wind to test the draft, narrowly missing your pack and the humming bronze tongue. The golden husks scatter instantly into the abyss, swallowed by the rising updraft from the glacier fields below.

He shakes his head and mutters about the unpredictability of the upper air, then turns back to secure his millstones.

nodes.brief: You shelter behind a dry-stone retaining wall while a sudden squall of ice-pellets rattles against the heavy bronze clapper like buckshot.

exits.label: Resume walking as the air clears
Check the milestone at the path edge

nodes.title: The Ice-Pellet Squall
nodes.page:
You shelter behind a dry-stone retaining wall while a sudden squall of ice-pellets rattles against the heavy bronze clapper like buckshot. The tiny frozen beads bounce off your canvas cradle and skitter across the frosty flags with a sharp, clicking chatter.

Waiting out the brief fury, you press your shoulder against the cold stone and steady the mule against the sudden gust.

nodes.brief: A Cable Court clerk offers a predatory credit token for your mule's shoes, promising safe transit down the remaining cliffs for half your rations.

exits.label: Adjust your chest harness firmly
Warn the nervous ropewright ahead

nodes.title: The Predatory Token
nodes.page:
A Cable Court clerk offers a predatory credit token for your mule's shoes, promising safe transit down the remaining cliffs for half your rations. His ink-stained fingers tap on a brass ledger while his eyes measure the bronze on your back with professional greed.

You pat Biscuit's warm neck and decline the thin parchment offer, knowing too well the price of borrowing from the court.

nodes.brief: Two fog-wardens pass you in the white gloom, their synchronized hand-bells ringing a mournful three-beat cadence to warn of the ice edge.

exits.label: Secure the heavy leather harness
Peer toward the frosted ladder drop

nodes.title: The Mournful Cadence
nodes.page:
Two fog-wardens pass you in the white gloom, their synchronized hand-bells ringing a mournful three-beat cadence to warn of the ice edge. Their wool cloaks are stiff with rime, and their faces are hidden beneath deep leather hoods, revealing only the grim set of their jaws.

They offer a brief nod as they stride past into the freezing vapor, their bells fading into a dull, rhythmic clatter.

nodes.brief: The stone path gives way to a slick sheet of blue glacier-run, forcing you to inch forward with your heels locked against the granite.

exits.label: Test the iron rungs below
Speak a quiet word of caution
Share water from the iron flask

nodes.title: The Blue Glacier-Run
nodes.page:
The stone path gives way to a slick sheet of blue glacier-run, forcing you to inch forward with your heels locked against the granite. Biscuit finds his footing with a desperate scramble, his iron shoes clicking sharply on the polished sheet of ancient ice.

The drop-off waits just beyond your boots, silent and steep, demanding absolute concentration with every single breath.

nodes.brief: A stray mountain goat watches from a high ledge, its amber eyes bright and indifferent to your struggle with the heavy metal load.

exits.label: Tighten the strap across your ribs
Look down toward the ice ladders

nodes.title: The High Watcher
nodes.page:
A stray mountain goat watches from a high ledge, its amber eyes bright and indifferent to your struggle with the heavy metal load. It shifts its weight on tiny, sure-footed hooves, completely unbothered by the sheer drop that makes your own stomach tighten.

As you pause to catch your breath, the animal turns gracefully and bounds upward into the swirling cloud.

nodes.brief: You find a discarded tinker's hammer frozen in a puddle, its wooden handle splintered by frost-expansion but the iron head still sound.

exits.label: Peer over the edge at the rungs
Pass the anxious terrace gate guard

nodes.title: The Frozen Tinker's Hammer
nodes.page:
You find a discarded tinker's hammer frozen in a puddle, its wooden handle splintered by frost-expansion but the iron head still sound. Prying it free with your thumb, you test its weight and find it balanced well enough for driving loose pitons into the rock.

You slip the cold tool into your belt pouch alongside a coil of spare hemp line, glancing down the narrowing path.

nodes.brief: The bronze clapper emits a sudden, low-pitched thrum that makes the loose pebbles at your feet dance in tiny concentric circles.

exits.label: Adjust the leather harness tightly
Approach the nervous terrace gate
Accept the iron piton from the miller

nodes.title: The Resonant Thrum
nodes.page:
The bronze clapper suddenly sounds a low note that makes the loose pebbles at your feet dance in tiny concentric circles. The vibration travels straight through the padded canvas and into your shoulders, setting your teeth on edge with its deep, bell-metal resonance.

Biscuit cocks an ear backward at the sound, stomping a dusty hoof against the frozen ground as if answering a distant call.

nodes.brief: A low stone shrine to the Mountain Mother holds three tallow candles guttering in the wind, their flames shielded by cracked slate tiles.

exits.label: Approach the freezing ladder edge
Share water with Biscuit
Accept the miller's piton

nodes.title: The Mountain Mother Shrine
nodes.page:
Three tallow candles gutter within a low stone alcove dedicated to the Mountain Mother, their frail flames shielded from the biting draughts by cracked slate tiles. The bronze clapper on your back knocks a low note that seems to hold the wax smoke before it can drift into your face. Biscuit shifts his weight on the gravel, blowing warm air against your frozen shoulder as you weigh the paths stretching out beyond the altar.

You can pause to leave a copper coin among the tallow stubs, press onward toward the steep ladder drops, or seek out the last miller before the stone gates close.

nodes.brief: Biscuit brays a harsh, echoing challenge into the canyon, startling a flock of white-feathered choughs from the sheer cliff face.

exits.label: Descend toward the darkening ladders
Rest and water the mule

nodes.title: The Mule's Challenge
nodes.page:
A harsh, echoing bray tears from Biscuit's throat, bouncing off the limestone canyon walls and startling a dense flock of white-feathered choughs from their ledges. The sudden flutter of wings leaves the high air ringing, while the bronze clapper on your back responds with a sympathetic thrum that sets your teeth on edge. The mule stamps his hoof against the frozen earth, eager to put the barley terraces behind him and test the open drops below.

You tighten your grip on the leading tether, calming the beast with a firm hand on his dusty flank as the wind howls through the stone gaps.

nodes.brief: You scrape crusted mud and barley hulls from your boot treads, shivering as the damp mountain air seeps through your woven wool tunic.

exits.label: Take the miller's iron piton
Step through the lowest terrace gate
Turn back toward the upper mill

nodes.title: Scraping the Treads
nodes.page:
Crusted mud and crushed barley hulls cake your boot treads, making the uneven stone path slick as you shiver in your woven wool tunic. The damp mountain air clings to your skin, turning every breath into a plume of white fog that vanishes instantly into the vast emptiness of the gorge. You lean against the retaining wall to scrape frozen clay away with an iron flake, keeping the clapper balanced across your shoulders.

The stone track narrows sharply here, offering a choice between pressing on into the gathering shadows or returning to the bitter shelter of the mill-houses.

nodes.brief: Following Biscuit's canny instinct down a mule-track blocked to humans, you bypass a dangerous ice-slide and gain an hour of precious daylight.

exits.label: Accept the miller's iron piton
Step through the lowest terrace gate

priv.why: Biscuit the mule is with the reader and knows the ledges and the ropeway stalls

nodes.title: The Clever Path
nodes.page:
Following Biscuit's infallible mule instinct down a treacherous goat-track forbidden to human boots, you bypass a glittering sheet of black ice that would have broken an ankle. The detour saves a precious hour of daylight and sets you safely below the worst terrace winds, the clapper riding easy in its cradle. Biscuit picks his way sure-footedly over the shale, his long ears twitching to catch the distant signals of the ropeway stalls.

You pat his warm, dusty grey neck in silent gratitude as the ground levels out near the boundary gates.

nodes.brief: A rusted iron wind-vane shaped like a leaping trout spins erratically on its spindle, squeaking a dry warning of the storm still to come.

exits.label: Share water with Biscuit
Step through the lowest terrace gate

nodes.title: The Leaping Trout
nodes.page:
A rusted iron wind-vane shaped like a leaping trout spins erratically upon its lichen-spotted spindle, squeaking a dry, frantic warning of the storm still gathering above the peaks. Frost crystals feather its metal tail, catching the pale grey light of the high altitude afternoon. The bronze clapper shifts slightly in its padded frame, answering the metallic squeal with a deep, subterranean vibration that travels straight down your spine.

You pull your wool collar tighter against the rising gale, eyeing the shadowed descents that wind away from the silent mills.

nodes.brief: You press your palm against the icy terrace retaining wall, feeling the ancient mortar vibrate with the underground hum of the falling mountain.

exits.label: Accept the miller's piton
Step through the lowest terrace gate

nodes.title: The Thrumming Wall
nodes.page:
Your palm presses flat against the icy terrace retaining wall, and the ancient, mortarless stones shake beneath your glove with the underground knock of the falling mountain. It is an ancient pulse that matches the bronze tongue resting against your spine. Far below, the cloud sea churns in grey silence, hiding the destination you must reach before the passes seal for winter.

You flex your cold fingers and adjust the harness straps, preparing for the long vertical stretches ahead.

nodes.brief: The wind-mills fall silent behind you one by one, their wooden sails lashed fast with hemp rope against the coming mountain gale.

exits.label: Step out onto the swaying ladder
Peer down into the cloud sea

nodes.title: The Silent Mills
nodes.page:
The windmills fall silent behind you one by one, their giant wooden sails lashed fast with thick hemp rope against the coming mountain gale. Not a single miller remains on the open platforms, leaving only the whistling of the high wind through the empty framing and the dry scrape of gravel underfoot. The bronze clapper on your back feels heavier with every yard, a constant reminder of the bronze weight awaiting the Lowgate forge-masters.

You reach the hard edge of the stone path where the world drops away into mist and vertical ice.

nodes.brief: A solitary iron milestone hammered into the cliffside marks the final boundary of the barley terraces and the start of the vertical ice.

exits.label: Step out onto the swaying ladder
Grip the uppermost rungs

nodes.title: The Iron Milestone
nodes.page:
A solitary iron milestone, hammered deep into the living rock of the cliffside, marks the final boundary of the barley terraces and the start of the vertical ice. Blackened by decades of mountain weather, its embossed numbers are worn smooth by the passage of countless boots and mule trains. The air here has a sharp, metallic edge that smells of frozen snow and ancient stone.

You pause beside the iron bolt to catch your breath before committing your weight to the frozen abyss.

nodes.brief: You tighten the leather harness across your chest, ensuring the heavy clapper cannot shift as you prepare for the steep descent ahead.

exits.label: Step out onto the swaying ladder
Grip the uppermost rungs
Descend with Biscuit on the chain

nodes.title: Securing the Harness
nodes.page:
You tighten the leather harness across your chest until the broad straps bite into your wool tunic so the clapper cannot shift or throw you off balance on the steep descent. The metal tongue settles against the padding with a faint tap once the knotwork holds. Biscuit stands at your elbow, his breath pluming white in the freezing air as he waits for the signal to move.

The stone pathway ends abruptly at the threshold of the open gulf, leaving only vertical rungs and cableways below.

nodes.brief: The fog clears for a heartbeat, revealing the dizzying drop to the glacier ladders where iron rungs frost over in the gathering dusk.

exits.label: Step out onto the swaying ladder
Grip the uppermost rungs

nodes.title: The Clearing Fog
nodes.page:
The mountain fog parts for a single, breathtaking heartbeat, revealing the dizzying drop to the glacier ladders where iron rungs frost over in the gathering dusk. Far below, tiny structural timbers of the lower cable stations jut from the blue-white ice like splinters in a frozen wound. The bronze clapper on your back catches a stray shaft of pale sunlight, flashing a dull amber glow against the gray cliffs.

You steady your boots on the rim of the precipice, choosing your exact line down the freezing iron.

nodes.brief: A nervous ropewright checks the anchor-bolts on the final terrace gate, warning you that the iron rungs below are glazed with black ice.

exits.label: Step out onto the icy rungs
Wait behind the stone wall
Look for a sheltered ledge nearby

nodes.title: The Anchor Bolts
nodes.page: Trembling hands trace the cold iron of the final terrace gate while a nervous ropewright checks every anchor-bolt against the rising gale. He warns that the rungs below are glazed with a treacherous skin of black ice, making every foothold a hazard. The bronze clapper rests against your shoulder blades, yet the mountain offers no easy passage through the freezing mist.

nodes.brief: You share a final draught of cold water from your iron flask with Biscuit, patting his dusty grey neck before the stairs run out.

exits.label: Lead the mule down the slope
Check your shoulder harness again

nodes.title: Sharing The Flask
nodes.page: Cool water refreshes your parched throat before you share the last draught from your iron flask with Biscuit, patting his dusty grey neck as the mule huffs plumes of white vapor into the thin air. The terrace path beneath your boots grows narrower by the stride, and the stairs are running out into open space above the cloud sea. You seat the bronze tongue in its padded cradle and check that the animal is settled for the steep drop ahead.

nodes.brief: The last miller of the tier hands you an iron piton for the ladders, muttering a dry blessing for your journey down to Lowgate.

exits.label: Slide the piton into your belt
Press forward past the barley tiers

nodes.title: The Miller's Piton
nodes.page: Heavy silver frost coats the barley stubble as the last miller of the tier hands you an iron piton for the ladders, muttering a dry blessing for your long journey down to Lowgate. His calloused fingers trace the leather straps of your pack, wishing the great bronze clapper a safe arrival at the foundry. The cold air bites at your cheeks, carrying the faint sound of distant ice cracking in the deep chasms below.

nodes.brief: You step past the stone threshold of the lowest terrace gate, leaving the whispered wind-calls of the millers behind in the freezing air.

exits.label: Step directly onto the hanging ladder

nodes.title: Beyond The Lowest Gate
nodes.page: Cold stone threshold bricks give way to the open void as you step past the lowest terrace gate, leaving the whispered wind-calls of the millers behind in the freezing air. The mountain drops away beneath your soles into a vast expanse of grey cloud and shifting mist. Only the bronze clapper's soft tick breaks the silence of the upper cliffs.

nodes.brief: The stone stairs terminate abruptly at a sheer drop of blue-white ice where the first great ladder swings in the mountain draft.

exits.label: Press on into the grey abyss

nodes.title: The Sheer Drop
nodes.page: Jagged stone stairs terminate abruptly at a sheer drop of blue-white ice where the first great ladder swings freely in the mountain draft. Below this dizzying threshold, the world vanishes into a churning floor of clouds that swallows every echo of the valley. The heavy bronze tongue shifts against your back, pulling your center of gravity toward the open abyss.

nodes.brief: Gripping the frozen iron rungs of the uppermost glacier ladder, you feel the bronze clapper pull your weight backward into the abyss.

exits.label: Press on down the frozen rungs

nodes.title: The Uppermost Rung
nodes.page: Frost bites into your bare fingers while gripping the frozen iron rungs of the uppermost glacier ladder, and you feel the heavy bronze clapper pull your weight backward into the abyss. The mountain wind howls through the narrow gap in the cliffs, testing your footing on the slick metal bars. Every muscle strains against the load as you peer down into the swirling white blur.

nodes.brief: Below your dangling boots, the cloud sea churns like curdled milk, hiding the distant roofs of Lowgate while the wind rises to a scream.

exits.label: Press on through the roaring wind

nodes.title: The Churning Clouds
nodes.page: Below your dangling boots, the cloud sea churns like curdled milk, hiding the distant roofs of Lowgate while the wind rises to a relentless scream. The copper-cored rope sings a low counterpoint to the roaring draft and shakes through your entire frame with every gust. Ice crystals gather on your eyelashes as you search the pale glare for the next foothold.

nodes.brief: With Biscuit tethered securely to your belt-chain, you take the first downward step onto the swaying rungs of the vertical world.

exits.label: Press on onto the swaying rungs

nodes.title: The Swaying World
nodes.page: Sturdy leather straps keep Biscuit tethered securely to your belt-chain as you take the first downward step onto the swaying rungs of the vertical world. The metal groans under the combined weight of the mule, the pack, and the humming bronze tongue, swinging out over the empty air. You steady your breathing against the cold and watch the fog part slightly below.

nodes.brief: Ignoring the warning wind-calls, you attempt to cross the high terrace in a gathering gale and plunge your heavy pack into the abyss.
nodes.title: The Broken Tier
nodes.page:
Ignoring the warning wind-calls echoing from the higher mills, you attempt to cross the exposed terrace while a sudden gathering gale tears at your cloak. The bronze clapper catches the fierce crosswind like a sail and throws your footing off the slick black ice. You pitch forward against the low stone parapet, and the momentum drags you and your precious burden over the rim.

For one weightless heartbeat, the screaming wind falls completely silent as the mountain drops away beneath your boots. Then the dark abyss swallows you whole, and only a faint bronze note fades against the empty air.

nodes.brief: Traded away all your daylight hours to master every miller's whistle until the mountain pass froze shut forever, entombing you and the clapper in silent ice.
nodes.title: The Silent Ice
nodes.page: Endless hours slip through your frozen fingers as you trade away the daylight to master every miller's whistle, lingering too long among the silent barley terraces. The mountain pass freezes shut forever around you, sealing the stone gates in solid rime. The heavy clapper grows as cold as your own pulse, entombing you both in a monument of absolute silence.

nodes.brief: Arrival in The Glacier Ladders: ice stairs and rope-bridges across a moving glacier, whiteouts and crevasses; the Clapper, the mule and the body are all tested. The reader enters with several ways forward.

exits.label: Follow the main stair
Cut across the lower ledges

exits.intent: Ask the way of a stranger
exits.label: Ask the way of a stranger
Take the old carriers' path

nodes.title: The Frozen Stair
nodes.page:
Blue ice shelves rise in tiered terraces ahead, fractured by deep crevasses that exhale a steady, sub-zero damp. You hitch the padded cradle on your shoulders until the bronze Clapper settles into a low rhythm against your spine. Biscuit stamps a stubborn hoof against the glazed rock, testing the treacherous footing of the upper glacier. Every breath crystallizes instantly in the thin mountain air, and the wind carries the distant, metallic rattle of ropeways disappearing into the blinding white mists below.

Ahead, the descent splits into several daunting paths through the ice labyrinths.

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Ice Cradle: the glacier begins; the reader decides how to protect the Clapper (wrapped and slow, or bare and quick but exposed)

exits.intent: Wrap the Clapper tight against the cold
exits.label: Wrap the Clapper tight against the cold

exits.intent: Leave it bare and keep your hands free
exits.label: Leave it bare and keep your hands free

nodes.title: The Ice Cradle Choice
nodes.page:
The frozen tongue of the glacier begins here in earnest, sweeping downward between walls of ancient blue-green ice that groan under immense pressure. Orison's bronze tongue rides against your pack, cold enough to bite through cloth. Wrap the clapper tight and the sacred metal stays clear of frost and abrasive ice; leave it bare and your fingers stay free for the climbs ahead.

Frost already beads on the bronze rim.

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Whiteout: a whiteout on a rope-bridge; the reader holds the line (and is frostbitten) or cuts loose what is slowing them

exits.intent: Hold the line through the whiteout with your own hands
exits.label: Hold the line through the whiteout with your own hands

exits.intent: Cut Biscuit's lead and save yourself
exits.label: Cut Biscuit's lead and save yourself

nodes.title: The Whiteout Choice
nodes.page:
Freezing winds howl across the swaying rope-bridge, turning the glacier into a swirling desert of blinding white where earth and sky dissolve into one terrifying void. Your fingers are nearly black with cold, and the sheer weight of the bronze Clapper threatens to pitch you backward into the abyss at any second. Biscuit plants his hooves stubbornly against the icy deck, trembling with exhaustion as the gale hammers your flanks.

You cannot stay here without freezing to the stone, and you cannot carry both yourself and the full burden forward without paying a terrible price to the mountain.

nodes.brief: Leaving The Glacier Ladders for The Fogbank Orchards: close this part of the journey.

exits.label: Go on deeper into the mist

nodes.title: Leaving the Ice
nodes.page:
The frozen rungs of the ladder-world finally give way beneath your boots as you drop below the reach of the scouring gales. Ice-rimed ropes slacken into damp hemp, and the unyielding white glare softens into a pearly, motionless gloom. You pat the bronze cradle on your back and find a lingering warmth still trapped in the metal despite the frost. Ahead, the world softens into gray dripping shapes and the smell of fermenting windfalls, marking the true boundary of the middle mountain.

The long descent of the ice stairs is behind you now, leaving your shoulders aching and your breath coming easier in the thickening mist.

nodes.brief: Frost grips the lower winch-shed where old Morven greases the iron cable against the impending blue-glacier freeze.

exits.label: Step past the greased winch and check the rope tension

Slip through the side hatch toward the upper ice ridge

nodes.title: The Winch Shed
nodes.page:
Frost grips the lower winch-shed where old Morven greases the iron cable against the impending blue-glacier freeze. The winch gear creaks as the wind bears down from the seracs, and rendered tallow mingles with the sharp scent of ozone. Biscuit shifts in the cramped doorway and shakes rime from his long ears while the bronze Clapper answers from its pack with a faint soft note. Morven pauses with his cloth, eyeing your burden and the toll ledgers bound with twine on the rough-hewn desk.

A ledger page flutters in the draft, and the collectors from the Cable Court stir by the corner post.

nodes.brief: Loose shale clatters into the blue abyss beneath the lower staging as Biscuit tests the frost-slicked timber.

exits.label: Tread carefully across the swaying timber planks
Climb the diagonal anchor-cable to bypass the bridge

nodes.title: The Staging Edge
nodes.page:
Loose shale clatters into the blue abyss beneath the lower staging as Biscuit tests the frost-slicked timber. The suspension bridge sways gently in the draft, its weathered planks groaning under your pack and the bronze Clapper together. Below, the glacier tongue grinds slowly against the canyon walls, a silent river of ancient ice scarred by deep, fathomless cracks. Every movement requires absolute balance, for a single misstep would send you tumbling into the freezing void.

The wooden guardrail is caked in clear glaze, offering little purchase for cold fingers. You tighten your grip on the harness and weigh your options for crossing.

nodes.brief: A sudden downdraft rattles the hanging ladder rungs above the crevasse while the bronze Clapper hums softly against your spine.

exits.label: Scramble across the swaying ladder to the moraine
Drop down to the dangling rope-line and shimmy across
Lead the mule along the narrow, ice-rimmed shelf

nodes.title: The Hanging Rungs
nodes.page:
A sudden downdraft rattles the hanging ladder rungs above the crevasse, and the bronze Clapper taps soft against your spine. The metal chains supporting the crossing bite into the ice rim with a sharp, metallic shiver, vibrating in tune with the rising gale. Biscuit tucks his tail against his flanks, bracing his weight against the swaying rungs as powdered snow blinds the view below. The air is so cold it burns your lungs, yet sweat freezes instantly at your temples.

You grip the icy iron links until your knuckles ache, scanning the white expanse for a secure route onward.

nodes.brief: Salt-crusted snow drifts across the gravel shelf where the Ropewrights have stacked coils of hemp line for the crossing.

exits.label: Follow the gray mist toward the glacier anchor-bolts
Adjust your shoulder straps and brave the wind-scoured rock

nodes.title: The Hemp Coils
nodes.page: Salt-crusted snow drifts across the gravel shelf where the Ropewrights have stacked coils of hemp line for the crossing. Ropes lie frozen stiff as iron, coiled neat beside rusted anchor-spikes driven deep into the permafrost. Biscuit blows a frosty ring into the air, his breath smelling of dry mountain feed while the Clapper hums a deep, warning note against your back. A discarded leather mitten lies half-buried in the drift, reminding you how quickly the cold numbs the unwary traveler.

nodes.brief: Rusted iron cramps bite into the blue glacier snout while a Fog-Warden named Jori clears rime from the signal horn.

exits.label: Pick your way across the brittle frost feathers on the upper serac shelf
Clip your harness to the taut cable spanning the glacial gap
Edge past the gaping blue crevasse while overhead cables sing

nodes.title: The Glacier Snout
nodes.page:
Rusted iron cramps bite into the blue glacier snout while a Fog-Warden named Jori clears rime from the signal horn. The brass instrument emits a low, resonant note that dies instantly in the vast white silence of the ice fields. Biscuit plants his hooves firmly against the blue-tinged rime, his ears twitching at the distant cracking of the seracs above. The bronze Clapper on your back answers the horn, a low tone that makes your teeth ache.

Jori points toward three distinct tracks vanishing into the blowing snow.

nodes.brief: Cable Court collectors wave you through an unguarded maintenance tunnel, bypassing the perilous ice-arch altogether.

exits.label: Take the narrow cleft in the ice wall to escape the draft

nodes.title: The Maintenance Tunnel
nodes.page:
Cable Court collectors wave you through an unguarded maintenance tunnel, bypassing the perilous ice-arch altogether. The damp stone walls of the shaft are slick with mineral ooze, and the air smells of old oil and damp wool. Biscuit ducks his head to avoid the low-hanging timber beams while the bronze Clapper taps against your spine, the sound made louder by the narrow vault. The collectors watch you with sharp, assessing eyes, knowing you carry a debt as heavy as your pack.

A branching series of dark corridors and hidden passages opens up ahead in the dim lantern light.

nodes.brief: Frozen spray coats the wooden handrails of the upper bridge while Biscuit digs his stubborn hooves into the blue rime.

exits.label: Clip your harness to the taut cable spanning the glacial gap
Take shelter from the gale in a narrow ice wall cleft
Edge past the gaping blue crevasse while overhead cables sing

nodes.title: The Icy Rail
nodes.page: Frozen spray coats the wooden handrails of the upper bridge while Biscuit digs his stubborn hooves into the blue rime. The wind shrieks through the canyon like a living thing, tearing at your hood and testing your balance with every stride. The Clapper on your back cools as if drawing the mountain's frost into its bronze tongue. Below, the glacial river flashes white and turquoise through gaps in the ice.

nodes.brief: Sharp blue shards flake off the towering wall above the crevasses, threatening to sever the frayed guide-ropes.

exits.label: Duck into a narrow ice wall cleft for shelter
