nodes.title: The Frayed Guide
nodes.page:
Sharp blue shards flake off the towering wall above the crevasses and could cut the frayed guide-ropes. Boot-crunch and the bronze Clapper's rhythm both sound larger than they should in this frigid air. Biscuit stands with lowered head while spindrift whips across the ledge and needles his hide. The old ropes show dangerous fraying where they pass over jagged crystal outcrops.

A fresh shard skitters across the ledge near Biscuit's hoof.

nodes.brief: A steep crevasse bridge made of notched larch poles groans under the weight of the bronze Clapper.

exits.label: Press forward across the crystal spikes littering the path
Descend into the deep blue ice vault where the stream roars
Climb the vertical blue serac using the Ropewright knot-line

nodes.title: The Larch Bridge
nodes.page:
A steep crevasse bridge of notched larch poles groans beneath the bronze Clapper. Frost has turned the bark to bone-white mail, and the chasm below yawns wide enough to swallow a cottage. Biscuit hesitates, his nostrils flaring at the smell of deep ice and moving water far beneath the floorboards. You calm the mule with a soft word and a firm hand on his halter while the metal tongue knocks against your weary shoulders.

The poles sway alarmingly in the crosswind, demanding your complete concentration for the remaining distance.

nodes.brief: Hushed winds whistle through the frozen moraine where a Terrace Miller salvage crew piles stray barley sacks.

exits.label: Climb the frozen timber steps toward the upper serac
Pick a path across the dazzling glacial basin

nodes.title: Moraine Salvage
nodes.page:
Hushed winds whistle through the frozen moraine where a Terrace Miller salvage crew piles stray barley sacks. You stand knee-deep in gray drift and brace the padded crate against your spine as the bronze Clapper inside answers the gale with a faint knock. The millers ignore your passage, intent on securing their grain before the afternoon freeze hardens the ruts into glass. Your boots slip on the gravel, forcing you to choose between the steep upper shelf or the blinding basin below.

The air tastes of dry chaff and old snow.

nodes.brief: A frozen rope-ladder dangles above an endless blue void while the bitter air chills the metal in your pack.

exits.label: Ascend the vertical blue serac on frozen timber steps
Cross the glaring ice-ridge toward the lower basin
Risk the weight of the crooked basket hoist over the abyss

nodes.title: The Dangling Ladder
nodes.page: A frozen rope-ladder dangles above an endless blue void while the bitter air chills the metal in your pack. Below your boots, the glacier groans and shifts, grinding ancient ice against rock with a sound like iron teeth. You grip the hempen rungs, stiff with rime and grey frost, while the bronze Clapper pulls your center of gravity back toward the abyss. Every breath stings your throat, and the wind offers no shelter as you weigh the iron routes ahead.

nodes.brief: Slick blue ice margins force you to crawl on hands and knees while the mule finds a narrower footing.

exits.label: Follow the subterranean stream into the blue ice vault
Pick a path across the dazzling glacial basin
Climb toward the frost-veneered stone stairhead

nodes.title: Slick Ice Margins
nodes.page: Slick blue ice margins force you to crawl on hands and knees while the mule finds a narrower footing. Biscuit stumbles once, his iron shoes clicking sharply against a hidden rib of blue glass before he regains his balance with a disgruntled snort. You keep your head low and listen to the bronze tongue knock against your spine with every shift. The pass splits ahead into a subterranean roar, a blinding glare, and a steep stairhead lost in rime.

nodes.brief: Gray mist rolls off the glacier tongue, obscuring the anchor-bolts and threatening to swallow the trail completely.

exits.label: Inspect the crooked basket hoist hanging over the abyss
Wait on the moraine ridge as the afternoon freeze sets in

nodes.title: Glacier Tongue Mist
nodes.page: Gray mist rolls off the glacier tongue, obscuring the anchor-bolts and threatening to swallow the trail completely. The world shrinks to the reach of your numb fingers and the scrape of Biscuit's hooves on the grit. Without the rope-lines to guide your shoulders, the drop-off into the white void feels dangerously close. You pause to catch your breath against the damp cold, listening to the iron rigging groan in the distance.

nodes.brief: Shivering against the wind-scoured rock, you adjust the shoulder straps while the bronze mass hums a deep warning note.

exits.label: Head toward the stone stairhead where a weary traveler rests
Battle the stinging ice granules on the exposed ledge

nodes.title: Shivering on the Ledge
nodes.page: Shivering against the wind-scoured rock, you adjust the shoulder straps while the bronze mass hums a deep warning note. The temperature drops sharply as the sun dips behind the high jagged teeth of the Orisonhold wall, turning the sweat on your collar into freezing needles. Biscuit presses his warm flank against your arm, sharing what little heat remains in the mountain air. Two distinct tracks offer an escape from the freezing ledge before night closes the passes.

nodes.brief: Brittle frost feathers snap underfoot on the upper serac shelf where an abandoned sled lies half-buried in blue snow.

exits.label: Cross the fragile ice bridges spanning the bottomless gulf

nodes.title: Upper Serac Shelf
nodes.page: Brittle frost feathers snap underfoot on the upper serac shelf where an abandoned sled lies half-buried in blue snow. The wood is splintered and gray, left behind by some earlier haul of timber or stone that never reached the lowlands. You check the lashings on your back and confirm the bronze Clapper sits secure in its padded cradle before taking another step. The path ahead narrows into a fragile rib of ice spanning the vast gulf.

nodes.brief: Twisted iron pitons hold a taut cable spanning the glacial gap while ice water drips steadily onto your leather collar.

exits.label: Step out onto the fragile ice bridges over the gulf
Follow the scratched brass markers along the old winter trail

nodes.title: Twisted Iron Pitons
nodes.page: Twisted iron pitons hold a taut cable spanning the glacial gap while ice water drips steadily onto your leather collar. The metal hums in harmony with the bronze Clapper on your back, creating a strange, vibrating chord that echoes off the blue walls. You test the tension with a gloved hand, feeling the solid anchor hold fast against the mountain's slow slide. Beyond the cable, scratched markers and bottomless gulfs compete for your attention.

nodes.brief: A narrow cleft in the ice wall offers shelter from the gale while Biscuit tests the firmness of the hard-packed drift.

exits.label: Venture out onto the fragile ice bridges spanning the gulf
Untangle the knotted guide-rope in the glacial shadow

nodes.title: Narrow Cleft Shelter
nodes.page: A narrow cleft in the ice wall offers shelter from the gale while Biscuit tests the firmness of the hard-packed drift. The walls here are translucent blue, glowing faintly with trapped light from centuries of packed snowfall. You slip the straps from your aching shoulders a moment and set the Clapper against the frozen stone while you catch your breath. The wind howls outside the crevice, but the air inside is still and bitterly cold.

nodes.brief: Overhead cables sing in the glacial draft like tightened harp strings while you edge past a gaping blue crevasse.

exits.label: Pick your way across the rime-covered stepping stones

exits.privWhy: the reader owes the Cable Court a toll-debt and is recognised by its collectors
exits.label: Hand over your Cable Court debt token to the toll-warden

nodes.title: Overhead Cables
nodes.page: Overhead cables sing in the glacial draft like tightened harp strings while you edge past a gaping blue crevasse. The sheer drop on your right vanishes into a milky sea of cloud, hiding the lower tiers of the mountain entirely. You lean inward against the rock face and keep the bronze mass balanced between your shoulder blades. Every gust tests your footing on the narrow, frost-slick ledge.

nodes.brief: Whistling back to the high terrace mills earns you a secret guide-rope shortcut across the shifting blue ice.

exits.label: Approach the rusted iron winch standing over the lower drop
Cross the hard-packed snow bridge toward the tinkling bell

nodes.title: Whistling Shortcut
nodes.page: Whistling back to the high terrace mills earns you a secret guide-rope shortcut across the shifting blue ice. A distant miller answers your signal with three sharp notes on a bone pipe, confirming that the upper cable is clear of drift-ice. You adjust your grip on the harness and follow the hidden line through a maze of séracs where few travelers dare to tread. The mule picks its way carefully behind you, ears flicking to the sound of the distant pipes.

nodes.brief: Shattered crystal spikes litter the glacier footway where the weight of your pack threatens to break your rhythm.

exits.label: Approach the frozen iron winch

exits.label: Show your token to the toll warden

nodes.title: Shards of Blue Ice
nodes.page:
Shattered crystal spikes litter the glacier footway, their razor edges catching the pale mountain light as the heavy bronze Clapper shifts against your shoulders. Every step onto the frozen debris threatens to break your rhythm, forcing you to lean hard into the padded cradle while Biscuit picks a cautious path among the glittering detritus. Frost rimes your eyebrows, and the sheer weight of the bell-tongue pulls your spine toward the cold stone.

A rusted iron winch stands sentinel over the lower glacier drop, its cable frozen fast in a blue sheath. You could try to clear the mechanism yourself or look for another way down the slope.

nodes.title: Beneath the Ice Vault
nodes.page:
Deep beneath the blue ice vault, a subterranean stream roars against the ancient stone while the bronze Clapper vibrates persistently on your back, humming in tune with the rushing water. The air smells of wet slate and mountain chill, thick with the sound of unseen currents carving through the heart of the glacier. Your boots slide on the damp floor, and you catch yourself against the freezing wall as the metal tongue tugs at your harness.

Hard-packed snow bridges the central crevasse where a stray mule bell tinkles faintly in the distance, offering a fragile path across the abyss.

nodes.brief: Frozen timber steps ascend the vertical blue serac where a Ropewright knot secures the guide-line against the gale.

exits.label: Traverse the sloping blue ice shelves
Head toward the weathered signpost

nodes.title: The Frozen Serac
nodes.page:
Frozen timber steps ascend the vertical blue serac where a Ropewright knot secures the guide-line against the gale. The hemp is stiff with frost but holds true to the tension of the mountain wind. Your shoulders ache from the cradle straps as you haul yourself upward hand over hand.

The summit of the ice-fall is within reach, provided your fingers retain enough feeling to grip the frozen rungs.

nodes.brief: Blinding sunlight reflects off the glacial basin, turning every ice-ridge into a dazzling hazard of white and blue.

exits.label: Cross the central snow bridge
Push into the biting gale-trough

nodes.title: Glacial Basin Sunlight
nodes.page: Blinding sunlight reflects off the glacial basin, turning every ice-ridge into a dazzling hazard of white and blue. You squint against the glare, relying on the rhythmic swing of the Clapper to keep your balance on the crust. The heat of the reflection threatens to soften the surface snow into treacherous slush.

nodes.brief: A abandoned basket hoist hangs crookedly over the abyss while the icy wind tests the strength of the rigging.

exits.label: Push into the biting gale-trough
Head toward the weathered signpost
Step across the jagged ice fracture

nodes.title: The Abandoned Basket
nodes.page:
An abandoned basket hoist hangs crookedly over the abyss while the icy wind tests the strength of the rigging. Rust flakes from its iron frame, painting the white snow orange beneath your boots. The valley below is entirely swallowed by thick grey cloud, leaving only the screaming wind for company.

You can skirt the edge or search for a firmer crossing point among the blue fractures.

nodes.brief: Slick frost veneers the stone stairhead where a weary traveler named Brann rests his frostbitten fingers.

exits.label: Press on through the freezing fog
Step across the jagged ice fracture
Adjust the frozen leather straps

nodes.title: The Weary Traveler
nodes.page:
Slick frost veneers the stone stairhead where a weary traveler named Brann rests his frostbitten fingers. He offers a tight, grim smile as you approach, rubbing warmth back into his hands against the bitter draft. The stairs plunge downward into shadow from this ledge, demanding absolute focus from every traveler who passes.

Various ways present themselves amid the frozen masonry and scattered debris.

nodes.brief: Heavy blue shadows lengthen across the moraine ridge as the afternoon freeze hardens the melting snow bridges.

exits.label: Step across the jagged ice fracture

nodes.title: Lengthening Shadows
nodes.page:
Heavy blue shadows lengthen across the moraine ridge as the afternoon freeze hardens the melting snow bridges. The sudden drop in temperature makes the glacier groan with deep subterranean cracks that ripple through your soles. Silence returns quickly, broken only by the steady trudge of the mule behind you.

Only one narrow path remains open across the thickening frost.

nodes.brief: Sharp ice granules sting your cheeks on the exposed ledge while Biscuit lowers his head against the rising squall.

exits.label: Step across the jagged ice fracture
Adjust the frozen leather straps
Turn back along the staging

nodes.title: Squall on the Ledge
nodes.page: Sharp ice granules sting your cheeks on the exposed ledge while Biscuit lowers his head against the rising squall. The pack straps bite hard through your heavy woolen coat as the wind tries to peel you from the cliff face. Every breath is a struggle against the freezing gale sweeping up from the lower gorges.

nodes.brief: Fragile ice bridges span the bottomless blue gulf while every step risks a collapse into the freezing depths.

exits.label: Descend the slanted ice rungs
Navigate the narrow ledge

nodes.title: Fragile Ice Bridges
nodes.page:
Fragile ice bridges span the bottomless blue gulf while every step risks a collapse into the freezing depths. Here the Clapper's note drops lower over the ancient ice beneath your feet. You test each frost-covered span with a cautious boot before committing your full weight.

Two routes lead onward across the perilous chasm.

nodes.brief: Scratched brass markers on the rock face indicate the old winter trail now choked with blue-tinted drifts.

Navigate the narrow ledge

nodes.title: Scratched Brass Markers
nodes.page:
Scratched brass markers on the rock face indicate the old winter trail now choked with blue-tinted drifts. These ancient guideposts, hammered deep into the stone by generations of bell-ringers, offer meager comfort against the driving snow. You clear the rime from one plaque to verify your bearing in the growing gloom.

The path splits around a towering wall of blue serac ice.

nodes.brief: Shivering in the glacial shadow, you untangle a knotted guide-rope while the bronze tongue hums against the cold.

exits.label: Scramble down the slanting blue rungs
Balance across the upper moraine crest

nodes.title: The Glacial Shadow
nodes.page: Frost glazes your knuckles as you tug at the frozen hemp and work free a stubborn overhand knot, the bronze tongue knocking icy against your shoulder-blade. Down in the gloom, pale walls of ancient ice creak and settle under the mountain's press. Biscuit stamps a heavy hoof on the packed snow, impatient for movement, breath pluming grey in the bitter draft.

nodes.brief: Rime-covered boulders provide precarious stepping stones across a meltwater pool atop the shifting ice sheet.

exits.label: Pick a path toward the moraine crest
Leap across the cracked timber baulks

nodes.title: Meltwater Crossing
nodes.page: Slush and black water slide sluggishly between rime-thickened boulders that offer the only solid stepping-stones across the sunken pool of the shifting ice sheet. The heavy bronze Clapper shifts in its cradle, threatening to unbalance your stance with every breath of the alpine wind. Biscuit tests the nearest stone with a cautious grey muzzle, ears flicking back at the sound of cracking crystal beneath the surface. You can press forward toward the freezing heights or seek a safer crossing along the basin edge.

nodes.brief: A rusted iron winch stands sentinel over the lower glacier drop, its cable frozen fast in a blue sheath.

exits.label: Descend by the forgotten hemp line
Cross the cracked timber baulks

nodes.title: The Frozen Winch
nodes.page: Iron plates welded to the cliff face are buried in blue rime around the silent winch, its crank handle locked fast by a thick crust of winter ice. The cable disappears down into a narrow fracture where the glacier groans against the bedrock. The bronze tongue on your back ticks faintly in time with the frozen machinery beside you.

nodes.brief: Spotting your Cable Court debt token, the toll-warden drops a hidden winch-brake to lower your pack safely.

exits.label: Climb toward the windy moraine crest
Cross the final timber baulks
Step into the shifting crevasse fog

nodes.title: The Toll-Warden's Brake
nodes.page: Heavy iron clicking echoes off the blue walls as the Cable Court warden recognizes the notched copper debt token hanging from your coat and wrenches the hidden brake lever. The rusted drum spins in reverse, easing the unbearable weight of the bronze Clapper off your aching spine with a mechanical groan. Biscuit huffs in relief as the harness straps slacken against his ribs. You can follow the wind-whipped ledge upward, cross the final timber bridge, or step into the swirling fog of the crevasse field.

nodes.brief: Hard-packed snow bridges the central crevasse where a stray mule bell tinkles faintly in the distance.

exits.label: Enter the swirling crevasse mist
Adjust your stiff leather harness
Heed the deep bronze vibration

nodes.title: The Crevasse Bridge
nodes.page: Packed snow forms a narrow bridge over the dark throat of the central crevasse, while far off down the ice-trough a stray mule bell tinkles a lonely note. The bronze Clapper knocks deep against your spine, matching the slow pulse of the glacier underfoot. Biscuit plants all four hooves firmly on the white arch, refusing to move until you test the firmness of the crust with your staff. You can plunge into the misty ice field, adjust your chafing harness, or let the bronze vibration guide your pace.

nodes.brief: Sloping blue ice shelves drop away into the mist without warning while your boots search for reliable purchase.

exits.label: Venture into the freezing fog
Fumble with the frozen harness buckles

nodes.title: The Sloping Shelves
nodes.page: Blue ice tilts away into a bottomless white haze without so much as a ridge for your boot-heels to catch. The cold air burns your throat with every shallow gasp, and the Clapper tugs you backward toward the void. Biscuit scrambles for purchase behind you, iron shoes clicking sharply against the glassy slope.

nodes.brief: Biting gales funnel down the glacier trough, carrying fine ice-dust that settles thick upon the Clapper's cradle.

exits.label: Press onward into the misty crevasse field
Struggle with the stiff leather harness

nodes.title: The Gale Trough
nodes.page: Fine ice-dust drives horizontally down the narrow gully, plastering the padded cradle and freezing hard across your woolen collar. The bronze Clapper jars a sharp, off-key note into your tired muscles while the gales buffet your loaded frame. Biscuit leans his shoulder hard into the wind, head bowed low against the stinging white onslaught. You can plunge forward into the obscured crevasse field or pause to wrestle with the stiff harness straps.

nodes.brief: Jagged slate teeth project from the glacier margin where a weathered signpost points toward the lower stairs.

exits.label: Follow the track to the weathered cairn
Heed the deep rhythmic bronze vibration
Step toward the slick frost-coated threshold

nodes.title: The Jagged Slate
nodes.page: Black shards of rock jut like broken teeth from the melting edge of the glacier, offering a brief respite from the endless expanse of white. A weathered signpost points with a rusted iron finger down toward the lower stairs, its painted lettering flaked away by decades of storm. The bronze tongue ticks against your back in time with your racing pulse. You can follow the upper track toward the cairn, listen to the deep bronze vibration, or step toward the frost-coated threshold.

nodes.brief: Freezing fog clings to your eyelashes while the mule's heavy breathing echoes off the compressed blue walls.

exits.label: Follow the deep rhythmic bronze vibrations
Reach for the slick frost-coated stone threshold

nodes.title: The Freezing Fog
nodes.page: Thick white vapor curls around your eyelashes and freezes instantly into tiny needles that blur the compressed blue walls of the ice-trough. The mule's heavy, rattling breathing echoes close behind, a ragged rhythm against the silence of the high glacier. The bronze Clapper knocks so hard the ground under your boots seems to shake. You can let the bronze vibrations guide your steps or press forward to the frost-coated stone threshold.

nodes.brief: A discarded packing crate serves as a stepping block over a jagged fracture in the blue ice field.

exits.label: Follow the deep rhythmic bronze vibrations
Cross toward the slick frost-coated threshold

nodes.title: The Packing Crate
nodes.page: Splintered pine planks from a discarded packing crate bridge a jagged fracture in the blue ice field, groaning under your boots with every cautious step. Freezing air bites deep into your lungs, and the bronze Clapper knocks a plain note against your spine. Biscuit picks his way across the makeshift timber bridge with ears pinned flat against the wind. You can follow the deep bronze vibrations onward or push toward the stone threshold ahead.

nodes.brief: Trembling fingers struggle with frozen leather straps while the glacier groans its deep-seated subterranean warning.

exits.label: Adjust the frozen harness bucklings
Lead the mule onward without delay

nodes.title: The Frozen Straps
nodes.page: Trembling fingers struggle with frozen leather straps while the glacier groans its deep-seated subterranean warning beneath your boots. Every breath tastes of iron and hoarfrost, and the bronze Clapper shifts restlessly in its padded cradle against your spine, matching the shiver in your bones. Biscuit plant his hoofs firmly into the blue crust, ears pinned back against the whistling draft.

nodes.brief: Slanted ice rungs lead down the blue precipice where a forgotten hemp line offers an alternative handhold.

exits.label: Descend using the frayed hemp line

nodes.title: The Blue Precipice
nodes.page: Slanted ice rungs lead down the blue precipice where a forgotten hemp line offers an alternative handhold against the abyss. The wind tears fiercely at your woolen cap, carrying the dry, sharp scent of distant stone and ancient packed snow. Below, the glacier tongue breaks into jagged seracs that catch the pale winter light like shattered glass. You grip the frayed rope, testing its hemp core for any sign of rot while the bronze tongue hums against your shoulder blade.

nodes.brief: Gusts sweep the upper moraine crest, scattering dry snow across the narrow ledge where you balance the Clapper.

exits.label: Step out onto the wind-swept shelf

nodes.title: The Moraine Crest
nodes.page: Gusts sweep the upper moraine crest, scattering dry snow across the narrow ledge where you balance the Clapper and wait out the squall. The world has shrunk to a blinding curtain of white and the dark, looming shapes of ice pinnacles down-slope. Biscuit lowers his muzzle, finding shelter behind a jagged slab of slate that juts from the frozen shale. Every muscle in your back aches from the dead weight, urging you to choose your footing carefully before the wind shifts again.

nodes.brief: Cracked timber baulks bridge the final blue chasm before the path levels onto the lower glacier moraine.

exits.label: Cross the fractured timber span
Seek a safer detour around the chasm

nodes.title: The Timber Baulks
nodes.page: Cracked timber baulks bridge the final blue chasm before the path levels onto the lower glacier moraine. These old pine beams are crusted with rime and groan under the relentless pressure of the shifting ice field beneath. Below the gap, a bottomless blue throat exhales a blast of cold air that smells of ancient stone and deep water. You take a slow breath, steadying the heavy bronze tongue in its pack before committing your weight to the groaning wood.

nodes.brief: Frozen mist rolls through the crevasse field, blurring the distinction between solid rock and bottomless ice drop.

exits.label: Advance deeper into the mist
Test the ice with your staff
Turn back toward the upper rocks

nodes.title: The Crevasse Field
nodes.page: Frozen mist rolls through the crevasse field, blurring the distinction between solid rock and bottomless ice drop. Every step requires a blind reach into the white haze, tapping the ice ahead with a wooden pole to test for hollow spans. Biscuit nudges your elbow anxiously, his breath coming in warm, rhythmic puffs against your coat. The Clapper's low note seems to answer the hollow ground underfoot, a hint of unstable bridges under the drift.

nodes.brief: Stiff leather gloves fumble with the harness buckle while the cold air burns the inside of your chest.

exits.label: Secure the buckle with bare fingers
Rely on the loosened strap for speed

nodes.title: The Stiff Harness
nodes.page: Stiff leather gloves fumble with the harness buckle while the cold air burns the inside of your chest like swallowed fire. The weight of the bronze Clapper pulls you backward toward the slope, threatening to unbalance your stance on the glassy crust. Nearby, a dark fissure splits the blue floor, whispering of hidden depths and biting drafts. You pause to catch your breath, fingers raw and aching as you wrestle with the frozen tongue of the bell.

nodes.brief: A weathered cairn marks the junction where the upper rope-track meets the shifting surface of the blue glacier.

exits.label: Take the steep ice stairs downward
Follow the cliff-hugging shelf route

nodes.title: The Weathered Cairn
nodes.page: A weathered cairn marks the junction where the upper rope-track meets the shifting surface of the blue glacier. Piles of gray stones, heaped by generations of rope-riders and muleteers, are capped with fresh drifts of powdery snow. The path ahead splits between a series of steep ice stairs and a precarious shelf hugging the cliff wall. You adjust the padded cradle on your back, feeling the heavy metal pulse against your shoulder as you weigh the two routes.

nodes.brief: Deep rhythmic vibrations pass from the heavy bronze Clapper straight into your tired muscles as the wind rises.

exits.label: Wrap the Clapper in extra wool

nodes.title: The Deep Vibration
nodes.page: Deep rhythmic vibrations pass from the heavy bronze Clapper straight into your tired muscles as the wind rises. The metal seems to remember every storm that ever shook Orisonhold's high tower, singing a low, mournful chord that vibrates through the very soles of your boots. Biscuit stamps his feet against the ice, unsettled by the sound echoing off the frozen canyon walls.

nodes.brief: Slick frost coats the final stone threshold before the descent into the chilling embrace of the ice cradle.

exits.label: Step down into the ice basin
Pause to check the weather ahead

nodes.title: The Stone Threshold
nodes.page: Slick frost coats the final stone threshold before the descent into the chilling embrace of the ice cradle. The wind drops for a fleeting moment, leaving an absolute silence broken only by the distant cracking of the glacier's frozen joints. Below you, the great basin stretches out in shades of cobalt and pale turquoise, vast and indifferent to your small struggle. You grip your wooden staff and check the mule's lead rope one last time before stepping over the threshold.

nodes.brief: The ice cradle opens wide before you, a vast bowl of blue-white pressure where the moving glacier splits.

exits.label: Press on across the ice floor
Turn back to the upper ridge

nodes.title: The Ice Cradle Basin
nodes.page: The ice cradle opens wide before you, a vast bowl of blue-white pressure where the moving glacier splits around a central spine of dark rock. Towering walls of compressed ice tower overhead, gleaming with an eerie internal light under the gray winter sky. The air is deathly still here, heavy with the ancient cold of the deep mountain core. You grip the straps of the Clapper tightly, preparing for the long crossing across the shifting floor.

nodes.brief: Standing at the brink of the glacier throat, you weigh the risks of wrapping the Clapper against the oncoming storm.

exits.label: Press on through the biting wind and shifting ice

nodes.title: The Glacier Throat
nodes.page: Jagged teeth of rime-glazed ice frame the narrow approach to the glacier throat, where the wind smells of absolute cold and crushed stone. You stand at the absolute margin of the drop. Binding the bronze closer fights the rising gale; a loose padded harness frees you for a sprint across the shifting floor. Biscuit stamps a hoof behind you and shivers against the grey squall rolling up from the lower valleys.

nodes.brief: The glacial wind howls through the ice cradle, demanding a choice between swift exposure and heavy protective padding.

exits.label: Press on across the freezing expanse despite the gale

nodes.title: Howling Frost
nodes.page: Bitter drafts shriek through the frozen ribs of the ice cradle, scouring the blue slopes with needles of wind-driven snow. You lean your weight against the biting gust, considering whether to trade swift mobility for thicker layers of wool and hide against the creeping numbness in your fingers. The bronze clapper answers with a low note against your spine in time with the distant groaning of the glacier's deep throat.

nodes.brief: Before stepping onto the shifting blue expanse of the ice cradle, you must decide how best to shield the heavy bronze.

exits.label: Press on into the heart of the white wasteland

nodes.title: Shifting Blue Expanse
nodes.page: Shimmering waves of turquoise ice stretch downward into the blinding white mist, hiding the deadly jaws of unseen crevasses beneath a thin skin of powder. Before taking that first precarious step onto the unstable slope, you must decide how best to secure the sacred metal against the hazards of the descent. The air is so thin and sharp that every breath burns your lungs like cold iron.

nodes.brief: On the ribbed blue ice of the snout, you step carefully between turquoise cracks while the bronze clapper hums against your shoulder-blades.

exits.label: Step carefully toward the dripping ice-arch ahead
Test the swinging hazel-withe ladder across the blue shaft
