exits.label: Slip away onto the quiet smugglers' shelf free of debt

nodes.title: Ribbed Blue Ice
nodes.page: Turquoise cracks snake beneath your boots on the ribbed snout of the glacier as you pick a careful path across the frozen wave. The wrapped clapper rests heavily against your shoulder-blades, its muffled hum vibrating through your woollen tunic with every careful stride. A pale sun glints off the high ridges, offering no warmth to counter the biting alpine draft.

nodes.brief: Frost forms thick on Biscuit's heavy ears as the mule digs its iron-shod hooves into the sliding gravel of the terminal moraine.

exits.label: Guide the mule along the glass-smooth cutting wall
Approach the timber housing of the frozen winch
Face the roaring ice-chute where the wind stings your cheek

nodes.title: Terminal Moraine
nodes.page: Heavy frost coats Biscuit's long ears as the stubborn mule drives its iron-shod hooves into the sliding grey gravel of the terminal moraine. Loose stones clatter down into the shadows of a yawning crevasse while you steady the padded frame on your back. The mountain air tastes of ozone and old bronze, sharp enough to make your teeth ache.

nodes.brief: Beneath a dripping ice-arch, an old cable-rider named Jorren warns you of shifting seracs before offering a dram of parsnip brandy.

exits.label: Follow the ice-track where a stray calf shivers by a bridge
Squeeze through a narrow fissure where blue icicles chime
Inspect an abandoned sledge half-swallowed by powder snow

nodes.title: The Dripping Arch
nodes.page: Icy water drips in slow, rhythmic pulses from a low, translucent arch of ancient glacier ice overhead. Jorren, an old cable-rider wrapped in oilskins and salt-cured wool, waits near the threshold, warning you of shifting seracs before offering a warming dram of parsnip brandy from a dented tin flask. The bronze clapper hums softly against your back, answering the subterranean music of the moving mountain.

nodes.brief: A frozen ladder of hazel-withe sways over a bottomless blue shaft, testing your grip while the metal weight shifts behind your neck.

exits.label: Lead the mule across the slush
Search the burnt signal fire shelf
Battle the downdraft on the foot-ledge

nodes.title: The Hazel Ladder
nodes.page: A suspended ladder of braided hazel-withe swings outward over a bottomless shaft of deep blue ice, groaning as the wind catches its frozen rungs. Every time you shift, the bronze Clapper knocks against its padded frame and nearly tips your balance into the empty air. Biscuit plants all four hooves at the threshold, refusing to budge until you pull the lead rope hard enough to test the knots. Cold bites through your mittens while the abyss below exhales a freezing draft that smells of ancient stone and snow.

nodes.brief: Walking unburdened by a pack-animal, you spot a dry smugglers' shelf free of ice where a stray toolkit lies abandoned in the rime.

exits.label: Ascend toward the signal fire and the coil of dry hemp
Examine the discarded grease-box wedged into a dark cleft
Crawl across the packed snow bridge arching over the blue throat

priv.why: the reader owes nobody and can bargain freely

nodes.title: The Debt-Free Shelf
nodes.page: With neither pack-animal nor debts on your back, you stride freely across the ice and no one holds a claim over your labor. Tucked away against a stone buttress lies a dry smugglers' shelf, untouched by the rime, where an abandoned toolkit gleams invitingly in the pale light. The peace of owing nothing to the Cable Court or the millers makes the thin mountain air feel lighter in your chest.

nodes.brief: You wedge your boots into hand-cut steps on a glass-smooth wall while a low subterranean groan ripples through the ancient glacier beneath you.

exits.label: Grab the tin grease-box in the cleft
Inspect the locked Cable Court shelter
Steady Biscuit against the black ice
Listen to the frozen organ-pipe fall

nodes.title: The Glass Wall
nodes.page:
Your iron-shod boots find shallow purchase in hand-carved steps on a vertical wall of blue-black ice that mirrors the grey clouds above. A deep subterranean groan rolls through the frozen heart of the glacier, rattling your teeth, and the bronze Clapper on your back frets like a trapped wasp. Biscuit scrabbles desperately behind you, his iron shoes scraping a sharp rhythm against the cliff face as the wind tears at your oilskins. You hug the glassy stone closely, searching for any handhold that might prevent a slip into the pale void below.

You can reach for a discarded grease-box in a cleft, inspect a locked stone shelter, hold the mule on black ice, or pause beside a frozen waterfall that knocks in time with the bronze.

nodes.brief: A ropeway winch frozen solid in its timber housing blocks the upper traverse, forcing you to chip clear the cogs with your belt-knife.

exits.label: Chip away the remaining ice to test the winch line

exits.privWhy: the reader travels without the mule, light and quick, and so notices what a pack-animal would crowd out
exits.label: Leave the frozen winch behind to squeeze through the narrow cleft
Follow the tattered red pennant along the rocky detour

nodes.title: The Frozen Winch
nodes.page:
Thick rime locks the oak gears of the traverse winch, leaving the cable slack and silent above the blue abyss. You wedge your belt-knife into the frozen grease of the cogs, scraping away the gray crust until cold iron screeches against steel. Biscuit stomps his iron-shod hooves on the trembling planks, anxious for the span to move. With a final crack of frost, the mechanism shudders loose, but the cable's groan reveals a new fracture in the iron shoes ahead.

You can test the newly freed winch and risk the main span, or leave the machinery behind to find a safer path around the crevasse.

nodes.brief: The wind howls down the ice-chute, carrying the metallic tang of Orison's bronze and stinging your exposed cheeks with needle-sharp sleet.

exits.label: Scrape the frozen sweat from your goggles
Clip your harness line to the iron ringbolt

nodes.title: The Howling Chute
nodes.page:
Wild gales shriek down the ice-chute, carrying the distinct metallic tang of Orison's bronze on the draft while needle-sharp sleet stings your exposed cheeks. Every breath feels like drawing shards of glass into your lungs as you lean into the bitter onslaught.

The clapper shifts slightly in its padded cradle on your back, a reminder of the desperate race against the closing ice-wind season. You need to secure your footing and push onward through the freezing gloom.

nodes.brief: A stray calf belonging to a Terrace Miller stands shivering beside a crevassed bridge, refusing to budge until you share your crust of bread.

exits.label: Share a mouthful of lukewarm tea with the stranded warden
Cross the swaying span of notched pine logs

nodes.title: The Stranded Calf
nodes.page:
Trembling against the biting wind, a stray calf belonging to a Terrace Miller stands frozen beside a narrow, crevassed bridge of packed snow. The little beast refuses to budge an inch, its dark eyes wide with terror as the ice groans beneath its hooves.

You reach into your pocket and break off a hard morsel of your travel crust, offering it out on an open palm to coax the animal into moving. A low, subterranean rumbling echoes up from the depths of the glacier as you wait.

nodes.brief: You squeeze through a narrow fissure where blue icicles click together like wind-chimes every time the glacier stirs beneath your soles.

exits.label: Share a mouthful of lukewarm tea with the stranded warden
Cross the swaying span of notched pine logs

nodes.title: The Chime Fissure
nodes.page:
Blue icicles crowd the narrow walls of the jagged fissure, clicking together like tiny wind-chimes every single time the glacier stirs beneath your soles. The air smells intensely of cold stone and ancient, compressed moisture that has not seen the sun for centuries.

You turn sideways to squeeze your shoulders and the padded bronze clapper through the gap without snagging your straps. Cold metal against your spine sends a shiver clean through your marrow.

nodes.brief: An abandoned sledge lies half-swallowed by powder snow, its runner iron gleaming in the weak mountain light beside a cairn of skulls.

exits.label: Share a mouthful of lukewarm tea with the stranded warden
Coax the stubborn mule past the frozen carcass

nodes.title: The Abandoned Sledge
nodes.page:
Half-swallowed by heavy powder snow, an old wooden sledge lies tilted on its side with its runner iron gleaming dully in the weak, gray mountain light. Right beside it rests a small, weathered cairn of bleached skulls left by some forgotten party of travelers.

The wind whistles through the jagged stones as you step carefully around the wreckage, keeping a watchful eye out for hidden drop-offs. The mule behind you snorts nervously, catching the strange scent of old iron and bone.

nodes.brief: You haul Biscuit by the halter across a treacherous tongue of slush where brown meltwater chatters beneath a fragile crust of frost.

exits.label: Coax the stubborn mule past the frozen carcass
Find purchase along the dark vein of volcanic ash

nodes.title: The Slush Tongue
nodes.page:
Brown meltwater chatters noisily beneath a fragile, glistening crust of frost as you haul Biscuit by the halter across a treacherous tongue of grey slush. Every step threatens to break through into freezing water that would soak your boots to the bone.

You keep the load balanced on your own back while guiding the animal through the shifting mire with short practiced commands. The air grows warmer and heavier here near the lower edge of the ice-flow.

nodes.brief: High on a wind-scoured shelf, you find a burnt-out signal fire where a Fog-Warden left a coil of dry hemp rope tied to an iron stake.

exits.label: Find purchase along the dark vein of volcanic ash
Tighten the leather straps of the clapper cradle

nodes.title: The Burnt Beacon
nodes.page:
High upon a wind-scoured shelf of rock stands a blackened, burnt-out signal fire where a Fog-Warden once kept watch over the perilous upper trail. A sturdy coil of dry hemp rope remains securely lashed to a heavy iron stake driven deep into the granite.

You pause for a brief moment to catch your breath in the thin, freezing air while checking the knots that hold your precious cargo. The valley below is completely choked with an unbroken sea of rolling white clouds.

nodes.brief: Ice-dust rattles against your oilskin coat as a sudden downdraft threatens to sweep you from the narrow foot-ledge into the gray abyss.

exits.label: Find purchase along the dark vein of volcanic ash
Inspect the rusted winch-handle near the meltwater

nodes.title: The Downdraft Ridge
nodes.page:
Bitter ice-dust rattles violently against your oilskin coat as a sudden, vicious downdraft tries to sweep you straight off the narrow foot-ledge and into the gray abyss. You drop low to the stone, pressing your weight firmly against the mountain face until the gust passes.

The bronze clapper answers the pressure change with a deep note, its metal singing against the howling gale. You must gather your nerve before standing up on the exposed path again.

nodes.brief: A cable-rider's discarded tin grease-box sits wedged in a cleft, offering a smear of tallow to waterproof your stiff leather mitts.

exits.label: Inspect the rusted winch-handle near the meltwater
Edge carefully along the overhanging snow cornice

nodes.title: The Grease-Box
nodes.page:
Wedged deep into a granite cleft sits a discarded tin grease-box left behind by some hurried cable-rider of the upper courts. You pry it open with a cold fingernail to find a thick, yellowish smear of rendered tallow still soft enough to use.

You scoop up a dollop with your stiff leather mitts, rubbing the grease into the seams to keep the moisture out and save your skin from cracking. The sharp scent of rendered fat cuts cleanly through the biting mountain chill.

nodes.brief: You crawl on hands and knees across a bridge of packed snow that arches over a yawning throat of blue ice humming with pressure.

exits.label: Brace against the sudden flurry of mountain ptarmigan
Follow the wooden signpost down through the murk

nodes.title: The Snow Bridge
nodes.page:
On hands and knees you crawl across an arched bridge of packed powder over a yawning throat of blue ice under immense pressure from below. Every breath is a calculated risk as you feel the hollow space breathing right beneath your palms.

The mule follows behind with cautious, rhythmic steps, its hooves packing the snow tightly with every movement. Beyond the far side of the arch, the path finally levels out onto safer stone.

nodes.brief: A small stone shelter built by the Cable Court stands locked and empty, its timber door etched with frosty tally-marks of vanished tolls.

exits.label: Edge along the precipice cornice
Dig a snow trench for shelter

nodes.title: The Toll Lock
nodes.page: Heavy iron frost encrusts a small stone shelter built into the rock face by the Cable Court. Its thick timber door remains bolted from within, sealed against the creeping glacier drafts, while the lintel bears deep frosty tally-marks recording the vanished tolls of travelers long since descended. Whenever mountain wind strikes the masonry, the bronze clapper on your back knocks a low note through your padded harness.

nodes.brief: You steady the clapper cradle as Biscuit slips on a patch of black ice, praying the wooden frame holds against the sudden dead weight.

exits.label: Quiet the startled ptarmigan flock
Follow the Lowgate signpost downward
Warm your stiffening fingers

nodes.title: The Mule Slip
nodes.page: Sudden panic grips your chest as Biscuit's iron-shod hoof finds a hidden lens of black ice beneath the powder, sending the mule sliding toward the edge of a jagged crevasse. You throw your weight against the padded wooden cradle, digging your boots hard into the crusted firn to arrest the momentum before the precious bronze payload shifts beyond recovery. The animal blows a ragged cloud of white breath into the freezing air, trembling as its hooves regain purchase on the slope.

nodes.brief: A frozen waterfall hangs like a set of organ pipes beside the track, vibrating in resonance with the deep bronze hum on your back.

exits.label: Descend toward the lower ladder
Check your frozen mittens
Hack clear the blocked blanket

nodes.title: The Frozen Pipes
nodes.page: Towering columns of ice hang thick and pale beside the narrow track, resembling the massive organ pipes of a mountain cathedral frozen mid-hymn. Every gust of wind sweeping down the glacier draws a deep trembling tone from the crystal formation, and it blends with the bronze knock against your shoulders. You steady your breathing in the biting air, careful not to dislodge the delicate icicles ringing the path.

nodes.brief: You carve extra foothold notches into the blue wall using your cold chisel while salt-rimed fog rolls upward from the valley floor.

exits.label: Clear the stiffened woolen obstacle

exits.privWhy: the reader believes the foundry has gone cold and looks for another way to recast the bell
exits.label: Hide a wedge in the cairn
Turn back toward the upper ledges

nodes.title: The Notch Cutting
nodes.page: Frigid white fog billows upward from the invisible valley floor, swallowing the ice-steps beneath your boots and leaving only the sheer blue wall before you. Holding your cold chisel steady against the dense glacial ice, you hammer out fresh footholds with sharp, measured strikes, letting the rhythmic ringing of metal on ice drown out the hollow groans of the moving glacier.

nodes.brief: Moving without the mule's bulk, you slip through a narrow needle-eye cleft in the granite that bypasses the crumbling ice-bridge entirely.

exits.label: Navigate the shifting blue seracs ahead
Traverse the gusting chasm by hand-line

priv.why: the reader travels without the mule, light and quick, and so notices what a pack-animal would crowd out

nodes.title: The Needle-Eye Cleft
nodes.page:
Unburdened by the pack-mule's clumsy flanks, you slide sideways through a vertical split in the granite wall where the mountain tightens like a fist. The rock is smooth and cold against your ribs, scraping lightly at the padded cradle on your back while the world opens up into a jagged corridor of ice. Without a beast to crowd your footing or test your nerves at every ridge, you notice the delicate patterns of frost ferns on the stone and the absolute, ringing silence of the high shadow. Ahead, the path divides into the chaotic heart of the glacier or drops down toward a thin line of safety strung across the chasm.

You can pick your way through the shifting blue seracs or trust your weight to a fraying hand-line.

nodes.brief: A tattered red pennant of the Ropewrights' Guild flutters from a piton, marking a safe detour around a collapsed section of the ladderway.

exits.label: Hack a path past the stiffened blanket
Pick your way through the shifting seracs

exits.privWhy: the reader believes the foundry has gone cold and looks for another way to recast the bell
exits.label: Recover the spare bronze wedge from the cairn

nodes.title: The Red Flag
nodes.page:
A tattered scrap of scarlet wool snaps furiously from a driven iron piton, marking where the ladderway has sheared away into empty air. The Ropewrights' Guild tied this warning well before the last freeze, leaving a narrow shelf of blue-tinted ice as the only viable bypass around the wreckage. Water drips deep under the glacier, slow as a clock counting the hours left before the passes choke with snow. You hitch the bronze Clapper on your shoulders; a faint metal pulse runs down your spine while you size up the next step.

You might press forward across the jagged blue towers, double back to check your hidden wedge, or test a completely different line through the frozen chaos.

nodes.brief: You pause to scrape frozen sweat from your goggles while the distant roar of a sub-glacial river echoes through the soles of your boots.

exits.label: Grip the frayed hemp hand-line
Turn back up the trail

nodes.title: The River Sub-Glacial
nodes.page: Thick frost crusts your protective goggles, forcing you to halt and scrape the rime away with a mittened thumb while a dull, subterranean thunder reverberates up through the soles of your boots. Deep beneath the glacial shell, an ancient river roars against the bedrock, reminding you of the immense pressure grinding away at the mountain's foundations.

nodes.brief: An old iron ringbolt driven into the cliffside offers a secure anchor point to clip your harness line before tackling the sheer traverse.

exits.privWhy: the reader believes the foundry has gone cold and looks for another way to recast the bell
exits.label: Retrieve the spare wedge from the cairn
Lead the mule across the corrugated iron

nodes.title: The Iron Ringbolt
nodes.page:
An ancient iron ringbolt, green-stained and bitten deep into the cliff granite, offers a solid anchor point in the middle of a dizzying wall of ice. You clip your harness line to the iron with fingers stiffened by the wind and catch your breath while the mountain shakes beneath your boots. The sheer traverse stretches out horizontally across a drop that seems to have no bottom, testing every ounce of your balance and nerve. Beside you, the mule plants its hooves with stubborn reluctance, blowing frosty plumes of air into the biting gale.

You can retrieve your hidden wedge from the cairn or guide the mule across the vibrating iron plates.

nodes.brief: You share a mouthful of lukewarm chicory tea with a stranded Fog-Warden whose signal horn is choked with hard-packed blue rime.

exits.label: Scale the sheer glass wall of ice
Lead the mule along the narrow ledge

nodes.title: The Fog-Warden's Hearth
nodes.page:
Sheltered in the lee of an azure ice-rib, a lone Fog-Warden sits bundled in grey wool, trying to clear the choked mouth of a bone signal horn with a wire pin. You share a draught of lukewarm chicory tea from your flask, tasting the bitter chicory and the metallic tang of the mountain air as the stranger nods in silent gratitude. The glacier all around you creaks and groans, settling into new shapes under the weight of the coming winter night. The steep wall ahead demands absolute focus, while the narrow ice-ledge offers a perilously wind-swept alternative.

You can tackle the vertical glass wall or coax the mule along the narrow ledge.

nodes.brief: A series of notched pine logs lashed with braided hemp spans a gap between two glass-green ice towers swaying in the freezing gale.

exits.label: Climb the steep wall of blue glass
Turn back toward the frozen upper winch

nodes.title: The Swinging Bridge
nodes.page:
A makeshift bridge of notched pine logs, lashed tightly together with braided hemp cable, sways in rhythm with the freezing gale between two towering pillars of glass-green ice. Every step causes the timber to groan and shift above a bottomless blue abyss where the wind howls like a trapped animal. The bronze Clapper on your back answers the swing of the logs, and its rhythm tests your balance with each step. Behind you, the mechanical housing of an upper ropeway sits frozen solid in the rime, while the glacier stretches onward into blinding white heights.

You can press upward onto the steep ice wall or turn back toward the frozen winch.

nodes.brief: You coax Biscuit past the frozen carcass of a pack-goat wedged into a crevice, keeping your eyes fixed ahead on the grey horizon.

exits.label: Face the sheer blue-white glass wall
Negotiate the narrow wind-lashed ice-ledge
Listen to the humming suspension cable

nodes.title: The Frozen Pack-Goat
nodes.page: Stubborn hooves refuse the turn until you haul on the leading rope, coaxing Biscuit past the rigid carcass of a pack-goat wedged tight into a blue-veined crevice. The cold bites at your knuckles through wet wool while the bronze Clapper shivers against your spine. Keeping your eyes fixed strictly ahead on the shifting grey horizon, you guide the mule forward through the treacherous cleft as the wind howls down the ice-chute.

nodes.brief: A vein of dark volcanic ash cuts through the glacier ice, giving your boots momentary purchase on the slick upward-sloping path.

exits.label: Steer the mule along the ledge
Heed the humming overhead cable
Climb onto the sulfur-scented rock shelf

nodes.title: The Volcanic Vein
nodes.page: A dark ribbon of volcanic ash slices straight through the pale glacier ice, offering your numbed boots sudden, gritty purchase on the slick, upward-sloping path. You lean into the slope, the heavy bronze tongue shifting in its leather cradle with a dull, resonant thud that jars your shoulder blades. Biscuit picks a cautious way behind you, ears pinned back against the howling gale.

nodes.brief: You tighten the leather straps of the clapper cradle as the mounting vibration threatens to work the bronze free from its padding.

exits.label: Guide the mule along the icy ledge
Test the straining overhead cable span

nodes.title: Securing the Bronze
nodes.page: Fingers clumsy with frost, you haul hard on the leather straps of the clapper cradle before a mounting shake works the bronze free of its padding. The metal sings a thin, complaining note against the gale, demanding your full attention to keep it lashed securely to your frame. Biscuit huddles close against your flank, shaking a crust of rime from his grey muzzle while you double-knot the harness.

nodes.brief: A rusted winch-handle left by the Cable Court lies half-buried in drift-snow near the entrance to a dark meltwater drainage tunnel.

exits.label: Follow the path beneath the humming cable
Climb up to the sulfur-scented stone shelf

nodes.title: The Meltwater Tunnel
nodes.page: Near the shadowed mouth of a dark meltwater drainage tunnel, a rusted winch-handle left by the Cable Court lies half-buried in a drift of crystalline snow and catches the pale light. Water drips from the frozen vault above in a slow hollow rhythm. The Clapper rides your back in its straps. You catch your breath once in the sheltered gloom, then press forward.

nodes.brief: You edge along a cornice of wind-blown powder that overhangs a thousand-foot drop into the mist-shrouded gorge of the lower glacier.

exits.label: Scramble up to the high rock shelf
Press flat against the freezing wall

nodes.title: The Cornice Edge
nodes.page: You edge carefully along a treacherous cornice of wind-blown powder that overhangs a thousand-foot vertical drop into the mist-shrouded gorge of the lower glacier. Every step must be tested twice to ensure the snow-bridge holds your weight and the heavy bronze burden on your back. Below you, the abyss churns with white vapour and the faint, haunting echo of falling ice.

nodes.brief: A flock of gray mountain ptarmigan bursts suddenly from a snow-pocket, startling the mule and nearly tipping your heavy burden sideways.

exits.label: Lead the mule across the narrow ledge
Pull yourself up to the rocky shelf

nodes.title: The Ptarmigan Flurry
nodes.page: A sudden explosion of gray mountain ptarmigan bursts straight out from a snow-pocket right beneath your boots, startling the mule with a frantic beating of wings. Biscuit rears back sharply and nearly tips your bronze burden sideways into the drift. You grab his halter-strap with a shouted warning, planting your heels firmly into the hard-packed crust until the flurry passes.

nodes.brief: You carve a hasty trench in the hard firn snow to shelter behind while a violent squall of needle-ice rakes the exposed mountain face.

exits.label: Crawl out onto the sulfur-scented shelf
Leap across the broken hanging ladder
Flatten against the freezing rock face

nodes.title: The Firn Trench
nodes.page: You carve a hasty trench into the hard firn snow with your belt-hatchet, crouching low to shelter behind its icy lip while a violent squall of needle-ice rakes the exposed mountain face. The wind shrieks overhead like a trapped spirit, driving frozen pellets into the wool of your hood. Biscuit presses his nose into your shoulder, sharing your meager shelter until the worst of the whiteout passes.

nodes.brief: A wooden signpost carved by Lowgate artisans points down through the thickening murk toward the lower ladder stations and the valley floor.

exits.label: Haunt the high rock shelf above
Attempt the leap across the broken ladder
Hug the freezing wall against the gust

nodes.title: The Lowgate Signpost
nodes.page: A sturdy wooden signpost carved with deep, weather-worn letters by Lowgate artisans points down through the thickening murk toward the lower ladder stations and the distant valley floor. The painted arrows are crusted with rime, but the carved destination remains unmistakably clear. You wipe the frost from the wood with a mittened thumb, measuring the remaining daylight against the long descent ahead.

nodes.brief: You check your fingers for numbness as the biting frost stiffens the wool of your mittens and turns your breath to rattling crystals.

exits.label: Press against the wall for the final push
Enter the thick bank of freezing fog

nodes.title: Numbed Fingers
nodes.page: You check your fingers one by one for feeling as the biting frost stiffens the knitted wool of your mittens and turns your ragged breath to rattling crystals. The cold seeps deep into your bones, making the straps of the clapper cradle feel heavier with every passing stride. Stamping your feet against the packed ice, you force your stiff joints to move once more along the trail.

nodes.brief: A discarded woollen blanket frozen stiff as a board blocks your footing, forcing you to hack it loose with your belt-hatchet.

exits.label: Lean into the freezing stone wall
Plunge into the oncoming freezing fog

nodes.title: The Frozen Blanket
nodes.page: A discarded woollen blanket frozen stiff as a rigid board blocks your footing on the narrow track, forcing you to hack it loose with short, sharp blows from your belt-hatchet. Shards of ice fly into the air as the fabric finally tears free and tumbles down the precipice. You steady Biscuit against the resulting shudder of the slope before taking your next step forward into the wind.

nodes.brief: You navigate a maze of shimmering blue seracs that shift and groan like living bone under the relentless weight of the moving ice river.

exits.label: Weave carefully between the cracking seracs
Climb higher to bypass the moving ice maze
Take the reckless way across the trembling span

nodes.title: The Groaning Seracs
nodes.page: Jagged towers of shimmering blue ice rise on every side, shifting and groaning like living bone under the relentless weight of the moving glacier. Deep beneath your boots, a muffled subterranean crack echoes through the frozen canyon, and the bronze Clapper answers in its padded cradle against your spine. You must pick your path through this unstable labyrinth before the shifting walls close entirely.

nodes.brief: Suspecting the lower forges may be shuttered, you stash a spare bronze wedge in a rock cairn just in case you must recast the bell yourself.

exits.label: Leave the cairn and press downward
Retrace your steps toward the open ridge

priv.why: the reader believes the foundry has gone cold and looks for another way to recast the bell

nodes.title: The Hidden Wedge
nodes.page: Doubting whether the lower foundry fires still burn through this bitter freeze, you pause behind a frost-rimed outcrop to cache your spare gear. With numb fingers you tuck a bronze wedge deep into a secure rock cairn, a backup if you must recast Orison yourself. The wind howls down the gully, urging you onward into the white expanse.

nodes.brief: A frayed hemp hand-line anchored to an ice-piton offers meager security against the gusting winds sweeping across the glacial saddle.

exits.label: Trust the frayed hemp and lean forward

nodes.title: The Frayed Line
nodes.page:
Gale-force winds tear across the exposed glacial saddle, threatening to wrench the padded bronze Clapper from your shoulders and hurl you into the grey abyss. A single frayed hemp hand-line, knotted clumsily around a frost-rimed iron piton driven into the blue-veined ice, offers the only tether between standing upright and sliding into nothingness. You lean your weight against the singing wind, fingers cramping white around the coarse fibers as the ice beneath your boots begins to crumble into fine, glittering powder.

Deciding whether to trust the rotting rope or brave the open gust without a guide, you grip the tether tighter and peer into the swirling vortex ahead.

nodes.brief: You lead Biscuit across a corrugated iron sheet laid over a widening crevasse, wincing at the hollow metallic clatter under hoof.

exits.label: Climb toward the sulfur-scented stone shelf
Flatten against the freezing rock wall
Step into the oncoming wall of fog

nodes.title: Across the Iron Sheet
nodes.page:
Frost-shrouded gaps in the glacier yawn wide beneath your boots, spanned only by a corrugated iron sheet that shrieks and flexes under every shift in weight. Biscuit steps hesitantly onto the shivering metal, ears pinned back against the howling gale, while each iron corrugation sends a hollow, metallic clang echoing deep into the blue ice. You clutch the bronze Clapper tightly in its cradle, matching the mule's cautious cadence as the freezing air bites at your cheeks and skitters loose gravel into the dark cleft below.

The passage narrows sharply where the sheet meets the jagged stone face, leaving you to choose whether to press on blindly or seek firmer footing against the cliff.

nodes.brief: The glacier steepens into a sheer wall of blue-white glass where every handhold must be chipped fresh out of the unyielding rime.

exits.label: Hew a staircase upward into the blue wall

nodes.title: The Vertical Glass
nodes.page: The path ahead vanishes into a sheer wall of blue-white glacier glass where every single handhold must be chipped fresh out of the unyielding rime. Your belt-hatchet rings sharply against the frozen surface, sending tiny diamond shards scattering into the deep void below. The weight of the bronze Clapper pulls heavily at your aching shoulders.

nodes.brief: You struggle to keep the mule's footing secure on a narrow ice-ledge while the wind whips stinging diamond-dust into your watering eyes.

exits.label: Secure the lead-rope and wait it out

nodes.title: Diamond Dust Squall
nodes.page:
Stinging diamond-dust whipped from the glacier crust blinds your watering eyes as you struggle to keep Biscuit's hooves planted on the narrowing ice-ledge. The mule shivers violently beneath its pack, slipping slightly on the slick blue rime while the bronze Clapper answers with a low vibration against your spine. Every breath burns your throat like liquid frost, and the steep drop-off to your left vanishes entirely behind swirling curtains of white.

Pausing to steady the trembling animal against the freezing stone, you weigh your options against the mounting fury of the storm.

nodes.brief: A rusted suspension cable hums like a plucked harp-string above your head as the upper span strains under the freezing gale's fury.

exits.label: Lash the lead-rope to an iron ring
Push ahead into the blinding fog wall

nodes.title: The Humming Span
nodes.page:
High above your head a rusted suspension cable shivers as the upper span strains and groans under the freezing gale. Vibrations travel down the iron wire straight into your aching shoulders and match the deep note of the bronze Clapper on your back. Ice flakes peel from the overhead links in tiny avalanches, stinging your wool-wrapped neck as you crouch low on the icy decking.

With the bridge shuddering violently beneath your boots, you must decide whether to anchor yourself securely or press forward before the cable snaps.

nodes.brief: You haul yourself over a jagged lip of glacier ice onto a rock shelf where the air smells faintly of sulfur and cold damp stone.

exits.label: Follow the rock shelf deeper inward
Descend the stone steps toward the gorge

nodes.title: Sulfur and Cold Stone
nodes.page: Strong arms haul you over the jagged lip of glacier ice onto a sheltered rock shelf where the air smells faintly of sulfur and cold damp stone. The sudden absence of the roaring wind is almost deafening as you catch your ragged breath against the cliff face. Here, the mountain feels ancient, solid, and still.

nodes.brief: A broken ladder-rung dangles by a single strand of hemp over empty air, forcing a dangerous leap while carrying the dead weight of bronze.

exits.label: Leap across the gap into the whiteout
Clutch the frozen guidelines and brace yourself

nodes.title: The Broken Rung
nodes.page:
A fractured wooden ladder-rung dangles by a single frayed strand of hemp over empty air, swinging sickeningly above the hazy blue depth of the glacier crevasse. The bronze Clapper's dead bulk turns the required leap into a desperate gamble with gravity and ice. Frost numbs your knuckles as you test the tension of the remaining strand, watching tiny shards of wood flutter down into the fog.

Preparing your muscles for the perilous bound across the void, you tighten your grip and eye the opposite ledge.

nodes.brief: You press your back against the freezing rock wall to let a gust of wind pass before attempting the final icy crossing to the gatehouse.

exits.label: Cross the final bridge to the gates
Take shelter inside the stone alcove
Climb the upper embankment to get your bearings

nodes.title: The Gatehouse Shelter
nodes.page: Shielded temporarily by a jutting buttress of black granite, you press your back against the freezing rock wall to let a violent gust pass. Just ahead the trail crosses ice toward the lower gatehouse and its dark timber walls. The bronze Clapper knocks soft against your spine, answering the nearness of masonry and old hearths.

nodes.brief: The clapper's internal bronze hum vibrates against your spine in frantic rhythm with the pounding of your own exhausted heart.

exits.label: Step carefully across the swaying span
Pause to check the heavy pack

nodes.title: The Humming Bronze
nodes.page:
A frantic rhythm pounds your exhausted ribs while the Clapper's bronze note presses straight into your spine. Every step across the tilting ladder rungs makes the heavy metal sing a low, warning note that matches your racing pulse. Ice crystals gather on your collar while the wind drives a bitter spray from the glacier depths below.

Between the howling gusts, you must decide whether to lean into the gale and push forward across the exposed span or pause to secure the swaying pack before the cold locks your joints entirely.

nodes.brief: A thick bank of freezing fog rolls up from the lower valleys, swallowing the trail markers and plunging the ladderway into absolute white.

exits.label: Follow the vibrating guide-rope onward

nodes.title: Swallowed by the Fog
nodes.page:
Thick banks of freezing fog roll relentlessly up from the lower valleys, swallowing the weathered trail markers and plunging the entire ladderway into absolute white. You can no longer see the anchor posts or the edge of the abyss, relying entirely on the taut hemp guideline vibrating beneath your gloved fingers. Biscuit stumbles behind you, blowing warm, anxious clouds into the frozen air as the visibility drops to zero.

Nothing remains but the length of your rope and Orison's tongue pressed hard against your shoulders.

nodes.brief: You lash Biscuit's lead-rope securely to an iron ring while the rising whiteout swallows the last visible marker posts of the upper route.

exits.label: Press on into the blinding white

nodes.title: Tethering the Mule
nodes.page:
Iron rings bite into the frozen granite as you lash Biscuit's lead-rope securely, anchoring the stubborn mule while the rising whiteout swallows the last visible marker posts of the upper route. The wind shrieks through the icy gap, tearing at your woollen hood and coating your eyelashes in instant frost. Biscuit stamps a hoof against the blue ice, his ears pinned back against the gale.

You stand alone at the precipice of the moving glacier, facing a blinding expanse of white where the trail vanishes into the mist.

nodes.brief: A wall of blinding white fog slams into the cliff-face, obliterating the rope-bridge rails and leaving you stranded in a howling vacuum.

exits.label: Press on through the freezing fog

nodes.title: Howling Vacuum
nodes.page:
Blinding white fog slams into the cliff-face like a physical wall, instantly obliterating the rope-bridge rails and leaving you stranded in a howling vacuum. Your breath freezes in white plumes before your face as you grope blindly for anything solid to steady your balance. The Clapper cuts a dull, stubborn note through the roar of the wind and into your back.

With the path ahead completely swallowed by the storm, standing still means freezing to the stone, while moving forward means stepping blindly into the white void.

nodes.brief: You tighten your grip on the frozen hemp guidelines as the whiteout turns the world to featureless milk and numbs your fingers to bone.

exits.label: Press on despite the biting cold

nodes.title: Numbed to Bone
nodes.page:
Frozen hemp guidelines cut into your palms as you tighten your grip, the whiteout turning the entire world into featureless milk and numbing your fingers straight through to the bone. Every breath tastes of iron and sharp frost. The heavy bronze tongue shifts in its padded cradle, throwing your center of gravity toward the dizzying drop of the crevasse.

You must keep moving before the biting cold seizes your limbs completely and turns you into another permanent fixture of the glacier stairs.

nodes.brief: The storm closes its white jaws around the ladderway, demanding you hold the guide-line or cast off your heavy pack to survive.

exits.label: Press on while holding the line

nodes.title: Jaws of the Storm
nodes.page:
White jaws of the storm close around the ladderway, forcing a hard grip on the guide-line unless you cast off the pack on your back just to stay upright. Ice rime cakes your woolen coat, turning your garments into stiff armor that restricts your breathing. Biscuit lets out a distressed bray that is instantly shredded by the gale-force winds whipping across the crevasse.

The choice is stark and immediate as the ice groans beneath your boots.

nodes.brief: Frost coats your eyelashes on the shattered ice shelf as you drag the humming bronze clapper past a yawning blue crevasse.

exits.label: Seek shelter beneath the overhanging ice
Fight your way across the buried ladder
Balance across the narrow ice-bridge

nodes.title: Shattered Ice Shelf
nodes.page:
Frost coats your eyelashes on the shattered ice shelf while you haul the bronze clapper past a yawning blue crevasse, bare fingers stuck to the hemp line until you rip them free with a sharp gasp. The wind drops to a low, whining moan, leaving the crisp air sparkling with diamond dust kicked up from the glacier's slow march. Every muscle in your back aches with a deep, frozen fatigue.

Ahead, the path splits around a towering blue serac where the glint of distant cable-work catches the pale mountain light.

nodes.brief: Biscuit digs her iron hooves into the sliding firn while the gale tries to strip the heavy woollen cradle from your frozen back.

exits.label: Pay the toll at the narrow cornice

exits.privWhy: the reader travels without the mule, light and quick, and so notices what a pack-animal would crowd out
exits.label: Squeeze through the tight blue ice-tunnel
Chip a fresh path up the vertical wall

nodes.title: Sliding Firn
nodes.page:
Biscuit digs his iron hooves into the sliding firn as the gale claws at the woollen cradle on your frozen back. Without the mule to share the burden of the pace, the climb feels steeper and the air thinner, yet you move with a lighter, unhindered agility across the fractured rungs. The bronze Clapper ticks a rhythmic beat against your shoulder-blades in time with your rapid stride.

The trail narrows sharply as it approaches a jagged corner of dark granite where the wind funnels through with renewed fury.

nodes.brief: You shelter beneath an overhanging serac where a shivering ropewright named Orry splices a frayed guyline with numbed fingers.

exits.label: Descend the glittering frost slope
Climb the swaying rope bridge
Traverse the blue pack-ice ledge

nodes.title: Splicing in the Shelter
nodes.page:
Frost glazes your knuckles as you huddle beneath an overhanging blue serac where a shivering ropewright named Orry works with numb, reddened fingers to splice a frayed guyline. The bronze clapper on your back knocks a low note against your spine, matching the distant groan of the glacier under your boots. Orry glances up from his twisted hemp cords, offering a brief, wry nod as the wind howls past your ice-bound sanctuary.

Three distinct paths branch out from the shelter: one drops steeply across a glittering frost-crusted slope, another winds upward toward a trembling rope bridge swaying over the void, and the third skirts a precarious ledge of blue pack-ice.

nodes.brief: A sudden avalanche of powdery snow sweeps across the lower ladder, burying your traction spikes just as daylight fails completely.

exits.label: Follow the buried guide-rail
Pull the blindfold over Biscuit
Repair the snapped guide-rope

nodes.title: Blinded by Powder
nodes.page:
A sudden, violent avalanche of powdery snow sweeps across the lower ladder, burying your iron traction spikes and blinding you in a swirl of white just as daylight fails completely. The bronze clapper tugs you forward into the drift while Biscuit lets out a distressed snort behind you in the freezing dark. You must feel your way blindly along the buried guide-rail before the shifting slope gives way entirely beneath your boots.

Two distinct courses remain open before you in the choking whiteout, each demanding an immediate and perilous choice.

nodes.brief: You negotiate a slick ice-bridge over a bottomless abyss while the bronze clapper hums a warning note against your spine.

exits.label: Skirt the groaning glass pillar

exits.privWhy: the reader swore the knot-oath and is known by the ropewrights for it
exits.label: Take the secret ropewright chute
Hack fresh steps in the ice

nodes.title: The Slick Ice-Bridge
nodes.page:
Your boots skim a razor-thin ice-bridge over a bottomless blue abyss, and the bronze clapper knocks a sharp warning note straight into your spine. Every breath plumes into ice crystals in the thin air, and the sheer drop on either side threatens to dizzy even the steadiest head. Across the gap, the ladder continues its jagged ascent into the frozen gloom.

Three distinct routes lie before you, each demanding a different measure of caution and endurance.

nodes.brief: An old cable-lord named Kimmich blocks the narrow cornice, demanding an exorbitant toll for the maintenance of the swaying hemp handrails.

exits.label: Slide down the steep firn chute
Hack through the frozen waterfall
Share a ration with Hauer
Dodge the shifting glacier fissure

nodes.title: The Cable-Lord's Toll
nodes.page:
An old cable-lord named Kimmich plants his iron-shod staff firmly across the narrow mountain cornice, barring your progress and demanding an exorbitant toll in silver or trade for the maintenance of the swaying hemp handrails. Behind him, the glacier winds whip viciously through the ropes, creating a high-pitched, singing shriek that drowns out the sound of your bronze cargo.

Kimmich's staff stays across the cornice. Ice grit ticks against the bronze on your back.

nodes.brief: Unencumbered by the mule, you squeeze through a tight blue ice-tunnel that bypasses the treacherous gale-swept ridge entirely.

exits.label: Step carefully near the fresh fissure
Haul the mule across the snow bridge
Inspect the abandoned supply sledge

priv.why: the reader travels without the mule, light and quick, and so notices what a pack-animal would crowd out

nodes.title: The Narrow Blue Tunnel
nodes.page:
Unencumbered by a pack-animal's bulk, you squeeze your shoulders through a tight, glistening blue ice-tunnel that bypasses the treacherous, gale-swept ridge entirely. The bronze clapper scrapes lightly against the frosty ceiling above you, and the tight chamber throws the sound back until your teeth take it up. Emerging from the narrow passage, you find yourself at a critical junction in the upper ice field.

Three distinct routes unfold before you out of the tunnel mouth.

nodes.brief: You chip frozen rungs into a vertical blue wall of ice while the wind screams like a trapped mountain hawk overhead.

exits.label: Lead the mule across the snow bridge
Investigate the half-buried supply sledge
Navigate the maze of towering seracs
Wrestle the clapper along the narrow ledge

nodes.title: Chipping the Vertical Wall
nodes.page:
Your hammer strikes the vertical blue wall of ice with dull, rhythmic thuds, sending brittle shards cascading into the abyss as you chip out fresh rungs against the screaming mountain wind. The bronze clapper grows harder to lift with every vertical inch you gain, its deep knock matching the pound of your own heart. Hanging suspended between cloud and crevasse, you peer upward to choose your next grueling maneuver.

Four distinct paths present themselves along the frozen precipice.

nodes.brief: A terrace miller named Joram offers you a cup of scorched barley tea behind a wind-break of stacked blue ice blocks.

exits.label: Cross the black rime bridge

nodes.title: Scorched Barley Tea
nodes.page:
A terrace miller named Joram steps out from behind a wind-break built of stacked blue ice blocks, handing you a small tin cup of scorched, bitter barley tea that burns delightfully down your throat. The heat thaws your stiffening jaw while the bronze clapper rests against the ice behind you, matching the wind that sings over the terrace walls for a moment. Joram points a mittened finger toward the dangerous paths ahead.

One clear route leads onward from the wind-break across the frozen expanse.

nodes.brief: The hemp bridge shudders violently under a gust, threatening to pitch both you and the bronze clapper into the white void below.

exits.label: Tread the black rime bridge
Heed the miller's loud warnings

nodes.title: Shuddering Hemp
nodes.page: The old hemp bridge shudders violently beneath your boots under a sudden, savage gust of wind, threatening to pitch both you and the humming bronze clapper into the grey white void below. You lock your fingers into the frozen guide-lines, pressing your body flat against the vibrating strands until the worst of the squall passes. Two onward routes beckon through the swirling drift ahead.

nodes.brief: You crawl across a narrow ribbon of blue ice on your belly while loose crystals roar down the couloir beside you.

exits.label: Heed the warnings from Vane
Wedge into the narrow ice cleft

nodes.title: Crawling the Ribbon
nodes.page:
You drop to your belly, crawling across a perilous, narrow ribbon of blue ice while loose crystals roar down the steep couloir directly beside you like a miniature waterfall. The bronze clapper is strapped tightly against your spine, scraping against the hard crust with every inch of forward progress.

Far side of the ribbon, the crust shows a narrow cleft and a scuffed shelf where someone chalked a warning mark in charcoal.

nodes.brief: A fog-warden named Tilda signals with a bronze hand-bell through the swirling drift, guiding you away from a hidden crevasse.

exits.label: Wedge into the narrow ice cleft
Lead Biscuit past the dark chasm
Take the reckless way

nodes.title: The Fog-Warden's Bell
nodes.page:
A fog-warden named Tilda cuts through the blinding whiteout with the sharp, clear note of a bronze hand-bell, guiding your stumbling boots safely away from a hidden, jaw-like crevasse. Her woollen cloak is crusted with rime, but her grip on your sleeve does not slip as she points out the remaining hazards of the glacier ladder. Three distinct choices face you in the swirling fog.

Select your path onward from the warden's sanctuary.

nodes.brief: Biscuit refuses to cross the icy threshold of an old avalanche chute until you blindfold her with a frozen scarf.

exits.label: Take shelter within the narrow ice cleft
Check the tautness of the frayed guide-cables

nodes.title: The Blindfolded Mule
nodes.page:
Biscuit plants his stubborn hooves hard against the grey crust of the old avalanche chute, refusing to take another step onto the treacherous, wind-scoured ice. You coax her with soft words, but her ears pin back against the howling gale. Reaching into your coat, you pull out a stiff, frozen wool scarf and wrap it gently around her wide eyes. Deprived of the terrifying white drop before her, she gives a low, rumbling huff and finally steps forward onto the slope.

The bronze clapper knocks against your spine as you push her on through the biting cold.

nodes.brief: You mend a snapped guide-rope using an old ropewright knot while freezing spray pelts your raw and bleeding knuckles.

exits.label: Duck into the narrow cleft to escape the squall
Inspect the tension on the vibrating guide-cables
Accept Bran's guidance toward the lower mist

nodes.title: Mending the Line
nodes.page:
Freezing mountain spray pelts your raw, bleeding knuckles as you fight to repair the snapped guide-rope lacing the icy abyss. Your fingers are clumsy with cold, but muscle memory takes over, looping the hemp into a secure, traditional ropewright knot that holds fast against the whistling wind. The cable tautens under your pull, offering a lifeline across the chasm.

You pause to blow warm breath onto your aching hands before deciding your next move along the frozen ladder.

nodes.brief: A jagged pillar of blue glacier-glass groans ominously above your head as you haul the heavy bronze load upward.

exits.label: Chop through the drift-snow blocking the shelter
Ring your boot spikes against the hidden boulder

exits.privWhy: the reader can answer the Terrace Millers' wind-calls
exits.label: Follow the whistle-call through the rock ribs

nodes.title: The Groaning Pillar
nodes.page:
A jagged pillar of blue glacier-glass groans ominously directly above your head, threatening to shatter as you haul the heavy bronze load upward. Every muscle in your back strains against the dead weight of the clapper while ice dust sprinkles down from the shifting roof like salt. You press yourself flat against the frozen rock wall, waiting to see if the ancient pillar holds its precarious balance.

The mountain breathes out another gust of bitter air, urging you to move before the fracture spreads further.

nodes.brief: Recognizing your sworn knot-oath, the ropewright guards lower a sheltered ice-chute shortcut straight down the glacier's frozen spine.

exits.label: Clear away the drift-snow blocking the old shelter
Pick your way carefully across the submerged boulder

priv.why: the reader swore the knot-oath and is known by the ropewrights for it

nodes.title: The Knotted Path
nodes.page:
The ropewright guards stationed at the checkpoint recognize the intricate, sworn knot-oath tied into the hem of your travel cloak immediately. Their stern expressions soften into respectful nods, acknowledging your standing with the guild. Without a word, they unlatch a heavy wooden gate and lower a sheltered ice-chute shortcut that cuts straight down the frozen spine of the glacier.

You step onto the slick slide, feeling the weight of the bronze clapper settle comfortably as gravity takes hold.

nodes.brief: You slide down a steep firn chute on your heels, balancing the humming metal weight against the rushing mountain wind.

exits.label: Push onward toward the final icy ridge

nodes.title: The Firn Slide
nodes.page:
You drop onto your heels, launching yourself down the steep, glittering slope of the firn chute while the rushing mountain wind tears at your cloak. The clapper knocks against your back with every meter of rapid descent and tests your balance on the slide. Spray crystals sting your cheeks as you steer your slide using only the heels of your iron-studded boots.

The gradient levels out slightly as you approach the jagged edge of the upper col.

nodes.brief: A frozen waterfall blocks the ladder steps, forcing you to hack fresh footholds with a blunt iron utility axe.

exits.privWhy: the reader can answer the Terrace Millers' wind-calls
exits.label: Follow the hidden wind-call through the rock ribs
Clear the drift-snow from the climber's shelter

nodes.title: The Frozen Cascade
nodes.page:
A wall of solid, frozen blue water completely blocks the narrow ladder steps, forcing you to halt your descent. You draw your blunt iron utility axe from your belt and begin hacking rhythmically at the crystal barrier, chipping away small, glittering shards to carve fresh footholds. Ice chips fly into the abyss below as you chip out a passage for yourself and the pack.

The melodic whistling of the valley wind drifts up from below, offering a familiar cue.

nodes.brief: You share a hard biscuit and a handful of dried plums with a stranded cable-inspector named Hauer in a shallow snow cave.

exits.privWhy: the reader can answer the Terrace Millers' wind-calls
exits.label: Answer the distant whistle through the rock ribs
Listen to the deep hum of the bronze clapper

nodes.title: The Snow Cave Rest
nodes.page:
You crouch low in a shallow snow cave, sharing a hard barley biscuit and a handful of wrinkled, dried plums with a stranded cable-inspector named Hauer. He rubs warmth back into his purple fingers while pointing out the safest routes etched into the glacier map spread across his knee. The small kindness of shared food eases the biting chill in your bones for a brief, quiet moment.

Outside the alcove, the glacier gives another low, metallic groan that vibrates through the rock.

nodes.brief: The glacier shifts with a sound like rolling thunder, opening a fresh fissure inches from your trembling lead boots.

exits.label: Stand firm against the humming bronze resonance
Guide the mule across the trembling wire bridge
Turn back toward the upper shelf

nodes.title: The Opening Fissure
nodes.page:
The glacier shifts beneath your boots with a deep sound like rolling thunder, opening a fresh, yawning fissure inches from your trembling lead foot. You throw your weight backward just in time, clutching the harness straps as loose ice rattles down into the dark, bottomless blue void. The sudden movement sets the bronze clapper into a low, sustained vibration that numbs the skin between your shoulder blades.

The freezing expanse offers few safe options as the ice continues to settle around you.

nodes.brief: You haul the mule across a slick bridge of packed avalanche snow while fine rime freezes over your heavy woolen mittens.

exits.label: Clamber back up from the dangling safety line
Pause to listen in the absolute ringing silence
Climb over the final lip of the glacier tongue

nodes.title: The Snow Bridge
nodes.page:
Across a slick bridge of packed avalanche snow you lead the stubborn mule, and fine rime crusts thick over your woolen mittens. Every breath billows out in a white cloud as you keep your eyes fixed on the far side, ignoring the dizzying drop beneath the fragile span. The animal's hooves crunch rhythmically against the frozen crust, steady and sure despite the freezing gale.

The vast white expanse stretches out endlessly ahead under a pale, cloudless sky.

nodes.brief: An abandoned supply sledge lies half-buried in blue ice, its runners twisted like dry twigs by the relentless pressure.

exits.label: Trade snow with the weary guard at the winch
Stand still in the sudden ringing silence of the ice
Haul yourself over the final lip of the glacier

nodes.title: The Buried Sledge
nodes.page:
An abandoned supply sledge lies half-buried in blue ice, its wooden runners twisted like dry twigs by the relentless pressure of the moving glacier. You brush a thick layer of powdery drift-snow from its frame, checking to see if any useful cordage or spare iron spikes remain intact. The empty waste stretches out on all sides, silent save for the whistling wind cutting across the frozen ridges.

A distant rope-tender waves from a winch station further down the line.

nodes.brief: You navigate a maze of towering seracs while the sun casts an eerie green glow through the ancient ice.

exits.label: Step onto the trembling wire span
Trade snow with the winch guard
Listen to the absolute white silence

nodes.title: The Green Seracs
nodes.page:
Towering walls of ancient blue-green ice loom on either side, casting an unearthly, emerald luminescence over the narrow track. Every breath plumes white in the drafty corridor as you guide Biscuit carefully around jagged pillars laced with hidden frost. The bronze clapper shifts in its padded cradle, and a faint subterranean ringing runs straight down your spine. Ahead, the maze branches into three distinct paths among the frozen monoliths.

One trail leads toward a precarious wire bridge spanning the blue void, another drops down to where a lone winch guard waits, and the third vanishes into an abrupt, absolute hush where the glacier wind dies away entirely.

nodes.brief: A gust of wind tears your woolen cap into the abyss as you wrestle the heavy clapper along the narrow ledge.

exits.label: Reach out to the lower winch guard
Climb over the final glacier lip

nodes.title: The Bitter Gust
nodes.page:
Without warning, a ferocious gale sweeps down the ice face, snatching your woolen cap from your brow and flinging it straight into the gray abyss below. You lean hard against the mountain wall, fingers locking white-knuckled into your pack-straps as the bronze clapper threatens to pitch you backward off the ledge. Biscuit plants his hooves deep into the frozen rime, ears pinned flat against the screaming wind.

Regaining your footing on the narrow shelf, you face a stark choice between descending toward the lower winch station or pushing upward and over the final lip of the glacier tongue.

nodes.brief: You cross a swinging rope bridge where each frozen plank is coated in a thin sheet of treacherous black rime.

exits.label: Cross the frozen planks to the moraine

nodes.title: The Black Rime Bridge
nodes.page:
Each frozen plank of the swinging rope bridge gleams with a treacherous coat of black rime, slick as polished glass above the roaring crevasse. You test the first timber with the toe of your boot while Biscuit blows a nervous cloud of steam into the crisp air. The hemp ropes groan rhythmically under the tension, swaying with every gust that sweeps up the vertical cliff face.

Beyond the far anchor post, the ice begins to give way to the solid, stone-strewn debris of the lower valley.

nodes.brief: A terrace miller named Vane shouts warnings from an upper outcrop about shifting snow bridges across the deep glacial moat.

exits.label: Pick a path down the rocky moraine
Follow the weathered signpost toward the fog

nodes.title: The Miller's Warning
nodes.page:
High above on a sunlit outcrop of rock, a terrace miller named Vane cups his hands around his mouth and shouts across the chasm, warning you away from the shifting snow bridges that span the deep glacial moat. The wind carries his voice away in ragged snatches, but the frantic waving of his arms leaves no room for misinterpretation. You pull the mule's lead rope tight, pausing to survey the broken ice field ahead.

The terminal moraine stretches out below like a dark spine, offering two distinct routes away from the treacherous upper ice.

nodes.brief: You wedge yourself into a narrow cleft in the ice wall to shelter from a sudden blinding squall of stinging hail.

exits.label: Step down onto the frozen moraine
Head toward the fog-choked canopy below
Look back up the towering glacier ladders

nodes.title: The Ice Cleft
nodes.page:
Stinging needles of driven hail force you to dive headfirst into a shallow, vertical cleft in the glacier wall, dragging a reluctant Biscuit in beside you. The cold bites through your woolen coat, but the stone-hard ice offers absolute shelter from the howling squall outside. The bronze clapper rests quietly against your aching shoulders, its faint metallic pulse keeping time with your racing heartbeat.

As the sudden gale subsides and leaves the white world sparkling anew, you can either push down onto the rocky moraine, follow the old signpost into the fog, or pause to gaze back up at the colossal stairway you have descended.

nodes.brief: Biscuit slips on a patch of blue glare-ice, nearly dragging you backward into the dark chasm of the lower tongue.

exits.label: Drag the mule across to the moraine
Head down the signposted trail in the mist

nodes.title: The Glare-Ice Slip
nodes.page:
Without warning, Biscuit's iron-shod hooves find a hidden sheet of blue glare-ice, his legs kicking out from under him with a sharp snort of panic. The sudden weight of the mule and the heavy bronze clapper drags you backward toward the ragged edge of a dark, bottomless crevasse. You throw yourself flat onto the slope, driving your own boot spikes into the crust with all your might.

The frantic struggle leaves you breathless, with the solid rocks of the lower moraine visible just beyond the hazardous slope.

nodes.brief: You check the tension on the frayed guide-cables while the bronze clapper vibrates rhythmically against your frost-stiffened coat.

exits.label: Unbuckle the cradle at the lower station
Look back up the ice-bound cascade

nodes.title: The Frayed Guide-Cables
nodes.page:
Rime-encrusted guide-cables shiver in the glacial draft while you pick at the hemp windings with numb, aching fingers. The bronze clapper vibrates inside its padded cradle against your frost-stiffened coat and answers the mountain's low chord with a soft knock. Biscuit stamps his grey hooves against the ice, eager to leave the high wind behind.

Downward, the route splits between the final resting place of the pack train and the breathtaking view looking back up the frozen cascade.

nodes.brief: A fog-warden named Bran checks your pack-straps with cold, competent hands before pointing toward the lower mist-line.

exits.label: Unburden your shoulders at the rest post

nodes.title: The Fog-Warden's Check
nodes.page:
Cold, competent hands pat down your pack-straps with practiced familiarity, checking every buckle and lash line against the mountain draft. A fog-warden named Bran nods in grim approval, her breath pluming white as she points an mittened finger down toward the rolling mist-line below. Biscuit shakes the accumulated rime from him grey ears, stepping out onto firmer footing as the worst of the glacier's grip finally loosens.

The path ahead drops to the resting post where you can shed your pack and cradle.

nodes.brief: You chop through a wall of blue drift-snow that has completely sealed the entrance to the old climber's shelter.

exits.label: Look back up the towering glacier ladders
Follow the lone fog-warden into the mist
Massage your fingers as the clapper hums

nodes.title: The Sealed Shelter
nodes.page:
Thick, blue drift-snow has completely choked the stone doorway of the old climber's refuge, sealing it into the mountainside like a frozen tomb. You hack fiercely at the compacted crust with the edge of your ice-axe until chunks tumble away into the void, revealing the dark, drafty interior within. The bronze clapper gives a single, resonant thrum against your back as the trapped air inside the shelter escapes.

Beyond the refuge, multiple routes beckon down into the deepening mists of the lower mountain.

nodes.brief: The iron spikes on your boots ring sharply against a submerged boulder beneath the thin and brittle glacier crust.

exits.label: Unbuckle your harness at the rest post
Marvel at the climb from the ridge

nodes.title: The Brittle Crust
nodes.page:
The iron spikes on your boots strike a submerged boulder with a sharp, metallic ring right beneath the thin and brittle glacier crust. For a heart-stopping moment, the white surface sags under your weight, threatening to drop you both into the blue depths. You lean forward into the harness, coaxing Biscuit past the hollow spot with a low whistle of encouragement.

Once across the hazardous skin of ice, the path divides between the lower rest station and the vantage point looking back at the climb.

nodes.brief: You hoist the heavy cradle higher onto your shoulders as the gradient steepens toward the final icy col.

exits.label: Rest the mule and unbuckle the heavy cradle
Seek the fog-warden by the stone marker
Turn back through the narrow ice-tunnel

nodes.title: The Icy Col
nodes.page:
Heavy canvas straps bite into your aching shoulders as you hoist the padded cradle higher, shifting your weight against the biting mountain gale. The gradient steepens sharply toward the narrow notch of the final icy col, where blue-tinted ice meets the grey glare of the high sky. Biscuit plants his hooves stubbornly in the crust, blowing a plume of warm steam into the freezing air while the bronze clapper pulses a slow beat against your spine.

Every breath burns your chest, yet the summit of this frozen pass lies only a short, punishing scramble away.

nodes.brief: Answering the terrace millers' whistling wind-calls earns you a hidden path through the sheltered rock ribs of the cliff.

exits.label: Marvel at the glacier ladders from the ledge
Meet the lone warden by the boundary marker
Descend toward the mist-shrouded orchard valley
Turn back along the narrow cornice trail

priv.why: the reader can answer the Terrace Millers' wind-calls

nodes.title: Whispers in the Rock
nodes.page:
High-pitched whistling notes carry across the steep gorge, echoing the traditional signals of the terrace millers as they manage their distant wind-engines. Matching your breath to the pattern, you catch the secret rhythm of the notes and find a hidden, sheltered path weaving through the solid rock ribs of the cliff. The biting wind drops instantly behind the natural stone bulwarks, sparing you and Biscuit the worst of the frozen onslaught.

The narrow passage offers several distinct directions away from the heights, each carrying the faint scent of damp earth or distant woodsmoke. You can continue down the steep track, look for the local warden, seek the lower orchards, or retrace your steps toward the upper ledges.

nodes.brief: A low tremor ripples through the glacier, setting the bronze clapper into a deep, sustained hum that numbs your teeth.

exits.label: Massage the numbness from your frost-nipped fingers
Step past the stone threshold onto the muddy path

nodes.title: The Bronze Resonance
nodes.page:
A sudden deep tremor ripples up through the glacier ice, shakes your iron-spiked boots, and sets the bronze clapper into a long low knock. The sound fills your skull and numbs your teeth, carrying the ancient memory of Orisonhold's high belfry over the silent white expanse. Biscuit tosses his grey head uneasily as the ice settles beneath him hooves, small powdery avalanches hissing down the distant crevasses.

The ringing fades into the thin air. You stand where the path divides ahead of the final descent. You can tend to your frozen fingers before moving on, or step directly onto the muddy track leading away from the glacier's reach.

nodes.brief: You guide the stubborn mule across a trembling bridge constructed of braided wire and frozen larch timber.

exits.label: Approach the lone fog-warden by the stone marker
Pause to warm your frost-nipped fingers in the shelter

nodes.title: The Wire Bridge
nodes.page:
You guide the stubborn mule step by careful step across a trembling bridge constructed from braided iron wire and frozen larch timber. Below your boots, a grey abyss opens where glacial meltwater roars unseen beneath thick green ice. Biscuit's iron shoes click sharply against the frozen wood, and every sway of the suspension cables sends a sympathetic shiver through the heavy metal clapper strapped to your back.

Reaching the far side safely brings you to a quiet stone platform overlooking the descending slopes. A lonely figure waits near the boundary marker, while the path beyond offers a chance to recover your warmth.

nodes.brief: A patch of rotten firn collapses beneath your leading foot, leaving you dangling by your safety line over empty space.

exits.label: Follow the apple-scented breeze toward the orchards
Step past the stone threshold onto the lower path

nodes.title: The Hanging Crevasse
nodes.page:
A patch of rotten firn collapses under your leading foot with a hollow crunch. You hang by your taut safety line over empty blue-shadowed space. Loose ice tinkles into the unseen depths. You scramble against the slick vertical wall and haul yourself back onto firm ice while Biscuit braces the rope from above with stubborn grace.

Breath comes back on solid ground. One route drops toward the damp apple-scented breeze of the lower valleys. The other crosses the stony threshold away from the glacier entirely.

nodes.brief: You trade a mouthful of melted snow with a weary rope-tender named Miri who guards the lower glacier winch.

exits.label: Descend toward the mist-shrouded orchard valley

nodes.title: The Lower Winch
nodes.page:
You pause beside the timber housing of the lower glacier winch and trade a mouthful of melted snow from your skin flask with a weary rope-tender named Miri. Grease and hemp-tar coat her fingers, and she nods respectfully at the padded cradle on your back before she tests the steel cables for slack where the wind pulls them. The air here feels slightly less brittle, carrying the first faint hints of mud and vegetation from the world below.

The winch platform provides a secure resting place before the final descent into the valley fog. From here, the path slopes gently downward toward the mist-shrouded orchards where the air grows mild.

nodes.brief: The wind drops suddenly, leaving an absolute and ringing silence over the vast expanse of white and jagged ice.

exits.label: Massage the numbness from your frost-nipped fingers
Step past the stone threshold onto the muddy path
Turn back through the narrow ice-tunnel

nodes.title: The Great Silence
nodes.page:
The howling gale drops away in a single breath, leaving an absolute and ringing silence over the vast, jagged expanse of white ice. The sudden quiet presses harder than the wind, broken only by the rhythmic puff of Biscuit's breath and the faint residual knock of the bronze clapper against your shoulders. All around you, the mountain peaks stand like silent sentinels under a pale, cloudless sky.

The stillness offers a rare moment of clarity as you survey the winding descent ahead. You can massage your stiff fingers, step out onto the lower path, or choose to turn back toward the upper heights.

nodes.brief: You haul yourself over the final lip of the glacier tongue, leaving the freezing labyrinth of ladders behind.

exits.label: Step past the stone threshold onto the lower path

nodes.title: The Glacier Tongue
nodes.page:
You haul yourself over the final rounded lip of the glacier tongue, leaving the freezing labyrinth of aluminum ladders and crevasse bridges behind. The ice here is dirty and grey, scored by ancient rock streams and streaked with wind-blown moraine dust. Biscuit shakes the remaining rime from him grey ears with a vigorous shudder, clearly relieved to feel solid earth beneath him hooves at last.

The frozen grip of the upper mountain finally releases you to the lower slopes. A clear stone threshold marks the beginning of the muddy track leading down into the misty world below.

nodes.brief: You stumble onto the frozen rocky moraine at the glacier's foot, where the air grows heavier and less brittle.

exits.label: Lead the mule down the winding stone track
Follow the dull toll of the distant warden bell
Enter the wet canopy of the fogbank orchards

nodes.title: The Terminal Moraine
nodes.page:
You stumble out onto the frozen, rocky expanse of the terminal moraine at the foot of the glacier, where the air grows noticeably heavier and less brittle in your lungs. The towering white wall of ice looms behind you like a receding frozen wave, while the ground shifts from blue-veined sheets to tumbled grey scree and damp earth. Biscuit picks his way cautiously among the boulders, his iron shoes clacking against stones freed from the retreating ice after centuries of sleep.

Several distinct tracks branch out across the moraine toward the lower altitudes. You can lead the mule down the winding stone track, listen for the distant warden bells, or plunge directly into the wet canopy of the fogbank orchards.

nodes.brief: A weathered signpost frozen into the terminal moraine points down toward the distant, fog-choked canopy of the orchard valleys.

exits.label: Lead the mule down the winding stone track
Follow the dull toll of the distant warden bell

nodes.title: The Weathered Signpost
nodes.page:
A weathered timber signpost, crusted in grey lichen and frozen deep into the terminal moraine, points down toward the distant, fog-choked canopy of the orchard valleys. Its carved arrows are worn smooth by decades of wind-blown sleet, but the downward direction remains unmistakable. The heavy bronze clapper shifts comfortably in its padded cradle as you pause to catch your breath and check the straps.

The path splits here among the tumbled grey boulders of the moraine. You can choose to lead the mule down the winding stone track or follow the dull toll of the fog-warden's bell from below.

nodes.brief: Biscuit shakes the rime from her grey ears while you unbuckle the heavy padded cradle from your exhausted shoulders.
