Follow the thin trail of smoke
Rest against the cold boulder

nodes.title: The Mule Rime
nodes.page:
Biscuit shakes the rime from him grey ears while you unbuckle the heavy padded cradle from your exhausted shoulders. The bronze clapper lies against the shale without a sound, its long tongue cold to the touch as the mountain air slowly stills around you. A thin ribbon of woodsmoke curls up from a hidden hearth somewhere down the rocky slope, promising shelter from the biting draft.

You weigh the leather harness in your calloused hands, wondering if the mule has the spirit for the descent ahead or if you should seek out the trail-keeper's warming hut before night settles over the moraine.

nodes.brief: You look back up the towering white cascade of the glacier ladders, marveling that the bronze clapper made the descent intact.

exits.label: Continue down the stony path
Shelter near the rock face
Retrace your steps upward

nodes.title: The High Cascade
nodes.page:
You look back up the towering white cascade of the glacier ladders, marveling that the bronze clapper made the descent intact. Jagged walls of blue-white ice loom like frozen cathedral spires against the pale sky, groaning under the pressure of their own immense weight. Every timber bridge and hemp rope you crossed now looks impossibly fragile from this safe distance on solid ground.

A sudden gust of wind rattles the metal tongue inside its padded leather housing, reminding you that the journey is far from finished.

nodes.brief: A lone fog-warden named Rix waits by the stone boundary marker to guide travelers down into the misty lower tiers.

exits.label: Ask the warden about the trail
Pass by without breaking stride

nodes.title: The Stone Marker
nodes.page:
A lone fog-warden named Rix waits by the stone boundary marker to guide travelers down into the misty lower tiers. Wearing a heavy wool cloak stiffened with salt and grease, Rix strikes a small bronze tuning fork against a knee-high cairn to test the density of the damp air. The resulting chime hangs suspended in the grey mist for a long, quiet moment before fading into the frost.

The warden nods a silent greeting, tapping the smooth wood of a long guiding staff against the damp earth.

nodes.brief: You massage feeling back into your frost-nipped fingers while the bronze clapper gives one last fading hum in the quiet air.

exits.label: Lead the mule toward the track
Adjust the straps on your back

nodes.title: Fading Hum
nodes.page:
You massage feeling back into your frost-nipped fingers while the bronze clapper gives one last fading hum in the quiet air. The metal seems almost alive against your spine, vibrating with the memory of Orisonhold's high towers whenever a cold gust sweeps across the moraine. A thin crust of rime flakes off the leather straps and scatters across the grey slate stones like salt.

You take a deep breath of the heavier, less brittle air, feeling the first true warmth of the lower altitudes reach your cheeks.

nodes.brief: The icy wind finally softens into a damp, apple-scented breeze blowing up from the mist-shrouded orchard valleys below.

exits.label: Step into the misty orchards

nodes.title: Apple-Scented Breeze
nodes.page:
The icy wind finally softens into a damp, apple-scented breeze blowing up from the mist-shrouded orchard valleys below. The harsh bite of the glacier begins to yield, replaced by the rich, earthy aroma of wet humus and rotting leaves. You can hear the distant, rhythmic creak of wooden cider presses turning somewhere down in the fog.

The heavy bronze load on your back feels slightly less burdensome in the gentler air.

nodes.brief: You step past the stone threshold of the glacier's reach, setting your feet firmly on the muddy path toward the fogbanks.

exits.label: Follow the path into the fog

nodes.title: Threshold of Mist
nodes.page:
You step past the stone threshold of the glacier's reach, setting your feet firmly on the muddy path toward the fogbanks. The white glare of the ice yields to a soft, diffuse grey as the low-hanging cloud layer swallows the trail ahead. Every sound is muffled here, turned into a dull thud by the thick, moisture-laden air that clings to your wool garments.

You keep one hand on Biscuit's leather halter to ensure the mule does not stray from the worn track.

nodes.brief: You lead the mule down the winding stone track as the gray shapes of the upper orchard fences loom through the rising mist.

exits.label: Press on through the gate

nodes.title: Upper Orchard Fences
nodes.page:
You lead the mule down the winding stone track as the gray shapes of the upper orchard fences loom through the rising mist. Moss-covered apple trees crowd either side of the path, their branches bent under late, frost-bitten fruit. The world above has vanished entirely behind a curtain of thick white cloud, leaving only the sound of clicking hooves on wet slate.

A wooden gate stands slightly ajar ahead, marking the boundary of the lower tier's managed lands.

nodes.brief: A distant bell tolls dully from the fog-warden post below, marking the safe passage of another traveler off the high ice.

exits.label: Press on into the mist

nodes.title: Distant Bell
nodes.page:
A distant bell tolls dully from the fog-warden post below, marking the safe passage of another traveler off the high ice. The sound is thick and muted by the surrounding moisture, carrying none of Orison's crystalline resonance but offering a steady, human rhythm nonetheless. Biscuit pricks his ears forward at the chime, quickening his pace along the narrowing dirt track.

The steep mountain wall now rises like a sheer black cliff to your left, entirely obscured by the creeping vapor.

nodes.brief: The last frozen rungs of the mountain world vanish behind you as the wet canopy of the fogbank orchards closes in.

exits.label: Press on down the track

nodes.title: Wet Canopy
nodes.page:
The last frozen rungs of the mountain world vanish behind you as the wet canopy of the fogbank orchards closes in. Water beads on your eyelashes and drips from the brim of your woolen cap, cool after the dry, lung-burning air of the heights. The path turns to packed mud underfoot, flanked by stone walls slick with green slime.

You hitch the padded cradle higher on your shoulders as the mule slips on a slick root.

nodes.brief: You adjust the heavy cradle on your back and stride into the damp, silver twilight of the lower orchard terraces.

exits.label: Press on toward the valley

nodes.title: Silver Twilight
nodes.page:
You adjust the heavy cradle on your back and stride into the damp, silver twilight of the lower orchard terraces. The air here smells of damp bark, wet grass, and the faint, sweet decay of fallen apples fermenting in the deep grass. Shadows lengthen across the terrace walls as the hidden sun sinks lower behind the thick blanket of clouds.

You grip the lead rope tighter and keep your eyes fixed on the winding dirt path ahead.

nodes.brief: Desperate to outrun the freezing gale, you unclip your safety tether and bolt across the trembling ice-bridge, plunging headlong into the blue abyss.
nodes.title: The Blue Abyss
nodes.page: Desperate to outrun the freezing gale, you unclip your safety tether and bolt blindly across the trembling ice-bridge, your boots sliding out from under you on a slick tongue of hidden rime. The heavy bronze Clapper tears the padded cradle from your shoulders, spinning away into the hazy blue depths like a falling star. You plunge headlong after it into the silent, yawning abyss, swallowed entirely by the glacier's cold white throat.

nodes.brief: You attempt to glissade down an unroped ice chute with the heavy clapper, losing your footing and tumbling endlessly into the deep blue crevasse maze.
nodes.title: The Blue Slip
nodes.page: Your iron-shod boot finds only slick blue air as the frozen crust gives way beneath the bronze tongue's immense weight. There is no time to shout, only the sharp hiss of tearing rime and the sudden, stomach-churning drop into the throat of the glacier. The world tilts into a clean, blinding sapphire, spinning you gently through walls of ancient, whispering ice where the light dies into a deep, velvety indigo. You fall without terror, held by the cold that shaped the mountain, and the clapper sounds one last long note against your shoulder before the blue silence takes you entirely.

nodes.brief: Arrival in The Fogbank Orchards: an orchard valley drowned in cloud, Fog-Wardens who navigate by whistle and bell-rope, rival carriers, a muffled and uncanny quiet. The reader enters with several ways forward.

exits.label: Follow the main stair
Cut across the lower ledges

exits.intent: Ask the way of a stranger
exits.label: Ask the way of a stranger
Take the old carriers' path

nodes.title: The Cloud Valley
nodes.page: Thick, wool-white vapor rolls through gnarled apple orchards that cling to the steep, stepped hillsides of the middle altitude. Muffled whistles drift across the damp air, answered by the dull, bronze clinking of guide-bells tied to hidden fence posts. This is the domain of the Fog-Wardens, who thread these dripping alleys by sound alone, sharing the gray quiet with rival carriers and silent harvesters. You stand at a damp crossroads where the descending steps split into several uncertain directions, each swallowed entirely by the creeping cloud bank.

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Orchard Gate: the fog-drowned orchard; those with Biscuit have a guide who smells the safe paths, those without must improvise

exits.intent: Biscuit knows the way through the fog

exits.label: Find your own way through the fog

nodes.title: The Orchard Gate
nodes.page: Deep within the choking mists of the Fogbank Orchards, the path fractures into a labyrinth of dripping boughs and treacherous mud. Those who travel with the muleBiscuit have a reliable guide whose sensitive nostrils can smell the firm soil beneath the bog, while those travelling alone must rely entirely on their own wits and the occasional faint echo of a warden's bell. Cold air bites at your fingers, and the Clapper knocks an anxious note against your shoulder blades as you pick your next step.

nodes.brief: Mandatory scene at the Warden's Post: Fog-Wardens at a whistle-post; those who learned wind-calls can talk their way past, the rest must sneak or bluff

Slip past the Wardens unseen

nodes.title: The Warden's Post
nodes.page: Fog-Wardens cluster around the low stone shelter, their polished horn whistles catching the pale light of the hanging lanterns. They are masters of the mist, relying on complex codes and breath-notes to track every traveler who passes between the thirteen hanging towns. The captain steps forward, blocking the narrow track with a steady, unblinking gaze that pierces through your hesitation.

nodes.brief: Leaving The Fogbank Orchards for Lowgate and the Foundry: close this part of the journey.

exits.label: Follow the winding road below

nodes.title: Leaving the Fogbank Orchards
nodes.page:
Leaving The Fogbank Orchards for Lowgate and the Foundry, you feel the dense white vapors slowly give way to the heavy, coal-scented air of the lower basin. The vertical world opens its stone throat, revealing slate rooftops and gray river water far below where the great mountain meets the plains. Every step downward brings a new dampness to your cloak and a sharper urgency to your tired limbs.

The final stretch of the journey awaits where the valley flattens out into mud and industry.

nodes.brief: Among grey apple trees dripping with mist, you test the bronze clapper's cradle while distant fog-bells toll a muffled warning about unseen drops.

exits.label: Step down the central lane
Follow the orchard fence line
Plunge into the gray thicket

nodes.title: Drip and Bronze
nodes.page: Gray apple trees drip silent moisture onto your leather cap while the heavy bronze clapper shifts uneasily in its padded frame. Far off through the thick wool of the fog, unseen bell-towers toll low, rhythmic warnings about hidden drops and crumbling terrace walls. You test the leather straps across your chest, making sure the metal tongue is lashed tight against the biting damp. The path splits before you into three distinct tracks, each swallowed instantly by the pale, swallowing gloom.

nodes.brief: Beside a mossy cider press swallowed by white vapor, you share dried pears with a shivering carter whose mule refuses to step into the white.

Grip the hempen fence-rope

nodes.title: The Cider Press
nodes.page: A rusted wooden wheel looms out of the mist like the skeleton of a great prehistoric beast, dripping moisture onto the flat stones below. You share a handful of dried pears with a bundled carter whose mule stands trembling, whites of its eyes showing as it stares into the impenetrable white wall. The damp air tastes of vinegar and old apples, sticking to the wool of your tunic and chilling your fingers. Several faint tracks lead away from the press into the gray gloom, offering an escape from the silent watcher and his frightened beast.

nodes.brief: Beneath dripping branches of the high orchard terrace, you untangle frozen reins from a low-hung fruit branch before the gray damp chills your marrow.

nodes.title: Tangled Boughs
nodes.page: Low-hanging fruit branches heavy with frost catch at your shoulder straps as you struggle to free a frozen leather rein from a gnarled pear tree. The gray damp clings to your eyelashes and sinks straight through your wool coat to chill your marrow. Moisture drips from the canopy into the mud at your feet in a maddening rhythm. Three murky paths branch away into the silent orchards, each promising either shelter or deeper confusion in the mist.

nodes.brief: At the edge of the sunken hollow where grey mist pools thickest, you hear a hidden warden whistle twice to warn travellers away from the sinkholes.

exits.label: Trace the frayed guide-rope
Watch the cursing rival carrier

nodes.title: The Warden's Hollow
nodes.page: Two sharp whistles cut through the thick gray damp from somewhere down in the sunken orchard hollow, warning unwary travellers away from the hidden sinkholes. Mud squelches beneath your boots as you steady the bronze clapper against your spine, listening intently to the fading echoes in the fog. The air smells of rich rotting mulch and cold stone under the cloud bank. Two distinct tracks skirt the edge of the depression, vanishing into the gray curtains of the valley.

nodes.brief: Within a drowned orchard lane where grey pears rot in ruts, you dodge a careening timber sledge whose runner has snapped off its iron shoe.

exits.label: Follow the rhythmic warden whistle
Tighten the heavy bronze harness
Haul your pack clear of the ditch

nodes.title: The Sledge Tracks
nodes.page: Deep ruts filled with rotting gray pears and black mud mark the floor of this drowned orchard lane where visibility barely reaches your outstretched hand. A careening timber sledge suddenly bursts out of the fog with a sharp snap as its iron shoe shears off against a hidden root. You throw yourself flat against a mossy trunk to let the runaway slide past into the gloom. The lane continues forward, splitting around the remains of an ancient stone wall half-buried in wet leaves.

nodes.brief: Under a dripping canopy of moss-bearded pear trees, you trade a pinch of salt with an old warden for a fistful of dry lichen to stuff your boots.

exits.label: Share a crust of rye bread
Haul your pack clear of the ditch

nodes.title: Lichen and Salt
nodes.page: Moss-bearded pear trees form a low, dripping canopy overhead that traps the damp breath of the valley like a wet wool blanket. You trade a pinch of coarse salt from your pocket with an old warden for a handful of dry lichen to stuff into the gaps in your leaking boots. The warden nods once without speaking, his eyes milky with age and mountain cataract. Two muddy tracks lead onward through the dripping orchard rows, vanishing into the gray distance.

nodes.brief: Beside a stone well choked with fallen leaves, you listen to water splashing deep underground while a rival carrier tries to pry your bronze burden.

nodes.title: The Whispering Well
nodes.page: Cold water splashes against stone deep underground as a stone bucket rattles against the wall of an old well choked with fallen leaves. A rival carrier steps out from behind the mossy brickwork, eyeing the padded bronze cradle on your back with calculating hunger. You shift your footing in the wet muck, keeping your hands free while the thick mist swirls around your ankles. The path continues past the wellhead, dividing into several uncertain directions among the gray trunks.

Bronze clapper cold on your shoulder blades, fog dripping overhead, you look from the open track to the stone drain and measure the risk of each.

The air tastes of cold iron and rotting leaves, and the weight of Orisonhold's great bell feels heavier with every yard of descent into the damp valley.

nodes.title: The White Labyrinth
nodes.page: Under a dense grey ceiling of low cloud, you trace the frayed edge of a warden's guide-rope that leads deeper into the white blind labyrinth of the lower orchards. Every footstep is a guess in the swallowing fog, yet the long metal tongue against your back gives you one fixed point in the drifting grey.

nodes.brief: Beside a muddy embankment where water drips endlessly from dormant boughs, you watch a rival carrier curse at a stuck wheel axle in the fog.

nodes.title: The Stuck Axle
nodes.page: Beside a muddy embankment where water drips endlessly from dormant boughs, you watch a rival carrier curse at a stuck wheel axle in the fog while their mule strains against the wet clay. The carrier casts a bitter, sidelong glance at your padded carrying frame and the humming bronze within before turning back to curse the mud.

nodes.brief: Within a drowned pear orchard where every tree looks like a grey ghost, you follow the rhythmic whistle of an unseen warden to stay on firm mud.

exits.label: Step towards the fading whistle in the gloom

nodes.title: The Whistling Orchard
nodes.page: You pick your way from tuft to sodden tuft through mist that hides the grey ghost-pears until they loom close, guided only by the rhythmic, three-note whistle of a warden unseen in the white gloom. The padded cradle on your back shifts, the cold bronze clapper within answering the hidden music ahead with a damp metal shiver. Mud sucks at your boots with every stride, threatening to pull you off the hidden stone path into the sunken ruts of the valley floor.

nodes.brief: Beside a crumbling stone cider press, you tighten the harness straps on your shoulders while the heavy bronze clapper hums a low, damp chord.

exits.label: Navigate the slick mud towards the orchard interior
Seek shelter near the moss-covered stone wall

nodes.title: The Cider Press
nodes.page: Dripping moss clings to the timbers of an abandoned stone cider press while you lean against its cold flank to adjust the leather harness straps biting into your shoulders. Inside its heavy cradle, the bronze clapper vibrates against your spine, a low and melancholy chord born of the mountain damp. Fog swirls between the gnarled pear trunks, swallowing the sounds of the descent and leaving only the rhythmic drip of moisture from leaf to leaf.

nodes.brief: Under a canopy of dripping branches, you share a crust of rye bread with a lost harvester whose pockets hold only bruised winter apples and copper.

nodes.title: The Winter Harvester
nodes.page: Frost-tipped branches form a low ceiling over the muddy track where you break a dry crust of rye bread with a shivering harvester whose pockets yield only bruised winter apples and a handful of dull copper coins. The stranger points a gloved finger deeper into the mist before vanishing between two ancient trees. You are left alone with the rhythmic knock of the metal on your back.

nodes.title: The Drainage Ditch
nodes.page:
Hauling your heavy pack clear of black water before the freezing silt sucks you down, you scramble up the muddy lip of a sunken drainage ditch. The bronze clapper hums a dull, shivering note against your shoulder blades as you catch your breath in the damp orchard air.

Biscuit shakes a spray of cold droplets from floppy ears, stamping impatient hooves into the wet leaf-mould while the fog swirls thick and grey around your boots.

nodes.brief: Beside a moss-grown milestone carved with faded mountain runes, you pause to catch your breath while the thick mist muffles every distant sound.

nodes.title: The Moss-Grown Milestone
nodes.page:
Beside a moss-grown milestone carved with faded mountain runes, you ease the bronze clapper down into its leather cradle. The thick mist muffles every distant sound, turning the drip of moisture from frozen boughs into a rhythmic, solitary heartbeat.

A sudden clatter echoes through the grey gloom, warning you that the orchard paths remain full of unexpected hazards and hurried travellers.

nodes.brief: Beneath an arbor of dormant vines heavy with frost, you dodge a crate of rotten pears dropped hurriedly by a fleeing rival carrier.

nodes.title: The Arbor of Vines
nodes.page:
Dodging a crate of rotten pears dropped hurriedly by a fleeing rival carrier, you press flat against a wooden post beneath an arbor of dormant vines heavy with frost. Bruised fruit smells bitter in the chill, and the bronze tongue strapped to your back answers with a faint metal shiver.

Biscuit shifts uneasily in the mist, eager to leave the littered clearing behind before more trouble finds you in the fog.

nodes.title: The Unencumbered Path
nodes.page:
Striding past a protesting toll-keeper into a neglected orchard shortcut where no rival dares to follow, you feel the rare, crisp freedom of walking entirely free from debt or bargain. No cable-lord holds a lien upon your time, and no guild ledger records your passage through the dripping trees.

The path grows narrower and greener, winding deeper into the silent mist where only independent travellers dare tread.

nodes.brief: Within a grey fog-shrouded clearing, you tie your cloak tighter against the wet chill while a distant bell-rope twitches against an unseen post.

exits.label: Pause to listen for the warden's three-tone call
Search the glade for the freshly notched guide-post

nodes.title: The Twitching Rope
nodes.page:
Pulling your woollen cloak tighter against the wet chill within a grey fog-shrouded clearing, you watch a distant bell-rope twitch sharply against an unseen wooden post. The damp air carries no sound of whoever pulled the line, leaving only the swaying hemp and the cold grey stillness of the orchard.

The bronze clapper gives a faint, sympathetic thrum against your spine as the hidden signal dies away into the mist.

nodes.brief: Beside a frozen sheep-dip filled with grey slush, you scrape thick mud from your boot soles and listen for the whistle of the lower terrace.

exits.label: Follow the path toward the notched guide-post

nodes.title: The Frozen Sheep-Dip
nodes.page:
Scraping thick mud from your boot soles beside a frozen sheep-dip filled with grey slush, you pause to listen for the faint, tin whistle of the lower terrace. The air tastes of wet wool and decaying autumn leaves, sharp and cold against the back of your throat.

A distant creak of timber reminds you that the mountain paths are never truly empty, even when the fog hides everything beyond arm's reach.

nodes.brief: Under a low trellis of dripping pear trees, you help an old Fog-Warden untangle a snagged guide-wire before the fog thickens into freezing sleet.

nodes.title: The Snagged Guide-Wire
nodes.page:
Helping an old Fog-Warden untangle a snagged guide-wire under a low trellis of dripping pear trees, you work quickly before the drifting fog thickens into freezing sleet. The warden nods a silent, gruff thank-you, tapping a wooden whistle against stained leather as the tension returns to the line.

The surrounding orchard remains quiet and muffled, offering several dim directions through the grey labyrinth.

nodes.brief: Within a hollow stone fruit-store smelling of vinegar and straw, you rest the bronze clapper against a cider cask while your aching shoulders thaw.

exits.label: Approach the steam-shrouded irrigation pond
Squeeze past the stranded timber sledge outside

nodes.title: The Stone Fruit-Store
nodes.page:
Resting the heavy bronze clapper against a cider cask inside a hollow stone fruit-store smelling of vinegar and straw, you let your aching shoulders finally thaw. The thick walls keep out the raw mountain wind, wrapping you in a cool, earthy quiet that feels miles away from the damp trails.

Narrow exits lead out from the dim shelter back into the grey, mist-choked orchards.

nodes.brief: Beside a broken wicker gate half-buried in dead leaves, you spot a discarded woollen scarf left behind by someone who bolted into the mist.

exits.label: Squeeze past the stranded timber sledge

nodes.title: The Abandoned Scarf
nodes.page:
Damp air clings to your eyelashes as you halt beside a broken wicker gate half-buried in soggy dead leaves. Trapped in the thorn bushes nearby, a discarded woollen scarf flutters feebly in the grey draughts, left behind by someone who bolted headlong into the suffocating mist. On your back the bronze clapper pulses against your spine in time with the distant, muffled beat of the valley bells. You pull your collar tight against the dripping branches, weighing your choices in the silent white gloom where every direction looks identical.

To your left, a narrow gap between wooden sheds beckons into deeper shadow. Straight ahead, the ground slopes past a slimy stone mounting block towards faint traces of woodsmoke. Or, if the chill proves too biting and the mist too deep, you can retrace your steps among the dripping pear trees.

nodes.brief: Under a grey expanse of dripping branches, you listen to the rhythmic thud of a distant waterwheel churning sluggishly through the valley mud.

exits.label: Check the stone mounting block for directions
Step carefully over the tangled heap of hemp rope

nodes.title: The Waterwheel's Thud
nodes.page: Listening to the rhythmic thud of a distant waterwheel churning sluggishly through the valley mud, you stand beneath a grey expanse of dripping branches. Damp soil knocks up through your boot soles in time with the clapper riding your back.

nodes.brief: Within a misty orchard lane where the ground turns to slick grey clay, you test every footstep with a stout hazel pole before shifting weight.

exits.label: Follow the muddy track straight ahead

nodes.title: The Slick Lane
nodes.page:
Thick grey clay pulls at your boots with every step you take through the muffled orchard lane. You lean on a stout hazel pole and probe the mud before you cross, the bronze clapper knocking a low note against your back. The mist hangs thick and cold, wrapping the dormant branches in dripping veils.

Beyond the next row of frosted apple trees, the ground rises toward a narrow track leading deeper into the fog.

nodes.brief: Beside a mossy drystone terrace wall, you pull your collar high against the dripping fog while the bronze clapper hums against your shoulder blades.

exits.label: Take the lower path along the stones
Turn into the overgrown pear alley

nodes.title: The Mossy Wall
nodes.page:
Cold moisture drips from the mossy drystone terrace wall as you pull your wool collar high against the biting fog. The bronze clapper rests against your shoulder blades and taps through your coat with each breath. The valley holds quiet except for a distant thud of water machinery somewhere down below.

One route winds downward along the damp stones toward the lower terraces. The other leads into a narrow alley between overgrown pear trees. Water beads on the bronze rim and drops onto the moss.

nodes.brief: Under a heavy canopy of frost-tipped boughs, you dodge a rolling barrel of winter apples that broke loose from an unattended timber cart.

exits.label: Step around the wreckage toward the gate
Circle wide through the orchard rows

nodes.title: The Rolling Barrel
nodes.page:
Frost-tipped boughs shake overhead as a stray barrel of winter apples, broken loose from an unattended timber cart, comes rolling swiftly through the wet grass. You leap sideways into the soggy brush just in time, watching the heavy wood crash into a rotting stump and splinter wide. The damp air fills with the sharp, sweet scent of crushed fruit mixed with cold mountain mud.

Ahead, the lane splits around a moss-grown outbuilding half-lost in the swirling grey mist. You can push past the wreckage toward the western gate or circle wide through the orchard rows.

nodes.brief: Biscuit snorts twice into the grey mist, turning sharply down a hidden mule-track that bypasses the flooded ditch and saves an hour of hauling.

exits.label: Follow the mule toward the timber gate
Head down the foggy lane toward the barrier
Take the narrow side-trail into the mist

priv.why: Biscuit the mule is with the reader and knows the ledges and the ropeway stalls

nodes.title: Biscuit's Sure Footing
nodes.page:
Biscuit snorts twice into the heavy grey mist, shaking frost from his grey ears before turning sharply down a hidden mule-track that bypasses the flooded ditch entirely. The faithful pack-mule knows every treacherous ledge and narrow ropeway stall by heart, picking his way through the slick clay with steady confidence. You keep close behind, glad of his mountain-bred footing, the bronze clapper pressed cold along your spine.

The hidden track branches further down, offering choices toward the lower barrier, the old timber gate, or a narrow side-trail winding off into the fog.

nodes.brief: Within a sunken hollow choked with dead bracken, you retrieve a dropped oilskin pouch containing a warden's spare copper whistle and dry matches.

exits.label: Head toward the looming wicker gate
Push deeper into the dormant plum orchard
Follow the marked trail toward the barrier

nodes.title: The Oilskin Pouch
nodes.page:
Sinking ankle-deep into a hollow choked with dead, soggy bracken, your boot catches on something firm hidden beneath the leaves. Reaching down, you retrieve a dropped oilskin pouch containing a warden's spare copper whistle and a dry bundle of friction matches. The metal feels freezing cold against your fingers, but the find could prove invaluable if the thick mountain fog closes in completely.

You straighten with the bronze resting against your back as the mist shifts slightly. You can head toward the looming wicker gate or push deeper into the dormant plum orchard.

nodes.brief: Beside an old wooden fruit-ladder half-consumed by damp rot, you adjust the padded cradle straps to stop the heavy bronze from bruising your spine.

exits.label: Walk toward the plum orchard perimeter
Proceed toward the tall wooden barrier

nodes.title: The Worn Ladder
nodes.page:
Weathered wood crumbles beneath your touch as you brush past an old fruit-ladder half-consumed by damp rot. You pause beside it to adjust the padded leather cradle straps biting into your shoulders, easing the immense weight of the bronze clapper before it can bruise your spine. The surrounding orchard remains deathly quiet, shrouded in a dense blanket of cloud that hides all distant landmarks.

Two narrow gaps in the dripping hedgerow invite you onward through the chill air. One path leads toward the plum orchard perimeter, while the other winds toward the tall wooden barrier.

nodes.brief: Under a low-hanging canopy of wet gray lichen, you pause to listen for the three-tone warden's call that marks the crossing of the middle brook.

exits.label: Move toward the looming wicker gate
Slip quietly into the plum trees

nodes.title: The Three-Tone Call
nodes.page:
Low-hanging lichen brushes against your brow as you halt beneath a dripping canopy, straining your ears to catch the faint three-tone warden's call that signals a safe crossing at the middle brook. The bronze clapper hums a counterpoint against your back, its metal resonance almost matching the hidden stream's burble through the stones. A sharp gust of wind stirs the fog, revealing a pair of diverging paths ahead.

You can choose to push toward the looming wicker gate in the distance or slip quietly into the stand of plum trees.

nodes.brief: Within a silent orchard glade where visibility spans only three paces, you find a freshly notched guide-post pointing toward the lower stone stairs.

exits.label: Head toward the great wicker orchard gate
Follow the guide-post toward the barrier

nodes.title: The Fresh Notch
nodes.page:
Visibility shrinks to barely three paces within the silent orchard glade, hiding everything beyond the dripping trunks. Your hand brushes against a freshly notched guide-post driven deep into the bark, its clean white slash pointing decisively toward the lower stone stairs. The cold mountain air carries a faint trace of woodsmoke and damp earth from below.

Two routes present themselves from this quiet junction in the mist. One trail leads toward the great wicker orchard gate, and the other heads toward the tall wooden barrier.

nodes.brief: Beside a stagnant irrigation pond shrouded in white steam, you watch a pair of wild ducks lift heavily into the fog without a single sound.

exits.label: Skirt the pond toward the wicker gate
Take the path toward the wooden barrier

nodes.title: The Hidden Pond
nodes.page:
White steam rises lazily from a stagnant irrigation pond shrouded in the dense valley fog. You freeze as a pair of wild ducks lift heavily from the reeds into the grey air, their powerful wings beating without a single sound before they vanish into the ceiling of cloud. The bronze clapper shifts slightly in its leather cradle, humming a deep note that ripples through your tired muscles.

The pond's edge offers two distinct directions to continue your descent. You can skirt the water toward the wicker gate or take the path leading to the wooden barrier.

nodes.brief: Under a towering pear tree dripping with heavy dew, you wipe moisture from your brow and check that your cargo's lashings remain iron-tight.

exits.label: Head toward the great wicker orchard gate
Make your way toward the plum trees
Push onward to the terrace edge

nodes.title: The Pear Tree
nodes.page:
Heavy dew drips from the sprawling branches of a towering pear tree directly onto your wool cap. You wipe your brow with a cold sleeve and check that the stout lashings on your cargo still sit iron-tight against your spine. The bronze clapper gives off a faint, reassuring pulse as you tighten the final knot.

The orchard mist parts slightly around the roots of the tree, revealing three distinct ways forward. You can move toward the wicker gate, slip into the plum trees, or push onward to the edge of the terrace.

nodes.brief: Within a narrow passage between two moss-grown storage sheds, you squeeze past a stranded timber sledge whose axle has sheared clean in half.

exits.label: Slip past the broken timber sledge
Climb the slope toward the pillar

nodes.title: The Sledge Passage
nodes.page: Damp moss clings to the weather-beaten storage sheds that lean inward against each other, creating a grey, narrow alleyway where the light dies entirely. Wedged firmly between the rotting planks is a stranded timber sledge, its heavy oak axle sheared clean in half like a dry twig, blocking all easy forward movement. You shift the padded cradle on your back and squeeze past the jagged splintered wood with the bronze clapper cool against your shoulder blades. The mist curls coldly around your ankles, smelling of old resin and wet earth, offering two distinct ways out of this confined trench.

nodes.brief: Beside a crumbling stone mounting block covered in green slime, you catch the faint scent of woodsmoke drifting up from the lower valley floor.

exits.label: Follow the scent toward the smoke
Seek the stone pillar by the orchard boundary

nodes.title: The Mounting Block
nodes.page: Green slime coats the crumbling stone mounting block where generations of valley folk once hoisted themselves onto mule saddles, now half-submerged in the tall, frost-bitten orchard grass. A faint acrid scent of burning pine drifts up from the lower valley floor and cuts through the fog blanket with the promise of shelter or company. You adjust the straps of your burden, wincing slightly as the weight settles against your tired muscles while the damp air chills your cheeks. Two paths open before you from this mossy waypoint, leading deeper into the muted gray labyrinth.

nodes.brief: Under a dreary gray vault of mist and branches, you step carefully over a tangled heap of abandoned hemp rope left by careless carriers.

exits.label: Step carefully past the old rope
Head toward the stone pillar ahead
Turn back along the warden's guide-rope

nodes.title: The Tangled Hemp
nodes.page: Dreary gray mist hangs from the low-slung branches and muffles every sound except moisture dripping from leaf to leaf. Your boots brush against a tangled heap of abandoned hemp rope left behind by careless carriers, its frayed strands slick with frost and frozen mud. You pause to catch your breath and hitch the bronze tongue in its cradle so it does not strike your frame. Ahead, the path splits around a broad pear trunk, offering several directions through the dense, silent thicket.

nodes.brief: Approaching the orchard boundary where grey mist thickens like wool, you hear the distant iron tongue of a warden's warning bell clanging dully.

exits.label: Advance cautiously toward the muddy gate
Listen closer by the hidden barrier

nodes.title: The Warning Bell
nodes.page: Gray mist thickens like raw wool around the orchard boundary, swallowing the trunks of the fruit trees until they look like floating charcoal sketches. Somewhere in the white shroud a warden's warning bell clangs once, and the iron note travels up through the soles of your boots. You halt near a low stone marker, listening intently to the rhythmic clatter to gauge how far the boundary truly lies. The fog parts slightly to reveal two narrow tracks plunging deeper into the damp gloom.

nodes.brief: Beside a moss-slicked timber gatepost marking the valley exit, you adjust your heavy burden while cold moisture drips steadily from your cap brim.

exits.label: Step out toward the distant guide-rope
Follow the path past the damp gate

nodes.title: The Moss-Slicked Post
nodes.page: Cold moisture drips steadily from your wool cap brim, soaking into the collar of your coat as you stand beside the moss-slicked timber gatepost that marks the valley exit. You hitch the bronze clapper higher on your back until the metal stops rattling and sits flat against your spine. The surrounding orchards stretch out like silent ghosts in the thick, clinging fog, blotting out the mountainside above and the path below. Two vague trails lead onward into the white obscurity, each promising a way through the quiet valley.

nodes.brief: Under the looming shadow of the great wicker orchard gate, you wait for the swirling fog to part so you can spot the path markers ahead.

exits.label: Press forward through the drifting mud
Wait by the timber barrier for the whistle

nodes.title: The Wicker Gate
nodes.page: The looming shadow of the great wicker orchard gate towers above you like the ribs of an ancient whale stranded in the mist. You wait patiently for the swirling white vapor to part so you can spot the weathered path markers nailed to the sturdy willow posts. The bronze tongue on your back gives a faint, sympathetic chime as you shift your weight, responding to the chill draft blowing through the woven bars. Two distinct gaps in the hedge beckon through the gloom, each swallowed entirely by the dense cloud cover.

nodes.brief: Within a dense stand of dormant plum trees near the perimeter, you listen to the low hum of the bronze clapper vibrating against the damp air.

exits.label: Follow the trail toward the muddy threshold
Listen by the timber barrier for the signal

nodes.title: The Dormant Plums
nodes.page: A dense stand of dormant plum trees crowds tightly around the perimeter path, their dark, twisted branches interlocking overhead like gnarled fingers. The low, resonant hum of the bronze clapper vibrates distinctly against the damp air, echoing softly through the hollow trunks of the orchard. You stand still a long moment as the familiar bronze note works through you and cold fog wraps your shoulders. The path divides silently between two rows of frost-covered fruit trees, offering a choice of direction in the mist.

nodes.brief: Beside a rusted iron hinge on the tall wooden orchard barrier, you find a scratched message left in the bark by a preceding mountain carrier.

exits.label: Take the path past the damp gate
Approach the locked wicket in the fog

nodes.title: The Rusted Hinge
nodes.page: Rust flakes away in orange scales from the heavy iron hinge of the tall wooden orchard barrier, leaving bright red streaks on the damp grey wood. Pressed into the soft bark beside the bolt, you find a rough scratch left by a preceding mountain carrier, pointing down toward the lower tiers with a hastily carved arrow. A cold finger follows the groove while you listen past the drip of moisture from the canopy for any other sound. Two narrow routes branch away from the rusted latch into the swirling white gloom.

nodes.brief: Under a cold grey ceiling of cloud at the edge of the terrace, you steady your aching shoulders as the mist stirs with sudden sharp drafts.

exits.label: Tread carefully toward the muddy clearing
Descend toward the damp orchard threshold

nodes.title: The Terrace Edge
nodes.page: A cold grey ceiling of cloud presses down upon the edge of the terrace, turning the distant drop-off into a featureless wall of white. You brace your aching shoulders against the straps of the carrying cradle as a sharp draft of wind stirs the mist. Below, the valley remains utterly hidden, save for the occasional creak of unseen branches shifting in the damp air. Two paths lead away from the stone ledge, swallowed quickly by the fog before they can show their true destination.

nodes.brief: Approaching the heavy wooden crossbeam of the lower gate, you smell woodsmoke and wet soil rising from the hidden valley floor beneath you.

exits.label: Approach the locked wicket in the fog

nodes.title: The Lower Crossbeam
nodes.page: Crossbeams of the lower gate loom from the fog, smelling sharply of wet soil and woodsmoke rising from the hidden valley floor beneath you. You pause with a hand resting on the damp timber, listening to the muffled creak of a warden's ropeway somewhere down in the white abyss. The bronze clapper shifts slightly in its padded cradle, its deep metallic drone blending with the damp silence of the orchards. A single narrow track runs on through the mist toward the locked wicket.

nodes.brief: Beside a weathered stone pillar guarding the orchard exit, you tighten your grip on the carrying poles while a lone warden whistles in the gloom.

exits.label: Follow the warden's distant whistle into the grey haze

nodes.title: The Weathered Pillar
nodes.page: Beside a weathered stone pillar guarding the orchard exit, you tighten your grip on the carrying poles while a lone warden whistles in the gloom. The damp air tastes of rotten leaves and cold stone, sticking to the wool of your scarf and frosting the metal rivets of the bronze Clapper cradle upon your back. Through the churning white veil, the outline of the twisted pear trees dissolves into shifting shadows that offer neither direction nor comfort.

nodes.brief: Standing before the fog-drowned orchard gate, you check your footing in the clinging mud while the distant guide-bells ring their hollow noon chime.

exits.label: Press onward through the damp wicket

nodes.title: The Fog-Drowned Gate
nodes.page: Standing before the fog-drowned orchard gate, you check your footing in the clinging mud while the distant guide-bells ring their hollow noon chime. The wicket's iron latch is slick with condensation, and its timber frame seems to sweat in the breath of the cloud-bank. Somewhere beyond the barrier a mule's harness jingles faintly, then vanishes into the moisture hanging between earth and sky.

nodes.brief: Before the heavy timber barrier lost in white mist, you listen for the warden's whistle that will tell you whether the lower path is clear.

exits.label: Press onward through the heavy mist

nodes.title: The Timber Barrier
nodes.page: Before the heavy timber barrier lost in white mist, you listen for the warden's whistle that will tell you whether the lower path is clear. The wood is swollen with moisture, smelling sharply of wet bark and hidden earth, while the great bronze tongue on your back hums a low, sympathetic vibration against your spine. Every breath draws raw cold into your chest, reminding you of the long miles still remaining before the valley floor.

nodes.brief: At the threshold of the damp orchard gate, you adjust the clapper's cradle while the surrounding fog swirls like cold smoke among the twisted boughs.

exits.label: Press onward into the white orchard

nodes.title: The Damp Threshold
nodes.page: At the threshold of the damp orchard gate, you adjust the clapper's cradle while the surrounding fog swirls like cold smoke among the twisted boughs. Droplets gather on your eyelashes and drip steadily onto your collar, chilling your skin with the relentless damp of the upper cloud-sea. The path ahead is nothing more than a pale suggestion of mud and stone fading entirely into the grey expanse.

nodes.brief: Facing the locked wicket of the fog-bound orchard gate, you brace yourself against the damp chill and wait for the mandatory warden check.

exits.label: Press onward when the latch lifts

nodes.title: The Locked Wicket
nodes.page: Facing the locked wicket of the fog-bound orchard gate, you brace yourself against the damp chill and wait for the mandatory warden check. The iron bars are freezing to the touch, and the silence of the orchard is heavy, broken only by the distant, rhythmic drip of condensation from low-hanging branches. Your shoulders ache from the balanced weight of the bronze tongue, yearning for the moment the path opens.

nodes.brief: Among dripping pear trees, you test a mossy fence line while the bronze Clapper hums softly against your aching shoulders.

exits.label: Follow the reedy whistle into the mist
Keep close to the rotting fence line

exits.privWhy: the reader owes the Cable Court a toll-debt and is recognised by its collectors
exits.label: Pay the tax clerk and move along

nodes.title: The Dripping Orchards
nodes.page: Drenched pear branches lean low across the muddy track, their heavy leaves weeping cold dew onto your woolen collar. You pause by a rotting larch fence, testing a moss-slick post that yields slightly to your pressure, and the bronze Clapper shivers against your aching shoulder blades. Somewhere out in the dense white smother, a Fog-Warden blows a two-tone copper whistle, the reedy call shifting directions as the valley draft twists through the dormant trees.

nodes.brief: Blinded by woolly mist near a stone cistern, you pause to listen for the Warden's guiding whistle ahead.

exits.label: Step blindly into the white orchard lane
Skirt the rim of the mossy stone cistern
Listen closely for another whistle from the hidden wardens

nodes.title: The Stone Cistern
nodes.page: Blinded by woolly mist near a stone cistern, you pause to listen for the Warden's guiding whistle ahead. The stagnant water inside the moss-choked basin ripples with tiny, invisible drops, echoing hollowly in the damp quiet. Your fingers are stiff with cold, gripping the shoulder poles so tightly your knuckles show white against the gloom.

nodes.brief: An old cider press blocks the sunken path, its rusted screw weeping amber juice into the soaked mulch.

exits.label: Climb over the slippery timbers of the press
Slip through the narrow gap near the stone wall
Wait out the chill while the cider drips

nodes.title: The Old Cider Press
nodes.page: Heavy wooden beams and a massive iron screw block the sunken lane, weeping thick amber juice into the soaked mulch beneath your boots. A damp chill rises from the rotting apple pomace, clinging to your woolens as you edge around the rusted machinery. The bronze Clapper shifts in its padded cradle, its deep resonant hum answering some hidden frequency within the dripping valley walls.

nodes.brief: Frost-bitten branches claw at your sleeves as you slip past a silent shed stacked with empty crates.

exits.label: Skirt the edge of the empty crates

exits.privWhy: the Clapper is bare and chipped, and rings or complains in the fog
exits.label: Silence the ringing bronze with your gloved hand
Step firmly onto the firmer turf ahead

nodes.title: The Empty Shed
nodes.page: Frost-bitten boughs claw sharply at your sleeves as you pick your way past a boarded fruit-shed stacked with rows of empty wooden crates. The air tastes of wet cedar and cold peat, muffled by a blanket of cloud pressed down on the valley floor. Your boots slide in the slick clay, and you lean forward to keep the bronze tongue balanced against your spine.

nodes.brief: A passing Cable Court clerk mistakes your pack-strap for a levy-tag, shoving a dry biscuit into your palm and pointing out an untracked gap in the hedge.

exits.label: Squeeze through the narrow hedge gap
Scramble up the slippery apple-wood bank
Tug the dangling bell-pull in the pear grove

priv.why: the reader owes the Cable Court a toll-debt and is recognised by its collectors

nodes.title: The Ledger Clerk's Mistake
nodes.page:
Heavy fog presses against your temples while a clerk from the Cable Court taps a dry knuckle against your leather cradle, muttering about unpaid toll-tariffs. Because your ledger-mark remains unredressed from the upper gates, he assumes you carry company freight, shoves a dry, salted biscuit into your cold palm, and points an ink-stained finger toward an untracked gap in the hawthorn hedge. The bronze tongue hums faintly against your shoulder blades as you weigh whether to slip through the thorny breach or stand your ground.

The damp air smells of wet wool and stale ledger ink.

nodes.brief: Shivering beneath a weeping willow, you adjust the heavy bronze tongue before the rising chill stiffens your leather straps.

exits.label: Climb over the heap of pruned apple wood
Pick your way past the shattered greenhouse glass
Follow the stampede of sheep into the fog
Tread carefully near the slippery clay dip

nodes.title: Shivering Beneath the Willow
nodes.page:
Freezing moisture drips from trailing willow branches down the back of your woollen collar as you pause to readjust the heavy bronze tongue. The bitter mountain wind slips through the valley orchards, threatening to stiffen your leather shoulder straps before you reach the lower terraces. You shift the dead weight of Orison's heart, feeling the cold bronze bite through the padding against your spine.

The grey light fades slightly into the thick mist as you ready your boots for the descent.

nodes.brief: A wicker handcart abandoned across the muddy lane forces you to scramble through a patch of stinging nettles.

exits.label: Dodge the falling tile from the shed roof
Step past the buried iron hoops in the humus
Trail your fingers along the damp retaining wall

nodes.title: The Blocked Lane
nodes.page:
An overturned wicker handcart blocks the sunken mud lane, forcing you to turn aside and force a path through a dense patch of stinging nettles. Your thick trousers blunt some of the bite, yet the sudden detour tips you sideways under the cradle. You adjust your footing in the cold slush, listening to the muffled dripping of moisture from the fruit boughs overhead.

The grey murk closes in behind you like a damp wall.

nodes.brief: Distant wood-pigeons clatter upward into the grey murk, warning of some unseen disturbance deeper in the orchard rows.

exits.label: Move forward along the damp retaining wall
Walk past the button-eyed scarecrow in the fog
Tighten your grip against the soaked shoulder straps

nodes.title: Disturbed Pigeons
nodes.page:
A sudden flurry of wood-pigeons clatters upward into the grey murk, their frantic wings warning of some unseen disturbance lurking deeper in the misty orchard rows. You freeze in your tracks and brace your knees against the downward pull of the bronze Clapper. After they go, the silence sits deliberate, broken only by condensation dripping from pear leaves.

You grip the cradle harness tighter and wait for the fog to shift.

nodes.brief: A row of dormant bee-hives hums with a deep vibration that matches the tired ringing in your marrow.

exits.label: Rest your aching back on the old stone bench
Push through the tangle of wild blackberry canes
Turn back toward the guiding stone cistern

nodes.title: The Humming Hives
nodes.page:
A long row of dormant bee-hives keeps a deep, live note that matches the tired ringing inside your marrow. The air here smells faintly of dead wax and frozen honey, thick enough to taste on the back of your tongue. You stand motionless for a moment, letting the shared tremor ease the ache in your shoulders before deciding your next step through the grey veil.

The mist swirls silently around the straw skeps.

nodes.brief: Tilted gravestones of ancient orchard-keepers loom from the damp turf like broken teeth in a grey gum.

exits.label: Pause by the lichen-covered stone bench
Navigate the thorny blackberry briars
Trace the edge of the misty pear branches

nodes.title: Graves of the Keepers
nodes.page:
Tilted gravestones of ancient orchard-keepers loom upward from the damp turf like broken teeth in a grey gum. Moss has swallowed their carved names, leaving only rough slate markers standing silent witness in the mist. You pick your way between the sunken mounds as the bronze Clapper shifts slightly in its canvas cradle.

The air smells of wet earth and centuries of fallen leaves.

nodes.brief: A rusted copper basin catches dripping condensation, plink-plonking in rhythm with your stumbling boots.

exits.label: Avoid the thorny canes by the dry wall
Step closer to the ditch of fermented windfalls

nodes.title: The Copper Basin
nodes.page:
A rusted copper basin catches drips of condensation from an overhanging branch, going plink-plonk in a slow rhythm that matches your stumbling boots. The stagnant air around the basin smells of rotting pulp and iron-rich water. You pause beside the low stone border, wiping moisture from your forehead while the heavy bronze tongue rests against your spine.

The rhythmic dripping echoes softly through the dead orchard.

nodes.brief: Tangled brambles catch the cradle harness, threatening to pin you fast in the dripping shadows.

exits.label: Ease your load upon the old stone bench
Brush past the snagging blackberry canes
Step over the gurgling iron drainpipe

nodes.title: Tangled Brambles
nodes.page:
Wild blackberry brambles reach out from the shadows to snag your leather gaiters and catch upon the cradle harness, threatening to pin you fast in the dripping gloom. You twist your shoulder to shake free of the thorny hooks, feeling the cold weight of the metal shift awkwardly against your back. The mist swirls thicker around your boots as you fight for footing in the mulch.

A single stray thorn scratches sharply through your woollen sleeve.

nodes.brief: The chipped bronze Clapper catches a rogue gust through the fog-gaps, chiming a clear C-natural that startles a roosting pheasant and reveals a hidden drainage culvert leading straight through the stone wall.

exits.label: Follow the path beneath the hanging mist-webs
Cross the narrow alder plank toward the ditch

priv.why: the Clapper is bare and chipped, and rings or complains in the fog

nodes.title: The Chipped Note
nodes.page:
A rogue gust of wind cuts through a gap in the fog, catching the chipped edge of the bronze Clapper and striking a clear, ringing C-natural. The sound startles a roosting pheasant into the grey sky and lays bare a hidden drainage culvert piercing straight through the damp stone wall. Because the metal is bare and damaged, its raw voice carries far in the damp air, revealing a passage you might otherwise have missed.

The vibration dies away into the muffled quiet of the valley.

nodes.brief: A moss-grown stone weir gurgles beside the track, its icy water tasting of iron and mountain loam.

exits.label: Retrieve the sodden mitten from the track ruts
Cross the rotting alder plank over the ditch
Scatter the fieldfares resting in the hawthorn hedge

nodes.title: The Iron Weir
nodes.page:
A moss-grown stone weir gurgles beside the muddy track, its icy water tasting strongly of iron and mountain loam. The white noise of the tiny stream drowns out the usual drip of the fog, offering a brief, clear space in the muffled silence. You pause by the low stone barrier to wet your parched throat with the cold mountain runoff before pressing onward.

The current pulls dark and swift beneath its green shroud.

nodes.brief: Piles of pruned apple wood smell sharply of sap, offering a greasy handhold as you scramble up a slippery bank.

exits.label: Cross the hidden ditch via the rotting alder plank
Chase the startled fieldfares into the dripping hawthorn hedge

nodes.title: The Pruned Wood
nodes.page: Piles of pruned apple wood smell sharply of sap, offering a greasy handhold as you scramble up a slippery bank. In its padded cradle on your back the bronze Clapper shifts, cold enough that it nearly tips you into the mud. Biscuit plants his stubborn hooves on the incline, ears pinned flat in the mist, and damp air closes over the orchard without a sound.

nodes.brief: An iron bell-pull dangles from a rotting pear trunk, swaying lifelessly in the stagnant air.

exits.label: Step carefully across the single rotting alder plank over the ditch
Push through the dripping leaves rustling with hidden fieldfares

nodes.title: The Iron Bell-Pull
nodes.page: An iron bell-pull dangles from a rotting pear trunk, swaying lifelessly in the stagnant air of the fogbank. You reach out a stiffened hand, tempted to ring it and rouse whatever Fog-Warden might be sheltering nearby, but the metal is encrusted with cold green rust. The bronze Clapper answers the silence with a faint knock against your shoulder-blades.

nodes.brief: Shards of broken glass glint beneath the rotting leaves where a greenhouse once stood against the cliff.

exits.label: Follow the slippery river stones down the forgotten water-channel
Press onward as grey vapor rolls heavily over the terrace steps
Inspect the rusted wind-vane shaped like a leaping trout

nodes.title: The Greenhouse Glass
nodes.page: Shards of broken glass glint beneath the rotting leaves where a greenhouse once stood against the cliff. Every movement must be calculated to avoid slicing your boots or turning the mule's delicate ankles on the treacherous debris. Heavy vapor curls around the shattered window frames, smelling of wet earth and ancient ironwork while the mountain wind remains locked far above.

The sudden noise sets Biscuit snorting in alarm, nearly tangling your pack-straps in the low-hanging branches of a gnarled plum tree. You steady the mule with a quiet word and a firm hand on his halter, waiting for the frantic clatter to fade into the damp distance.

nodes.title: The Sheep Dip

The stone basin is filled with stagnant, greyish water that laps against its mossy sides with a dismal sound. Biscuit tests the footing with one cautious hoof, ears twitching at the muffled sounds of the orchard.

nodes.title: The Falling Slate
nodes.page: A slate roof tile slips from an unseen shed above and shatters inches from your boots on the flags. You jerk backward, the padded cradle of the Clapper shifting uncomfortably against your spine as the echoes die instantly in the thick fog. Somewhere above, water drips from the unseen eaves, one drop after another, maddening in the quiet.

nodes.brief: Rusted iron hoops lie half-buried in the humus like the ribs of stranded river-boats.

nodes.title: The River-Boat Ribs
nodes.page: Rusted iron hoops lie half-buried in the humus like the ribs of stranded river-boats left behind by some ancient flood. The ground here has a hollow, spongy feel beneath the leaf-mold, whispering of buried wood and forgotten masonry. You hitch the straps over your shoulders and keep a tight grip on Biscuit's lead rope as the white silence presses in from every side.

nodes.brief: The fog thickens to a woolly grey soup, forcing you to trail your fingers along a damp retaining wall.

nodes.title: The Woolly Soup
nodes.page: The fog thickens to a woolly grey soup, forcing you to trail your fingers along a damp retaining wall to keep your bearings. The stones are slick with cold slime, but they offer a reassuring line through the featureless grey world. Biscuit plods blindly behind you, his breath coming in warm, rhythmic puffs that vanish instantly into the mist.

nodes.brief: A weathered scarecrow stuffed with damp straw watches you pass with empty, buttonless eye sockets.

nodes.title: The Scarecrow Guard
nodes.page: A weathered scarecrow stuffed with damp straw watches you pass with empty, buttonless eye sockets. Its crooked wooden arms jut out into the fog like a hesitant signpost pointing toward the lower reaches of the valley. Against your back the bronze Clapper knocks once, low, as if greeting this silent guardian of the blighted orchard.

nodes.brief: Thick condensation beads on your woollen cloak, soaking through to your shoulders where the heavy cradle straps bite.

exits.label: Skirt the patch of boggy ground near the lower terrace
Seek out the stone shelters where wood-smoke scents the air

nodes.title: The Heavy Drops
nodes.page: Condensation beads on your woollen cloak and soaks through to your shoulders where the cradle straps bite into the fabric. Every breath tastes of cold moisture and the faint, sweet decay of fallen fruit rotting in the damp grass. You shift the burden slightly, trying to find a drier patch of cloth against your aching back while the fog swallows the path ahead.

nodes.brief: An old stone bench covered in grey lichen offers a moment to ease the bruising weight of the Clapper.

exits.label: Follow the fern-fringed gravel toward the guard post

nodes.title: The Lichen Bench
nodes.page: You rest the cradle against cold stone and take a brief sanctuary from the mountain's unending downward pull. Grey lichen coats the old wooden surface where generations of orchard workers have paused to catch their breath. The bronze Clapper knocks softly against your shoulder pads, matching your own tired pulse. Through the clinging white mist, the path ahead winds deeper into the damp orchard silence.

nodes.brief: A tangle of wild blackberry canes snags your leather gaiters beside a dry-stone retaining wall.

exits.label: Approach the fern-fringed guard post along the gravel track
Step toward the fragrant stacks of fresh birch logs

nodes.title: Tangled Briars
nodes.page: Thorny blackberry canes catch at your leather gaiters, binding your feet as you attempt to navigate the narrow terrace lane. Beside the path, an old dry-stone retaining wall leans precariously under the weight of wet earth and winter frost. Stacks of split birch wood release a sharp, clean scent of fresh sap that cuts through the heavy smell of fog and rot.

nodes.brief: The sweet tang of fermented windfalls rises from a ditch where spoiled fruit rots away in the damp.

exits.label: Follow the fern-veiled gravel path
Listen for the bone whistle ahead
Grip the hemp handrail above the drop

nodes.title: The Fermenting Ditch
nodes.page: Rotting pears fill the damp air with a sharp, wine-dark sweetness that rises thick from the weed-choked ditch beside your boots. Biscuit halts, blowing a warm, wet breath against your shoulder as the cradle straps strain beneath the bronze clapper's dead weight. The white fog clings to your woollen sleeves, damp and heavy, blurring the orchard rows into a shifting maze of grey trunks and dripping branches.

nodes.brief: A rusted iron drainpipe gurgles with cold mountain runoff, splashing your trousers with yellow clay.

exits.label: Approach through the stone archway

Take the reckless way

nodes.title: The Gurgling Drain
nodes.page: Icy mountain runoff spills from a rusted iron pipe, splashing yellow clay across your shins as you pick your way between the gnarled fruit trees. The bronze clapper knocks against your shoulder blades, a faint vibration that numbs the muscle under your woollen tunic. Somewhere in the blinding mist ahead, a warden's bone whistle cuts sharp through the wet silence, warning that the path is guarded.

nodes.brief: Shimmering spider-webs heavy with mist hang between the pear branches like grey lace curtains.

exits.label: Follow the whistling sound ahead

nodes.title: The Mist-Laced Branches
nodes.page: Slender threads of spider-silk stretch tight between the pear boughs, heavy with shimmering beads of moisture that catch the pale, diffused light. Every movement shakes a cold shower of condensation down your neck, chilling your skin where the cradle straps bite into the fabric. Fallen leaves and black mud slick the ground under your boots, and every step asks for balance as you carry the bronze through the silent orchard.

nodes.brief: A discarded woollen mitten lies sodden in the ruts, reminding you how easily a traveller loses his grip here.

nodes.title: The Sodden Mitten
nodes.page: A single woollen mitten lies abandoned in the deep mud, soaked through and grey with dirt from the trail. It serves as a quiet warning about the perils of losing one's grip on these slippery mountain slopes. The heavy bronze Clapper shifts in its cradle, pulling your shoulders down as you survey the orchard path.

nodes.brief: The ground dips sharply toward a hidden irrigation ditch bridged by a single rotting alder plank.

nodes.title: The Alder Bridge
nodes.page: A single rotting alder plank spans the sunken irrigation ditch, groaning under your boots as you step carefully across the black water. Frost-rimed plum branches crowd the narrow track until the bronze clapper scrapes the frozen bark with a dull, ringing thud. Biscuit plants his stubborn hooves at the water's edge, refusing to cross until you haul firmly on his halter rope.

nodes.brief: A flock of fieldfares bursts from a hawthorn hedge, their frantic wings rustling the dripping leaves above.

nodes.title: The Fieldfare Flight
nodes.page: A sudden flurry of brown wings erupts from the dripping hawthorn hedge, startling a flock of fieldfares into the thick white fog above. Their frantic calls fade into the muffled silence of the orchard valley as you hitch the cradle straps on your aching shoulders. The damp air smells of wet earth and frozen wood, cold enough to turn your breath into grey wisps that vanish before they touch the bronze.

nodes.brief: Smooth river stones pave a forgotten water-channel that now serves as a treacherous, slippery footpath.

exits.label: Take the rope-railway path

nodes.title: The Water-Channel Path
nodes.page: Rounded river stones pave the bed of an ancient water-channel, now transformed by autumn rains into a treacherous, slippery footpath. Water slides silently over the green-tinted pebbles and can twist an ankle with every step you take beneath the cradle. The bronze clapper vibrates straight through your spine, matching the exhausting rhythm of your boots on wet stone.

nodes.brief: A broken pruning knife glints among the roots of a gnarled plum tree, half-swallowed by green velvet moss.

nodes.title: The Broken Blade
nodes.page: Half-swallowed by emerald moss, a rusted pruning knife lies half-buried among the gnarled roots of an ancient plum tree. The damp air presses close from all sides, thick with the scent of frozen soil and decaying vegetation that clings heavily to your woollen cloak. Biscuit shifts behind you, his iron-shod hoof striking a flint stone with a sharp, lonely spark that dies instantly in the mist.

nodes.brief: Heavy vapor rolls down the terrace steps in grey tendrils, smelling strongly of woodsmoke and damp earth.

nodes.title: Smoke in the Mist
nodes.page: Grey vapor rolls down the terrace steps in soft tendrils, smelling of woodsmoke and damp earth. Your shoulders ache under the bronze clapper, cold metal against the padding of your pack frame, and you pause to catch your breath. The world has narrowed to the damp stone beneath your boots and the shifting shroud of white clouds that swallows the mountain edge.

nodes.title: Narrow Stone Passage
nodes.page: Unencumbered by a pack animal's clumsy bulk, you slip sideways through a narrow gap between stone buttresses just as a rolling boulder crashes down the lane. Without the stubborn breadth of a mule to hinder your footing, you move with a nimble lightness that lets you navigate the tightest corners of the terrace. The air here tastes sharply of pine resin and wet rock, untainted by animal sweat or heavy harness.

nodes.title: The Leaping Trout

The metallic groan of the weather-vane echoes strangely in the quiet air, competing only with the distant, melancholy drop of water from the eaves above.

nodes.brief: Yellowed dock leaves brush against your knees as you skirt a patch of boggy ground near the lower terrace.

nodes.title: The Foggy Margin
nodes.page:
Yellowed dock leaves brush against your knees as you skirt a patch of boggy ground near the lower terrace, each step sinking ankle-deep into cold, peat-scented muck that tries to pull your boots down. The bronze Clapper on your back shifts its weight, a dull, reassuring hum against your spine that counterbalances the damp chill rising through your woolen trousers. Through the grey mist overhead, fat drops of moisture fall from the leaf-laden boughs and patter on your leather pack.

Two separate trails diverge from this soggy hollow: one narrow track plunges deeper into the dripping thicket where a curtain of falling water masks the path, while the other winds toward a stone wall where the sharp tang of woodsmoke drifts on a sudden mountain draft.

nodes.title: The Crumbling Kiln
nodes.page: A crumbling brick kiln emits a faint, lingering heat that thaws the ice on your stiffened leather gloves. You stand close to the warm masonry a moment, letting the kiln-heat ease your aching muscles while the great bronze clapper taps soft against your spine. Wisps of steam rise from your damp wool cloak as the surrounding fog presses in, silent and close.

nodes.brief: The damp air tastes of wood-smoke and wet wool, signaling the proximity of inhabited stone shelters ahead.

nodes.title: Wool and Woodsmoke
nodes.page: The damp air tastes of wood-smoke and wet wool, signaling the proximity of inhabited stone shelters ahead. You hitch the padded straps holding the bronze tongue until the familiar low pulse runs through your ribs. The path grows firmer beneath your soles, paving stones smoothed by generations of orchard-keepers and travelers heading down the mountain.

nodes.title: The Fern Arch

The masonry is slick with moisture, and tiny droplets cling to the delicate fronds like beads of glass. Through the damp aperture, the faint outline of a low-roofed stone building looms in the thick white haze of the orchard valley.

nodes.title: The Bone Whistle
nodes.page: The muffled sound of a bone whistle echoes off the wet cliffs, warning that the checkpoint is near. You halt for a heartbeat, listening to the shrill, bird-like notes dance through the fog and vanish into the damp evergreens. The bronze clapper shifts in its cradle, its metal knock answering the lingering vibration of the guard's call.

nodes.title: Piles of Birch Logs
nodes.page: Piles of split birch logs line the narrow track, smelling of fresh sap and winter fuel stores. The white bark gleams softly against the grey stone walls as the fog drifts slowly between the stacked wood. Each log is cut to a precise measure, ready to keep the upcoming guard post warm against the biting mountain chill.

nodes.brief: A frayed hemp rope tied to a stump serves as a handrail above a steep drop into the white fog.

nodes.title: The Hemp Handrail
nodes.page: A frayed hemp rope tied to a stump serves as a handrail above a steep drop into the white fog. The thick fibres are wet to the touch, and you grip them hard against the pull of the bronze burden on your back. Below the path, the abyss remains entirely hidden behind an opaque wall of cloud and mist.

nodes.brief: Frost-rimed plum trees crowd the path so tightly that your heavy bronze burden scrapes against their frozen bark.

nodes.title: Frost-Rimed Plum Trees
nodes.page: Frost-rimed plum trees crowd the path so tightly that your heavy bronze burden scrapes against their frozen bark with a dry, metallic rasp. Each twisting bough hangs low under the grey weight of the cloud-drenched air, trapping you in a silent, freezing tunnel of wood and rime. Biscuit plants his hooves behind you, snorting a warm plume of mist against the damp moss as the branches claw at your canvas straps.

nodes.brief: A wooden signpost with worn lettering points blindly into the heavy mist, its directions long since washed away.

exits.label: Follow the faint arrow west

nodes.title: The Blind Signpost
nodes.page: A wooden signpost with worn lettering points blindly into the heavy mist, its directions long since washed away by decades of mountain rain and biting frost. Barely legible grain streaks hint at old paths toward the lower orchards, but the wood is swollen and damp beneath your exploring fingers. Biscuit nudges your shoulder, eager to leave the quiet gloom of the crossing while the air remains still. You can trust the faint impression of an arrow pointing toward the western steps or follow the sound of dripping water past the splintered post.

nodes.brief: The rhythmic dripping of moisture from overhead branches creates a deceptive curtain of sound masking the guard-post.

exits.label: Dart quickly through the dripping screen

nodes.title: The Deceptive Curtain
nodes.page: The rhythmic dripping of moisture from overhead branches creates a deceptive curtain of sound masking the guard-post just beyond the hedgerow. Water droplets strike broad pear leaves one after another until the muffled orchard wears a soft, whispering screen of sound. You pause and tug the bronze Clapper straps tighter, taking a slower breath in the cold. The temptation to dart past while the acoustics remain tangled in the foliage pulls at your nerves, but the risk of stumbling into an unseen patrol grows with every step.

nodes.brief: Cold mountain draft channels down the stone corridor, carrying the sharp tang of woodsmoke and roasted chestnuts.

exits.label: Take the narrow stone service stair

nodes.title: The Draft and Smoke
nodes.page: Cold mountain draft channels down the stone corridor, carrying the sharp tang of woodsmoke and roasted chestnuts from a hearth hidden somewhere in the white gloom. The sudden warmth is a welcome relief against your stiff shoulders, though the heavy iron cradle holding Orison's tongue remains bitterly cold. You lean against the damp masonry to catch your breath while Biscuit stamps an impatient hoof on the flagstones. Beyond the drafty threshold, the path splits between a narrow service stair and a wider mule track half-blocked by fallen crates.

nodes.brief: Pale lantern light flickers through the greasy horn windows of the low stone shelter where the whistle-guards wait.

exits.label: Press on past the lighted window
Turn back toward the old orchard roots

nodes.title: Pale Lantern Light
nodes.page: Pale lantern light flickers through the greasy horn windows of the low stone shelter where the whistle-guards wait out the heavy mountain haar. Inside, a low murmur of voices rises over the steady hiss of damp firewood and boiling chicory. You hitch the padded straps, and dull bronze taps your spine while you stand in the shadow of the eaves and pick your next move. Pressing onward past the lighted window risks drawing the attention of the vigilant wardens, while turning back means losing precious hours before the ice-wind season closes the upper passes.

nodes.brief: A notched wooden tally stick hangs beside the heavy oak door of the post, recording the day's transit tolls.

exits.label: Press on into the dense white fog

nodes.title: The Notched Tally Stick
nodes.page: A notched wooden tally stick hangs beside the heavy oak door of the post, recording the day's transit tolls in neat, rough-hewn gashes. The wood smells of resin and old ink, untouched by the drifting fog that clings stubbornly to the lintel and stone jambs. You run a gloved finger over the recent marks, wondering how many carriers have passed this way today with loads heavier than your own. The road ahead vanishes completely into the white soup, leaving you with little choice but to step forward and face whatever lies beyond the threshold.

nodes.brief: Piles of grey wool blankets sit on a rough bench inside the porch, smelling faintly of sheep lanolin and rain.

exits.label: Press on into the damp grey gloom

nodes.title: Piles of Grey Wool
nodes.page: Piles of grey wool blankets sit on a rough bench inside the porch, smelling faintly of sheep lanolin and lingering rain. The shelter offers a brief, dry respite from the chill of the Fogbank Orchards, though the bronze Clapper on your back reminds you the journey cannot pause for long. Biscuit shakes his head, sending a cascade of droplets from his ears onto the dusty flagstones. You can either shoulder your burden and plunge back into the damp gloom or linger a moment longer to warm your frozen fingers.

nodes.brief: A tin kettle boils over on an iron brazier, filling the drafty watch-room with steam and the scent of chicory.

exits.label: Press on into the chilly mountain air

nodes.title: The Boiling Tin Kettle
nodes.page: A tin kettle boils over on an iron brazier, filling the drafty watch-room with steam and the scent of roasted chicory. The sudden heat fogs your spectacles and dampens your collar, but the warmth sinks gratefully into your aching muscles. Outside the small iron-barred window, the grey mist shifts sluggishly against the glass like a restless animal.

nodes.title: The Mossy Run
nodes.page: Slipping past the Warden post beneath dripping pears, you follow a mossy irrigation run while the bronze clapper hums against your aching shoulder-blades. The cold mountain air smells of wet bark and crushed leaves, thick enough to taste on your tongue. Every breath comes sharp and shallow, in time with water trickling over grey river stones. Ahead, the path splits around a dense thicket of blackthorn where lanterns flicker against the creeping white fog.
