nodes.page:
Coal dust coats the damp cobblestones of the narrow alley, where an old bailiff named Vane steps out from the gloom and raises an ash-wood staff to block your path, insisting on inspecting the wooden cradle on your back. The air tastes of sulphur and wet soot, and every breath burns the back of your throat.

You can let the bailiff inspect your heavy burden, demand to know by whose authority he stops travellers, or slip your hand toward the strap and prepare to push past him.

nodes.brief: Beside a sputtering pitch-pot, a weary drover named Corin curses his balky mule while blocking the narrow flagstone thoroughfare.

exits.label: Slip past the sputtering pitch-pot toward the rope-loft
Wait for the drover to clear the dock-marshal's landing
Take the reckless way across the swollen drainage canal

nodes.title: The Pitch-Pot Thoroughfare
nodes.page: Thick, acrid smoke from a sputtering pitch-pot curls across the flagstones, stinging your eyes as a weary drover named Corin curses his balky mule. The stubborn beast plants its hooves in the center of the narrow thoroughfare and blocks your way, the bronze clapper tapping faintly against your spine. Corin wipes soot from his forehead and glares at the animal, offering no room to squeeze past unless you take matters into your own hands.

nodes.brief: Near the flooded timber yards, a nervous watchman named Farris mistakes your heavy bronze burden for contraband salt and draws his truncheon.

exits.label: Duck away toward the slippery stone landing
Dart past the hissing lime-pit into the alley

nodes.title: Timber Yard Confrontation
nodes.page: Splintered pine and dark, oily water surround the flooded timber yards where a nervous watchman named Farris steps out from behind a stack of dripping planks. He mistakes the heavy wooden cradle on your back and its bronze burden for smuggled contraband salt, drawing his ash-wood truncheon with a sharp warning. The low-slung fog rolls in off the river, chilling the air as you weigh your options against the watchful guard.

nodes.brief: Within a dripping salt-shed, a sharp-eyed hawker named Jute tries to palm off a counterfeit brass token for your bronze clapper.

exits.label: Leave the hawker for the damp cooperage floorboards
Hurry past the hissing lime-pit into the fog
Kick past the snarl of a starving hound under the granary arch

nodes.title: Salt-Shed Exchange
nodes.page: Salt-crusted rafters drip condensation onto your shoulders inside the gloomy shed, where a sharp-eyed hawker named Jute leans over a barrel. He taps a counterfeit brass token against the rim, trying to palm it off in exchange for the sacred bronze clapper on your back. Outside, the tide laps the pilings, and damp air carries the low persistent note of the metal tongue you carry for Orisonhold.

nodes.brief: Beside a stagnant drainage ditch, an anxious carter named Lorn begs you to help lift a snapped axle from his mired wagon.

exits.label: Step carefully around the mud toward the cooperage
Head past the hissing lime-pit into the gathering gloom
Turn back toward the murky watergate and safety

nodes.title: Mired Wagon Dilemma
nodes.page: Mud bubbles lazily beside a stagnant drainage ditch where an anxious carter named Lorn struggles against the failing light, begging you to help lift a snapped axle from his mired wagon. The heavy wheels are sunk deep in black sludge, and the strain of your own burden makes your knees ache with every breath.

nodes.brief: Under the shadow of the great brick granary, a shivering beggar named Paul thrusts a grease-stained map of the flooded vaults into your hand.

exits.label: Ignore the map and head toward the lower granary arch
Follow the slipway tracks toward the exhausted winch-man

nodes.title: Granary Map
nodes.page: Towering brick walls cast a deep shadow over the damp ground where a shivering beggar named Paul intercepts your path, thrusting a grease-stained map of the flooded vaults directly into your hand. His fingers tremble with cold as he mutters warnings about the rising waters below Lowgate. Against your pack-frame the bronze clapper sounds a warning note that matches the anxious rhythm of the streets.

nodes.brief: In a soot-blackened courtyard, an old woman named Martha stirs a copper vat of foul-smelling tallow while warning you of rising floodwater.

exits.label: Seek shelter inside the half-submerged boat-shed
Follow the slipway tracks past the sleeping winch-man
Cross the narrow timber catwalk above the spray

nodes.title: Tallow Vat Warning
nodes.page: Boiling tallow bubbles in a copper vat, filling the soot-blackened courtyard with a thick, greasy stench as an old woman named Martha stirs the brew with a wooden oar. She pauses to wipe her brow, warning you that the river lock is failing and the floodwaters will soon swallow the lower streets. The heavy bronze tongue on your back feels suddenly burdensome as you weigh her words.

nodes.brief: Across a splintered plank bridge, a surly toll-keeper named Greaves measures the width of your mule's hooves against a notched willow stick.

exits.label: Pay the toll and cross toward the boat-shed
Bypass the bridge and head for the slipway tracks

nodes.title: Plank Bridge Toll
nodes.page: Frost crisps the edges of a splintered plank bridge where a surly toll-keeper named Greaves plants his boots and measures the width of your mule's hooves against a notched willow stick. He demands a heavy coin fee for every iron nail and bronze gram passing into the lower ward, eyeing the sacred clapper with greedy suspicion. The cold mountain wind whistles through the gaps in the timber planks beneath your feet.

nodes.brief: By the rotting pilings of the fish market, a desperate tanner named Thatch offers you a dry leather doublet in exchange for your woollen scarf.

exits.label: Decline the trade and push toward the boat-shed
Walk past the slipway toward the resting winch-man
Cross the narrow timber catwalk above the churning water

nodes.title: Fish Market Trade
nodes.page: Rotting pilings release a foul, fishy reek into the damp air as a desperate tanner named Thatch shuffles out of the mist, offering you a dry leather doublet in exchange for your woollen scarf. His teeth chatter in the biting wind blowing off the river-port. You adjust the padded cradle holding the heavy bronze clapper while considering whether to trade your warmth against the encroaching chill.

nodes.brief: Recognising your overdue ledger mark, a grinning Cable Court collector named Skiff points out a secret drainage tunnel that bypasses the guards.

exits.label: Take the dark drainage tunnel toward the foundry alley
Refuse the shortcut and head for the peat stacks

priv.why: the reader owes the Cable Court a toll-debt and is recognised by its collectors

nodes.title: Secret Drainage Tunnel
nodes.page: Ledger marks from your unpaid debts to the Cable Court still linger in the collector's damp pocket, and a grinning toll-lord named Skiff spots them immediately. Recognizing your overdue tally, he leans in close and points out a hidden drainage tunnel that neatly bypasses the heavily guarded foundry gates. The dark opening reeks of stagnant river water, but it offers a clear, unguarded path into the heart of Lowgate.

nodes.brief: Inside a leaking canvas tent, a deaf charcoal burner named Gault mistakes your heavy footfalls for an approaching flood warning and screams.

exits.label: Quiet the burner and slip into the foundry alley
Move past the tent toward the towering peat briquettes

nodes.title: Canvas Tent Scream
nodes.page: Rain lashes the canvas roof of a leaking tent where a deaf charcoal burner named Gault mistakes your heavy footfalls for an approaching flood warning and lets out a shrill scream. Black coal dust coats every surface within the cramped shelter, and the sudden noise startles your mule into a restless shuffle. You must calm the panicked worker before his cries draw unwanted attention from the night watch.

nodes.brief: Beneath the rusted iron ribs of the barge-lock, a soaked watchman named Bael demands a copper coin for every foot of rope you carry.

exits.label: Pay the coin and head toward the gates
Dodge past the watchman toward the outer yard

nodes.title: The Barge Lock Watch
nodes.page: Beneath the rusted iron ribs of the barge-lock, a soaked watchman named Bael demands a copper coin for every foot of rope you carry. The damp air smells of stagnant river silt and tar, clinging to your woollen coat as Biscuit stamps restlessly against the slick stone. You hitch the bronze tongue in its padded cradle against your spine while you weigh Bael's steep toll against the narrow escape routes leading deeper into the foundry quarter.

nodes.brief: Beside a bubbling vent of sulphurous steam, a frantic tinker named Darr attempts to barter a cracked soldering iron for your mule's halter.

exits.label: Ignore the tinker and head for the black gates
Turn toward the soot-stained threshold of the outer yard
Seek a cooler route past the blistering portal

nodes.title: The Steam Vent Barter
nodes.page: Beside a bubbling vent of sulphurous steam, a frantic tinker named Darr attempts to barter a cracked soldering iron for your mule's halter. The heat wraps around your face like a wet blanket, smelling strongly of boiled iron and sulfur while Biscuit lowers his head and huffs a cloud of white vapor into the mist. You adjust the heavy cradle on your shoulders, glancing between the steaming vent and the various paths winding onward through the sprawling, soot-dusted industrial yard.

nodes.brief: The chipped bronze clapper suddenly emits a low, resonant thrum that startles a flock of roosting gulls and reveals a dry maintenance ladder.

exits.label: Step carefully past the iron gates
Hurry toward the soot-darkened yard ahead

priv.why: the Clapper is bare and chipped, and rings or complains in the fog

nodes.title: The Singing Clapper
nodes.page: The chipped bronze clapper suddenly sounds a low note that startles a flock of roosting gulls and reveals a dry maintenance ladder. Uncovered and battered from the long descent down the thirteen stair-towns, the heavy metal tongue complains in the damp fog, its raw edges vibrating with a ghostly chill that sets your teeth on edge. The sudden sound echoes off the slick masonry walls, drawing uneasy glances from the shadows as you stare down the available paths.

nodes.brief: In the shadow of the great water-wheel, a mud-caked miller named Crix curses the clogged paddles and begs you to help clear the debris.

exits.label: Walk past the wheel toward the black gates
Skirt the mill channel and enter the outer yard

nodes.title: The Water Wheel Debris
nodes.page: In the shadow of the great water-wheel, a mud-caked miller named Crix curses the clogged paddles and begs you to help clear the debris. Splintered pine branches and wet barley straw wrap tightly around the massive wooden spokes, groaning under the heavy pressure of the swollen canal. You steady the strapped bronze clapper on your back, feeling the cold weight shift slightly as you weigh whether to spare a moment for the struggling miller.

nodes.brief: Within a soot-stained charcoal bunker, a nervous apprentice named Ren hides from his master while clutching a stolen pouch of flux-dust.

exits.label: Approach the blistering heat of the sealed portal
Move deeper into the vibrating shadow of the furnace wall

nodes.title: The Charcoal Bunker Secret
nodes.page: Within a soot-stained charcoal bunker, a nervous apprentice named Ren hides from his master while clutching a stolen pouch of flux-dust. Fine black powder coats his trembling fingers and dusts his eyelashes, making him look like a phantom carved from fireplace ash in the dim gloom. You keep your footsteps light to avoid startling him further, listening to the distant roar of the massive blast furnaces while deciding where to direct your next steps.

nodes.brief: Beside a flooded winch-pit, an old salt-boiler named Hobb warms his arthritic hands over a brazier of damp coke and offers you shelter.

exits.label: Leave the brazier and approach the iron gates
Head toward the soot-caked threshold of the yard
Pass the glowing coals and seek the sealed portal

nodes.title: The Salt Boiler Hearth
nodes.page: Beside a flooded winch-pit, an old salt-boiler named Hobb warms his arthritic hands over a brazier of damp coke and offers you shelter. Steam rises in grey curls from his sodden canvas apron, mixing with the sharp tang of boiling brine that hangs thick in the damp air. Biscuit shakes his long ears, sending droplets flying as you pause by the meager warmth, weighing the comfort of the fire against the urgency of your descent.

nodes.brief: Under the sagging rafters of the rope-loft, a blind weaver named Mellie runs her fingers over your pack-straps to test the quality of your twine.

exits.label: Leave the loft and make for the iron gates
Proceed toward the soot-stained outer yard
Follow the brick buttress toward the warm masonry

nodes.title: The Rope Loft Weaver
nodes.page: Under the sagging rafters of the rope-loft, a blind weaver named Mellie runs her fingers over your pack-straps to test the quality of your twine. Her calloused thumbs trace the mountain knots with practiced ease, checking for fraying fibers caused by the biting mountain ice and granite edges above. The scent of hemp oil and dried tallow fills the dim alcove, offering a brief respite from the freezing drizzle outside before you must choose your next direction.

nodes.brief: Across a slippery stone landing, a harassed dock-marshal named Tarsus threatens to impound your mule unless you clear the gangway immediately.

exits.label: Follow the stoker past the brick buttress
Slip past the marshal toward the roaring flues

nodes.title: The Slippery Landing
nodes.page: Across a slippery stone landing, a harassed dock-marshal named Tarsus threatens to impound your mule unless you clear the gangway immediately. Grey river spray lashes the timber planks, soaking your trouser hems while Biscuit plants his stubborn hooves firmly against the wet stone. Tarsus rests a heavy hand on his brass tally-stick, glaring impatiently at your heavily laden frame as you search for a way around him.

nodes.brief: Inside a damp cooperage, a frightened journeyman named Kelt drops his adze as the floorboards shudder beneath a sudden surge of river water.

exits.label: Wade toward the vibrating furnace wall
Head across the threshold into the roaring foundry

nodes.title: The Cooperage Surge
nodes.page: Inside a damp cooperage, a frightened journeyman named Kelt drops his adze as the floorboards shudder beneath a sudden surge of river water. Unfinished oak staves float like giant wooden ribs across the flooded floor, clattering against one another with a hollow wooden rhythm. You cinch the canvas straps that bind the bronze clapper to your shoulders, bracing against the sudden tremor while you hunt an exit from the rising tide.

nodes.brief: Beside a hissing lime-pit, an anxious messenger named Stannard drops his leather satchel of dispatches into the caustic white sludge.

exits.label: Hurry past the lime toward the sealed portal
Take the path beside the warm brick buttress
Head toward the shadow of the vibrating furnace wall

nodes.title: The Lime Pit Mishap
nodes.page: Beside a hissing lime-pit, an anxious messenger named Stannard drops his leather satchel of dispatches into the caustic white sludge. Bubbles of boiling gas burst lazily from the thick paste, sending up choking plumes of vapor that sting your eyes and throat. You step back instinctively, steadying Biscuit by the halter while considering which path will take you furthest from the noxious fumes.

nodes.brief: Under the stone arch of the lower granary, a starving stray hound snarls at your boots while guarding a crust of mouldy rye bread.

exits.label: Step past the snapping jaws
Toss a ration scrap
Quiet the hungry hound gently
Turn back to the quay

nodes.title: The Granary Hound
nodes.page: Coarse rye crumbs scatter across damp flags as a starving stray hound lowers its wedge-shaped head, baring yellow teeth and snarling directly at your travel-worn boots. The creature stands over a crust of moldy bread beneath the deep, soot-greased stone arch of the lower granary, its ribs heaving beneath matted fur while the bronze clapper hums a low, sympathetic vibration against your spine. Biscuit stamps a stubborn hoof in the rising mud, ears pinned back against the chill river wind.

nodes.brief: Within a half-submerged boat-shed, a desperate smuggler named Vetch begs you to hide a heavy sack of contraband tin beneath your mule blanket.

exits.label: Hide the contraband tin
Refuse the risky cargo

nodes.title: The Submerged Shed
nodes.page: Dark river water laps against the rotting wooden joists of the half-submerged boat-shed, smelling sharply of stagnant silt and old grease. A desperate smuggler named Vetch crouches upon a barrel, his fingers trembling as he begs you to tuck a heavy, canvas-wrapped sack of contraband tin deep beneath your mule blanket. Outside, the slate-grey current rises another notch against the pilings, threatening to swallow the remaining dry floorboards before you can make up your mind. Biscuit huffs a wet breath into the gloom, uneasy at the smell of untaxed metal and wet canvas.

nodes.brief: By the rusted tracks of the slipway, an exhausted winch-man named Gorm sleeps upright with his greasy cap pulled down over his eyes.

exits.label: Slip past without waking him
Wake the tired winch-man
Turn back to the quay

nodes.title: The Asleep Winchman
nodes.page: Along the slipway iron chains groan on rusted pulleys while the river current climbs higher against the stone wharves. An exhausted winch-man named Gorm sits slumped upright on a timber baulk, his greasy wool cap pulled down hard over his eyes while his chest rises and falls in deep, ragged breaths. A heavy wrench dangles loosely from his calloused hand, inches from the locking gear that holds the upper cable drum still. Biscuit shifts restlessly behind you while the clapper ticks a low note into the chill mountain air.

nodes.brief: Across a narrow timber catwalk, a nervous clerk named Penn checks off cargo tallies while dodging spray from a broken drainage pipe.

exits.label: Hurry across the shaking timber
Wait for the clerk to move
Step carefully around the tallies

nodes.title: The Catwalk Tally
nodes.page: Icy spray from a fractured lead drainage pipe pelts your neck as you step across the narrow timber catwalk suspended above the churning tail-race. A nervous clerk named Penn stands ankle-deep in puddles, frantically checking off cargo tallies on a sodden parchment while ink runs in purple streaks down his knuckles. Below the damp planks, the river tears at the foundation stones with a hungry roar, sending tremors up through the wooden framing. Biscuit plants all four hooves firmly on the balks, refusing to take another stride until you decide the route.

nodes.brief: In a soot-choked alley behind the foundry, a scarred veteran named Drake sharpens a broad meat-cleaver on a damp sandstone block.

exits.label: Walk past the scarred veteran

nodes.title: The Cleaver in the Alley
nodes.page: Sparks from a hidden forge flicker against the slick brickwork of a soot-choked alley behind the foundry. A scarred veteran named Drake sits on an overturned coal tub and draws a broad meat-cleaver back and forth across a damp sandstone block in a rasping rhythm. The metallic scrape echoes loudly above the distant rumble of the mountain water, and his cold eyes do not leave your boots as you approach. Biscuit flattens his ears against the dark stone walls, sensing the tension in the narrow passage.

nodes.brief: Beside a towering stack of peat briquettes, a shivering child named Fay holds out a chipped porcelain cup for a drop of water.

exits.label: Share your water with Fay
Push onward past the stack

nodes.title: The Child by the Peat
nodes.page: Black peat briquettes tower mountain-high beside the damp foundry wall, shedding fine coal-dust that settles in your eyelashes and greases the mule's flanks. A shivering child named Fay crouches near the stack, holding out a chipped porcelain cup and whispering a dry plea for a single drop of clean water from your skin. The air tastes of sulfur and unburned coal, and the chill breath of the lower gorges rides it. Biscuit drops his head toward the ground and blows a warm ring of condensation into the soot.

nodes.brief: Approaching the black iron gates, you find a nervous guard named Skel firing warning sparks from a flint-lock to keep the crowd back.

exits.label: Call out to the nervous guard

nodes.title: The Iron Gates
nodes.page: Thick, acrid smoke rolls across the cobblestones as towering black iron gates loom out of the gloom. A nervous guard named Skel stands just beyond the spiked bars, rapidly firing warning sparks from a heavy flint-lock pistol to drive back a murmuring crowd of desperate townsfolk. Every flash illuminates the scars on his knuckles and the frantic roll of his eyes. Behind him, the great foundry strains like a wounded animal under the mountain's press.

nodes.brief: Within the soot-stained threshold of the outer yard, an anxious foreman named Brind inspects the soot-caked hinges for signs of buckling.

exits.label: Help the foreman inspect the hinges
Push past into the courtyard

nodes.title: The Soot-Caked Hinges
nodes.page: Heavy soot cakes the massive iron hinges of the outer yard, muffling the rhythmic pound of hammers from within the dark complex. An anxious foreman named Brind runs a blackened finger along a stress-fracture in the metal, muttering curses as another tremor shakes the masonry. Burning coke and heated scale stink in the air, and the copper clapper on your back rings with a sharp warning tone. Biscuit stamps nervously against the gritty flagstones.

nodes.brief: Before the blistering heat of the sealed portal, a sweating apprentice named Jora splashes bucket-water onto the glowing iron bolts.

exits.label: Help douse the glowing bolts

nodes.title: The Blistering Portal
nodes.page: Waves of blistering heat wash over your face from the sealed iron portal, carrying the metallic tang of molten slag and scorched coal. A sweating apprentice named Jora frantically splashes bucket-water onto the glowing bolts, his skin reddened and blistered by the relentless backdraft. Steam hisses violently into the dim chamber, clouding your vision and turning the air to hot soup. The great bronze clapper grows uncomfortably warm within its padded cradle against your shoulder blades.

nodes.brief: Beside the massive brick buttress, a weary stoker named Kelp leans against the warm masonry and points toward the stubborn latch.

exits.label: Force the stubborn latch open
Ask the stoker for help

nodes.title: The Warm Buttress
nodes.page: Massive blocks of dark granite radiate a deep, comforting warmth against your shoulder as you lean for a brief second against the brick buttress. A weary stoker named Kelp sits in the shelter of the masonry, wiping soot from his forehead with a rag and pointing a scarred finger toward the stubborn iron latch of the inner door. The low, continuous roar of the great furnace vibrates through the soles of your boots, drowning out the river below. Biscuit lowers his long ears and lets out a long, shuddering sigh.

nodes.brief: In the vibrating shadow of the furnace wall, a frantic smith named Hargin beats a heavy iron spud against the jammed door-frame.

exits.label: Lend your strength to the iron bar
Search the smoky perimeter for another entry

nodes.title: The Jammed Doorframe
nodes.page: Sparks scatter like startled fireflies across the flagstones as a frantic smith named Hargin beats a heavy iron spud against the jammed door-frame. Each blow sends a dry, jarring shriek through the soot-stained masonry while the air grows thick with the smell of scorched coal and hot scale. The bronze clapper presses hard against your shoulder blades as you watch the warped iron refuse to yield an inch to his fury.

nodes.brief: Under the roaring draft of the flues, a soot-blackened artisan named Fenn tries to wedge a steel crowbar into the glowing gap.

exits.label: Help him heave against the wedge
Step back into the cooler shadows

nodes.title: The Glowing Gap
nodes.page: Deafening roars roll down from the overhead flues as a soot-blackened artisan named Fenn tries to wedge a steel crowbar into the glowing gap of the portal. The metal groans under the immense pressure, turning a dull cherry-red while tiny beads of sweat carve pale tracks through the grime on his forehead. Every breath tastes of sulfur and old coke, making your lungs ache as you stand frozen in the blinding heat of the chamber.

nodes.brief: Across the threshold of the roaring foundry, a desperate master-founder named Corvo shouts over the din for someone to break the seal.

exits.label: Step forward with the heavy bronze

nodes.title: The Foundry Threshold
nodes.page: Voices strain to be heard over the continuous, hungry roar of the draft as a desperate master-founder named Corvo shouts over the din for someone to break the seal. The wooden beams overhead tremble in time with the deep, rhythmic knock from the mountain's core below. He waves a grease-stained arm toward the massive iron barrier, his face blackened by soot and lined with exhaustion.

nodes.brief: Facing the towering barrier of blackened steel, you steady your aching shoulders as the great furnace demands entry for the broken bronze.

exits.label: Throw your weight against the latch
Shout out to Corvo for assistance
Turn back toward the fish market

nodes.title: The Towering Barrier
nodes.page: Iron plates radiate a punishing wave of dry heat against your chest as you steady your aching shoulders before the towering barrier of blackened steel. The great furnace demands immediate entry for the broken bronze of Orison, its hungry belly roaring for the metal that once sang above the clouds. Every muscle in your legs trembles under the combined burden of the cold mountain air and the furnace's fierce breath.

nodes.brief: The massive iron furnace door glows cherry-red in the gloom, radiating a dry, roaring heat that makes the hair on your arms prickle.

exits.label: Press on into the blazing heat

nodes.title: The Cherry-Red Iron
nodes.page: Deep in the gloom, the massive iron furnace door glows a fierce cherry-red, radiating a dry, roaring heat that makes the hair on your arms prickle and curl. The ground beneath your boots vibrates with the relentless thrum of the mountain's furnace, reminding you that time has nearly run out before the high passes freeze shut. Dust motes dance wildly in the convection currents, caught in the blinding glare of the opening.

nodes.brief: Inside the vaulted chamber of the lower forge, the air tastes of sulfur and old coke while the great bellows wheeze like a dying leviathan.

exits.label: Press on toward the glowing core

nodes.title: The Vaulted Lower Forge
nodes.page: Sulfur and old coke hang thick in the vaulted chamber of the lower forge, where the great bellows wheeze like a dying leviathan in the dark. Shadows stretch and twist against the soot-caked stone walls as the massive hearth draws in air for the final melt. The mountain above presses harder here, bearing down through the rock with the collective gravity of thirteen abandoned towns.

nodes.brief: Before the impenetrable barrier of the master hearth, every idle apprentice and scarred forge-master waits to see if the mountain's heart can be recast.

exits.label: Press on to face the founders

nodes.title: The Master Hearth
nodes.page: Every idle apprentice and scarred forge-master waits in tense silence before the impenetrable barrier of the master hearth to see if the mountain's heart can be recast. Whispers pass like dry leaves among the crowd regarding the missing tin and the stubbornness of the ancient locks. The air is so hot and still that every breath feels like swallowing embers from a dying campfire.

nodes.brief: With the heavy bronze clapper resting against the hot cobblestones, you raise your fist to strike the stubborn iron of the furnace door.

exits.label: Press on to strike the door

nodes.title: The Heavy Clapper
nodes.page: Warmth still lives in the cobblestones under your boots as you set the bronze clapper on the ground and raise your fist to strike the stubborn iron of the furnace door. The metal tickles faintly against your knuckles, answering the heat and the nearness of the forge where it was first shaped long ago. All around you, the low murmur of the foundry falls silent as the final moment arrives.

nodes.brief: By the basalt threshold of the lower furnace, you strike the iron bolt with a cobblestone while the bronze clapper hums against your aching spine.

exits.label: Strike the bolt once more for attention
Shift the heavy bronze burden and wait quietly
Step past the threshold into the smoky gloom

nodes.title: The Threshold Strike
nodes.page: Cold basalt chills your knuckles as you raise the rough cobblestone against the iron-banded threshold of the lower furnace, striking a sharp, ringing blow that vibrates straight up into your aching spine. Beneath your padded leather straps, the bronze clapper answers, matching the subterranean pulse of Lowgate. Soot settles in your hair like fine grey snow while orange sparks scatter across your worn boots from an unseen flue above.

nodes.brief: You thrust a rusted crowbar into the frozen iron latch of the roaring portal, risking a snapped knuckle to save the abbey's voice.

exits.label: Throw your full weight against the rusted crowbar

exits.privWhy: the reader carries a Ropewrights' Guild rope and is waved through guild places
exits.label: Slide the guild-knotted rope free to show your badge
Drop the lever and search for a cooler side-entrance

nodes.title: The Iron Latch
nodes.page:
Frost crusts the rusted iron latch of the roaring portal; your knuckles risk a snap as you jam a jagged crowbar into the frozen gap. The metal groans under you and shrieks against decades of soot and expansion. A violent gust of superheated air bursts from the seam and singes your eyebrows. Inside that vast dark chamber the abbey's voice waits for restoration, and forcing the door will take every ounce of strength you have left.

The barrier gives a fraction of an inch with a dull crack.

nodes.brief: Within the soot-choked antechamber, master smith Garth clears his throat through the grey haze, demanding proof that your burden is truly Orison's tongue.

exits.label: Unbuckle the heavy cradle to show the bronze
Demand he respect the sacred commission of Orisonhold
Point to the ancient mountain runes carved on the metal

nodes.title: The Master's Smoke
nodes.page:
Thick grey haze fills the soot-choked antechamber, burns your raw eyes, and tastes of sulfur and wet coal. Through the swirling fog, master smith Garth clears his throat with a harsh, rattling cough, crossing his soot-blackened arms over a leather apron stiff with grease. He demands immediate, undeniable proof that the heavy mass strapped to your back is genuinely Orison's tongue rather than common scrap metal meant for the melting pot.

The low rumble of the furnace provides a tense backdrop to his scrutiny.

nodes.brief: Water drips from the vaulted ceiling onto your smoking leather jerkin as you navigate the narrow trench between two cooling slag vats.

exits.label: Follow the narrow brick ledge past the glowing vat
Leap across the steaming runoff channel toward the dark alcove
Pause to adjust the harness before your shoulders give way

nodes.title: The Slag Trenches
nodes.page: Steamy condensation drips in fat droplets from the vaulted brick ceiling onto your smoking leather jerkin as you pick through the trench between two cooling slag vats. Red light pulses rhythmically from the pits, casting long, distorted shadows of your burden across the glistening flagstones. Every breath burns your lungs with the dry, metallic tang of boiling rock and quenched iron.

nodes.brief: A discarded leather apron lies across a coal-scuttle, smelling of old tallow and burnt hair while sparks dance over your boots.

exits.label: Step past the smoking scuttle toward the central crucible
Kick the tangled copper wire aside and search for the foreman

exits.privWhy: the reader believes the foundry has gone cold and looks for another way to recast the bell
exits.label: Duck down the low auxiliary passage toward the side-shed

nodes.title: The Tallow Apron
nodes.page:
A discarded leather apron lies draped across an iron coal-scuttle, reeking heavily of old tallow and burnt hair while erratic sparks dance across the toes of your boots. The surrounding gloom presses in close, broken only by the distant, rhythmic groaning of giant mechanical bellows somewhere deep in the foundry bowels. Your shoulders throb with a dull, steady ache from the long descent down the mountain stairs.

A choice opens up between the main hearth and the labyrinthine service tunnels.

nodes.brief: You steady the heavy wooden cradle on your shoulder as a stray gust of coal-gas catches in your raw throat, threatening to choke you.

exits.label: Follow the rattling chain of the overhead crane
Lean your forehead against the cool buttress stone
Dodge past the stack of refractory bricks into the shadows

nodes.title: The Choking Gust
nodes.page:
A sudden gust of sulfurous coal-gas billows from a low-slung exhaust duct, catching in your raw throat and threatening to choke off your breath entirely. You stagger against the rough stone wall, steadying the heavy wooden cradle on your shoulder with both trembling hands until the noxious cloud clears. The bronze tongue lies cool against your spine, an anchor in the suffocating heat of the Foundry quarter.

You must clear your lungs and decide your next direction in the dim haze.

nodes.brief: Because your hempen bindings are knotted in the precise loop of the Ropewrights' Guild, the guards step aside with a silent nod to let you pass.

exits.label: Slip past the guards toward the roaring hearth
Pause beside the dark river trough to catch your breath
Seek out the master's office as the burly hand advised

priv.why: the reader carries a Ropewrights' Guild rope and is waved through guild places

nodes.title: The Knotted Passport
nodes.page:
Because your hempen bindings are knotted in the precise, intricate loop of the Ropewrights' Guild, the heavily armed foundry guards step aside with a silent, respectful nod to let you pass unhindered. They recognize the authority written in the cordage around your waist, granting you safe passage where others face hostile interrogation and turned backs. The damp air of the inner courtyards feels momentarily lighter against your soot-stained cheeks.

Ahead of you, the vast inner workings of the complex open up in a maze of steam and iron.

nodes.brief: The rhythmic thud of a distant water-hammer shakes the damp flagstones beneath your feet, vibrating straight up into the bronze you carry.

exits.label: Head toward the dark river trough in the corner
Locate the master's office past the roaring furnace
Investigate the rattling metal bins by the anthracite stacks
Wipe your streaming eyes and push deeper into the maze

nodes.title: The Hammer Stroke
nodes.page:
A ground-shaking thud travels through the damp flagstones beneath your boots and up from the foundations into the bronze you carry. Each impact of the distant water-hammer sends a sympathetic chime through the metal against your back, reminding you of the high mountain belfry far above the clouds. The air is thick with flying grit and the smell of hot oil.

Fog-shrouded aisles of Lowgate meet under your boots.

nodes.brief: Beneath a rusted exhaust hood, apprentice Jory shovels grey coke into the hopper while glancing nervously at your heavy burden.

exits.label: Ask the boy where the master smith is hiding
Offer to take the shovel while he rests his arms

nodes.title: The Coal Hopper
nodes.page:
Beneath a rusted exhaust hood that drips black grease, apprentice Jory shovels grey coke into the gaping hopper with frantic, exhausted sweeps. He glances nervously over his shoulder at the cradle on your back, his young face streaked with sweat and coal-dust that highlights the dark circles under his eyes. The heat radiating from the open hatch is fierce enough to blister exposed skin within seconds.

You must address the apprentice before he drops his shovel from exhaustion.

nodes.brief: You slip on a slick patch of condensed grease near the quenching trough, barely keeping the clapper from slamming against the stone wall.

exits.label: Steady your grip and continue toward the coke stacks
Press flat against the damp wall until the steam clears

nodes.title: The Greasy Quench
nodes.page:
Your boot heel catches on a slick patch of condensed tallow near the great quenching trough, sending a sudden jolt of panic through your chest as you stumble sideways. Only a desperate twist of your torso keeps the heavy clapper from slamming ruinously against the unforgiving stone wall. Water sloshes over the rim of the trough, hissing loudly as it hits the hot brick floor and wrapping you in a blinding cloud of steam.

You recover your balance with a sharp intake of breath.

nodes.brief: A blind weaver named Marda sits by the coal-bins, her fingers tracing the weave of your coat to see if you bring trade or trouble.

exits.label: Skirt the glowing molten slag stream
Squeeze past the cooling ovens
Listen to the coin-collectors arguing nearby

nodes.title: The Blind Weaver
nodes.page: Marda the blind weaver sits beside the towering heaps of grey coal-bins and runs calloused fingers across the coarse wool of your coat to sort honest trade from bitter trouble. Her sightless eyes turn toward the bronze clapper strapped against your spine, sensing Orisonhold resting upon your shoulders. The surrounding air carries the sharp, metallic tang of unrefined ore and damp stone, reminding you that time grows short in the cavernous halls of Lowgate.

nodes.brief: Steam vents hiss sharply from a cracked brass pipe overhead, bathing the dark alcove in a blinding veil of white vapour.

exits.label: Step toward the flickering wall-bracket lamp
Inspect the smudged debt ledger on the keg

nodes.title: The Hissing Vents
nodes.page:
High-pressure steam vents hiss sharply from a fractured brass pipe overhead, bathing the dark stone alcove in a blinding veil of scalding white vapour. You shield your face with a soot-stained sleeve as the damp heat clings instantly to your woollen garments, making it hard to draw a clean breath. Through the rushing roar of escaping steam, the distant rhythmic pounding of the great forge hammers vibrates straight through the flagged floorboards.

The blinding cloud begins to thin slightly, revealing narrow paths leading deeper into the foundry's dim labyrinth.

nodes.brief: You heft the clapper higher as the leather straps bite deeper into your bruised collarbones, ignoring the numbness creeping into your fingers.

exits.label: Squeeze through the narrow gap between ovens
Creep closer to the supervisor's noisy office

nodes.title: The Burdened Spine
nodes.page:
You hitch the bronze clapper higher on your back as the hardened leather straps bite deeper into your bruised collarbones, ignoring the numbness creeping into your cold fingertips. The relentless weight of Orison's tongue seems to pull you down toward the stone floor with every step, a constant reminder of the mountain journey left behind. Sparks drift lazily through the dim air like dying fireflies, caught in the draft of the massive bellows laboring in the distance.

The corridor ahead branches out into the smoke-choked shadows, demanding a choice of direction.

nodes.brief: In the shadow of a giant graphite crucible, an old woman stirs a pot of lentil mash with a broken oar and ignores your approach.

exits.label: Walk past toward the coin-collectors' office
Head for the ventilation hatch in the draft

nodes.title: The Graphite Crucible
nodes.page:
Deep in the massive shadow of a towering graphite crucible, an old woman stirs a thick pot of lentil mash with a splintered oar, completely ignoring your exhausted approach. The rich, earthy smell of boiled grain cuts sharply through the sulfurous coal-smoke hanging thick beneath the iron rafters. A faint ember glows from beneath her makeshift hearth, casting long, wavering shadows across her lined face and your dust-covered boots.

You wait a moment for her to look up, but she only stirs the porridge in slow circles and does not glance your way.

nodes.brief: A bundle of discarded copper wire trips your stride in the gloom, sending a metallic clatter echoing across the cavernous foundry floor.

exits.label: Move toward the drafty ventilation hatch
Pace past the rows of silenced hand-hammers
Watch the spinning iron wheel on its cord

nodes.title: The Tangled Wire
nodes.page: A heavy bundle of discarded copper wire catches your trailing stride in the gloom, sending a sudden metallic clatter echoing sharply across the cavernous foundry floor. You freeze instantly, holding your breath as the harsh clatter fades into the slow knock of the mountain machinery. The dark workspace around you appears entirely deserted save for the slow drift of black soot settling over rusted iron frameworks.

nodes.brief: Convinced the main hearth has died, you duck down a low side-tunnel toward the auxiliary bellows-shed to find another way in.

exits.label: Follow the path toward the hanging iron wheel
Cross the wet wooden drainage grating

exits.privWhy: the reader carries the frostbite scar that marks them as one who crossed the glacier
exits.label: Show your frost-bitten fingers to the gatekeeper

priv.why: the reader believes the foundry has gone cold and looks for another way to recast the bell

nodes.title: The Auxiliary Bellows
nodes.page:
Convinced that the main hearth has finally died in this forsaken quarter, you duck down a low side-tunnel toward the auxiliary bellows-shed to find another way inside. The stone walls here are slick with cold condensation, smelling strongly of stale grease and stagnant river water rather than coal smoke. Your tired legs burn with every upward step along the sloping floor, but the desperate need to recast the bell keeps you moving.

Three distinct routes diverge before you in the damp gloom of the subsidiary passage.

nodes.brief: Sparks cascade from an overhead crane chain as it hauls an empty ingot mould across the rafters, smelling fiercely of hot oil.

exits.label: Walk past the rows of silenced hand-hammers
Head toward the spinning wheel on its cord
Step cautiously across the wet drainage grating

nodes.title: The Overhead Crane
nodes.page:
White-hot sparks fall from an overhead crane chain as it hauls an empty ingot mould across the rusted rafters. Hot oil smells sharp enough to taste in the damp. You duck low beneath the swinging mould and watch grease drip from the overhead pulleys onto the flagstones inches from your pack. Iron slides on iron with a screech that sets your teeth on edge against the blackened stone walls of the foundry.

The chain clanks away into soot-blackened tunnels that fork ahead.

nodes.brief: You lean your forehead against the cool stone pillar of a buttress, letting the freezing damp soothe the throbbing ache in your skull.

exits.privWhy: the reader carries the frostbite scar that marks them as one who crossed the glacier
exits.label: Present your glacier-scarred fingers to the guard
Duck under the swinging chain-hoist's path

nodes.title: The Buttress Pillar
nodes.page:
You lean your tired forehead against the cool stone pillar of a massive structural buttress, letting the freezing damp soothe the throbbing ache behind your eyes. The heavy wooden cradle holding the bronze clapper rests against the masonry with a soft, dull thud as you catch your breath. Low voices murmur from somewhere beyond the thick stone pier, speaking in the rough, practical dialect of Lowgate forge-masters.

The chill from the stone begins to seep through your hair, urging you back onto your feet.

nodes.brief: A stray mongrel darts out from behind a stack of refractory bricks, snapping at your trailing pack-strap before vanishing into the shadows.

exits.label: Follow the trail of the discarded muffler
Approach the tired workers sharing bread

nodes.title: The Stray Mongrel
nodes.page: A thin, mangy mongrel darts out suddenly from behind a towering stack of refractory bricks, snapping viciously at your trailing pack-strap before vanishing back into the shadows. You stumble half a step sideways and catch yourself on a grease-smeared wooden post; the clapper answers with a dull warning against your spine. The sharp odor of wet dog and coal dust lingers in the frigid air around you.

nodes.brief: You pause beside a trough of dark river water, watching your soot-streaked reflection ripple away as bubbles rise from the silt below.

exits.label: Avoid the swinging hook of the chain-hoist
Listen to the deep subsonic hum of Orison

nodes.title: The Silt Trough
nodes.page:
You pause beside a long wooden trough of dark river water, watching your soot-streaked reflection ripple and distort as tiny bubbles lift from the silt below. The water smells of mountain mud and old iron, perfectly still except for the vibrations sent down by the distant foundry works. Your shoulders ache with a deep, bone-weary fatigue that no amount of cold air can properly numb.

The quiet moment slips away as the muffled sounds of working machinery return to the forefront.

nodes.brief: A burly forge-hand named Brann points a greasy thumb toward the master's office, warning you that tin prices have doubled since dawn.

exits.label: Approach the master's office door
Turn back toward the cooler yard

nodes.title: The Cost of Tin
nodes.page:
Heavy iron doors groan open against the draft as a burly forge-hand named Brann points a greasy thumb toward the master's office, warning you that tin prices have doubled since dawn. The weight of the clapper shifts on your aching shoulders as you calculate the meager coins left in your pouch, wondering if Orisonhold's bronze will be enough to buy the smiths' full cooperation or if you must barter with empty promises.

Smoke billows from a nearby quenching trough, stinging your eyes and coating the back of your throat in salt and sulfur. The choice narrows between pressing forward into the heat of negotiation or retreating before the debts crush you.

nodes.brief: The floor trembles as a fresh load of anthracite crashes into the metal bins outside, rattling the iron cups on a nearby shelf.

exits.label: Follow the service tunnel inward
Take the broader corridor past the slag

nodes.title: The Rafters Shake
nodes.page:
The floor trembles as a fresh load of anthracite crashes into the metal bins outside, rattling the iron cups on a nearby shelf and showering fine coal-dust across your boots. Lowgate's eternal heartbeat, the rhythmic crush of ore and the roar of draft-furnaces, echoes off the damp brickwork and drowns out all thought save the pull of the bronze tongue on your back.

A narrow service tunnel yawns to your left, while a broader, soot-slicked corridor leads deeper into the roaring heart of the lower works. You adjust the canvas straps over your bruised shoulders and prepare to move.

nodes.brief: You wipe a sleeve across your streaming eyes to clear the stinging coal-dust, pressing deeper into the labyrinth of brick pillars and flues.

exits.label: Seek the quieter outer perimeter
Plunge into the central foundry bustle

nodes.title: Through the Choking Flues
nodes.page:
You wipe a sleeve across your streaming eyes to clear the stinging coal-dust, pressing deeper into the labyrinth of brick pillars and flues where the air tastes of old ash and hot iron. Every breath burns your lungs, yet the steady, low resonance of the clapper vibrates against your spine like a reassuring hand in the dark.

Shadows stretch long and distorted across the masonry as distant workers shout over the din of the bellows.

nodes.brief: Beside a towering stack of coke sacks, a shivering boy named Pip holds out a tin cup of tepid tea for a copper coin.

exits.label: Trade a coin for the tea and move on

nodes.title: The Tea Seller
nodes.page:
Beside a towering stack of coke sacks a shivering boy named Pip offers a tin cup of tepid tea for a copper coin, staring at the canvas-wrapped bulk on your back. The sweet metallic stench of the river-port fills the damp air and mixes with the bitter steam rising from his dented kettle.

You fumble through your pockets for a stray coin while the great engines of the forge thump in slow, rhythmic succession against the stone floor. Time slips away in the chill, demanding your next step.

nodes.brief: The air grows thick with the sulfurous stink of melting slag as you skirt the lip of a sluggish, glowing runoff trench.

exits.label: Take the left path toward the primary crucible
Follow the trench to the grand pouring pit
Veer right toward the bubbling bronze cauldron

nodes.title: The Slag Runoff
nodes.page:
The air grows thick with the sulfurous stink of melting slag as you skirt the lip of a sluggish, glowing runoff trench, casting a harsh orange light across the soot-caked walls. Sparks dance like fireflies above the molten channel, hissing softly whenever stray droplets of condensation fall from the low brick ceiling above.

Heat bakes through your woollen tunic, and the bronze clapper on your back feels twice as hard to bear. Three distinct paths branch away from the trench, each swallowed by darkness and noise.

nodes.brief: An unlit tallow lamp flickers in a wall-bracket, casting long, writhing shadows of your heavy load against the soot-blackened masonry.

exits.label: Head toward the grand pouring pit
Approach the bubbling bronze cauldron

nodes.title: The Wall Bracket
nodes.page:
An unlit tallow lamp flickers in a wall-bracket. Shadows of your load stretch long across the soot-blackened masonry while distant machinery groans. Mountain damp sticks to your skin even beside the furnace heat; beyond the valley gates the ice-wind season still waits.

Ahead, the corridor splits around a massive buttress supporting the upper smelting floors. Voices carry from somewhere near the casting pits.

nodes.brief: You squeeze through a narrow gap between two cooling ovens, your backpack scraping harshly against the abrasive fire-brick walls.

exits.label: Walk toward the grand pouring pit
Step closer to the bubbling bronze cauldron

nodes.title: Squeezing the Gap
nodes.page:
You squeeze through a narrow gap between two cooling ovens, your backpack scraping harshly against the abrasive fire-brick walls and sending a cascade of dry mortar dust down your neck. The intense radiating heat bakes the sweat into your shirt, making every breath feel thick and metallic.

Emerging into a wider chamber, you catch the distant scent of ozone and scorching oil. Two distinct routes lie ahead through the maze of machinery.

nodes.brief: A soot-covered ledger lies open on a nail-keg, its ink smudged by damp air and listing debts that Lowgate can never hope to pay.

exits.label: Approach the bubbling bronze cauldron
Rest your pack by the great chimney

nodes.title: The Smudged Ledger
nodes.page:
A soot-covered ledger lies open on a nail-keg, its ink smudged by damp air and listing debts that Lowgate can never hope to pay to the ruthless Cable Court. The figures are columns of human misery and broken contracts, written in a cramped, hurried hand that suggests the clerk fled before finishing the page.

You step past the keg as the floor trembles from the heavy drop of an ore bucket nearby. The corridor continues past a row of silent, cold hearths toward the roaring core.

nodes.brief: You hear the muffled clink of coins from a supervisor's office nearby, where Cable Court collectors argue bitterly with the foundry elders.

exits.label: Walk toward the primary crucible
Slip past toward the grand pouring pit
Head for the bubbling bronze cauldron
Turn back toward the quieter corridor

nodes.title: The Supervisors' Dispute
nodes.page:
You hear the muffled clink of coins from a supervisor's office nearby, where Cable Court collectors argue bitterly with the foundry elders over overdue loans and melting rights. The sharp, angry timbre of their voices cuts through the constant background roar of the bellows, highlighting the desperate politics governing every ounce of tin in this place.

A low archway opens beside the office door, offering several ways forward through the tangled architecture of the foundry.

nodes.brief: A gust of freezing river air sweeps through a broken ventilation hatch, raising goosebumps on your arms beneath your sweat-soaked woollens.

exits.label: Approach the bubbling bronze cauldron
Stand by the safety flare and hopper

nodes.title: The Broken Hatch
nodes.page:
A gust of freezing river air sweeps through a broken ventilation hatch, raising goosebumps on your arms beneath your sweat-soaked woollens and bringing the sharp scent of melting snow. The sudden draft makes the overhead gas-flares flutter wildly, casting frantic shadows across the pitted iron floor plates.

You pull your cloak tighter against the biting chill, eyeing the two remaining paths deeper into the foundry complex. The noise of hammers grows deafening ahead.

nodes.brief: You steady your breathing against the lung-burning smog, counting your paces past the deadweight of silenced hammers and idle casting tables.

exits.label: Approach the roaring primary crucible
Step toward the grand pouring pit
Balance the clapper near the hopper
Turn back toward the antechamber

nodes.title: The Silent Forges
nodes.page:
Thick soot coats the rafters, and the empty casting floor holds still where no fires burn this evening. You steady your breathing against the lung-burning smog, counting your paces past the deadweight of silenced hammers and idle casting tables. Each footstep comes back thin off the damp stone walls. The bronze tongue has ridden a long way with you from the frozen heights of Orisonhold.

Ahead, multiple paths branch through the gloom of the foundry quarter, each offering a different way forward through the maze of machinery and shadowed archways.

nodes.brief: A rusted iron wheel hangs from a rafter by a frayed hemp cord, spinning slowly in the draft like a hanged man's token.

exits.label: Seek shelter near the great chimney
Unroll the Orisonhold deed on a barrel
Take the reckless way into the slag-pit

nodes.title: The Rusted Wheel
nodes.page:
Damp air cuts through your woollen cloak as a rusted iron wheel hangs from a rafter by a frayed hemp cord, spinning slowly in the draft like a hanged man's token. Below it, the stone floor is slick with condensation and black grease dripping from overhead winches. The clapper on your back sounds a low warning note against your spine in time with the distant rumble of the river outside the foundation walls.

You can either seek shelter closer to the massive chimney structure or spread out your documents to inspect the path ahead, though both choices demand steady nerves in this freezing gloom.

nodes.brief: You cross a wet wooden grating that spans a deep subterranean drainage channel, hearing the sullen rush of river water far below.

exits.label: Approach the glowing safety hopper
Walk toward the shadow of the chimney

nodes.title: The Subterranean Channel
nodes.page:
Water drips rhythmically from the ceiling vaults, echoing through the cavernous gloom of the lower works. You cross a wet wooden grating that spans a deep subterranean drainage channel, hearing the sullen rush of river water far below. The timber planks groan under your boots, slippery with spray and fine coal dust carried up from the active furnace chambers deeper in the mountain's roots.

Beyond the grating, the passage splits into two distinct routes lit by the faint, flickering glow of distant safety flares.

nodes.brief: Because your fingers bear the deep, pale ridge of glacier-frost, the gatekeeper recognises your ordeal and waves you through without question.

exits.label: Step toward the safety hopper
Lay the parchment upon a barrel-head

priv.why: the reader carries the frostbite scar that marks them as one who crossed the glacier

nodes.title: The Gatekeeper's Nod
nodes.page:
Heavy iron gates stand slightly ajar, guarded by a veteran warder whose face is mapped with old burns from flying slag. Because your fingers bear the deep, pale ridge of glacier-frost, the gatekeeper recognises your ordeal and waves you through without question. He offers a brief, respectful nod to the padded cradle on your back, acknowledging the freezing heights from which you have descended with Orison's tongue.

Inside the threshold, the foundry floor stretches out in a haze of smoke and dim lantern light, offering two clear paths toward the heart of the works.

nodes.brief: A discarded woollen muffler catches your boot-toe, dragging behind you like a ghostly tail across the gritty stone floor.

exits.label: Head toward the great chimney's shadow
Unroll the parchment across a barrel-head

nodes.title: The Frayed Muffler
nodes.page:
Cobbles slick with coal dust and greasy river spray make every step a careful calculation in the dim light. A discarded woollen muffler catches your boot-toe, dragging behind you like a ghostly tail across the gritty stone floor. You pause to kick it free, listening to the muffled clatter of distant machinery somewhere deep within the bowels of the mountain.

Two routes open before you out of the shadows, leading deeper into the labyrinth of furnaces and cooling floors.

nodes.brief: You duck beneath a swinging chain-hoist just as a rusty hook grazes the top of your wooden cradle with a hollow metallic clang.

exits.label: Walk to the shadow of the chimney
Stand at the flooded casting floor
Approach the circle of forge-masters

nodes.title: The Swinging Hoist
nodes.page:
Overhead chains rattle in the freezing draft as heavy iron tackle sways above the narrow walkway. You duck beneath a swinging chain-hoist just as a rusty hook grazes the top of your wooden cradle with a hollow metallic clang. The sudden movement nearly throws you off balance, forcing you to lean hard against the stone wall until the swinging iron settles.

Ahead of you, the passage opens up toward the wet casting floors and the circle of waiting smiths.

nodes.brief: A pair of tired foundry workers lean against a brick pier, sharing a dry crust of bread while staring blankly into the distance.

exits.label: Head toward the great chimney
Step onto the flooded casting floor
Join the circle of waiting forge-masters
Turn back toward the vibrating water-hammer

nodes.title: The Weary Workers
nodes.page:
The smell of stale sweat and wet wool hangs heavy in the stagnant air between the brick support piers. A pair of tired foundry workers lean against a brick pier, sharing a dry crust of bread while staring blankly into the distance. They barely glance up as you pass, too exhausted by the endless shifts and fuel shortages to question an apprentice carrying a sacred bell-tongue.

Beyond them, the foundry paths divide toward the massive chimneys, the flooded pits, and the watchful elders.

nodes.brief: The low, subsonic hum of Orison's bronze clapper grows louder on your back, vibrating in harmony with the massive furnace flues ahead.

exits.label: Walk to the flooded casting floor
Approach the circle of forge-masters

nodes.title: The Humming Bronze
nodes.page:
The air grows noticeably warmer as you draw closer to the heart of the industrial complex, smelling strongly of sulfur and hot iron. Orison's bronze clapper knocks louder on your back, keeping time with the massive furnace flues ahead. Your shoulders ache from the cradle's load, yet the familiar knock feels like a nudge from the mountain temple you left behind.

Two pathways lie ahead, leading either to the flooded casting floor or directly to the waiting forge-masters.

nodes.brief: You round a massive pillar of slag-stone and find your path blocked by a stack of warped iron plates waiting for the scrap-heap.

exits.label: Enter the circle of waiting forge-masters

nodes.title: The Slag-Stone Pillar
nodes.page:
Thick shadows pool between towering walls of discarded masonry and cooling refuse from previous melts. You round a massive pillar of slag-stone and find your path blocked by a stack of warped iron plates waiting for the scrap-heap. You have to squeeze carefully past the jagged metal edges to avoid tearing your woollen pack or scraping the padded cradle holding Orison's tongue.

Beyond the obstruction, the main gathering area of the forge-masters comes into view through the haze.

nodes.brief: Before the roaring maw of the primary crucible, master smith Orren holds out his bare scarred palm for the abbey's token.

exits.label: Heave the cracked clapper into the crucible

nodes.title: The Crucible's Maw
nodes.page:
Heat blasts against your face like a physical wall as you step out of the shadows and onto the raised iron grating. Before the roaring maw of the primary crucible, master smith Orren holds out his bare scarred palm for the abbey's token. Sparks dance in his tired eyes as he looks from your frost-bitten hands to the heavy bronze clapper resting in your wooden cradle, waiting to see if you have brought what is needed to save Orisonhold.

The final moment has arrived, and the glowing metal awaits your command to begin the melting process.

nodes.brief: At the lip of the grand pouring pit, you untie the hempen lashings while the gathered smiths watch in breathless, reverent silence.

exits.label: Tip the sacred tongue into the melting pot

nodes.title: The Grand Pouring Pit
nodes.page: Standing at the absolute lip of the grand pouring pit, you unpick the stiff hempen lashings with cold, trembling fingers while the gathered smiths watch in breathless, reverent silence. The air reeks of sulfur and damp coke after twenty mountain days come to an end. Every eye fixes on the padded cradle as the heavy bronze tongue shifts against its straps, waiting for the final word that will tip it into the waiting fire below.

nodes.brief: Beside the bubbling bronze cauldron, a Cable Court bailiff taps his ledger with a silver pen, demanding immediate toll for the metal's descent.

exits.label: Surrender the sacred tongue to pay the toll debt
Refuse the bailiff and shove the bronze into the fire

nodes.title: The Bailiff's Ledger
nodes.page: Beside the bubbling bronze cauldron, a Cable Court bailiff taps his ledger with a sharp silver pen, demanding immediate toll for the metal's descent down the mountain stairs. Steam rises from the quench-troughs to cloud his spectacles, yet his hand remains outstretched for payment or collateral. The surrounding forge-masters step back into the shadows, leaving you alone to weigh the cost of passage against the integrity of the monastery's bell.

nodes.brief: Under the flickering glare of the safety flare, you balance the heavy clapper on the edge of the hopper, ready to tip it into the fire.

exits.label: Let the sacred metal slide into the white-hot flames
Pull the bronze back and hoist your pack once more

nodes.title: The Safety Flare
nodes.page: Under the flickering, sickly glare of the safety flare, you perch the clapper on the rim of the iron hopper, ready to tip it into the roaring fire. Sparks shower upward from the crucible, catching in your frost-stiffened hair and dying out against your woollen sleeves. The heat is a tangible wall pressing against your chest, urging a swift, irreversible motion before your strength gives out entirely.

nodes.brief: In the shadow of the great chimney, you drop your pack to the flagstones, feeling your spine straighten as twenty days of mountain cold leave your bones.

exits.label: Cast the broken voice straight into the central furnace
Turn away from the heat and carry the tongue back upward
Slip the heavy bronze into the dark drainage sluice

nodes.title: The Great Chimney
nodes.page: In the deep shadow of the great chimney, you drop your leather pack to the soot-blackened flagstones, feeling your spine straighten as twenty days of mountain cold finally leave your aching bones. The foundry hums with the low, subterranean vibration of water-wheels and bellows, drowning out the whistle of the high winds far above. Around you, the low-country air feels thick and rich, smelling of river mud and coal smoke rather than glacier ice.

nodes.brief: Before the central hearth, you unroll the frayed parchment deed of Orisonhold, laying it across a barrel-head for the master's final signature.

exits.label: Hoist the bronze onto your back and leave the forge
Hide the sacred tongue inside the secret drainage channel

nodes.title: The Frayed Deed
nodes.page: Before the roaring central hearth, you unroll the frayed parchment deed of Orisonhold, laying it flat across a damp barrel-head for the master's final signature. The parchment smells of old wax and mountain damp, its edges scorched by the proximity of the open flame. Forge-masters crowd close in the dim light, eager to seal the contract that will bind the mountain's voice to the low-country's forge.

nodes.brief: At the edge of the flooded casting floor, you stand ankle-deep in tepid river run-off, staring up at the gaping throat of the primary furnace.

exits.label: Slide the heavy clapper down into the dark drainage sluice

nodes.title: The Flooded Casting Floor
nodes.page: At the edge of the flooded casting floor, you stand ankle-deep in tepid river run-off, staring up at the gaping throat of the primary furnace as it swallows the shadows. Water laps gently against your boots, carrying small flakes of slag and coal dust from the upper basins. There is no one here to demand tolls or offer contracts, only the steady, unyielding roar of the fire waiting for its fuel.

nodes.brief: Within the circle of waiting forge-masters, you set the heavy bronze tongue down upon a wooden block, letting its low hum die away into the steam.

exits.label: Hoist the heavy cradle back onto your tired shoulders
Push the sacred metal away into the hidden water run-off

nodes.title: The Wooden Block
nodes.page: Within the silent circle of waiting forge-masters, you set the bronze tongue down on a solid wooden block. Its low knock fades into the rising steam. The men look down at the cracked metal with scarred hands resting on their aprons, weighing its worth in tin and tradition. Nobody speaks, leaving the decision entirely in your hands as the steam curls around your knees.

nodes.brief: You heave the cracked clapper straight into the white-hot crucible, letting the bronze melt down so Orison can be reborn without the debts of the mountain.

exits.label: Press on

nodes.title: The White-Hot Crucible
nodes.page: You heave the cracked clapper straight into the white-hot crucible, letting the old bronze melt down instantly so Orison can be reborn without the heavy debts of the mountain. Sparks explode toward the blackened rafters in a brilliant cascade of green and gold, illuminating the astonished faces of the watching smiths. The weight leaves your shoulders entirely, leaving you standing empty-handed in the roaring heat.

nodes.brief: You hand the heavy tongue over to the Cable Court bailiffs as collateral for the toll-debt, watching the sacred bronze vanish into the hands of the valley's lords.

exits.label: Press on

nodes.title: The Valley's Lords
nodes.page: You hand the heavy tongue over to the waiting Cable Court bailiffs as collateral for the extortionate toll-debt, watching the sacred bronze vanish securely into the hands of the valley's lords. The bailiff smiles thinly, sealing the cold metal inside a reinforced crate while the smiths turn their backs in quiet disgust. The debt is settled, but the mountain has lost its voice to the low-country ledger-men.

nodes.brief: You turn your back on the roaring furnace and hoist the clapper back into its wooden cradle, deciding to carry the broken voice back up the stairs before the ice-wind closes the pass.

exits.label: Press on

nodes.title: The Upward Stairs
nodes.page: You turn your back on the roaring furnace and hoist the clapper back into its wooden cradle, deciding to carry the broken voice back up the stone stairs before the ice-wind closes the pass for good. The strap cuts sharply into your bruised shoulder, familiar and grounding as you step away from the warmth of the Lowgate forge. Biscuit lets out a low, approving grunt from the courtyard shadows as you lead the way toward the steep ascent.

nodes.brief: You slide the clapper into the secret drainage sluice to hide it from both the guild and the court, leaving Orisonhold without a bell but keeping its ancient spirit wild.

exits.label: Press on down the mountain track

nodes.title: The Secret Sluice
nodes.page:
Water runs dark and fast through the stone drainage grate beneath the lower forge, smelling of cold mud, old cinders, and melting snow from the high peaks. You slip the heavy bronze tongue from its padded cradle and let it slide downward into the shadows of the sluice, where neither the greedy guild-masters nor the bailiffs of the court will ever fish it out. The monastery-city above will go without its sacred voice for the winter, but the metal remains hidden, wild, and untouched by petty debts.

The rushing current pulls at the edges of the dark tunnel, and you turn your back on the foundry floor to face whatever path remains down the mountain.

nodes.brief: Attempting to leap a swollen drainage canal with the heavy clapper on your back, you slip into the black, freezing silt and lose your grip forever.
nodes.title: The Freezing Silt
nodes.page: Rushing water roars past your ears as you try to leap a swollen drainage canal with the clapper strapped tight on your back. Your boot heel catches on a patch of slick, hidden moss, sending you pitching sideways into the black, freezing silt of the lowgate runoff. The weight of the bronze drags you down instantly into the icy current, pulling you under the dark surface as the hum of the metal fades into the rushing water forever.

nodes.brief: Ignoring all warnings, you hurl yourself and the heavy clapper directly into a sputtering, half-drowned slag-pit, burying the abbey's voice beneath tons of suffocating, grey-hot refuse.
nodes.title: The Slag Pit
nodes.page: Steam rises in blinding, sulfurous white plumes from the churning grey-hot trough where the foundry dumps its worthless waste. You defy every warning shouted by the scarred forge-masters and heave the bronze clapper and yourself straight into the bubbling mire. The thick refuse closes over you with a sucking sigh and buries the abbey's ancient voice deep beneath tons of suffocating, grey-hot slag. There is no climb back from this furnace, only the quiet, final warmth of sinking into the mountain's belly.

nodes.brief: The reader has chosen to recast the great bell for the lowlands: the moment of carrying it out, with the consequences about to fall (do not decide which of the endings it is; the exits do that).

exits.label: The Bell Rings Whole
A True Bell, No Choir
The Cracked Note

nodes.title: The Casting Choice
nodes.page: The heavy bronze tongue is hefted toward the mouth of the roaring furnace while the forge-masters wait for your final word on its fate. Every eye in the crowded workshop watches the scarred metal gleam under the firelight, balancing the ancient needs of the mountain against the practical hunger of the valley below. You hold the decisive thread of the journey in your hands, knowing that whatever path you clear now will shape the songs and silences of Orisonhold for generations to come. The heat washes over your face, dry and fierce as a summer gale.

nodes.brief: The reader has chosen to carry the clapper back up the mountain: the moment of carrying it out, with the consequences about to fall (do not decide which of the endings it is; the exits do that).

exits.label: Biscuit Carries It Home
The Long Way Up

nodes.title: The Upward Turn
nodes.page: You turn your back on the roaring mouth of the furnace and hoist the heavy wooden cradle back onto your aching shoulders. The bronze tongue feels colder now, as if it already longs for the high, thin air and the frost-rimed stones of Orisonhold. The valley folk stare in silence as you step away from the warmth of the forge-fires and toward the long, winding staircase that climbs back into the clouds. There are no debts paid down here today, only the stubborn weight of an unfinished journey and a mountain waiting for its voice.

nodes.brief: The reader has chosen to melt it into ploughshares for the terraces: the moment of carrying it out, with the consequences about to fall (do not decide which of the endings it is; the exits do that).

exits.label: Ploughshares, No Strings
The Song in the Metal
Bronze and Silence

nodes.title: The Ploughshare Choice
nodes.page: The great bronze tongue lies on the anvil while the iron-workers lift their hammers to beat the sacred voice into long flat blades for the barley fields. The Terrace Millers lean against the doorway, watching with hungry, hopeful eyes as the metal prepares to surrender its history to the furrow and the soil. You stand by the hearth, feeling the final weight of the mountain's ancient promises melting away into the spark-lit air. The choice is made to turn bronze into bread, leaving the peaks to their own silence.

nodes.brief: Ending "The Bell Rings Whole": You give the Clapper to the forge-masters to recast the Great Bell for the lowlands: it arrives unmarked, the knot-oath brings the Ropewrights to hang it, and Orison rings true across the mountain.

exits.label: Read on to the final chapter

nodes.title: The Bell Rings Whole
nodes.page:
You hand the Clapper to the master smiths, wrapped in the sacred wool and sealed with the knot-oath you swore beneath the high eaves. The bronze melts down pure and bright in the crucible, running like liquid sunlight into the earthen mold prepared by the entire valley. When the great casting cools and is hoisted into the high belfry by the Ropewrights' Guild, Orison rings out across the mountain with a clean, golden resonance that clears the morning frost from the slate roofs.

Weeks later, the people of Orisonhold and Lowgate gather together in the crisp air to listen to the evening chime, knowing the mountain's heart beats true once more.

nodes.brief: Aftermath of "The Bell Rings Whole": what changes for the people of the mountain and the lowlands, weeks later.

exits.label: The last page

nodes.title: The Valley Reborn
nodes.page:
The old hostility between the cable-lords and the terrace-keepers softens into a quiet, steady peace as the new bell marks the passing hours of the day. You find yourself sitting on the low stone wall outside the gate, watching Biscuit graze peacefully on the green shoots pushing through the melting valley snow. Nobody speaks of the long, freezing stairs or the narrow escapes in the dark, because the sound of Orison overhead tells every traveler all they need to know about the road behind them.

The air is clear, the bells are whole, and every promise made in the high passes has finally found its rest.

nodes.brief: Final page of "The Bell Rings Whole": a closing image and a last line for the book.
nodes.title: The Bell Rings Whole
nodes.page: The sun dips below the western ridge, painting the cloud-line in shades of copper and violet as the evening Angelus begins to toll from the high stone tower. You let your hands fall idle on your knees, feeling the vibration of the bronze pass gently through the stone beneath you and up into the soles of your boots. The world is large and cold, but for the first time in many seasons, every voice in the mountain sings the same note. You close your eyes against the fading light and listen to the bell.

nodes.brief: Ending "A True Bell, No Choir": You give the Clapper to the forge-masters and the bell is recast well, but nobody owes you a favour, and the Ropewrights and the Cable Court both squabble over who may hang it.

exits.label: Read on to see the outcome

nodes.title: A True Bell, No Choir
nodes.page:
The forge-masters take the Clapper and cast the great bell well, but without the seal of an oath or the backing of the guilds, you stand alone in the soot and the shadows. The bronze is sound and the tone is true when it is hauled upward, yet no one comes forward to thank you for the labor or lift the burden from your shoulders. Instead, the Ropewrights and the Cable Court immediately begin to squabble over who holds the privilege of hanging it in the frost-nipped belfry.

Days pass in cold argument. The bronze hangs in the scaffold while the guilds bicker below.

nodes.brief: Aftermath of "A True Bell, No Choir": what changes for the people of the mountain and the lowlands, weeks later.

exits.label: The last page

nodes.title: The Silent Banners
nodes.page:
Winter settles over Orisonhold with a dry, whistling bite, and still the new bell hangs silent in its wooden scaffolding while the guilds trade insults across the courtyard. You watch the dispute from the warmth of the chimney-corner, realizing that a voice made without friends is only half-heard in the wind. The mountain does not care who won the argument, but the people grow tired of waiting for a sound that never quite reaches their hearths.

The snow piles high against the doors, sealing the quarrel away in white silence until the spring thaw promises a new reckoning.

nodes.brief: Final page of "A True Bell, No Choir": a closing image and a last line for the book.
nodes.title: A True Bell, No Choir
nodes.page: The fire in the hearth burns low, casting long, flickering shadows across the rafters as the mountain wind rattles the frozen windowpanes outside. Somewhere up in the grey mists the un-hung bell murmurs, and you wonder if the metal itself regrets coming down the long stairs. There are no grand songs sung for your return, only the steady ticking of the clock and the quiet patience of an apprentice who has learned the cost of walking alone. You pull your wool blanket tighter and let the silence take the room.

nodes.brief: Ending "The Cracked Note": You give the Clapper to the forge-masters, but the bare bronze is chipped from the climb; the recast bell rings with a flaw in its note that the whole mountain learns to love.

exits.label: Step forward to witness the valley's reaction

nodes.title: The Cracked Note
nodes.page:
From the padded leather the bronze slides into Lowgate forge heat; the master presses a scarred thumb to the metal and finds the small, pale nick the glacier stairs left. Sparks spit orange against the soot-caked rafters while the bellows groan like tired lungs, feeding a fire that turns the tongue of Orison into liquid gold. When the recast bronze cools in its sand bed, it carries that ancient scar within its grain, a faint imperfection born of the high winds and the long descent. By the cooling pit, soot on your sleeves and hot slag in your nose, you watch the smiths hoist the core into the sling for the return haul.

Read on, to see how the mountain greets its slightly altered voice.

nodes.brief: Aftermath of "The Cracked Note": what changes for the people of the mountain and the lowlands, weeks later.

exits.label: Turn the page for the closing image

nodes.title: The Cracked Note
nodes.page:
